Porcupine\n\nA porcupine is an animal with sharp spines all over its body. These spines are called quills and they help keep the porcupine safe from other animals that might want to eat it. Porcupines are big and slow, and they come in brown, gray, and white colors. A baby porcupine is called a porcupette, and its quills are soft at first. The quills are like needles and can stick into an attacker. Porcupines live in many places like forests, deserts, and grasslands in Asia, Africa, and America. Some porcupines live in trees, and some live on the ground. They like to eat salty things, so they might chew on wood, tools, or even car tires.
Sculpture\n\nA sculpture is a kind of art that you can see and touch. It is not flat like a drawing. It has height, width, and depth, just like a real person or a toy. People make sculptures out of stone, wood, clay, or metal. Some sculptures are very big and stand outside in parks. Others are small and sit on a table. You can walk all around a sculpture and look at it from every side.
Condensation\n\nCondensation is when a gas turns into a liquid. It happens when the gas touches something cold. For example, when you see water drops on a cold glass, that is condensation. The water in the air turns into little drops on the glass. Condensation is part of how water moves around the Earth. It is the opposite of water turning into gas, which is called evaporation. When gas turns into liquid, it gives off heat.
Manila\n\nManila is a big city and the capital of the Philippines. It sits on a big island called Luzon, next to a bay named Manila Bay. Many people live there, and it has tall buildings and busy streets. Long ago, Spanish people built a walled city called Intramuros, with old stone churches and forts. There is also a big park named Rizal Park, named after a hero. Manila is where many people work, shop, and have fun.
Remote control\n\nA remote control is a small box you hold in your hand. It has buttons you push to tell a TV or other machine what to do. You can change the channel or make the sound louder. The remote control talks to the TV using a special light or radio waves. It needs batteries to work, like AA or coin batteries. There is no wire connecting the remote to the TV.
Nonverbal communication\n\nNonverbal communication is talking without using words. You can show how you feel with your face, like smiling or frowning. You can also use your hands and body, like waving or crossing your arms. Even the way you sit or stand tells others something. Clothes and hairstyles can also send messages. When you hug someone, that is a kind of touch that says something. Animals like dogs and cats use nonverbal communication too, like wagging their tail or purring.
Slavic languages\n\nSlavic languages are a group of languages that people speak in parts of Europe and Asia. Some Slavic languages are Russian, Polish, and Serbian. Some are written with one kind of letters, and some with another. People use these languages to talk, read, and write.
Red-eared slider\n\nA red-eared slider is a kind of turtle that lives in water and on land. It is a very popular pet turtle in the United States. It has a red mark near each ear, which is how it got its name. These turtles live in the southern part of the United States. They can also be found in other places where people have let them go. You should not feed them rhubarb leaves because those are bad for them. Also, do not give them too much food, or they can get sick.
Solar System\n\nThe Solar System is a big group of things in space that all go around the Sun. The Sun is a huge, hot ball of glowing gas that gives us light and warmth. Everything in the Solar System moves around the Sun because the Sun pulls them with its gravity. There are eight big planets in the Solar System. The planets closest to the Sun are Mercury, Venus, Earth, and Mars. They are made of rock. The planets farther away are Jupiter, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune. They are made of gas and ice. Earth is the planet where we live. Some planets have moons that go around them. Saturn and Jupiter have rings made of ice and dust. There are also many smaller things in the Solar System, like asteroids, comets, and meteoroids. Most asteroids are found in a big ring between Mars and Jupiter called the asteroid belt. Comets are made of ice and dust, and when they get close to the Sun, they grow a long, glowing tail. Sometimes a small rock from space falls into Earth's sky and makes a bright streak called a shooting star. The Sun is the biggest and most important part of the Solar System. It is so big that it holds almost all the weight of the whole Solar System. The Sun makes energy by turning one kind of gas into another, and that energy comes to us as light and heat. The Solar System is very old. It started forming a very long time ago, even before the dinosaurs. People have looked at the sky for thousands of years and learned about the planets and stars. Today, we send robots and spaceships to explore the planets and moons.
Mechanical engineering\n\nMechanical engineering is a job where people make and fix machines. These machines can be very big, like a rocket ship, or very small, like a tiny computer part. Mechanical engineers use science to figure out how things move and how to build them strong. They help make cars, toys, and even roller coasters work.
Longitude\n\nLongitude is a way to tell where a place is on Earth. It uses an imaginary line called the Prime Meridian. Longitude says how far east or west a place is from that line. It is measured in degrees, like angles. Long ago, people on boats had a hard time knowing their longitude. Better clocks helped them figure it out. Lines of longitude are close together at the North and South Poles and far apart at the middle of the Earth.
Cubism\n\nCubism is a way of making art that shows a person or thing from many sides all at once. The pictures look like they are made from cubes and other shapes. Two artists named Pablo Picasso and Georges Braque started Cubism a long time ago. At first, they used only one color so people would look at the shapes. Later, Picasso began to use many colors and also glued pieces of paper onto his art. That is called collage. Cubism was a new and different way to draw and paint.
Antbird\n\nAntbirds are small birds that live in warm forests in Central and South America. They have round wings, strong legs, and heavy bills that are often hooked at the tip. Most antbirds are gray, white, brown, or reddish. The mommy and daddy birds look a little different from each other. Some antbirds have white patches on their backs that they show to warn other birds. Antbirds eat bugs and other small creatures. About eighteen kinds of antbirds follow army ants to catch the bugs that run away from the ants. Mommy and daddy antbirds stay together for life. They build a nest and lay two eggs. Both parents take turns keeping the eggs warm and feeding the babies. When the babies leave the nest, each parent takes care of one baby. Some antbirds are in danger because people cut down the forests where they live.
Rhine River\n\nThe Rhine River is a very long river in Europe. It starts in a lake in Switzerland and flows through Germany and the Netherlands to the sea. The river is so big that big boats can travel on it to carry things. Many cities are built along the Rhine, like Cologne and Bonn. The river has fish, but long ago factories put dirty water in it and many fish died. Now people are cleaning the river so fish can come back. Some parts of the Rhine have old castles on the hills next to it.
Guava\n\nGuava is a fruit that grows on small trees in warm places. It comes from Mexico, the Caribbean, Central America, and South America. Now people grow guavas in many hot countries. Guavas are a kind of berry. The most common guava is the apple guava. Red guavas are called maroon guava. Guavas have a lot of vitamin C, even more than oranges.
Amaranth\n\nAmaranth is a plant that grows in many places around the world. It has pretty flowers that can be purple, red, or gold. Some amaranth plants are weeds, but people also eat the leaves and seeds. The seeds can be cooked like rice or ground into flour.
Kelp\n\nKelp is a kind of seaweed that grows in the ocean. It is brown and looks like long, wavy leaves. Kelp grows very fast, sometimes as much as 30 centimeters in one day. Some kelp can be as long as 60 meters, which is longer than a big bus. Kelp has little air pockets that help it float near the top of the water. Many fish and other sea animals live in kelp forests and eat kelp for food. People also eat kelp as a vegetable. You can see kelp in some aquariums, like the big one in Monterey.
Information\n\nInformation is something you can learn or know about. A book or a newspaper has information about the world. When you use a computer, information is like facts that have been checked and are true. People can trust information that has been checked. Long ago, people started using computers to store information. Now we live in a time when there is a lot of information all around us.
Cerebellum\n\nThe cerebellum is a part of your brain. It helps you keep your balance so you do not fall down. It also helps your arms and legs move the way you want them to. When you walk, run, or catch a ball, your cerebellum is working. It takes messages from your eyes, ears, and muscles to help you move smoothly.
Jamaica\n\nJamaica is an island country in the Caribbean Sea. It is a warm place with beaches and mountains. The capital city is Kingston. Many people in Jamaica speak English. Jamaica is famous for reggae music and the singer Bob Marley. The runner Usain Bolt, who is very fast, comes from Jamaica. The island has a long history. Long ago, the Taino people lived there. Then Spain ruled the island, and later England took over. Jamaica became its own country in 1962. Today, the king of England is also the king of Jamaica, but the people vote for their own leaders.
Yangtze River\n\nThe Yangtze River is a very long river in China. It is the longest river in China and the third longest in the whole world. The river starts high up in the mountains in western China and flows all the way to the ocean. Many boats travel on the Yangtze River every day. A big dam called the Three Gorges Dam sits on the river. It is the biggest dam in the world. The river is home to special animals like the finless porpoise. But the river is getting very dirty. People throw trash and waste into the water, which is bad for the animals and the river.
Motorcycle\n\nA motorcycle is a vehicle with two wheels and a motor. It can go fast and carry one or two people. Some motorcycles have a sidecar for an extra passenger. Motorcycles are faster than bicycles and can be faster than cars. Riders must wear a helmet and special clothes to stay safe. In poor countries, many people use motorcycles because they cost less than cars. In rich countries, people ride motorcycles for fun and sport.
Toronto\n\nToronto is a big city in Canada. It is the capital of a part of Canada called Ontario. Many people live there, more than in any other Canadian city. Toronto is next to a big lake called Lake Ontario. You can see a very tall tower there called the CN Tower. People from all over the world live in Toronto, so there are many different foods and festivals. There are sports teams like the Toronto Maple Leafs for hockey and the Toronto Raptors for basketball. You can also visit museums, a zoo, and a big amusement park called Canada's Wonderland.
Passerine\n\nA passerine is a kind of bird that can perch on branches. Most passerines are small and can sing very well. They are also called songbirds. There are many, many kinds of passerines all over the world. They live in trees and bushes and make nests. Some passerines are tiny, like a sparrow, and some are a little bigger, like a robin. They have special feet that help them hold onto twigs. Baby passerines hatch from eggs and learn to sing from their parents.
Website\n\nA website is a place on the internet where you can see pages with words and pictures. You look at websites on a computer, a phone, or a TV. The pages are kept on big computers called web servers. Most websites have a home page that is like the front door. You can click on links to go to other pages. Some websites sell things, some let you talk to friends, and some help you learn new things. A blog is a kind of website where people write about what they think. To go to a website, you type its address into the web browser. The address often starts with 'www' and ends with something like '.com' or '.org'. Websites can look different, but they are all made with special code that tells the computer how to show them.
Senegal\n\nSenegal is a country in West Africa. The capital city is Dakar. Many people live there, about 18 million. The weather is warm, with a dry season and a rainy season. People in Senegal grow peanuts, sugarcane, cotton, and fruits like mangoes. They also catch fish. French is the main language people speak. The country has a big river called the Senegal River. Another country called The Gambia is inside Senegal. Senegal used to be ruled by France, but now it is its own country.
Economy\n\nAn economy is how people make, share, and use things. People make things like toys and food. People also do things for each other, like fixing a car or cutting hair. To get things, people use money. Money helps people trade without swapping one thing for another. The word 'economy' comes from a very old word that means 'someone who takes care of the house.'
Angel Falls\n\nAngel Falls is the tallest waterfall in the world. It is in a country called Venezuela. The water falls from a very high mountain called Auyantepui. The drop is so long that the water turns into mist before it hits the ground. The waterfall is named after a pilot named Jimmy Angel, who crashed his airplane near the top of the falls a long time ago.
Baba Yaga\n\nBaba Yaga is a make-believe old woman from stories in a part of the world called Slavic countries. She looks like a scary, ugly woman. Her house is very strange because it has giant chicken feet and can walk around. Sometimes she flies through the air in a big bowl that moves by magic. In stories, Baba Yaga can be mean and try to eat people, but sometimes she helps the good person in the story. She is like nature: she can help you or hurt you. You can find Baba Yaga in some video games and funny advice columns.
Shoebill\n\nA shoebill is a very tall bird with a big beak that looks like a shoe. It lives in wet, marshy places in East Africa, like in Sudan, Uganda, and Zambia. The shoebill is mostly gray with a whitish belly. Its beak is straw-colored with black marks and has a hook at the end to catch fish. It eats fish like lungfish and catfish, and sometimes even baby crocodiles. The shoebill is usually quiet, but it can make sounds like a cow's "moo" or a high-pitched "beeeeh." It likes to live alone and keeps its nest away from other shoebills. There are not many shoebills left in the world, so people are trying to protect them.
Jungle\n\nA jungle is a place in a rainforest where many plants grow close together. It is very hard to walk through because there are so many trees and bushes. Jungles have lots of rivers and streams. More kinds of animals and plants live in jungles than anywhere else on Earth. Some jungles are in the Amazon, which is a big forest in South America. In the jungle, there are snakes like the Green Anaconda. These snakes eat animals like rodents, monkeys, birds, frogs, fish, and even deer.
Echidna\n\nAn echidna is an animal that lives in Australia and New Guinea. It has a long, tube-like mouth and a sticky tongue. Its body is covered in sharp spines. When it is scared, it digs a hole with its long claws and hides so only its spines stick out. That way, other animals cannot hurt it. If there is a fire, it digs deep into the ground to stay safe. The echidna eats ants and termites. It picks them up with its sticky tongue. A baby echidna hatches from an egg.
Hand\n\nA hand is the part of your body at the end of your arm. Most people have two hands. Each hand has four fingers and a thumb. The inside of your hand is called the palm. Your hand has many bones inside, even in your wrist. When you bend all your fingers tight, you make a fist. Your hand can hold things like toys and spoons. Some animals also have hands, but human hands can do special things.
Emerald\n\nAn emerald is a green stone that people find in the ground. It is a kind of crystal that looks bright green. Some people wear emeralds as jewelry, like rings or necklaces. The emerald is a very special and expensive stone. If your birthday is in May, the emerald is your birthstone.
Pony\n\nA pony is a small horse. Ponies have short legs and a chubby body. They are not the same as miniature horses, which look like tiny horses with longer legs. Ponies live on farms and eat grass. A baby pony is called a foal. Some well-known pony breeds are Shetland ponies.
Willow\n\nA willow is a tree or a bush that grows near wet ground. It has long, bendy branches that can be soft and easy to move. The wood is tough but not hard. Willow roots are very strong and hard to kill. In early spring, before the leaves come out, the willow grows fuzzy little flowers called catkins. Some willows are very small, and some grow very tall. You can find willows in cool, wet places in the north part of the world.
Podcasting\n\nPodcasting is a way to share stories and news using sound. People make audio shows that you can listen to on a computer or a small music player. You can find podcasts about almost anything, like funny stories, learning new things, or your favorite TV shows. Many people like to listen to podcasts while they play or travel. Anyone can make a podcast and share what they know with others.
Map\n\nA map is a picture of a place. It shows where things are, like streets, parks, and houses. Long ago, maps were drawn on paper. Today, you can see maps on a phone or a computer. A map helps you find your way. A globe is a round map that looks like a little Earth.
Helsinki\n\nHelsinki is a big city in Finland. It is the capital city, which means the most important city in the country. Helsinki is in the south of Finland, near the sea. The city has many islands and bays. Some islands have a zoo and a big fortress. People can take boats to other cities like Tallinn and Stockholm. There is also an airport in a nearby town called Vantaa. Many people live in Helsinki and the towns around it.
Fandom\n\nA fandom is a group of people who really like the same thing. They might like a sports team, a book, a movie, or a singer. People in a fandom talk about what they like and share it with each other. Being in a fandom is fun because you can make friends who like the same things you do.
Djibouti\n\nDjibouti is a country in Africa, on the east coast. The capital city is also called Djibouti. It is a hot and dry place with deserts and mountains. Many people live there, mostly Somali and Afar. They speak Somali, Afar, Arabic, and French. Most people in Djibouti are Muslim. The country is near the Red Sea, so ships pass by. Soccer is the most popular sport there.
Monster\n\nA monster is a made-up creature in stories. Monsters are often big, ugly, and scary. They can look like many different things, such as a dragon, a ghost, or a giant. Some monsters try to scare people or eat them. But not all monsters are bad. Some monsters are nice and help people. You can find monsters in books, movies, and pretend games.
Mayan civilization\n\nThe Maya civilization was a group of people who lived a long time ago in Central America. They built big stone cities and tall pyramids. The Maya grew food like corn, beans, and peppers. They had a written language and made calendars by watching the stars. They traded things like salt, shells, and jade with other people. After many years, the Maya cities in the south were left empty. No one knows exactly why. But Maya people still live in the same area today. They speak old Maya languages and keep many old traditions.
Vampire\n\nA vampire is a make-believe creature in stories. Vampires used to be people, but now they are not alive like us. In many stories, vampires drink blood to stay strong. They bite people on the neck with two long, sharp teeth. Some vampires can turn into bats or wolves. People tell stories about vampires in books and movies. The most famous vampire is Dracula. In stories, garlic can keep vampires away. But vampires are not real. There is a real animal called a vampire bat that drinks blood from other animals.
Wood\n\nWood comes from trees. It is the hard part inside a tree that keeps it standing up tall. Wood has rings inside that show how old the tree is. People use wood to make many things. They build houses, chairs, tables, and beds out of wood. Wood can also be burned for heat and to cook food. Paper is made from tiny bits of wood. Some wood is light in color, and some is dark. Hard wood like oak and maple is strong. Soft wood like pine is easier to cut. A person who cuts down trees for wood is called a lumberjack. Wood can be painted or covered with clear shiny paint to keep it nice.
Ant\n\nAn ant is a very small insect. Ants live together in big groups called colonies. A colony has a queen ant that lays eggs. Worker ants find food and dig tunnels. Soldier ants fight to protect the colony. Ants are very strong and can carry things much heavier than themselves. They live almost everywhere on Earth except in very cold places like Antarctica. Ants cannot live alone for long because they need to work together.
Boston\n\nBoston is a big city in the United States. It is in a state called Massachusetts. Boston is one of the oldest cities in the country. A long time ago, people from England came to live there. They started the first public school and the first university in America. Boston is famous for the American Revolution, when people fought to be free from England. You can see old places like Faneuil Hall and the Freedom Trail. Today, Boston has many schools and hospitals. People there love sports. The Red Sox play baseball at Fenway Park. The Celtics play basketball, and the Bruins play hockey. Many people from other countries live in Boston, especially from Ireland and Italy. The city has a big airport called Logan Airport. Boston is also near the ocean.
Floor\n\nA floor is the flat part inside a building that you walk on. Floors can be made of wood, stone, or other hard things. Sometimes people put soft carpets on the floor. The word "floor" also means the different levels of a building. In some countries, the bottom level is called the first floor, and in others it is called the ground floor. Gymnasts also do tricks on a special floor.
Trust (social science)\n\nTrust is a feeling you have when you know someone will be good and do what they say. It is like being sure about something, even if you cannot see it. When you trust your mom, you know she will take care of you. When you trust your friend, you know they will share their toys. But trusting someone without thinking can be tricky. Sometimes people break your trust, and that feels sad. The opposite of trust is mistrust, which means you do not feel sure about someone.
Horned lizard\n\nA horned lizard is a small animal that lives in hot, dry places in North America. It has sharp scales and horns on its head to keep it safe. When it is scared, it can shoot blood from its eyes to scare away animals that want to eat it. It mostly eats ants and other bugs. The mother horned lizard lays her eggs in a hole in the ground.
Guinea pig\n\nA guinea pig is a small animal with fur. It is not a pig and it does not come from Guinea. People keep guinea pigs as pets in many parts of the world. They like to live with at least one other guinea pig because they are friendly animals. Guinea pigs need a big cage with soft bedding. They eat hay, fresh vegetables, and special food pellets. They also like to be held gently in your hands. Some people in South America raise guinea pigs for food. The word "guinea pig" can also mean a person who tries something new first.
Tarantula\n\nA tarantula is a very big spider with lots of hair on its body. There are many kinds of tarantulas all over the world. They live in warm places. Some tarantulas hunt for food up in trees, and some hunt on the ground. All tarantulas can make silk, which is like a thin thread. They use the silk to make a safe home in a tree or in a hole in the ground. When a tarantula catches a bug to eat, it wraps the bug up in silk first. Big snakes and a special kind of wasp like to eat tarantulas. Tarantulas hide to stay safe, and they have sharp fangs to bite.
Internet meme\n\nAn internet meme is a funny picture, video, or saying that people share on the computer. It starts with one person and then many people copy it and change it a little bit. You might see a meme of a cat doing something silly or a funny face. People send memes to their friends to make them laugh.
Jaipur\n\nJaipur is a big city in India. It is the capital of a place called Rajasthan. Many people live there. The city was built a long time ago by a king. He wanted a new city because the old one did not have enough water. Jaipur has schools, roads, and places where people make things. It is also a place where people come to see old buildings and learn about history.
Couch\n\nA couch is a big, soft piece of furniture that more than one person can sit on. It has a place to rest your arm on each side. You usually find a couch in the living room, often in front of the TV. Some couches are small for two people, and some are big for more. A person who sits on the couch a lot and does not move much is called a "couch potato." Couches are soft and comfortable to sit on.
Brunei\n\nBrunei is a small country in Southeast Asia. It is on the island of Borneo, next to Malaysia. The capital is Bandar Seri Begawan. The leader is called the Sultan, and he is very rich because Brunei sells oil. Most people in Brunei follow the religion of Islam. Some people also follow Buddhism or Animism. The people speak Malay and English. Brunei is one of the smallest Muslim countries in the world.
Macaque\n\nA macaque is a kind of monkey that lives in Africa and Asia. Some macaques even live in a place called Gibraltar. Macaques have a group where some monkeys are the boss. If a lower monkey has berries, a higher monkey can take them away. In 2014, a macaque took a man's camera and took a picture of itself. The picture was put on the internet for everyone to see.
Parachute\n\nA parachute is a big piece of fabric that looks like an upside-down umbrella. It helps people float slowly down from the sky so they land safely. People use parachutes when they jump out of airplanes. This is called skydiving. Soldiers who jump with parachutes are called paratroopers. A parachute has a backpack that holds the fabric, and straps that go around the jumper's body. When the jumper pulls a small parachute called a pilot chute, it pulls the big parachute out and fills it with air. Most parachutes have two parachutes: a main one and a spare one in case something goes wrong. The spare parachute has saved many lives. Parachutes must be folded carefully so they open the right way.
Artificial island\n\nAn artificial island is a piece of land that people build in the water. It is not made by nature. People make these islands by piling up sand, rocks, or dirt until the land sticks out of the water. Some artificial islands are very big, and some are small. People build them for many reasons, like making a place for houses or parks. A country that builds an artificial island near its coast gets to keep it as part of that country.
Hunger\n\nHunger is the feeling when your body wants food. After you play or run around, you might feel hungry. When you eat, the hungry feeling goes away. People can live for many days without food, but they need water to stay alive. Some people do not have enough food and feel hungry a lot. That is called hunger too.
Trial\n\nA trial is when two people or two groups argue in a special room called a court. One side says the other side did something wrong. A judge sits at the front and makes sure everyone follows the rules. Sometimes, a group of people called a jury listens and decides who is right. If someone is found to have done something wrong, the judge decides what happens next, like paying money or going to a special place called prison. Trials can be short or take a very long time.
White blood cell\n\nWhite blood cells are tiny helpers inside your body that fight germs and keep you from getting sick. When you have a cold or a cut, your body makes more white blood cells to help you get better. There are different kinds of white blood cells. Some eat the germs, some make special stickers called antibodies that stick to germs, and some kill sick cells. When you are healthy, the number of white blood cells goes back down. A doctor can take a little bit of your blood to count how many white blood cells you have.
Palace\n\nA palace is a very big and fancy building. A king or queen might live there. Some palaces are very old and now people can visit them to see how kings and queens used to live. A palace can also be a big building where people go for shows or parties. The word "palace" comes from a hill in Rome where Roman leaders lived long ago. Palaces are different from castles because castles were built to be safe from enemies. Some palaces have many rooms and are made of beautiful wood or stone. They often have big gardens around them.
Istanbul\n\nIstanbul is a very big city in a country called Turkey. It is special because it sits in two parts of the world at the same time: one part is in Europe and the other part is in Asia. A big water called the Bosporus runs through the middle of the city and separates the two sides. Many people live in Istanbul, more than in most other cities in Europe. The city has a very old history. Long ago it was called Constantinople, and it was the capital of a big empire called the Ottoman Empire. Today, many people from other places come to visit Istanbul every year. Some parts of the city are so old and important that they are protected as a World Heritage Site.
Nutmeg\n\nNutmeg is a spice that comes from a tree. The tree is green all year and grows in warm, wet places like Southeast Asia and Australia. People dry the seed of the nutmeg tree and grind it into a powder. The powder smells sweet and warm. Some people put nutmeg in cakes, cookies, and warm drinks. But too much nutmeg can make you sick, and some people are allergic to it.
Titan (moon)\n\nTitan is a big moon that goes around Saturn. It is the only moon in our whole solar system that has air around it. The air is very thick, but people cannot breathe it because it is too cold and has poison in it. The air is made of nitrogen and methane. Titan has lakes and liquid on its surface, just like Earth, but the liquid is methane, not water. Titan is bigger than the planet Mercury, but it is lighter. A spacecraft called Cassini-Huygens visited Titan and took pictures of its lakes. Titan takes about 16 days to go all the way around Saturn.
Natural resource\n\nA natural resource is something people take from nature to use. Air, water, wood, oil, and sunlight are natural resources. Some natural resources, like sunlight and wind, never run out. Other natural resources, like oil and coal, will run out one day. People need natural resources to live. When people do not have clean water, they can get sick. People try to save natural resources so there is enough for everyone.
Dairy product\n\nDairy products are foods made from animal milk. Most dairy comes from cows, but some comes from goats and other animals. Milk, cheese, butter, yogurt, and ice cream are all dairy products. They are good for your bones and help you grow strong.
Management\n\nManagement is about telling a group of people what to do so they can finish a job together. The people who do this are called managers. They help decide how to use things like money, tools, and time to get work done. Managers also help people work as a team.
Yahweh\n\nYahweh is a name for God that people used a long, long time ago in a place called Israel. Long ago, people thought there were many gods, and Yahweh was one of them. Later, people started to believe that Yahweh was the only God. They told stories about Yahweh making the land grow food and helping them in fights. Today, many people still use the name Yahweh when they talk about God.
Sink\n\nA sink is a place where you wash your hands, face, and dishes. You can find sinks in kitchens and bathrooms. A sink has a bowl that holds water, one or two taps that water comes out of, and a drain that lets the water go away. Some sinks have a spray to clean things faster, and some have a soap holder.
Giraffe\n\nA giraffe is a very tall animal that lives in Africa. It has a very long neck and long legs, and it is the tallest land animal on Earth. Giraffes have a long black tongue that they use to pull leaves off tall trees. Their fur is light yellow or tan with brown patches, and no two giraffes have the same pattern. Both boy and girl giraffes have small horn-like bumps on their heads called ossicones. Giraffes live on the grassy savannah or in light woodland, not in thick forests. They eat mostly leaves from tall trees and can go without water for weeks. A baby giraffe is called a calf, and it is already 2 meters tall when it is born. Giraffes can live up to 25 years in the wild.
Month\n\nA month is a long time, like a big piece of a year. There are 12 months in one year. Each month is about as long as it takes the moon to go around the Earth. Some months have 30 days, some have 31, and February has 28 or 29 days. We use months to know when things happen, like birthdays and holidays.
Medicine\n\nMedicine is how doctors help people who are sick or hurt. Doctors learn many things to keep people healthy. They give medicine to stop sickness and fix broken bones. Some doctors help children, and some help with hearts or skin. Nurses also help doctors take care of people. When you go to the doctor, they check your body and make sure you are okay.
Spinal cord\n\nThe spinal cord is a long bundle of nerves inside your back. It is like a soft tube that carries messages between your brain and the rest of your body. The bones of your spine keep it safe. When you touch something hot, the spinal cord tells your brain, and your brain tells your hand to pull away. It also helps you move your arms and legs.
Handball\n\nHandball is a game where two teams try to throw a ball into the other team's goal. Each team has seven players, including one goalie. Players use their hands to pass and bounce the ball. The game lasts one hour, with two parts of 30 minutes each. The playing area is a big rectangle, a little bigger than a basketball court. Only the goalie can stand in a special area near the goal. If a player breaks the rules, they have to sit out for a while.
Bow (weapon)\n\nA bow is a tool that shoots arrows. It is made of a long curved stick with a string tied to both ends. Long ago, people used bows to hunt animals and in wars. Today, people use bows for sport. A person who uses a bow is called an archer. To shoot, you put an arrow on the string, pull the string back, and let go. The string throws the arrow forward. Some bows are made of wood, and some are made of plastic.
Housefly\n\nA housefly is a small bug that lives near people. You often see it inside houses. It has two wings and six legs. Houseflies like to land on food and garbage. They can make people sick, so it is not good to let them touch your food. A mother fly lays many tiny eggs. The eggs turn into little white worms called maggots. Maggots eat old food and dead things. Then they turn into hard brown cases. After a few days, a new fly comes out. Adult flies live for a few weeks.
Architecture\n\nArchitecture is the job of designing buildings and other structures like houses, churches, bridges, and tunnels. People who do this job are called architects. They use art and science to make buildings that are strong and look nice. Long ago, people built simple huts to stay safe from the weather. Later, the Ancient Egyptians made big temples and pyramids. The Greeks and Romans made buildings that were very balanced and pretty. In the Middle Ages, people built tall churches with pointy windows and arches. Today, architects use steel and glass to build very tall buildings called skyscrapers. Some famous architects are Frank Lloyd Wright and Norman Foster.
Brown dwarf\n\nA brown dwarf is an object in space that is made of the same stuff as stars, but it is not big enough to shine like a star. Stars shine because they smash tiny bits inside them together to make heat and light. Brown dwarfs are too small to do that, so they only give off a very dim glow. They are bigger than the biggest planets, but smaller than the smallest stars. Even though they are called brown, they would look pinkish or purple to our eyes. The first brown dwarf was found in 1994. Since then, scientists have found many more. Some brown dwarfs are very close to Earth, but they are hard to see because they are so dim.
Electricity generation\n\nElectricity generation is how people make electricity. Most electricity comes from big machines called generators. These machines are turned by engines that use different kinds of power. Some power comes from burning coal, gas, or oil. Some comes from the sun, wind, or water. The electricity then travels along wires to homes and schools. People use it to turn on lights, run computers, and power toys. Making electricity can sometimes hurt the environment, so people are trying to use cleaner ways like solar panels and wind turbines.
Power (physics)\n\nPower is how fast work is done. It tells how quickly energy moves from one thing to another. A bright light bulb uses more power than a dim one. A kettle uses a lot of power to boil water. A car uses even more power to go fast. Power is measured in watts. One watt is one unit of energy used every second. If you lift a heavy toy slowly, you use less power. If you lift it fast, you use more power.
Polar bear\n\nA polar bear is a big white bear that lives in the cold Arctic. It has black skin under its white fur. The fur keeps it warm. Polar bears are strong and can run fast for a short time. They can swim very well. They eat seals, fish, and other animals. They wait at holes in the ice to catch seals. Polar bears live alone. Baby polar bears are called cubs. They are born very small and drink their mother's milk. The mother protects them and teaches them to hunt. After two years, the cubs leave to live on their own. Polar bears can live up to 30 years in the wild.
Steam engine\n\nA steam engine is a machine that uses steam from hot water to move. The steam pushes parts inside the engine to make them go. Long ago, people used steam engines to run trains, boats, and factory machines. The steam is made in a big pot called a boiler. Fire heats the boiler to turn water into steam. The steam pushes a part called a piston back and forth. That motion can turn wheels or pump water. Today, some power plants still use steam to make electricity.
Bovid\n\nA bovid is an animal with hooves that are split into two toes. Cows, goats, sheep, and antelopes are all bovids. They live in many places around the world, but not in South America, Australia, or Antarctica. Bovid animals eat grass and plants. They have a special stomach that helps them digest their food very well. Some bovids, like cows and sheep, live on farms and give us milk and wool.
Elijah\n\nElijah is a person from a very old book called the Bible. He was a special helper of God. He told people what God wanted them to know. One time, Elijah told a king that it would not rain for a long time. Then God sent birds to bring Elijah food. Elijah also helped a woman who had almost no food. He told her to make him a small cake first, and then her flour and oil did not run out until the rain came. When her son got very sick and stopped breathing, Elijah prayed to God, and the boy came back to life. Another time, Elijah had a contest with many false prophets. They called to their god, but nothing happened. Then Elijah prayed to God, and fire came down from the sky and burned up his offering. After that, the people knew that God is real. At the end of his life, Elijah went up to heaven in a strong wind.
Piano\n\nA piano is a big musical instrument with black and white keys. When you press a key, a little hammer inside hits a string and makes a sound. The piano can play loud or soft sounds. It has pedals at the bottom that you push with your feet to change the sound. People play the piano by sitting on a bench and pressing the keys with their fingers. Many songs are written for the piano, and lots of people like to listen to it.
Koi\n\nA koi is a fish that lives in outdoor ponds. Koi can be many colors like white, black, red, yellow, blue, and cream. They have patterns and scales on their bodies. People keep koi in water gardens because they are pretty to look at. In some places, like Queensland in Australia, it is not allowed to have koi because they can cause problems for other animals.
Fact\n\nA fact is something that is true and real. It is something that has really happened or is really there. You can check a fact to see if it is true. For example, if you ask "what color is this?" and someone says "red," that is a fact if the thing is really red. A fact is different from an opinion. An opinion is what someone thinks or feels. But you can have facts about opinions, like "Alice said she likes the book." That is a fact about what Alice said. Scientists find facts by looking very carefully and doing tests. A fact can be something simple, like "the sky is blue," or something big, like "the Earth goes around the Sun."
Migraine\n\nA migraine is a kind of headache that hurts a lot on one side of the head. The pain feels like a pounding or throbbing. It can be so bad that a person cannot do anything. Some people also feel sick to their stomach or dizzy. Bright lights and loud noises can make it worse. Some people see funny patterns or have blurry eyes before the headache starts. A migraine can last from four hours to three days. Sleeping often helps it go away. More girls than boys get migraines when they grow up. If someone in your family has migraines, you might get them too.
Blue whale\n\nA blue whale is the biggest animal that has ever lived on Earth, even bigger than the biggest dinosaurs. It lives in the ocean and is a mammal, which means it breathes air like you do. A blue whale can be very, very long, as long as two school buses. Its body is long and skinny, and it is blue-gray on top and lighter underneath. Blue whales eat tiny little animals called krill, which look like very small shrimp. They eat a lot of krill every day. Long ago, many people hunted blue whales, but now they are protected, so there are not as many as before. You can see them in some oceans, like near Canada.
Deity\n\nA deity is a very powerful spirit that people believe in. Deities are also called gods. A female god is often called a goddess. Different religions have different ideas about deities. Some religions believe in many gods. The two biggest religions in the world believe in only one God. Most people think deities cannot die and have powers much bigger than people have.
South China Sea\n\nThe South China Sea is a big area of ocean near China. Many countries use this sea for boats and fishing. The water is warm and blue. There are many small islands in the sea. Some islands have people living on them, but most are too small for people. Different countries say the islands and water belong to them.
Herb\n\nAn herb is a plant that people use for food, to make medicine, or for its nice smell. Herbs have soft stems when they are young. Some herbs grow back every year, and some live for only one year. People put herbs in food to make it taste good. Some herbs smell nice and are used in perfumes. Others help people feel better when they are sick. You can grow herbs in a garden or in a pot near a sunny window.
Color blindness\n\nColor blindness is when a person cannot tell the difference between some colors. Most of the time, it is something you are born with. Boys get it more often than girls. Some people cannot see red and green. A few people can only see black, white, and gray. There is no medicine to fix it. But color blind people can be good at seeing through camouflage. Doctors use special pictures with dots to test for color blindness.
Lime\n\nA lime is a small, round, green fruit. It is a citrus fruit, just like a lemon. Limes grow on trees. They taste sour and a little bitter. People use lime juice in drinks and cooking. Limes have vitamin C, which helps keep you healthy. Long ago, sailors ate limes so they would not get sick on their long trips.
Chain\n\nA chain is like a rope, but it is made of many small rings called links. The links are joined together one after another. You can pull a chain, and it can hold things. Some chains are made of metal, and some are made of plastic. You might see a chain on a swing or on a necklace.
France\n\nFrance is a country in Europe. It is shaped like a hexagon, which is a shape with six sides. France is next to Belgium, Germany, Italy, Spain, and other countries. The capital city is Paris. Many people visit France every year because it has famous places like the Eiffel Tower. The language people speak in France is French. France has mountains called the Alps and the Pyrenees. There are also big rivers like the Seine and the Loire. The weather is different in different parts of France. In the north and west, it is often cool and rainy. In the south, summers are hot and dry, and winters are cool and wet. France is known for its food like bread, cheese, and pastries. The flag of France has three stripes: blue, white, and red.
Wage\n\nA wage is money that someone gets for doing work. When you work for a boss, the boss pays you a wage. Some people get paid for each hour they work. Others get paid for each thing they make. A wage is different from a salary, which is the same amount every week or month. Many countries have a rule that bosses must pay at least a certain amount of money. This is called the minimum wage. It helps make sure workers get enough money for their work.
Electronic dance music\n\nElectronic dance music is music made with computers and machines that you can dance to. People play this music at parties and clubs. DJs use special tools like keyboards and drum machines to make the music. It has a fast beat that makes you want to move your body. There are many kinds of electronic dance music, like house and techno. Some songs from a long time ago helped make this music popular.
Gel\n\nA gel is a wobbly, squishy stuff that is not quite solid and not quite liquid. It feels soft and jiggly when you touch it. Jelly is a kind of gel that you can eat. Some gels are used to make things like contact lenses and slime.
Aconcagua\n\nAconcagua is a very tall mountain in South America. It is the highest mountain in the Americas. It is in a country called Argentina, in a place called the Andes. The top of Aconcagua is very high up, higher than any other mountain in North or South America. Some people try to climb it, but it can be dangerous because of the cold wind and the thin air. Many people have tried to reach the top, and some have gotten hurt or died. That is why climbers must be very careful and prepared.
Rocky Mountains\n\nThe Rocky Mountains are a very long line of tall mountains in the western part of the United States and Canada. They are also called the Rockies. These mountains are very old, but they were made when the ground pushed up a long time ago. The highest part is called Mount Elbert. Some of the Rocky Mountains are in a special park where people can visit and see the big peaks and deep valleys. The mountains have hard rocks inside them that were made even before the mountains grew up.
Fuse\n\nA fuse is a little part that helps keep things safe. When too much electricity tries to go through a wire, the fuse gets hot and breaks. This stops the electricity so nothing gets hurt. After the fuse breaks, you have to put a new one in. Some fuses break fast, and some take a tiny bit longer.
Lumber\n\nLumber is wood that has been cut into flat pieces for building things like houses and furniture. People use big saws to cut trees into boards of different sizes. Some boards are called two-by-fours, which means they are about two inches thick and four inches wide. Lumber can be long or short, and it comes in many lengths like eight feet or twelve feet. Builders use lumber to make walls, floors, and roofs.
Wildfire\n\nA wildfire is a big fire that burns in forests, grasslands, or other places with many plants. Wildfires happen on every continent except Antarctica. Some start by themselves from lightning or heat, but many are started by people by accident or on purpose. Wildfires can burn houses and hurt people, but they also help some plants. Some trees, like Sequoia, need fire to open their cones and let new seeds grow. Other plants have thick bark or oily leaves that help them survive fire. After a fire, new plants can grow from seeds that waited in the ground.
Lake Michigan\n\nLake Michigan is a very big lake in North America. It is one of the five Great Lakes. The lake is so big that it is the fifth largest lake in the whole world. Four states in the United States touch Lake Michigan: Indiana, Illinois, Wisconsin, and Michigan. The biggest city on the lake is Chicago. A long time ago, people called the lake "mishigami," which means "great water." Many people live near the lake, mostly in Chicago and Milwaukee.
Marketing\n\nMarketing is how people tell others about things they can buy. It helps connect the people who make things with the people who want them. People who do marketing find out what others like and want. Then they show those things in ads or stores so people know about them.
Pottery\n\nPottery is a thing made from wet clay that gets baked in a very hot oven called a kiln. The baking makes the clay hard and strong. Sometimes the potter puts a shiny coat called glaze on it to make it smooth and waterproof. People have made pottery for a very long time, even before farms and cities. The oldest pottery we know about is a little statue from a long time ago. People use pottery to make bowls, cups, and plates for eating and drinking. Some pottery is just for looking at, like art. A place where pottery is made is also called a pottery.
Cedar\n\nA cedar is a tall tree that grows in warm places near the sea. It has needles instead of flat leaves, and those needles stay green all year long. The tree makes cones that hold seeds. The wood of a cedar tree smells nice and spicy. Some cedar trees are very, very tall. The bark on the trunk is thick and has cracks in it. The branches are wide and flat. Baby cones are green at first, and then they turn brown. When the cones get old, they break open and let the seeds fly away on little wings. Squirrels like to eat the seeds, but the seeds have a bad taste that keeps some squirrels away.
Strait of Magellan\n\nThe Strait of Magellan is a water path that connects two big oceans. It is near the bottom of South America, between the mainland and a group of islands. The water there is often foggy and stormy. A long time ago, a man named Ferdinand Magellan found this path. Now the country of Chile owns the land around it.
Acid\n\nAn acid is a kind of chemical. Some acids taste sour, like lemon juice. Acids can change the color of a special paper called litmus to red. Strong acids can hurt your skin, so you must be careful. Acids are in your stomach to help break down food. Some ants make acid to protect themselves. Acids are also inside your body in DNA, which tells your body how to grow.
People's Republic of China\n\nThe People's Republic of China is a big country in East Asia. It has more people than any other country in the world. The capital city is Beijing. Shanghai is a very big city with lots of people. China has many other cities and places. Hong Kong and Macau are special parts of China. China is very old and has a long history. People in China invented writing a long time ago. They also made many things like paper and silk. The flag of China is red with five yellow stars. Many children in China go to school and learn to read and write.
Snowboarding\n\nSnowboarding is a sport where you stand on a flat board and ride down a snowy mountain. Your feet are both on one board, like surfing on snow. Some snowboarders like to jump over bumps and do tricks. You need warm clothes, goggles to protect your eyes, and a helmet to keep your head safe. The board has bindings that hold your boots tight. You can stand with your right foot in back or your left foot in back. Most people put their right foot in back.
Arithmetic\n\nArithmetic is about numbers. You learn it in school. The four main things you do with numbers are adding, taking away, multiplying, and sharing. Adding means putting numbers together. Taking away means finding how many are left. Multiplying means adding the same number many times. Sharing means splitting a number into equal parts. People use arithmetic for many jobs like building houses, fixing cars, and helping sick people. You can do arithmetic in your head or use a calculator.
Courtship\n\nCourtship is a time when two people get to know each other. They spend time together to see if they want to get married later. Sometimes it is just between the two people, and sometimes their families help. In some places, people court for a long time before they decide to get married. Long ago, many people courted only to find a husband or wife. Today, some people still do this, but others do not.
Aztecs\n\nThe Aztecs were a group of Native American people who lived in Mexico a long time ago. They built a big city called Tenochtitlan on an island in a lake. That city is now Mexico City. The Aztecs had a king and many gods. They believed in gods like the sun god and the rain god. They grew food like corn, beans, and squash. They also made chocolate, but it was not sweet like today. The Aztecs played a game with a rubber ball and hoops on walls. They used a calendar with 365 days. The Aztecs were very powerful until Spanish people came and took over their land in 1521. Today, many Mexican people have Aztec ancestors, and the Mexican flag has an Aztec symbol on it.
Sibling\n\nA sibling is your sister or brother. If you have a brother, he is your sibling. If you have a sister, she is your sibling too. Some siblings live in the same house and play together. Older siblings can help take care of younger ones. Sometimes siblings share toys or argue, but they still love each other.
Yellowstone National Park\n\nYellowstone National Park is a big park in the United States. It was the first national park in the world. The park has hot water that shoots up from the ground, called geysers. The most famous geyser is Old Faithful. Many big animals live there, like bison, bears, wolves, and elk. People visit the park to see the animals and the geysers. The park is in Wyoming, Montana, and Idaho. It has a big volcano that is sleeping now. Sometimes the ground shakes a little. The park is a special place where nature is protected.
Lake Erie\n\nLake Erie is a big lake in North America. It is one of the five Great Lakes. Part of Lake Erie is in the United States and part is in Canada. Water comes into Lake Erie from the Detroit River and other rivers. Water leaves Lake Erie and goes to Niagara Falls, a very big waterfall. Big cities like Cleveland and Buffalo are near Lake Erie.
Toy\n\nA toy is something you play with. Kids play with toys, and sometimes grown-ups and pets do too. Long ago, toys were made from rocks, sticks, or clay. Now, most toys are made of plastic. Toys can be balls, cars, dolls, or even video games. Children have played with toys for a very long time.
Eurasian eagle-owl\n\nThe Eurasian eagle-owl is a very big bird that flies at night. It is one of the largest owls in the world. The female is bigger than the male. It has special feathers on its head that look like ears. This owl lives in rocky places and mountains in Europe and Asia. It hunts for food near woods and wet areas.
Percentage\n\nA percentage is a way to talk about parts of one hundred. The sign for it is %. If you have 3 apples and 1 orange, 3 out of 4 pieces of fruit are apples. That is 75 out of 100, or 75%. Percentages help compare things, like test scores, even if the tests have different numbers of questions.
Easter Island\n\nEaster Island is a small island far away in the ocean. It is famous for its huge stone statues called Moai. The statues are very big and look like people. They were made a long time ago by the people who lived there. The island also has a big hole in the ground called a crater, with a lake inside. The capital city is Hanga Roa. Many people visit Easter Island to see the Moai statues.
Sabbath\n\nA sabbath is a special day each week when people rest and pray. The word comes from a very old language and means "rest." Long ago, in a holy book, it tells how God rested after making the whole world. Many people remember this day as a time to stop working and be quiet. Some people rest on Saturday, and some rest on Sunday. It is a day to be with family and think about good things.
Hymn\n\nA hymn is a special song that people sing in church. Many people sing hymns together, or sometimes a small group called a choir sings them. A piano or organ often plays the music while people sing. Hymns talk about God and how people love God. One famous hymn is called "Amazing Grace." It tells how God helps people even when they make mistakes.
Field research\n\nField research is when people study things in the place where they live, not in a room. A scientist might watch animals in the woods to see what they do. Another person might talk to people in their homes to learn about them. The people who do field research watch and listen carefully. They do not change what is happening. They just look and learn.
Sewage treatment\n\nSewage treatment is how we clean dirty water from toilets, sinks, and factories so it doesn't hurt people or rivers. The dirty water goes through pipes to a special plant. First, big things like rags are taken out with screens. Then sand and grit fall to the bottom. Next, fats float to the top and solids sink, and that gunk is called sludge. The water then gets air with lots of oxygen, which kills tiny germs. After that, the water is clean enough to go back to rivers. Some plants use ponds or rocks with helpful germs to clean the water. The sludge can be used to make gas or fertilizer for farms.
Clause\n\nA clause is a part of a sentence. It has a who or what (the subject) and what happens (the predicate). For example, 'I love you' is one clause. 'I love you and I will always love you' has two clauses joined by the word 'and'. Some clauses can stand alone, like 'I love you'. Other clauses cannot stand alone, like 'and always will'. Sentences with fewer clauses are easier to understand.
Betelgeuse\n\nBetelgeuse is a big red star in the sky. It is in the Orion shape, which looks like a hunter. Betelgeuse is very big, much bigger than our Sun. It is so big that if it were in our sky, it would look like a giant red ball. Betelgeuse is not very old, but it is very heavy. It will one day explode in a big flash. You can see Betelgeuse in the night sky. It is one of the brightest stars.
Ancient Greece\n\nAncient Greece was a big area near the Mediterranean Sea where people spoke Greek. It was much bigger than the country of Greece today. The people did not have one ruler. Instead, there were many city-states, like Athens and Sparta. Each city-state had its own rules. Some had kings, and some let people vote. The Greeks learned to read and write from another people called the Phoenicians. They made the alphabet that we use today. Many Greek cities were near the sea because the land was rough. They built new cities along the coast. The Greeks made beautiful buildings and statues. One famous building is the Parthenon. Ancient Greece ended when the Romans took over.
Mouse\n\nA mouse is a very small animal with a pointy nose, round ears, and a long tail. Mice can be gray or brown. Some mice live in people's houses and look for food. People also keep mice as pets. Mice eat seeds, berries, and weeds. Owls, snakes, and cats like to eat mice. Baby mice are called pups. Some mice in cartoons, like Mickey Mouse, walk and talk like people, but real mice do not do that.
Brazil nut\n\nA Brazil nut is a food that comes from a very tall tree in the Amazon rainforest. The tree can grow very big and live for a long, long time, even hundreds of years. The nuts grow inside a hard fruit that falls from the tree. People eat the nuts as a snack.
Cliff\n\nA cliff is a very steep wall of rock that goes straight up and down. You can see cliffs by the ocean, in the mountains, and along rivers. Cliffs are made of hard rock that does not break apart easily. Sometimes water falls from the top of a cliff and makes a waterfall. The tallest cliff in the whole solar system is on a moon of Uranus, and it is very, very high.
Asmara\n\nAsmara is a city in Africa. It is the biggest city and the capital of a country called Eritrea. About 579,000 people live there. Long ago, four small villages joined together to make Asmara. The name means "the four females united" in a local language. In the 1930s, people from Italy built many buildings in Asmara that look like buildings in Italy. Some of those buildings are still there today. People in Asmara make clothes, meat, beer, shoes, and ceramics.
Skateboarding\n\nSkateboarding is riding on a skateboard and doing tricks. A skateboard is a flat board with four wheels. People who skateboard are called skateboarders. Skateboarding can be a fun hobby or a way to get around town. It is also a sport in the Olympics. You should always wear a helmet and pads on your knees, elbows, and wrists to stay safe. Skateboarders learn tricks like the ollie, where they jump with the board, and the kickflip, where they spin the board with their foot.
Nebula\n\nA nebula is a big cloud of dust and gas in space. Some nebulae are where new stars are born. The gas and dust come together and get hot, and then a star starts to shine. Other nebulae are what is left after a star dies and explodes. Some nebulae make their own light, some just reflect light from nearby stars, and some are dark and block the light from stars behind them. The Crab Nebula is a famous one that was made when a star exploded a long time ago.
Brittany\n\nBrittany is a place in the northwest of France. It is next to the big ocean. The weather there is not too hot and not too cold. It rains a lot in winter. The biggest city in Brittany is called Rennes. Long ago, Brittany was its own country. Now it is part of France. People in Brittany speak French and also a special language called Breton. There are many old stones standing up in the ground in a place called Carnac. Farmers in Brittany grow food and raise pigs and chickens. There is also a dog breed called Brittany.
Satire\n\nSatire is a way to make fun of people or things in a funny way. It can be in books, shows, or movies. People use satire to show when someone is being silly or doing something wrong. A long time ago, a writer named Swift wrote a book called 'Gulliver's Travels' that made fun of people. Today, some cartoons and comedians use satire to make us laugh and think.
Latvia\n\nLatvia is a country in Northern Europe. Its capital city is Riga. Latvia is next to Estonia, Lithuania, Russia, and Belarus. People from Latvia are called Latvians, and they speak the Latvian language. Long ago, people in Latvia fished, hunted, and traded. Many different groups ruled Latvia over time. Latvia became its own country in 1918, then later joined the European Union in 2004. Latvia has many small towns and big cities where people live and work.
Insect\n\nAn insect is a small animal with six legs and a hard outside skin. Insects live almost everywhere on land. They are the biggest group of animals in the world. There are more kinds of insects than all other animals put together. An insect has three body parts: a head, a middle part called the thorax, and a back part called the abdomen. On its head are two feelers and big eyes. Most insects have wings and can fly. They start life as an egg. Some baby insects look like tiny grown-ups. Others look like worms and change shape inside a cocoon before becoming grown-ups. Insects are cold-blooded, so they like warm places. In winter, many insects sleep until spring. Spiders are not insects because they have eight legs.
Balloon\n\nA balloon is a bag that you fill with air or gas. Most balloons are made from thin, stretchy rubber and come in many colors. People use small balloons for parties and decorations. Some balloons are made to look like animals. Big balloons called hot air balloons can lift people up into the sky. You can also fill a balloon with water and have a water balloon fight.
Brass\n\nBrass is a kind of metal that looks golden. It is made by mixing two other metals: copper and zinc. Brass is harder than pure metals and does not rust easily. People use brass to make things like door handles, musical instruments, and coins. Brass can be melted and shaped into many different forms. Almost all brass can be recycled and used again.
Monaco\n\nMonaco is a very small country on the Mediterranean Sea, next to France. It is the second smallest country in the world, after Vatican City. The whole country is just one city. Many rich people live there because they do not have to pay taxes. Monaco is famous for the Monte Carlo Casino and a big car race called the Monaco Grand Prix. The prince of Monaco is named Albert II. People in Monaco speak French. The money they use is called the euro.
Rome\n\nRome is a big city in Italy. It is the capital of Italy and has many people living there. Rome is very old and has a long history. A long time ago, Rome was the center of a big empire. The city has many old buildings, like the Colosseum. Rome also has many fountains, more than any other city in the world. The Vatican City is inside Rome, where the Pope lives. Rome has an airport and trains that go to other cities. Children in Rome go to school from age six to sixteen.
Music of Africa\n\nMusic of Africa is the music people make in Africa. Africa is a very big place with many countries, so the music sounds different in each part. People use music for special times like when they pray or have a party. They sing songs and dance to tell stories from long ago. Some African music mixes with American pop music to make a new kind of music called Afropop. People all over the world like to listen and dance to it.
Marten\n\nA marten is a small animal that lives in forests. It has a thin body, a long bushy tail, short legs, and a pointed face. Its fur is brown with a lighter chest. Martens hunt at night and eat small animals like mice, rabbits, and squirrels, as well as fish, bugs, eggs, and berries. They have claws that can pull back like a cat's, so they can climb trees easily. Martens like to live alone and do not want other martens too close. Baby martens are called kits, and they are born blind and without fur in early spring.
Rugby League\n\nRugby League is a ball game where two teams of 13 players try to score points. The ball is shaped like an oval. The field is a big rectangle, 100 meters long and 70 meters wide. The game lasts 80 minutes, split into two halves of 40 minutes each. To score a try, a player must put the ball down in the special area at the end of the field. A try gives 4 points, and if the team kicks the ball through the goal posts after, they get 2 more points. You can also score with a drop goal or a penalty kick. Rugby League is played in many countries like Australia, England, and New Zealand. The best teams play in the Rugby League World Cup.
Steam locomotive\n\nA steam locomotive is a big train engine that uses steam to move. It was used a lot from about 1830 to 1970. People burned coal in a special box called a firebox. The fire made hot air that went through tubes in a big tank of water. The water got hot and turned into steam. The steam went into a tube and pushed a part called a piston. The piston moved a metal rod that turned the wheels. Then the steam went out through the chimney. Today, most trains use electricity or diesel, but some places still use steam locomotives.
Leech\n\nA leech is a kind of worm that lives in wet places. Some leeches live in water and can swim. Other leeches live on land in wet and humid areas. A leech has a long body made of 34 parts. Some leeches eat tiny animals. Other leeches drink blood from bigger animals, like people.
Flute\n\nA flute is a musical instrument that makes sound when you blow into it. The person who plays the flute is called a flautist. Most flutes today are made of metal, like silver or gold, but long ago they were made of wood. The flute player holds it sideways and blows across a hole at one end. This makes the air inside move and creates a sound. You can change the sound by pressing buttons called keys or by blowing harder or softer. The flute can make high, bright sounds that remind people of birds. It can also make soft, sad sounds. Flutes are used in many kinds of music, like in orchestras and bands. There are many different flutes from all over the world, like the bansuri from India, the shakuhachi from Japan, and the pan pipes from Greece.
Slavs\n\nSlavs are a group of people who live in many countries in Europe and Asia. There are more Slavs than any other group of people in Europe. Some Slavs are called Russians, Poles, Ukrainians, Czechs, Slovaks, and many other names. They speak languages that are a lot alike, like Polish and Slovak. Many Slavs live in Russia, Poland, and Ukraine. Some Slavs live in other places too, like Germany and China.
Hoopoe\n\nA hoopoe is a colorful bird with a special crown of feathers on its head. It lives in many warm places across the world. The hoopoe makes a sound like 'hoop-oop-oop,' and that is how it got its name. It has a long, thin beak and pretty orange, black, and white feathers.
Christianity\n\nChristianity is a religion about Jesus. People who follow this religion are called Christians. They believe Jesus is God's son and that he came to earth to teach people how to be good. Christians believe Jesus died on a cross and then came back to life. They celebrate this on Easter. Christians read a special book called the Bible. It has two parts: the Old Testament and the New Testament. The New Testament tells stories about Jesus and his friends, the apostles. Many Christians go to a building called a church to pray and sing songs. There are different kinds of Christianity, like Catholic, Protestant, and Orthodox. All of them believe in Jesus.
Banknote\n\nA banknote is a piece of paper that people use to buy things. It is also called a bill. Banknotes are a kind of money, just like coins. Coins are for small amounts, and banknotes are for bigger amounts. Long ago, people used gold or silver to pay for things. But carrying heavy metal was hard and not safe. So banks started making paper notes that promised to give gold or silver if you brought the paper back. Later, people just used the paper to pay for things. Today, banknotes have pictures and numbers on them to show how much they are worth.
Raspberry\n\nA raspberry is a small red fruit that is made of many tiny parts stuck together. It looks like a blackberry, but it is hollow inside. You can buy raspberries at the store. The plant that grows raspberries has leaves that people use to make tea. Raspberry plants grow in fields or in open spaces in the woods. They are easy to grow in places that are not too hot or too cold. The plant makes new stalks each year, and the fruit grows on those stalks. Some plants give fruit in the summer, and some give fruit in both summer and fall. Raspberries are sweet and good to eat.
Mother\n\nA mother is a woman who has a baby. She is also called mom or mommy. A mother takes care of her child. She feeds the baby milk. Some mothers adopt children and love them just as much. A mother's family is called her family. In many languages, mother is called mama, madre, or mutter.
Personal protective equipment\n\nPersonal protective equipment, or PPE for short, are special clothes and things you wear to keep your body safe. You might see people wearing them at the doctor's office or on a building site. Some examples are hard hats to protect your head, safety glasses to protect your eyes, and gloves to protect your hands. These things help stop you from getting hurt.
Latin America\n\nLatin America is a big part of the world. It includes many countries in South America and Central America, and some islands in the Caribbean Sea. People there speak Spanish or Portuguese. Some people also speak old languages from Native Americans. Many people in Latin America like to make music, dance, and tell stories. The biggest cities are very big and have lots of people. Most people are Christians. Some countries are very poor, and many people do not have enough food.
Sailing (sport)\n\nSailing is a sport where people race boats that are pushed by the wind. The boats can be small or big. Small boats often race against other boats that look just like them. Big boats race with a special system to make it fair. A big sailing race is called a regatta. Some races go around floating markers near the shore. Other races go far across the open ocean. The America's Cup is a famous sailing race that started in 1851. Sailing is also in the Olympic Games. People who sail must be strong and smart to make the boat go fast.
Head of state\n\nA head of state is the top leader of a country. In some countries, the head of state is a president chosen by the people. In other countries, the head of state is a king or queen who gets the job from their family. Some heads of state help run the government, like the president of the United States. Other heads of state just represent the country and do not run the government, like the king or queen of the United Kingdom.
Multiplication\n\nMultiplication is a way to add the same number many times. For example, three times five means adding three fives together, which makes fifteen. You can write it as 3 times 5 equals 15. Multiplication helps you find out how many things there are in a rectangle. If you have 3 rows and 5 columns of tiles, you have 15 tiles in all. The opposite of multiplication is division. Teachers often ask children to learn a multiplication table to help them multiply faster.
Wheel\n\nA wheel is a round shape that spins. It helps things move along the ground. A wheel is a simple machine. Most cars, bikes, and trains have wheels. A wheel can be attached to a rod called an axle. The wheel and axle turn together. The middle part of the wheel is called the hub. Some wheels have teeth and are called gears. People use wheels on many things like carts, wheelchairs, and skateboards. A long time ago, people in a place called Mesopotamia made the first wheel. Early wheels were solid circles. Later, wheels had spokes like on a bike.
Breastfeeding\n\nBreastfeeding is when a mother gives her baby milk from her body. The baby puts its mouth on the mother's nipple and sucks the milk out. This milk is called breastmilk. Breastmilk is the best food for most babies. It helps babies grow strong and stay healthy. Breastfeeding can also help mothers stay healthy. Most mothers can make enough milk for their babies. Some mothers use a special tool called a breast pump to take milk out and save it for later. The milk can be kept in a clean container in the fridge. Babies who breastfeed have a lower chance of getting sick. Breastfeeding costs less than buying baby formula. The World Health Organization says babies should only have breastmilk for the first six months. After that, babies can start eating other foods too. When a baby stops breastfeeding, that is called weaning. Weaning should happen slowly over many weeks. Some babies stop breastfeeding on their own, but most need help from their mother.
Eating\n\nEating is when you put food in your mouth and swallow it. People and animals eat to get energy to run, jump, and play. Plants make their own food from sunlight, but people and animals cannot do that. We eat plants or animals to get the energy we need. When you eat an apple or a sandwich, you are getting energy from the sun that the plant used to grow.
Electric charge\n\nElectric charge is a special power that tiny bits inside everything have. Some tiny bits, called electrons, have a minus charge. Other tiny bits, called protons, have a plus charge. Things with different charges pull together. Things with the same charge push apart. This is why electrons and protons stick together to make everything around us. When you rub your feet on a carpet, you can pick up extra electrons. Then if you touch a metal doorknob, the electrons jump across and you feel a little shock. That shock can make your hair stand up because each hair has the same charge and pushes away from the others. Lightning is a very big shock from clouds. The shock can be dangerous if too many electrons flow through you.
Symphony\n\nA symphony is a long piece of music that a big group of players called an orchestra plays together. It is usually split into three or four parts, and each part is called a movement. The first movement is often fast, the second is slow, and the last one is called the Finale. Many famous people like Beethoven and Mozart wrote symphonies.
Weapon\n\nA weapon is something people use to hurt other people or animals. Long ago, people used rocks and sticks as weapons. Later, they made bows and arrows, swords, and big machines that threw rocks. Then people invented guns that shoot bullets. Some weapons, like bombs, can hurt many people at once. Today, countries make rules about which weapons people can have.
North Sea\n\nThe North Sea is a big body of salt water in northern Europe. It is part of the Atlantic Ocean. The North Sea sits between Norway and Denmark on one side, and Scotland and England on the other. It also touches Germany, the Netherlands, Belgium, and France. The North Sea is not very deep — only about as deep as a tall building. Many ships travel on it, making it one of the busiest seas in the world. Rivers like the Thames and the Rhine flow into it. People fish in the North Sea for food, but we must be careful not to take too many fish. Birds like puffins and terns live along its shores.
Spleen\n\nThe spleen is an organ inside your body. It sits on the left side, under your heart. The spleen helps fight germs and keeps your blood healthy. It cleans out old blood cells and saves the good parts. It also stores extra blood in case your body needs it fast. The spleen is shaped like a loose fist. Sometimes it gets bigger when you are sick. If it gets too big, it can break open, and you would need a doctor right away. Long ago, people thought the spleen controlled feelings like anger.
