They have parties with dancing, food, and games like volleyball and basketball to remember their home.
Large intestine\n\nThe large intestine is a long tube inside your belly. It is also called the colon. It connects the small intestine to the place where poop comes out. The large intestine is about as long as a tall kid. It is shorter than the small intestine but wider. Water from the food you eat gets soaked up here. The leftover stuff turns into poop and stays there until you go to the bathroom.
Fluorescence\n\nFluorescence is a special kind of light. Some things can soak up light and then give off a different light. When you turn off the light that shines on them, they stop glowing. Some rocks and toys can do this. They can take in light you cannot see, like the light from a black light, and then glow in colors you can see. Scientists use this to find tiny things in their work.
Falcon\n\nA falcon is a bird that hunts other animals for food. It has pointed wings and a long tail. Most falcons have dark gray or brown backs and white bellies. They eat small animals like mice and other birds. The peregrine falcon can dive very fast to catch birds in the air. Some people train falcons to hunt for them, which is called falconry. Long ago, people did this to get food, but now it is a sport. One kind of falcon, called Eleonora's falcon, sometimes traps small birds in cracks in rocks to save them for later.
Alpha Centauri\n\nAlpha Centauri is a group of stars that are the closest stars to our Sun. There are three stars in this group. Two of them are big and bright, and one is smaller and dimmer. The two big stars look like one star when you look at them from far away. The small star is called Proxima Centauri. It is a little closer to us than the other two. People want to send a spaceship to Alpha Centauri one day, but it would take a very long time to get there.
Orchestra\n\nAn orchestra is a big group of people who play music together. Each person plays a different instrument. Some play violins, some play flutes, and some play drums. A person called a conductor stands in front and waves a stick to help everyone play at the same time. The orchestra has four families of instruments: strings, woodwinds, brass, and percussion. The strings are violins, violas, cellos, and basses. The woodwinds are flutes, oboes, clarinets, and bassoons. The brass are trumpets, trombones, French horns, and tubas. The percussion are drums, cymbals, and other things you hit. All these instruments play together to make beautiful music.
Visual arts\n\nVisual arts are art that you can see. They make things like drawings, paintings, and sculptures. You can also make art with clay, cameras, or computers. Some art is for looking at, and some art is for using, like pretty dishes or clothes.
Kickboxing\n\nKickboxing is a sport where people use their hands and feet to hit. It is like boxing, but you can also kick. People do kickboxing to stay healthy or to fight in a ring. There are different kinds of kickboxing. In most kinds, you can punch and kick above the waist. You can also kick the legs. Fighters wear gloves, mouth guards, and pants. Some famous kickboxers are Benny Urquidez and Andrew Tate.
Micronesia\n\nMicronesia is a place in the ocean with many small islands. The name means "small islands" in an old language. The islands are in the Pacific Ocean, near the Philippines and Indonesia. Many of the islands are ring-shaped and made of coral. Each island has a leader called a chief. The chief listens to a group of helpers. Everyone belongs to a big family group. Families are spread across many islands. People share things so everyone has enough. In some islands, some people are richer than others.
Terrestrial planet\n\nA terrestrial planet is a rocky planet. Earth is one, and so are Mercury, Venus, and Mars. These planets are made of rock and metal. They have a hard outer shell called the crust, a middle part called the mantle, and a center called the core. The core is mostly made of iron. Terrestrial planets can have mountains, volcanoes, and big holes called craters. Some are very hot and some are very cold. The Moon is also rocky, but it is not a planet.
Kiwi\n\nThe kiwi is a bird from New Zealand. It has a long beak and brown feathers that look like fur. Kiwis cannot fly because their wings are very small. They cannot see well, but they can hear very well. Kiwis are awake at night and sleep during the day. They eat worms and bugs. Kiwis live alone or with their mate in a special area called a territory. They dig burrows in the ground or under tree roots to sleep and lay eggs. The female kiwi lays very big eggs, almost as big as herself. The eggs take a long time to hatch. Kiwis can live for more than 20 years. People from New Zealand are sometimes called Kiwis.
Cuckoo\n\nA cuckoo is a bird that makes a sound like "cu-ckoo." The male cuckoo sings this song. The female cuckoo does not build a nest or take care of her babies. Instead, she lays her egg in another bird's nest. She watches the other bird's nest and waits for the right time. Then she quickly puts her egg in the nest and flies away. The other bird does not notice and takes care of the cuckoo egg. When the baby cuckoo hatches, it grows very fast. It pushes the other eggs or baby birds out of the nest. The baby cuckoo is much bigger than the other bird. It makes a loud cheeping sound, so the other bird thinks it has many babies to feed. The cuckoo eats hairy caterpillars. It has a long tail and looks a little like a hawk when it flies. The cuckoo lives in Europe and Asia in the summer and goes to Africa in the winter.
Extraversion and introversion\n\nExtraversion and introversion are two ways to describe how people feel. Extraverts like to be with other people and feel happy when they play or talk with friends. Introverts like to be alone or with just one friend, and they feel tired after being around lots of people. Everyone is a little bit of both, but some people are more one way. Being an introvert is not the same as being shy. Shy people feel scared around others, but introverts just like quiet time.
Kamchatka Peninsula\n\nThe Kamchatka Peninsula is a long piece of land in eastern Russia. It sits between two big bodies of water: the Pacific Ocean and the Sea of Okhotsk. The peninsula has many volcanoes that are special and protected by the world.
Rat\n\nA rat is a medium-sized animal with a long tail. Rats eat many kinds of food. They are bigger than mice. Some rats live in cities and sewers. People keep some rats as pets, called fancy rats. Pet rats are smart and can learn tricks. They like to play with toys. Pet rats live 1 to 3 years. Wild rats usually live less than one year. Rats can be brown, black, or white. Some rats have no hair. Rats have helped scientists learn about diseases and how the brain works.
Diary\n\nA diary is a book where you write about things you have seen, heard, or done. People keep diaries to remember what happened in their lives. Some people write in a diary every day. Children in school sometimes write a diary to tell about their day and how they feel. A diary can be a small book where you write down things you need to do, like going to the doctor or meeting a friend. Long ago, a man named Samuel Pepys wrote a diary about the big fire in London. A girl named Anne Frank wrote a diary while she was hiding. Today, some people write a diary on the computer, and it is called a blog.
Computer data storage\n\nComputer data storage is where a computer keeps information. There are different kinds of storage. Some storage is very fast but can only hold a little bit of data. This kind needs electricity to keep the data safe. Other storage is slower but can hold a lot of data, like a hard drive or a USB stick. Some storage is very slow and holds even more data, like a tape drive. The computer uses the fast storage for things it is working on right now, and the slow storage for saving things for later.
News\n\nNews is when people talk about things that are happening right now. You can see news on TV, hear it on the radio, or read it in a newspaper or magazine. News tells you about many things like sports, weather, school, and fun events. Some TV channels show news all day long. A person who helps with the news is called a newsman.
Disability\n\nA disability is something about a person that makes some things harder for them. Some people are born with a disability. Some people get a disability from an accident or sickness. A disability can be about how a person moves, thinks, learns, or feels. Some disabilities are easy to see, and some are not. People with disabilities may use special tools to help them, like a wheelchair, a hearing aid, or a computer that talks. Places can have ramps and wide doors to make it easier for everyone to get around. It is not nice to be mean to someone because of a disability. Everyone should be treated kindly.
Constitution\n\nA constitution is a special paper that tells how a country works. It says who the leaders are, how they are chosen, and how long they stay. It also says what rules people must follow and what rights they have. Some countries have one big paper for their constitution. The United States has a short one. India has the longest one. The United Kingdom does not have one single paper; its rules are written in many old papers and in what judges have decided over a long time.
Writing system\n\nA writing system is a way to write down words using special marks. Different places use different marks. English uses the ABCs, which are called the Latin alphabet. Some writing systems use marks for whole words, like Chinese. Others use marks for sounds. Some writing goes from left to right, like English. Some goes from right to left, like Arabic. Some writing goes up and down, like Japanese.
Owl\n\nAn owl is a bird that hunts at night. It has a big head, a flat face, and big eyes that look forward. Owls can turn their heads almost all the way around. They have soft feathers that help them fly without making noise. Owls eat small animals like mice and bugs. They live in many places around the world, but not in very cold places like Antarctica. Some owls are brown, gray, or white with spots. They have sharp claws and a hooked beak to catch food. Owls can hear very well and see far away, but they cannot see things close to their eyes. After eating, owls spit out the parts they cannot digest, like bones and fur.
Waterfall\n\nA waterfall is a place where water falls down a big rock. The water comes from a river and drops from high land to low land. The sound of a big waterfall is very loud. Many people think waterfalls are beautiful. The highest waterfall in the world is Angel Falls.
Cauliflower\n\nCauliflower is a white vegetable that looks like a big flower. It is a kind of cabbage. You can eat it raw, cooked, or pickled. People in Poland like to eat it in soup with cream or fried with bread crumbs. Cauliflower is good for you and helps you grow strong.
Valve\n\nA valve is a part that can stop or let water, air, or other stuff move through a pipe. You can turn a handle to open or close it. Some valves work by themselves. There are many kinds of valves.
Carpathian Mountains\n\nThe Carpathian Mountains are a long chain of big, tall hills in Europe. They go through many countries like Romania, Poland, and Ukraine. The mountains make a big curve like a smile. Some parts are very high and covered with snow. People go there to hike and see the pretty trees and animals.
Medication\n\nMedication is something you take when you are sick to help you get better. It is also called medicine. Some medicines you can buy at the store without a note from a doctor. Those are called over-the-counter medicines. Other medicines are very strong, and a doctor must give you a note called a prescription to get them. Medicine can come as a pill you swallow or as a liquid you drink. Sometimes a doctor gives medicine through a tiny needle into a vein, and that works very fast. You must take the right amount of medicine. Taking too much can make you very sick. That is called an overdose. Medicine can also cause side effects, which are things you did not want, like feeling sick to your stomach. But not everyone gets side effects. Different companies give the same medicine different names. For example, one medicine might be called Tylenol by one company and Panadol by another, but it is the same thing.
Bankruptcy\n\nBankruptcy is a special court process for when a person or a company has no money left to pay what they owe. The court picks someone to take the things they own and sell them to get money to pay back some of what is owed. After that, the person is free from those debts, but it can be hard to borrow money again. Sometimes a company that goes bankrupt has to close, and people lose their jobs. There are different kinds of bankruptcy in the United States, like Chapter 7 where things are sold, and Chapter 13 where the person pays back some money over a few years.
Ice pellets\n\nIce pellets are tiny balls of ice that fall from the sky. They are a kind of frozen rain. Sometimes they bounce when they hit the ground. Big ice pellets are called hailstones.
Cypress\n\nA cypress is a kind of tree that stays green all year long. It has leaves that look like needles and small cones that hold seeds. Many cypress trees grow tall and strong. They can live for a very long time, even many hundreds of years. You can find cypress trees in warm places near water or in parks.
Plumbing\n\nPlumbing is the job of putting pipes in a building to bring clean water in and take dirty water out. A plumber is a person who fixes or puts in these pipes. Pipes can be made of metal or plastic. Long ago, people used pipes made of clay or stone. Today, pipes are made of copper or plastic because they are safe. Toilets, sinks, and bathtubs are parts of plumbing. They let us wash our hands and get rid of waste. Plumbers make sure the water comes out of the faucet and the dirty water goes away.
Tag\n\nA tag is a small label. It can be a piece of paper or plastic that you put on something to say what it is. Some tags are electronic and can be read by a machine. People also use the word tag for a name or mark they write on a wall.
Pi\n\nPi is a special number that helps us measure circles. If you take the distance around a circle (called the circumference) and divide it by the distance across the circle (called the diameter), you always get the same number: pi. Pi starts with 3.14 and then keeps going with more and more numbers forever, never stopping or repeating. That is why we call it an irrational number. People use pi to find out how far it is around a circle or how much space is inside a circle. Many people celebrate Pi Day on March 14, because 3-14 looks like the first three numbers of pi. Some people even have contests to see who can remember the most digits of pi!
Mandarin orange\n\nA mandarin orange is a small fruit that looks like an orange. It has a thin skin that is easy to peel with your fingers. You can pull it apart into little pieces without making a mess. Mandarin oranges taste sweet and are good for you because they have vitamin C. People eat them plain or in fruit salads. You can also buy them in cans. During Chinese New Year, people give mandarin oranges as gifts because they are a sign of good luck.
Thoroughbred\n\nA thoroughbred is a kind of horse. People use thoroughbreds mostly for racing because they can run very fast. They are tall and have long legs. A thoroughbred can be brown, red-brown, black, or gray. All thoroughbreds come from three special father horses that lived a long time ago. Thoroughbreds are also good at jumping. They can be a little bit jumpy, but they learn quickly and are loyal to their people.
Tiger\n\nA tiger is a big wild cat with orange fur and black stripes. It lives in Asia. Tigers are very strong and hunt for their food. They eat deer, pigs, and other animals. Most tigers have orange fur with black stripes and a white belly. No two tigers have the same stripes. Some tigers have white fur with black stripes. Tigers live alone and need a big area to hunt. They like to be near water and places where they can hide. Tigers are becoming rare because people hunt them and take away their homes. Many tigers live in zoos to keep them safe.
Timor\n\nTimor is a big island in the ocean. It is near the Timor Sea. Part of the island is a country called East Timor. The other part belongs to another country called Indonesia. The name Timor means "east" in a language from far away.
Ice\n\nIce is frozen water. When water gets very cold, it turns into hard ice. Ice is cold and slippery. You can make ice at home by putting water in the freezer. Ice floats on top of water because it is lighter. Big pieces of ice on land are called glaciers. Ice can break rocks and pipes when it freezes and gets bigger. There is also dry ice, which is frozen air that makes fog.
Bulgaria\n\nBulgaria is a country in Europe. It is near the Black Sea. The biggest city is Sofia. People in Bulgaria speak Bulgarian. Their money is called lev. Bulgaria is part of the European Union. The country has mountains and beaches. Many people live in cities and towns. Some people are farmers. Bulgaria has a long history with many different rulers.
Hiroshima\n\nHiroshima is a big city in Japan. About one million people live there. A long time ago, during a war, a very big bomb fell on Hiroshima. The bomb was called "Little Boy." It hurt many people and broke many buildings. One building that did not fall down is still there and is called the Atomic Bomb Dome. Near Hiroshima is a small island called Miyajima. Deer live on that island. There is an old shrine made of red wood. The shrine has a big gate that goes into the water when the tide comes in. Today, the shrine and the Atomic Bomb Dome are special places that people visit.
Picture\n\nA picture is a flat thing you can look at that shows something else. It can be a drawing, a painting, or a photograph. People who make pictures are called artists or photographers. Pictures help us remember things and learn new things. Some pictures are made with paint and brushes, and some are made with cameras. A camera makes a picture that looks very real. Pictures can be on paper, on walls, or even on glass. When many pictures are shown very fast, they make a moving picture called a movie. Some pictures show what is inside something, like a cutaway picture.
Bulbul\n\nA bulbul is a small bird that sings. Bulbuls live in Africa, the Middle East, and southern Asia. There are many kinds of bulbuls. Some live in forests, and some live in open places. They make pretty sounds with their voices.
Psychology\n\nPsychology is the study of the mind and brain. It looks at how people think, feel, and act. A person who studies psychology is called a psychologist. Psychologists try to understand how the mind works so they can help people. They ask questions and do experiments to learn more. Some psychologists talk to people about their feelings. Others watch how people behave. Psychology helps us understand why we do the things we do.
Talk show\n\nA talk show is a TV or radio show where a host talks with guests. The host asks questions and the guests answer. Sometimes people at home can call in and talk too. Talk shows can be funny or serious. Some talk shows have famous people like actors or singers. Other talk shows have experts who know a lot about one thing. The host might be a famous person or become famous because of the show. People watch talk shows to learn new things or just to have fun.
Snooker\n\nSnooker is a game played on a big table with a green cloth. Two players use long thin sticks to hit a white ball. They try to knock colored balls into holes on the table. There are red balls worth one point, and other balls worth more points. The player who gets the most points wins. People in the United Kingdom and other places like to watch snooker on TV.
Northern pike\n\nA northern pike is a big fish that lives in fresh water like lakes and rivers. It has a long body and many sharp teeth. Its body is dark with light spots on the sides. Northern pike like cold water and live in deep lakes. They hide near weeds and fallen logs in shallow water. They eat other fish and can swim very fast to catch them. People like to catch northern pike for fun.
Tornado\n\nA tornado is a very fast spinning wind that comes from a big storm and touches the ground. It looks like a big, dark funnel coming down from the sky. Tornadoes can be very dangerous because they can blow away houses, cars, and trees. Most tornadoes happen in the United States, in a place called Tornado Alley. The wind inside a tornado can go very fast, sometimes as fast as a race car. When a tornado is coming, you should go to a safe place like a basement or a small room without windows. You should never stay in a car or a mobile home during a tornado.
Microphone\n\nA microphone is a tool that changes sound into a little bit of electricity. It catches your voice or music and sends it to a speaker or a computer. You can see microphones in telephones, on TV, and in recording studios. Some microphones have a special screen called a pop filter that stops popping sounds from your mouth. The first microphones were used in telephones a long time ago.
Cereal\n\nCereal is a food made from grains like wheat or corn. Many people eat it for breakfast with milk. Some cereals are sweet with sugar or fruit. Long ago, people ate meat for breakfast instead of cereal. The first cereal was called Granula, and it was very hard. You had to soak it in water all night before you could eat it. Today, cereal comes in boxes and is easy to eat.
Nile\n\nThe Nile is a very long river in Africa. It is the longest river on Earth. The Nile starts in a big lake called Lake Victoria and flows all the way to the Mediterranean Sea. Many boats travel on the Nile because it is an easy way to get around. People in Egypt use the water from the Nile to grow food. Long ago, the Nile flooded every year and helped the crops grow. The ancient Egyptians used a plant called papyrus from the Nile to make paper. Many animals live in or near the Nile, like crocodiles, birds, and fish. The pyramids in Egypt were built close to the Nile so big stones could be moved on the river.
Oral hygiene\n\nOral hygiene means keeping your mouth clean and healthy. You do this by brushing your teeth every day. Brushing helps stop bad breath and keeps your teeth strong. You can also rinse your mouth with salt water. Salt water kills tiny germs and helps your gums feel better. Doing these things every day keeps your mouth happy and healthy.
Bell\n\nA bell is a thing that makes a ringing sound. Most bells are made of metal. Many churches have bells that ring to tell people the time. Ships also have a bell. Alarm bells ring to warn people about danger. Some bells are in tall towers and ring every hour.
Mojave Desert\n\nThe Mojave Desert is a very dry, sandy place in the United States. It is in parts of California, Nevada, and Arizona. Some plants that live there are the Joshua tree, the creosote bush, and the silver cholla. These plants do not need much water. The desert is very hot, and it has Death Valley, where the hottest temperature ever was recorded.
Spider\n\nA spider is a small animal with eight legs. Spiders live almost everywhere in the world, except in very cold places like Antarctica. Most spiders eat bugs like flies. They catch bugs in different ways. Some spiders make a sticky web to trap bugs. Some spiders hide and jump on bugs. Others throw a silk thread at bugs. Spiders have two body parts and eight eyes. Their fangs are like tiny needles that put poison into bugs to kill them. Some spiders are very small, and some are big like tarantulas. Baby spiders are called spiderlings.
Golden Rule\n\nThe Golden Rule is a simple idea: treat other people the way you want them to treat you. If you like it when someone shares a toy with you, then you should share your toys too. If you do not like it when someone is mean to you, then you should not be mean to others. Many people around the world follow this rule. It is called 'golden' because it is very important and good. Some people learn it from their religion, and some learn it from their family. The rule helps everyone get along and be kind to each other.
Poetry\n\nPoetry is a way of using words that sounds like music. Poems can be spoken, sung, or written down. They often have words that rhyme and a beat that you can tap your foot to. Some poems are very short, like a few words, and some are as long as a whole book. People write poems about many things, like animals, feelings, or fun stories. A poem is made of lines, and groups of lines are called stanzas. There are many kinds of poems, like nursery rhymes and haikus.
Burkina Faso\n\nBurkina Faso is a country in West Africa. It is next to Mali, Niger, Benin, Togo, Ghana, and Côte d'Ivoire. The country does not touch any ocean. The capital is Ouagadougou. People from Burkina Faso are called Burkinabè. The country used to be called Upper Volta. In 1984, the name changed to Burkina Faso, which means "land of honest people." Burkina Faso is mostly flat. It has a hot climate with a rainy season and a dry season. In the dry season, a hot wind called the harmattan blows. The country has two national parks where animals and plants are protected.
Season\n\nA season is a part of the year. Many places have four seasons: spring, summer, fall, and winter. Spring is when flowers start to grow. Summer is the warmest time, with long sunny days. Fall is when leaves change color and fall off trees. Winter is the coldest time, with short days and sometimes snow. Some warm places have only two seasons: a wet season and a dry season. The wet season has lots of rain, and the dry season has very little rain. Seasons change because the Earth tilts as it goes around the sun.
Dynamite\n\nDynamite is a thing that can make a big bang. A man named Alfred Nobel made it a long time ago. Dynamite has a special liquid inside that can explode very easily. To make it safer, the liquid is mixed with a soft rock powder. But water can make the liquid leak out, which is dangerous. Today, people do not use dynamite much because there are safer things to use. But you still see dynamite in cartoons and movies.
Ivory Coast\n\nIvory Coast is a country in West Africa. It is near the ocean called the Gulf of Guinea. The biggest city is Abidjan. The capital city is Yamoussoukro. Ivory Coast has five neighbor countries: Liberia, Guinea, Mali, Burkina Faso, and Ghana. The country is split into 12 parts called districts.
Roma people\n\nThe Roma are a group of people who travel and live in many countries. They first came from India a long, long time ago. Then they moved to Europe. Roma people have their own music and like to play guitars and violins. They also have special dances. Many Roma families travel in big wagons with all their things. Some Roma people have a dark spot on their skin when they are born, like some babies in Asia. Today, many Roma live in Eastern Europe. They have their own language and special holidays.
Poverty\n\nPoverty is when people do not have enough money for things they need, like food, water, and a place to live. Many people in some parts of the world live in poverty. Some people have to live on very little money each day. People who have a job but still cannot buy what they need are called the working poor. One way to help is to teach poor people new things so they can get better jobs and help their country grow.
Viola\n\nA viola is a musical instrument that looks like a violin but is a little bigger. It has four strings and makes a lower, deeper sound than a violin. You play it with a bow in your right hand, or you can pluck the strings with your fingers. People sometimes think a viola is a violin because they look almost the same. But the viola's sound is darker and more mellow. The viola is part of a group of instruments called an orchestra. It often plays harmony notes, which are the notes that go along with the main tune. A person who makes violas is called a luthier.
Provence\n\nProvence is a place in the south of France. It is near the big river Rhône and the country of Italy. The biggest city there is Marseille. Other cities are Nice, Avignon, and Aix-en-Provence. The sun shines a lot in Provence, and there are pretty fields of flowers and old stone houses.
Cardiology\n\nCardiology is a kind of doctor work that helps your heart and the tubes that carry blood. The doctors who do this work are called cardiologists. They check if your heart is beating the right way and if blood is moving well. They are not the same as heart surgeons, who fix the heart with tools in a special room.
Spice\n\nA spice is something you put in food to make it taste good. Spices can be sweet or strong, like cinnamon or nutmeg. Some people use spices to make food taste exciting. In India, people use many spices together, like garam masala.
Haddock\n\nA haddock is a fish that lives in the salty ocean. It has fins and a tail to help it swim. Haddock live in the North Atlantic Ocean and nearby seas. People catch haddock for food. You can eat it fresh, frozen, or smoked. Some smoked haddock is called Finnan haddie or Arbroath smokie.
Earth's inner core\n\nThe inner core is the very middle of the Earth. It is the hottest part of our planet. The inner core is a big ball of solid metal, mostly iron and nickel. It is as hot as the sun. The inner core is very, very deep underground, more than 5,000 kilometers down. It was discovered by a woman named Inge Lehmann. She studied earthquakes to find it. Earthquakes make shakes that travel through the Earth. Those shakes helped her know there was something solid at the center.
Rickshaw\n\nA rickshaw is a vehicle with two wheels. A person pulls it by walking or running. Some rickshaws are pulled by a bicycle, and some have a motor. Rickshaws are common in Bangladesh and Japan. People ride in them to go from one place to another.
Mongoose\n\nA mongoose is a small animal that looks a bit like a cat. It has a long body, short legs, and a bushy tail. Mongooses live in Asia, Africa, the Caribbean, and southern Europe. They are very brave and can fight snakes. In a story called "The Jungle Book," a mongoose named Rikki-Tikki-Tavi saves a family from snakes.
Refrigerator\n\nA refrigerator is a machine that keeps things cold. People put food and drinks inside to keep them good for a longer time. It has a part that takes the heat from inside and moves it outside. Most refrigerators use electricity to work. Some small ones, called coolers, use ice instead. Refrigerators come in many colors, but white is common. A freezer is a special kind of refrigerator that is even colder. It keeps food frozen so it lasts a very long time. Freezers can be part of a refrigerator or a separate box. Some freezers stand up like a refrigerator, and some lie down like a chest.
Rutabaga\n\nA rutabaga is a vegetable that grows in the ground. It has a rough outside that is often covered in wax. Inside, a rutabaga is yellow. When you cook it, the inside turns a bright yellow color. Rutabagas grow best when the weather is cool. They take a long time to grow big.
Cuba\n\nCuba is an island country in the warm Caribbean Sea. It is made up of one big island and many smaller ones. Havana is the biggest city and the capital. People from Cuba are called Cubans, and they speak Spanish. Cuba is warm all year long. Cuba is famous for fun dance music like salsa and mambo. Many people in Cuba love to read books and play sports like baseball. Before people from Spain came, three groups of native people lived on the island. They grew food like beans and corn and slept in hammocks. Later, Spain ruled Cuba and brought many people from Africa to work as slaves. In 1898, the United States helped Cuba become free from Spain. In 1959, a man named Fidel Castro led a revolution and took over the country. Cuba became a communist country, which means the government controls many things. The United States stopped trading with Cuba, and many Cubans moved to America. In the 1990s, Cuba became very poor when the Soviet Union, its friend, fell apart. Later, Cuba started letting tourists visit, and that helped the country make money again.
Fire\n\nFire is a hot, bright thing that gives off light and heat. It happens when something burns very fast. Fire can be useful: it keeps us warm on cold days, cooks our food, and helps us see in the dark. But fire is also very dangerous. It can burn your skin if you touch it, and it can burn down houses and trees. Forest fires can destroy big areas quickly. Fire needs three things to keep burning: air, something to burn like wood, and heat. To stop a fire, you can take away the air, cool it with water, or remove the fuel. Firefighters are people who are trained to put out fires and help people.
Chicken as food\n\nChicken is a bird that people eat as food. It is the most common bird people eat around the world. People cook chicken in many ways, like boiling, baking, frying, or grilling. Chicken is healthier than red meat because it has less of the bad stuff that can make you sick. People have been eating chicken for a very long time, since ancient times. Today, many people eat chicken from fast food places. Some chickens are raised just for their meat, and they are called broilers. The parts of a chicken that people eat are the breast, legs, wings, and thighs.
Oil paint\n\nOil paint is a kind of paint that artists use to make pictures. The color in oil paint is mixed with oil, usually from flax seeds. A picture made with oil paint is called an oil painting. Oil paint takes a long time to dry, so artists can keep working on it for many days. Some artists even work on a painting for years. Oil paint can be used on wood or on cloth called canvas. Artists can make the paint thick or thin, and they can mix colors to get new ones. Oil paintings can last a very long time.
Harvest\n\nHarvest is when farmers pick the food that has grown in the ground. They gather fruits, vegetables, and grains that are ready to eat. Sometimes the plants get hurt by bad weather or bugs, and then there is less food to pick. That is called a harvest failure. People can also harvest things from the water, like oysters and scallops.
Photocopier\n\nA photocopier is a machine that makes copies of words or pictures from one piece of paper onto another. You put the paper you want to copy on a glass window, close the lid, and press a button. The machine then makes a new paper that looks just like the first one. Some photocopiers can make many copies at once, and some can even print in colors. You can find photocopiers at school, at the library, or at an office where grown-ups work.
Mastiff\n\nA Mastiff is a very big dog with a big head and wrinkled forehead. It has a strong body and thick muscles. Mastiffs are one of the largest dogs and can weigh more than many grown-up men. They are gentle with their family and make good guard dogs. Mastiffs are calm and take their time to learn things. They need patient training when they are puppies. A Mastiff will protect its family if someone is mean. It is important to teach a Mastiff who is a friend and who is not.
Electric current\n\nElectric current is a flow of tiny bits called electrons through a wire. It is like water moving through a hose. When you turn on a light, electric current flows through the wire to make it glow. Batteries also have electric current inside them. Lightning is a very big and fast electric current in the sky. Electric current can be fast or slow, and we use things called resistors to make it go slower.
Lemon\n\nA lemon is a yellow fruit that tastes sour. It grows on a small tree. People squeeze lemons to get juice. The juice can be used to make lemonade or to cook food. Lemons first grew in Asia, in places like India and China. They are related to oranges.
Passenger pigeon\n\nThe passenger pigeon was a bird that lived in North America. It was once the most common bird in the world. These birds flew in huge groups that could be very long and wide. Sometimes there were so many birds that they blocked the sun. People hunted them for food, and soon there were no more passenger pigeons left. The last one died in 1914.
Thought\n\nThought is what your brain does when you are awake. It is like a little voice inside your head that helps you think about things. You use thought to solve problems, like figuring out how to put a puzzle together. Animals also use their brains to solve problems, but we do not know if they think like we do. Many smart people study thought to understand how our brains work.
Mountain range\n\nA mountain range is a long line of big, tall mountains that stand close together. Some mountain ranges are very long, like the Andes in South America. The Himalayas have the highest mountains in the world, including Mount Everest. Mountains can change the weather: when wind blows against them, the air gets cold and makes rain or snow on one side, while the other side stays dry. Over a very long time, rain and wind wear the mountains down, and the broken pieces turn into sand and dirt that fill up valleys.
Sling (weapon)\n\nA sling is a weapon that you swing a rock around in to make it go fast, then you let go and the rock flies far. Long ago, people used slings to fight. A boy named David used a sling to throw a stone at a giant named Goliath and hit him on the head. A good slinger could hit a small target from far away. The rock could go as far as 200 meters.
Profit\n\nProfit is the extra money you have after you sell something. If you buy a toy for 5 and sell it for 8, you have 3 more than before. That 3 is your profit.
Atlantic Ocean\n\nThe Atlantic Ocean is a very big body of salt water. It is the second biggest ocean in the world. It covers about one-fifth of the Earth. The Atlantic Ocean sits between North America and South America on one side, and Europe and Africa on the other side. A long time ago, the land on each side was all stuck together. Then the land slowly moved apart, and the ocean filled in between. The Atlantic Ocean is still getting bigger every year. There is a big underwater mountain chain called the Mid-Atlantic Ridge that runs down the middle of the ocean. The Gulf Stream is a warm current in the Atlantic. It brings warm water from near the Caribbean Sea up toward Europe. This makes places like France and England warmer in winter than places like Canada that are far north too. Many ships cross the Atlantic Ocean. A famous ship called the Titanic sank in the Atlantic Ocean long ago.
Equator\n\nThe equator is a pretend line that goes around the middle of the Earth. It is not a real line you can see. The equator is exactly halfway between the North Pole and the South Pole. At the equator, day and night are the same length all year long. Places near the equator are very warm and wet, and they do not have four seasons like spring, summer, fall, and winter.
Foam\n\nFoam is made when gas gets trapped inside tiny bubbles. You can see foam in soapy water when you wash your hands. The bubbles are filled with air and have thin walls of liquid around them. Foam feels light and soft, and it can pop easily.
Goose\n\nA goose is a bird that lives near water. Geese have long necks and webbed feet. They like to stay together in groups. A group of geese is called a gaggle. A baby goose is called a gosling. Geese fly in a V shape when they go to warm places in the fall and come back in the spring.
Astronomical object\n\nAn astronomical object is anything that floats in space. Stars, planets, moons, and rocks in space are all astronomical objects. The Sun is a star, and Earth is a planet. The Moon is a rock that goes around Earth. Some space rocks are very small, and some are very big.
Digestion\n\nDigestion is how your body breaks down food so it can use it. First, your teeth chew food into small pieces. Then the food goes down a tube into your stomach. Your stomach mashes the food into a soupy mix. Next, the mix goes into a long tube called the small intestine. There, tiny bits of food go into your blood. Your blood carries the food bits to your liver, which is like a factory for your body. The leftover food goes into the large intestine, where water is taken out. The rest is called poop, and it stays in your bottom until you go to the bathroom.
Examination\n\nAn examination is a test. It asks questions to see what you know or can do. A doctor might examine you to find out why you are sick. A mechanic might examine a car to see why it does not work. In school, a test shows how much you have learned. You might take a written test, a test on a computer, or a practical test like driving a car or playing a song. If you answer the questions right, you pass. If you get many wrong, you fail. Sometimes you can try again later. When you pass, you might get a paper that says you did well.
Bass guitar\n\nA bass guitar is a big string instrument that makes low, deep sounds. It looks like an electric guitar but is longer and bigger. People play it with their fingers or a pick. The bass guitar has four thick strings, but some have five or six. It is used in rock, pop, country, and jazz music to play the low part of the song. The first bass guitar was made by Leo Fender in the 1950s. It is made of wood and has metal frets on the neck to help play the right notes. The strings sit over magnetic pickups that send the sound to an amplifier so everyone can hear the deep notes.
Vehicle\n\nA vehicle is a machine that moves people and things. It is not alive. Some vehicles go on land, like cars, buses, bicycles, and trains. Most land vehicles have wheels. Some vehicles go on water, like boats and ships. Some vehicles fly in the sky, like airplanes and balloons. A few vehicles can even go to outer space. Vehicles need power to move, like gas or electricity. Some vehicles, like gliders, do not have their own power.
Faroe Islands\n\nThe Faroe Islands are a group of eighteen islands in the north Atlantic Ocean. They are part of the Kingdom of Denmark. The name means "Sheep Islands" because there are many sheep. In fact, there are more sheep than people living there. About 55,000 people live on the islands. The islands have cool summers and cold winters. There are no big lakes or rivers. Many birds live there, like eider ducks and puffins. You can also see grey seals and sometimes whales in the water. People there catch fish and raise sheep. They also have tourists who visit.
Bias\n\nBias is when someone likes one idea more than another and does not give other ideas a fair chance. For example, a newspaper might write more good stories about one group and more bad stories about another group because the people who work there like that group better. Bias can also happen when someone uses mean words to talk about a group of people. Another kind of bias is when a measurement is not right, like measuring how tall someone is while they are wearing shoes, which makes them seem taller than they really are.
Danish language\n\nDanish is a language that people speak in Denmark. It sounds different from English. People in Denmark, the Faroe Islands, and parts of Greenland and Germany talk in Danish. About five and a half million people speak it. The people who live in Denmark call their language 'dansk'.
Bobsleigh\n\nBobsleigh is a sport where people ride a sled down a slippery ice track very fast. The track is made of concrete with ice on top. Teams of two or four people sit in the sled and steer it down the hill. Bobsleigh is played at the Winter Olympic Games. The first bobsleds were made a long time ago in a place called St. Moritz, Switzerland.
Forensic science\n\nForensic science is when people use science to help answer questions about a crime. They look for clues like fingerprints, hairs, or tiny pieces of skin. These clues are checked in a lab to see if someone was at the place where the crime happened. The people who do this job have to be very careful, because a mistake could put the wrong person in trouble.
Zinc\n\nZinc is a metal that looks shiny and bluish-grey. It is found in the ground inside rocks. People use zinc to stop metal from rusting, like on cars and boats. Zinc is also in batteries that make toys work. Your body needs a tiny bit of zinc to stay healthy. You can get zinc from food like whole wheat. Some vitamins have zinc in them too.
Consonant\n\nA consonant is a sound you make when you partly block the air in your mouth. Letters like B, C, D, F, G, H, J, K, L, M, N, P, Q, R, S, T, V, W, X, Y, and Z are consonants. When you say a consonant, your lips, teeth, or tongue stop the air a little bit. For example, the sound "b" is made by closing your lips and then opening them. Some consonants are quiet, like "p," and some are loud, like "b." You need a vowel next to a consonant to make a word part.
Symbolism\n\nSymbolism is when something stands for something else. A heart can stand for love. A red light means stop. In stories, a bird might stand for being free. Symbols help us understand big ideas in a simple way.
Andromeda galaxy\n\nThe Andromeda galaxy is a huge group of stars far, far away in space. It is the closest big galaxy to our own galaxy, the Milky Way. Andromeda looks like a small, fuzzy star in the night sky. It has more stars than our galaxy—about one trillion stars! Andromeda is moving toward us, and in a very, very long time, it will bump into the Milky Way and they will become one big galaxy. You can see Andromeda without a telescope on a dark, clear night.
Force\n\nA force is a push or a pull between things. When you push a toy car, that is a force. When you pull a door open, that is also a force. Forces can make things move, stop, change direction, or change shape. Gravity is a force that pulls everything down toward the ground. It is why things fall when you drop them. The strength of a force is measured in newtons. Forces always come in pairs: when you push something, it pushes back just as hard.
Emotion\n\nEmotions are what people feel inside. They are very old and all mammals have them. Emotions help animals change how they act when things around them change. For example, a dog wags its tail when it is happy to see you. People show emotions on their faces, like smiling when happy or frowning when sad. Charles Darwin studied how people show emotions in different places and found that people everywhere show them in the same way. Some animals, like cats and dogs, also have feelings that look like ours.
Tug of war\n\nTug of war is a game where two teams pull a rope. Each team holds one end of the rope. The teams try to pull the other team across a line or into a mud pit. The team that pulls the hardest wins. It is a fun game for children and grown-ups.
Burn\n\nA burn is a hurt on your skin. It can happen when you touch something very hot, like fire or hot water. Most burns are small and get better at home. A first-degree burn hurts the top layer of skin and heals fast. A second-degree burn goes deeper and might need a doctor. A third-degree burn is very bad and hurts all the way through the skin. A fourth-degree burn is the worst and can hurt the nerves so much that you feel no pain there. Bad burns need to be treated at the hospital right away.
Australian rules football\n\nAustralian rules football is a sport that people play in Australia. It is the most popular sport there. The game is played on a big oval field. Two teams try to kick a ball between four tall poles at each end. If the ball goes between the middle two poles, it is a goal and gives six points. If it goes between the outer poles, it is a behind and gives one point. Players can run with the ball, but they must bounce it every few steps. They can also hit the ball with their hand to pass it to a friend. When a player catches a ball that was kicked by someone else, that is called a mark, and no one can touch him until he starts moving again. The game has four parts called quarters, each twenty minutes long. Many people go to watch the games, and sometimes over 100,000 people come to see the big matches.
Theatre\n\nA theatre is a place where people go to watch a story acted out on a stage. Long ago in Greece, people made up plays and acted them outside in big open spaces. The actors wore masks so the crowd could see different characters. Today, a theatre can be a big building with a stage, seats, and lights. People called actors pretend to be other people and tell a story. Some theatres show movies, and some show live plays. Going to the theatre is fun because you can watch a story come to life.
Colombia\n\nColombia is a country in South America. It is near the equator, so it is warm. Colombia has beaches on two big oceans: the Pacific Ocean and the Caribbean Sea. Many people live there, more than 51 million. The capital city is Bogotá. Other big cities are Medellín, Cali, and Cartagena. People in Colombia speak Spanish. Colombia has high mountains, big plains, and part of the Amazon rainforest. It is home to many kinds of animals and plants. Colombia has more kinds of birds than any other country. It also makes most of the world's emeralds, which are green shiny stones.
Dune\n\nA dune is a hill made of sand. Wind blows the sand into piles, and that makes a dune. You can find dunes in deserts and on some beaches. Dunes can be big or small, and they can move slowly when the wind pushes them. Mars, a planet far away, also has dunes.
Infinity\n\nInfinity is a word that means something never ends. It is like counting 1, 2, 3, and never stopping. You can keep adding numbers forever. Some things in math are infinite, like the list of all numbers. There are different kinds of infinity. One kind is like counting forever. Another kind is like a line that goes on and on without end. Infinity is not a real number, but it helps us think about things that are very, very big and never stop.
Jurassic\n\nThe Jurassic was a time long, long ago, even before the dinosaurs were gone. It was the middle part of the age of dinosaurs. The weather was hot and wet, and the land was all one big piece called Pangaea. Many big dinosaurs lived then, like the long-necked sauropods. There were also flying reptiles called pterosaurs and swimming reptiles like plesiosaurs. The first birds, like Archaeopteryx, appeared. Plants like ferns and conifers grew everywhere. The Jurassic ended about 145 million years ago.
Earless seal\n\nAn earless seal is a kind of animal that lives in the water and on land. It has a round body, short front flippers, and no outside ears. Earless seals swim very well and eat fish. They live in cold places like the Arctic and Antarctica. Baby earless seals are called pups and have soft white fur.
Statue of Liberty\n\nThe Statue of Liberty is a very big statue of a woman. It stands on an island near New York City. The statue was a gift from France to the United States a long time ago. It shows a woman holding a torch high in the air. In her other hand she holds a tablet with a date on it. She wears a robe, a crown, and sandals. The statue is made of copper, which turned green over time. People can take a boat to visit the statue and climb up inside it. The statue welcomes people who come to America by ship.
Alice's Adventures in Wonderland\n\nAlice's Adventures in Wonderland is a story about a girl named Alice. One day, Alice sees a white rabbit and follows it down a hole. She falls into a magical place called Wonderland. In Wonderland, Alice meets funny characters like a cat that smiles and a caterpillar. She eats cakes and mushrooms that make her grow big or small. At the end, Alice wakes up and finds she was dreaming. The story was written by Lewis Carroll a long time ago. Many movies and shows have been made about Alice's adventures.
Atlantis\n\nAtlantis is a name for a big island that people tell stories about. A long time ago, a Greek man named Plato wrote about Atlantis. He said it was a very large island in the ocean, and the people who lived there were half human and half god. They were good at first, but then they did bad things. The gods got angry and sent earthquakes and fire to make the island sink into the sea. Many people think Atlantis was just a story, but some people wonder if it was real. Today, Atlantis appears in comic books and movies, where it is a city under the water.
Barranquilla\n\nBarranquilla is a big city in the country of Colombia. It is in the north part of Colombia. Many people live there. It is the fourth biggest city in Colombia. The city has a big party every year called Carnival. People wear colorful clothes and dance in the streets.
Public\n\nPublic means people. In some learning, public is a group of people who have the same problem and try to fix it. For example, a public can be people who talk about a problem together. Some publics are about the same ideas or hobbies. Other publics use technology like social media to connect. Publics can be different based on how much they know about a problem and what they do about it.
Rivet\n\nA rivet is a small metal piece that holds two flat metal parts together. Long ago, people used rivets to build big ships and bridges. Workers would heat the rivet until it was very hot, then hammer it into a hole. When the metal cooled, it pulled the two parts tight. Riveting made a loud noise. Today, most things are built with welding or strong bolts, but airplanes still use rivets because they are light and strong.
Copper\n\nCopper is a metal that comes from the ground. It is a reddish-orange color when it is new, but it turns green after being in the air for a long time. That is why the Statue of Liberty is green. Copper is very soft and can be stretched into thin wires. People use copper wires to carry electricity in houses. Copper is also used to make pipes for water. When copper is mixed with tin, it makes a harder metal called bronze. When mixed with zinc, it makes brass. Copper is important for our bodies, and we get it from food. Some animals, like snails and crabs, have blue blood because they have copper in their blood.
New World monkey\n\nNew World monkeys are a kind of monkey that lives in Central and South America. They have flat noses with holes that point to the sides. Many of them cannot see all colors. Some have long tails that can grab things like tree branches. Baby monkeys often come in pairs of two, and both mom and dad help take care of them.
Baghdad\n\nBaghdad is a big city in a country called Iraq. It is the biggest city in that country. Many people live there. The city sits next to a big river called the Tigris. A long time ago, Baghdad was a very important place where people learned many things. It was a center for art and poetry. The city was built by a ruler named al-Mansur. Later, other groups took over the city. Today, Baghdad is still a busy city with many people.
Supermarket\n\nA supermarket is a big store where people buy food. You can find fresh fruit, vegetables, meat, and fish there. Some supermarkets also sell soap, toothpaste, and cleaning things. You take a cart or basket and pick what you want. Then you pay at the checkout. Some supermarkets have a bakery or a place that sells hot food. Every week, some items cost less, and a paper shows which ones are on sale.
Planet\n\nA planet is a very big ball in space that goes around a star, like Earth goes around the Sun. Planets do not make their own light, but they can shine because the Sun's light bounces off them. There are eight planets in our Solar System. The biggest one is Jupiter, and the smallest one is Mercury. Planets are round like a ball, but a little squished. Some planets are made of rock, like Earth and Mars. Others are made of gas, like Jupiter and Saturn. A long time ago, people named the planets after gods and goddesses from old stories.
Filter\n\nA filter is a tool that takes out things you do not want. For example, a coffee filter lets the brown drink through but keeps the coffee grounds out. In a radio, a filter helps you pick one station and block the others. Some filters clean water by taking out tiny bits that make it dirty. A camera can use a filter to change how a picture looks. On a computer, a filter can hide words or pictures you do not want to see.
Eurasia\n\nEurasia is a very big piece of land on Earth. It is made of two parts: Europe and Asia. The Atlantic Ocean is on one side, and the Pacific Ocean is on the other. The Arctic Ocean is at the top, and the Mediterranean Sea and Indian Ocean are at the bottom. Eurasia is the biggest land area in the world. Its name comes from putting "Eur" from Europe and "Asia" together. Some people think Eurasia is one big continent because Europe and Asia are on the same big rock under the ground and there is no sea between them. Long ago, Greek people thought Europe and Asia were two different places, and many people still think that today. The Ural Mountains sometimes split Eurasia into west and east parts. Many countries are in Eurasia, from near the European Union all the way to the far east.
Fairy tale\n\nA fairy tale is a kind of short story. It is not a true story. Fairy tales often have magic, like fairies, goblins, elves, trolls, giants, or talking animals. They also have kings, queens, princes, and princesses. Many fairy tales start with "Once upon a time." Some old fairy tales are "Sleeping Beauty," "Little Red Riding Hood," and "The Three Little Pigs." New fairy tales can be written by people like Hans Christian Andersen. Fairy tales are for children, but grown-ups used to like them too.
Arabian Peninsula\n\nThe Arabian Peninsula is a very big piece of land in Asia. It is shaped like a boot sticking out into the water. The Red Sea and the Arabian Sea are next to it. Many countries are on this peninsula, like Saudi Arabia and Yemen. Most of the land is hot desert with lots of sand. There are some mountains that get a little rain. People find oil under the ground in the north part.
Maze\n\nA maze is a puzzle with many paths. Some mazes are on paper, and you draw a line to find the way out. Other mazes are big enough to walk through. You have to find the right path to get to the end. Some mazes have a ball that you move through the paths.
Theism\n\nTheism is when people believe in a god. Some people believe in one god, and some believe in many gods. A person who believes in a god is called a theist. A person who does not believe in any god is called an atheist. Different people have different ideas about god.
Fertilizer\n\nFertilizer is a special food for plants. It helps plants grow big and strong. Plants take food from the dirt, and rain can wash the food away. Fertilizer puts the food back. Some plants need more of one kind of food, and some need another. You can buy fertilizer in bags at a garden store.
San Marino\n\nSan Marino is a very small country in Europe. It is inside Italy, like a tiny island on land. Fewer than 30,000 people live there. The capital city is also called San Marino. People there speak Italian. Many visitors come to see the old buildings and buy stamps. The country is very old and has been a republic for a long time. It started a very long time ago, in the year 301. A man named Saint Marinus built a small church on a mountain, and that became San Marino. The land is hilly and rocky, with a big mountain called Monte Titano. The food is like Italian food, and they make a special chocolate cake called Torta Tre Monti.
Washing machine\n\nA washing machine is a machine that washes dirty clothes. You put clothes inside a big round tub, and the machine fills it with water and spins very fast. The spinning makes the water clean the dirt off the clothes. You also add soap called detergent to help get the clothes cleaner. Some washing machines have a door on the front, and some have a lid on top. A front-loading machine can have a dryer stacked on top to save space. A top-loading machine has the opening on top, so you cannot put things on top of it. Some machines do everything by themselves, and some need you to move the clothes to a separate dryer.
Manchuria\n\nManchuria is a big piece of land in the northeast part of China. It is where the Manchu people used to live. The land has mountains, grass, rocks, and some dry places. In summer it is very hot and wet, and in winter it is very cold and dry. Long ago, the Manchu people made their own country and later ruled all of China. Some parts of Manchuria are now in Russia.
Vienna\n\nVienna is a big city in a country called Austria. It is the capital, which means it is the most important city in that country. More than 1,800,000 people live there. The city sits on a big river called the Danube. Long ago, Vienna was the home of famous music makers like Mozart and Beethoven. Today, people can visit old buildings, churches, and museums in the city center. Vienna also has two famous orchestras that play beautiful music.
Dialect\n\nA dialect is a way of speaking a language that a group of people use. People who live in the same place or are in the same group may share a dialect. For example, British English and American English are different ways of speaking English. They have some different words and sounds, but people who speak them can still understand each other. Sometimes it is hard to tell if something is a language or a dialect. A long time ago, travel was hard, so people in different towns spoke in different ways. Even some birds and whales have different songs in different places, and people call those dialects too.
Expressionism\n\nExpressionism is a way of making art. Artists who use expressionism do not try to show things exactly as they look. Instead, they use colors and shapes to show how they feel inside. For example, they might paint a sky red if they feel angry or excited. This kind of art started a long time ago, before the First World War. It became very popular in the 1920s in a city called Berlin. Expressionism can be seen in paintings, plays, dances, movies, and even buildings. One famous expressionist painting is called "The Scream" by an artist named Edvard Munch. It shows a person who looks very scared or sad.
Clay\n\nClay is a soft, wet dirt that comes from rocks that have broken down into very tiny pieces. When clay is wet, you can squish it and shape it with your hands. People use clay to make pots, cups, and bricks. After you shape the clay, you can put it in a very hot oven called a kiln to make it hard. Clay can be many colors, like red, brown, or white. It feels smooth and sticky when it is wet.
Conscience\n\nConscience is a little voice inside you that tells you if something is right or wrong. When you do something nice, your conscience feels happy. When you do something not nice, your conscience can make you feel sad. It helps you want to be good.
20th-century classical music\n\n20th-century classical music is music written by people who make special songs and sounds, called composers, from the year 1900 to 1999. This music is very different from older music because composers tried new ideas. Some composers, like Arnold Schoenberg, made music that did not sound like it was in a key, and they used a special way to put notes in order called serialism. Other composers, like Igor Stravinsky, used music from old times but changed it with strange sounds, which is called neoclassicism. In France, Claude Debussy made music that sounds like paintings, with blurry notes and pretty chords. Some composers kept writing music that sounds like old romantic songs, like Edward Elgar and Sergei Rachmaninoff. In America, jazz music mixed with classical music, like in George Gershwin's songs. Later, some composers made music that repeats simple ideas over and over, called minimalism, like Steve Reich and Philip Glass. There are many kinds of 20th-century classical music, and each composer had their own way of making sounds.
Leprechaun\n\nA leprechaun is a make-believe little man from stories in Ireland. He looks like a tiny old man and likes to play tricks. People say he has a pot of gold hidden somewhere. If you look at a leprechaun, he cannot run away. But if you look away even for a second, he disappears.
Angle\n\nAn angle is made when two straight lines meet at a point. The lines are called the sides of the angle. We measure how big an angle is using degrees. A full circle has 360 degrees. A square corner is 90 degrees. A straight line is 180 degrees. Some angles are small, and some are big. We see angles in many places, like the corner of a book or the hands of a clock.
Alpine skiing\n\nAlpine skiing is a winter sport where people slide down snowy hills on long, thin boards called skis. The person who goes down the fastest wins. There are different kinds of races, like going straight down fast or zigzagging between poles. This sport started a long time ago in Norway. Today, many people can try it at ski places all over the world. The best skiers race in big competitions like the World Cup and the Olympics.
Aquaculture\n\nAquaculture is when people grow fish and other sea animals on farms. People have been doing this for a very long time, starting in China. They grow fish like catfish, salmon, and trout. Some farms grow shrimp and seaweed too. Today, half of the fish people eat in the United States comes from these farms. When farms are run well, they do not hurt the ocean much.
Decathlon\n\nA decathlon is a sports contest with ten different races and throws and jumps. The word decathlon means 'ten feats' in an old language. Athletes run fast, jump far, jump high, and throw heavy things. They do all ten events to see who is the best all-around athlete.
Etiquette\n\nEtiquette is a set of rules about how to be nice to other people. It tells you to say please and thank you, to wait your turn, and to share. Different places have different rules. What is nice in one place might not be nice in another. Etiquette helps everyone get along.
School\n\nA school is a place where children go to learn. At school, a teacher helps students learn new things like reading, writing, and math. Children sit in a classroom with other kids their age. There are different types of schools: some are for little kids, some for bigger kids, and some for grown-ups. In many places, children must go to school for a certain number of years. Schools can be for boys only, girls only, or both boys and girls together. Some schools are boarding schools, where children live at school and only go home for holidays. Long ago, not many people could read or write, but now almost all children go to school to learn.
Santo Domingo\n\nSanto Domingo is a big city and the capital of the Dominican Republic. It is on an island near the Caribbean Sea. The city sits where the Ozama River meets the sea. Santo Domingo is the oldest city in the Americas where people have lived since it was built long ago. The weather is warm all year, but sometimes big storms called hurricanes come. Many people live there, and most have dark skin. The old part of the city is called the Colonial Zone, with old buildings and walls from long ago. There are parks, a zoo, and a big garden. People there love baseball, and two baseball teams play in the city. There are also many schools, including the first university in the Americas.
Jaw\n\nYour jaw is the part of your body that helps you eat. It has two bones in your mouth. The top bone is called the upper jaw, and the bottom bone is called the lower jaw. Your jaw moves up and down so your teeth can chew food. Some animals, like bugs, have jaws that open left and right instead. Sea urchins have five jaws with one tooth each. Some animals do not have jaws at all.
Frequency\n\nFrequency is how many times something happens in one second. For waves, like light or sound, frequency tells us how many wave tops go past a spot in one second. We measure frequency in hertz. If a wave has a high frequency, many tops go by each second. If it has a low frequency, only a few tops go by. Light and radio waves are different kinds of waves, and they have different frequencies. You can think of it like trains: if two trains go the same speed, the one with smaller cars will have more cars pass a sign in one second. That is like a higher frequency.
Great white shark\n\nA great white shark is a very big fish that lives in the sea. It is the biggest fish that eats other animals. It can grow as long as a car and weigh as much as a small truck. Great white sharks have many sharp teeth in rows. When a tooth falls out, a new one comes to take its place. They can smell one tiny drop of blood in a whole swimming pool of water. Great white sharks eat fish, seals, sea lions, and other sea animals. They are very fast swimmers. Sometimes they jump out of the water to catch food. Great white sharks live in warm seas near the coast. They are not mean to people on purpose, but sometimes they bite by mistake because they are curious. Most of the time, they bite once and then swim away.
Swallow\n\nA swallow is a small bird that flies very fast. It has long, pointy wings and a tail that looks like a fork. Swallows catch bugs while they are flying in the sky. They build their nests out of mud and stick them under roofs or on walls. Some swallows fly to warm places in winter and come back in spring. You can see them swooping and diving in the air.
Caribbean\n\nThe Caribbean is a place with a big blue sea and many islands. The sun is hot, and there are lots of white sandy beaches. Some famous islands are Cuba, Jamaica, and Puerto Rico. The islands have many different plants and animals, even some that are hard to find anywhere else. Long ago, people from Europe, Africa, and India came to live there, so the Caribbean has a mix of many cultures.
Salmon\n\nSalmon is a fish that lives in the ocean and in rivers. It can swim from the ocean into rivers to lay eggs. Many people like to eat salmon. Some salmon are raised on fish farms. The meat of salmon is pink because of the food they eat. If they do not eat that food, the meat is gray. People cook salmon in many ways, like smoking it.
Birth\n\nBirth is when a baby comes out of its mother. For animals that lay eggs, the baby comes out of the egg. For animals like people, the baby comes out of the mother's body. This is how new babies start their life. A mother's body changes to help the baby come out safely.
Marathon\n\nA marathon is a very long running race. People run 26 miles in a marathon. That is a very long way. Runners must practice a lot before they can finish a marathon. The race is named after a battle a long time ago. A man named Pheidippides ran a long way to tell people good news. Today, many marathons happen all over the world.
Pesticide\n\nA pesticide is a special chemical that people use to kill small animals they do not want. These unwanted animals are called pests. Pests can be bugs, tiny germs that hurt plants, or other things that are bad for people. But many pesticides are also bad for people and the world around us. They can make water dirty and hurt fish and other animals that live in water. Pesticides can also kill good bugs that help flowers and plants grow. Sometimes there are other ways to get rid of pests without using chemicals.
Computer graphics\n\nComputer graphics are pictures made with a computer. They can be one picture or many pictures that move, like in a movie or a video game. People use computer graphics to make movies, video games, and art. Some computer graphics are flat, like a drawing on paper. Others look like real things because they have height, width, and depth. Flat pictures are called 2D, and they can be made with lines and shapes or tiny dots called pixels. Pictures that look real are called 3D, and they are used in movies and video games. People use special computer programs to make these graphics.
Citrus\n\nCitrus is a kind of plant that grows fruit. These plants are like small trees or bushes with flowers. The fruit they make is called citrus fruit. Oranges, lemons, limes, and grapefruits are all citrus fruits. Citrus plants grow in warm places like Asia and Australia. People have been growing them for a very long time. The fruits taste sour or sweet and are good to eat.
Pterosaur\n\nA pterosaur was a flying reptile that lived a long time ago, at the same time as the dinosaurs. Some pterosaurs were small, but others grew very big. The biggest one, Quetzalcoatlus, had wings as wide as a big house. Pterosaurs were the first animals with backbones to fly by flapping their wings. Their wings were made of skin that stretched from their body to a very long finger. Some pterosaurs had long tails and teeth, while others had short tails and no teeth. They ate fish or insects. Pterosaurs are not alive today; they all died out a very long time ago.
Samoa\n\nSamoa is a country in the Pacific Ocean. It has two big islands called Upolu and Savai'i. The capital city is Apia, on the island of Upolu. People in Samoa speak Samoan and English. The most popular sport in Samoa is Rugby, and many Samoans play it. Samoa is near the equator, halfway between Hawai'i and New Zealand. The weather is warm. Many people in Samoa are Samoan, and some have mixed European and Polynesian family. Samoan people have special tattoos for boys and girls. The boys' tattoo is called Pe'a, and the girls' tattoo is called malu.
Fish\n\nA fish is an animal that lives in water. Fish breathe through special parts called gills. Most fish have scales on their body and fins to help them swim. Fish come in many sizes. Some are smaller than your finger. The biggest fish is the whale shark, which can be as long as a school bus. Fish live in rivers, lakes, and oceans. Some fish live in fresh water, and some live in salt water. Fish eat tiny plants, small animals, or other fish. People eat many kinds of fish, like tuna and salmon. Fish are very old animals. They were on Earth a long time before people.
Yin and yang\n\nYin and yang is a Chinese symbol from an old belief called Taoism. It looks like a circle with two parts: one black and one white. The black part has a little white dot, and the white part has a little black dot. This shows that things that seem opposite, like day and night or hot and cold, actually need each other. The symbol reminds us that we should not have too much or too little of something, like food. You can see this symbol on pictures, in movies, and on some artwork.
Stickleback\n\nA stickleback is a small fish that lives in fresh water in Europe, Asia, and North America. It has no scales, but some have bony plates on their body. Sticklebacks have sharp spines on their back. They eat tiny animals like small bugs and fish babies. The male stickleback builds a nest from plants and uses a sticky stuff from his body to hold it together. He then shows the nest to a female, and she lays her eggs inside. The male takes care of the eggs until they hatch. Some sticklebacks are bold and like to take risks, while others are shy.
Neptune\n\nNeptune is a big, blue planet far, far away from the Sun. It is the eighth planet from the Sun and the farthest one. Neptune is very cold and has the strongest winds of any planet. The winds blow faster than any storm on Earth. Neptune looks blue because of a tiny bit of something called methane in its air. A spaceship named Voyager 2 flew by Neptune in 1989 and saw a big dark spot, like a storm. Neptune has five thin rings around it, but they are hard to see. No one has visited Neptune since Voyager 2.
Frying\n\nFrying is a way to cook food in hot butter or oil. You can fry food in a little bit of fat in a pan or in a lot of oil in a pot. Some restaurants fry a big amount of food in a lot of oil. When you fry food, it gets hot and crispy on the outside.
Guild\n\nA guild is a group of people who do the same kind of work, like making bread or building houses. Long ago, in towns, these groups helped teach new workers how to do the job. A new person had to learn from a master for many years before they could work on their own. There were guilds for bakers, blacksmiths, weavers, and many other jobs. Some guilds still exist today, like the ones in London that help choose the city's leader.
Social network\n\nA social network is a group of people who know each other and spend time together. They can be friends, family, or people who like the same things. People in a social network help each other and share fun times. Most people have a few hundred friends they know well. Social networks can be small, like a family, or big, like a town. Sometimes people in a network do not help when they should, but usually everyone works together to stay safe and happy.
Decibel\n\nA decibel is a way to measure how loud a sound is. It tells us if a sound is soft or very loud. A whisper is about 20 decibels. A normal talk is about 60 decibels. A loud rock concert can be 120 decibels. Sounds that are too loud can hurt your ears. People use earplugs to protect their ears from very loud sounds.
Dinner\n\nDinner is a meal that people eat. In many places, dinner is the big meal you eat in the early evening. Sometimes dinner means a meal in the middle of the day. Dinner can have many different foods, like meat, vegetables, and bread. On special days like Thanksgiving and Christmas, families eat a big dinner together.
Cape Town\n\nCape Town is a big city in South Africa. It is on the coast near the bottom of Africa. The city has a big flat-topped mountain called Table Mountain. Many people visit to see the mountain and the ocean. The weather is warm and sunny in summer. The country's leaders meet in Cape Town to make rules for South Africa.
Thor\n\nThor is a make-believe god from old stories. He is the god of thunder and lightning. Thor is very strong and protects people. He has a magic hammer that always comes back to his hand. Thor rides in a chariot pulled by two goats. Thursday is named after Thor.
Eclipse\n\nAn eclipse is when one thing in the sky blocks the light from another thing. A solar eclipse happens when the Moon moves in front of the Sun. The sky gets dark for a little while. A lunar eclipse happens when the Earth blocks the Sun's light from reaching the Moon. The Moon looks red or dark. Eclipses do not happen very often.
Flying disc\n\nA flying disc is a round, flat toy that you can throw. It has a thick edge that helps you hold it and throw it. When you throw it, you make it spin so it stays steady in the air. People play games with flying discs, like Ultimate and Disc Golf. You can throw a flying disc in many ways, like a backhand or a forehand. Some flying discs are light and can fly very far. The spin keeps the disc from wobbling and falling.
Siren\n\nA siren is a make-believe creature from old stories. Long ago, people said sirens looked like birds with women's heads. Today, many people think sirens look like mermaids. Sirens live on an island with rocks all around. They sing a very pretty song. Sailors hear the song and want to go to the sirens. But the sailors' boats crash into the rocks, and the sailors fall into the water. In one story, a man named Odysseus puts wax in his men's ears so they cannot hear the song. He ties himself to the boat so he cannot go to the sirens. When they pass the island, his men hold him tight until the song is gone.
Newt\n\nA newt is a small animal that lives in water and on land. It is a kind of salamander. Newts are found in North America, Europe, and North Asia. A baby newt starts as an egg in the water.
