Equatorial Guinea\n\nEquatorial Guinea is a small country in Africa. It is next to Cameroon and Gabon, and near the ocean. Part of the country is on the mainland, and part is on islands. The capital city is called Ciudad de la Paz, and it is on an island called Bioko. A long time ago, Spain ruled this country, so many people there speak Spanish. The country is split into eight parts called provinces.
Beauty\n\nBeauty is when something is nice to look at, hear, feel, taste, smell, or think about. A person can be beautiful too. Beauty is also a feeling that is hard to describe. Different people think different things are beautiful. Some people think a pretty flower is beautiful. Some people think a song is beautiful. No one knows for sure if only people can feel beauty.
Botany\n\nBotany is the study of plants. It is a kind of science. People who study botany are called botanists. They learn how plants grow, eat, and make seeds. Botany helps us know why trees are big and flowers are pretty.
Cape Verde\n\nCape Verde is a country made of islands in the Atlantic Ocean, near the west coast of Africa. The islands are from volcanoes. The sun shines almost every day, and the weather is warm. There are two seasons: a windy season and a rainy season. Many birds and reptiles live only on these islands. People grow coffee, bananas, and corn. A popular food is a stew called cachupa. The capital city is Praia. People speak Portuguese. Cape Verde used to belong to Portugal, but it became its own country in 1975.
Food group\n\nA food group is a bunch of foods that are alike. People who help us eat healthy put foods into groups. For example, milk, cheese, and yogurt are in the dairy group. Some people say kids should have some dairy every day. But grown-ups might not need it. Different countries have different food groups. In Canada, there are four main food groups. All other foods are called "another."
Zebra\n\nA zebra is a horse that lives in Africa. It has black and white stripes all over its body. No two zebras have the same stripes. Zebras have short fur because they live in hot places. They eat grass and stay near water. Zebras live in big groups called herds. They like to be together and sometimes clean each other. A baby zebra is called a foal. Zebras are in danger of disappearing.
Plain\n\nA plain is a big, flat piece of land with no hills or mountains. The ground is smooth and easy to walk on. Farmers like plains because they can grow food there.
Old World monkey\n\nOld World monkeys are animals that live in Africa and Asia. They have tails, but their tails cannot grab things like some other monkeys' tails can. Some Old World monkeys are baboons and macaques. They can be small or big. The smallest is the talapoin, and the biggest is the mandrill. Most of them live in groups. Girl monkeys stay with their mothers for their whole lives. Boy monkeys leave the group when they grow up. They live in many different places, like forests, grasslands, and mountains.
Zagros Mountains\n\nThe Zagros Mountains are a very long line of big, tall mountains. They are in Iran and Iraq, and also a little bit in Turkey. The mountains go all the way from near a big lake in Turkey down to the Persian Gulf. Some of the mountains are so high that snow stays on top all year. There is oil deep under these mountains.
Land\n\nLand is the dry part of Earth that is not covered by water. About 29 out of every 100 parts of Earth are land. The rest is water. Land can be covered with dirt, sand, rocks, or grass. Some land has forests with many trees. Some land is used for farms where people grow food or keep animals. Cities and towns are built on land too. The biggest pieces of land are called continents. Smaller pieces of land with water all around are called islands. Land can change over a very long time. When big pieces of rock under the ground push together, they can make mountains. Volcanoes can make new islands. Some land wears away and sinks into the ocean.
Beirut\n\nBeirut is a big city by the sea. It is the capital of Lebanon. The city sits on a hill next to the blue Mediterranean Sea. To the east, there are tall mountains with snow on top. People have lived in Beirut for a very long time. It is a rich city with many banks and newspapers. Some people call it the Paris of the Middle East because it is so pretty and busy.
Voting\n\nVoting is when people say what they want to decide something. It can be for picking a leader or making a rule. People vote in small groups, like friends choosing a game, or in big groups, like a country picking a president. After everyone votes, the votes are counted. The side with the most votes wins. In some votes, each person gets one choice. In other votes, people can rank their top picks. Voting is how people in a democracy make choices together.
Cutlery\n\nCutlery is the name for tools we use to eat food. The most common cutlery is a knife, a spoon, and a fork. Some cutlery is made of shiny metal like silver or steel. Some cutlery is made of plastic and can be thrown away after one use. People use different cutlery for different foods. For example, you use a spoon for soup and a fork for noodles. In some countries, people eat with chopsticks instead of a knife and fork.
Soy milk\n\nSoy milk is a drink that looks like milk but is made from soybeans. Soybeans are small beans that grow in pods. People grind the beans with water to make soy milk. It comes from China, where soybeans first grew. Later, people in Japan also started making it. You can drink soy milk cold or warm. Some people drink it because they cannot drink cow's milk.
Ghana\n\nGhana is a country in West Africa. It is very warm there because it is near the middle of the Earth. Many people live in Ghana, and the biggest city is called Accra. Ghana has a big lake called Lake Volta. People in Ghana grow cocoa to make chocolate. They also find gold and diamonds in the ground. Football is the most popular game to play and watch. The national football team is called the Black Stars. Ghana has two seasons: a rainy season and a dry season.
Moth\n\nA moth is an insect with wings, just like a butterfly. Most moths come out at night. They have little feathery feelers on their heads. When they rest, their wings lie flat on their back. Many moths are very small. Some moths are pests because their babies, called caterpillars, eat farmers' plants. Other moth caterpillars eat wool clothes and blankets. People farm some moths, like the silkworm, to get silk for making soft cloth. Moths fly toward bright lights at night. They help flowers that open at night by carrying pollen from one flower to another. Bats and some birds eat moths. Some moths make sounds to trick bats.
Philippine Sea\n\nThe Philippine Sea is a big body of salt water. It is east of the Philippines and Taiwan. This sea is part of the big Pacific Ocean. It sits on a big piece of the earth's crust called the Philippine Plate.
North America\n\nNorth America is a very big piece of land on Earth. It is between two big oceans: the Pacific Ocean and the Atlantic Ocean. The Arctic Ocean is to the north. North America has many countries, like the United States, Canada, and Mexico. It also has warm islands like the Bahamas. A long time ago, North America was connected to other lands by bridges of land. Now it is connected to South America. Many people live in North America.
Mammoth\n\nA mammoth is a big animal that lived long ago, like an elephant with long, curved tusks. Mammoths had thick, shaggy hair to keep them warm in cold places. They lived in Africa, Europe, Asia, and North America. Some mammoths lived until about 4,000 years ago. Early people hunted mammoths for food. Mammoths are gone now, but we find their bones and tusks in the ground.
Cabbage\n\nCabbage is a plant that you can eat. It looks like a big round ball made of many leaves. Cabbage is green or sometimes red. People eat cabbage in many ways. They can put it in salads or make it into coleslaw. Some people make sauerkraut or kimchi with cabbage. Cabbage tastes a little bit like broccoli or cauliflower. You can find cabbage in the grocery store.
Decomposition\n\nDecomposition is what happens to plants and animals when they die. They slowly break down and turn back into dirt. Tiny living things like bacteria and fungi eat the dead plants and animals. That is how they get food and energy. Sometimes little bugs called maggots help eat the dead body. After a long time, everything that was once alive becomes part of the soil again.
Galley\n\nA galley is a kind of ship that people move by rowing with long sticks called oars. Long ago, people in Egypt and Greece used galleys for fighting and trading. Some galleys had two or three rows of oars on each side, stacked on top of each other. War galleys had long, skinny bodies and a sharp point at the front to hit other ships. Merchant ships were wider and used sails more. The Vikings had small galleys called longships that could hold about 50 or 60 people. Later, ships with only sails became more common, but galleys were still used in battles until about 500 years ago.
Cherry\n\nA cherry is a small fruit that grows on a tree or a bush. It is red and has a little seed inside. Cherries taste a bit sour. People put them in cakes, ice cream, and pies. They are good for you because they have vitamins. Many cherries come from Turkey, the United States, and Iran.
Reggae\n\nReggae is a kind of music that comes from a place called Jamaica. It started a long time ago, in the 1960s. Reggae music has a special beat that makes you want to move. The guitar plays a sound called a "skank" on the off-beat. The drums hit on the second and fourth beat. Reggae bands also use a bass, a keyboard, and horns like trumpets and saxophones. Many reggae songs are about love, being happy, or helping people. Bob Marley is the most famous reggae singer. Other singers are Peter Tosh, Jimmy Cliff, and Ziggy Marley. Reggae music became very popular in the 1970s.
Calendar\n\nA calendar is a tool that helps people keep track of days. It gives each day a name and a number, like a date. People use calendars to remember when something happened or to plan for something that will happen. The year and month are based on how the Sun and Moon move in the sky. Farmers use calendars to know when to plant their crops. There are many kinds of calendars, like the one most people use today called the Gregorian calendar.
Market\n\nA market is a place where people go to buy or sell things. Sellers set up stalls, like little tents, to show what they have. Some markets are inside a building, and some are outside in an open space. After the day is done, the sellers take their stalls down. The word "market" can also mean how many people want to buy something. For example, if lots of people want to buy toys, we say there is a big market for toys.
Iris (plant)\n\nAn iris is a flower that grows in many colors like purple, yellow, white, and blue. Its name comes from a word that means rainbow. Irises are easy to grow and can stay outside all winter. They have three big petals that hang down and three petals that stand up. Some irises have soft hairs in the middle, like a little beard. Butterflies and hummingbirds like to visit irises. People also pick irises to put in vases because they are pretty.
Rhyme\n\nRhyme is when words sound the same at the end. Poems and songs often use rhyme. Nursery rhymes are fun to say because they rhyme. For example, 'cat' and 'hat' rhyme. Some rhymes are not exact, like 'bone' and 'home'. Dr. Seuss books have many funny rhymes.
Chair\n\nA chair is something you sit on. It can be made of wood, plastic, metal, or fabric. Some chairs have arms to rest your elbows. A rocking chair moves back and forth. A bean bag chair is soft and squishy. A sofa is a long chair for more than one person. Chairs are in homes, schools, and cars.
Lake Titicaca\n\nLake Titicaca is a very big, deep lake high up in the Andes mountains. Part of it is in Peru and part is in Bolivia. It is the biggest lake in South America. Many boats use this lake to carry things from one place to another. The lake has 41 islands. Some islands have people living on them. The Uros people make floating islands out of thick reeds that grow in the lake. They build houses and watchtowers on these reed islands. Another island called Amantani has two mountain peaks with old ruins on top. People there grow wheat, potatoes, and vegetables. Taquile island is famous for weaving and knitting. Isla del Sol has many old ruins from the Inca people. The lake is home to many water animals, like the big Titicaca water frog and a bird that cannot fly. The water level has been going down because of less rain and melting ice. People are trying to keep the lake clean and safe for the animals.
Easter\n\nEaster is a special day in spring. Some people celebrate it because they believe Jesus came back to life after he died. Other people celebrate it as a fun spring holiday. On Easter, many children get baskets with candy. They also decorate eggs with pretty colors and hide them for the Easter Bunny to find. People wear new clothes and go to church. Families sometimes take trips to see each other or go to the beach. Easter happens in March or April, but not on the same day every year.
Mobile device\n\nA mobile device is a small machine you can carry with you. It works without being plugged into a wall because it has a battery inside. A phone is a mobile device. A tablet is also a mobile device. You can use it to play games, listen to music, and look at pictures. It can connect to the internet without wires. You can take it anywhere you go.
Climate change\n\nClimate change is when the weather on Earth changes over a very long time. The Earth can get hotter or colder. Right now, the Earth is getting hotter because people are doing things that make the air warm up. When we burn things like gas and coal, it puts bad stuff into the air. This makes the Earth warmer. When the Earth gets warmer, the ice at the North and South Poles melts, and the water in the ocean rises. It can also make storms stronger. A long time ago, before there were people, the Earth was sometimes very hot and sometimes very cold. There were ice ages when a lot of the Earth was covered in ice. The Sun also changes a little bit every 11 years, but that is not why the Earth is getting hot now. People can use clean energy from the sun, wind, and water to help stop the Earth from getting too hot.
Hagfish\n\nA hagfish is a long, slimy sea animal that looks like an eel but is not an eel. It has no bones, only a skull made of hard rubbery stuff. Hagfish live at the bottom of the ocean. They have small eyes that do not work well, so they use their nose and whiskers to find food. They eat dead fish and worms. When a hagfish is scared, it makes a lot of slime from its sides. The slime puffs up big in the water. Some people in Korea eat hagfish. People also use hagfish skin to make wallets and belts. Scientists are studying hagfish slime to make new things.
Priest\n\nA priest is a person who works in a church and helps people learn about God. Priests lead prayers and teach about being good. Some priests are in charge of a church and the people who go there. To become a priest, you have to study a lot. In some churches, priests cannot get married. In other churches, they can. Some churches let women be priests, and some do not. There are also priests in other religions, like Buddhism and Shinto in Japan.
Cambodia\n\nCambodia is a country in Southeast Asia, near Vietnam, Laos, and Thailand. About 13 million people live there. The people are called Cambodians or Khmer, and they speak Khmer. Long ago, Cambodia had a big empire called Angkor. A famous temple from that time is Angkor Wat, which is the biggest religious building in the world. Most people in Cambodia follow Buddhism. The country has a big river called the Mekong that runs through the middle. People eat rice, noodles, and soup for breakfast. They celebrate New Year in April. The flag has a picture of Angkor Wat on it. People use boats, cars, motorcycles, and even elephants to get around.
Wales\n\nWales is a country that is part of the United Kingdom. It is west of England and next to the Irish Sea. The people who live in Wales are called the Welsh. They have their own language, called Welsh, and many children learn it in school. Most people in Wales also speak English. The capital city is Cardiff, and it is the biggest city. Three million people live in Wales. Wales has high mountains, like Snowdon, which is the tallest. There are also three national parks with beautiful nature. Welsh people are proud of their country. They have a special festival called Eisteddfod where they sing and share stories. Rugby is a very popular sport in Wales. The national flowers are the leek and the daffodil.
Shaving\n\nShaving is cutting hair off your face or body with a special tool called a razor. Men often shave the hair on their face. Some men cut their face hair short, and some take it all off. A man who does not shave his chin has a goatee. A man who does not shave above his mouth has a mustache. Some men also shave all the hair off their head to be bald. In many armies, soldiers have to shave their heads.
Geological history of Earth\n\nThe geological history of Earth is the story of how our planet changed from the very beginning until now. A long, long time ago, Earth was very hot and had no plants or animals. Over millions of years, the ground cooled down and became hard rock. Scientists look at rocks and layers of dirt to learn about what happened long ago. They give different names to different times, like when dinosaurs lived or when big ice covered the land.
Sardinia\n\nSardinia is a big island in the middle of the sea. It is the second biggest island in the Mediterranean Sea. Sardinia is part of Italy, and the biggest city there is called Cagliari. The island has mountains, valleys, and rivers. The highest mountain is Punta La Marmora. There are also many small islands around Sardinia. People in Sardinia speak Italian and also a special language called Sardinian.
International Space Station\n\nThe International Space Station is a big home in space where people can live for many months. It was built by many countries working together, including the United States, Russia, Europe, Japan, and Canada. The first part went up in 1998, and people have lived there since the year 2000. The station goes around the Earth very fast, so the sun rises and sets 16 times every day. Astronauts sleep in sleeping bags stuck to the wall so they do not float away. There is no gravity in space, so everything floats. Astronauts have to exercise every day to keep their legs strong. They eat food from pouches and drink water from bags. They clean themselves with wet cloths because water floats around. The toilet uses air to suck away waste instead of water.
Empathy\n\nEmpathy is when you can feel what another person feels. If your friend is sad, you feel sad too. If your friend is happy, you feel happy too. Empathy helps you be kind and help others. Most people have empathy. Some people have trouble feeling what others feel.
Allosaurus\n\nAllosaurus was a big dinosaur that ate meat. It lived a long, long time ago, in a time called the Jurassic. It walked on two strong back legs and had two smaller arms with three fingers and sharp claws. Its tail was long and heavy, and it helped the dinosaur balance. Allosaurus had a big head with lots of sharp teeth. It was one of the biggest meat-eating dinosaurs of its time. Allosaurus probably hunted other dinosaurs like Stegosaurus and Apatosaurus. Some scientists think Allosaurus may have hunted in groups, like a pack of wolves. Others think they fought each other. Many Allosaurus bones have been found in a place in Utah called the Cleveland-Lloyd Dinosaur Quarry. That is why we know a lot about this dinosaur. Allosaurus is the state fossil of Utah.
Symbiosis\n\nSymbiosis is when two different kinds of living things live together for a long time. Sometimes both are helped, and sometimes one is helped and the other is hurt. For example, a flower and a bee help each other. The bee gets food, and the flower gets its seeds spread. Some tiny living things live inside bigger ones, like the helpers in your tummy that help you digest food. Almost every plant and animal has these helpers. A long time ago, even the tiny parts inside your cells used to be separate living things that started living together.
Stockholm\n\nStockholm is the biggest city in Sweden and the capital. It is built on many islands with water all around. There are 14 islands and 57 bridges. The old part of the city is called Gamla Stan, which means "Old Town." There is a big park on an island called Djurgården, where you can see animals at Skansen zoo. Stockholm is sometimes called the "Venice of the North" because of all the water.
Arcade game\n\nAn arcade game is a fun machine that you play with coins. You can find arcade games in places like restaurants and game rooms. Some arcade games are pinball tables where you hit a ball with flippers. Other arcade games are video games on big screens. People put a coin in the machine to start playing.
Cave\n\nA cave is a big hole under the ground. It is dark and cool inside. Caves are made when water wears away soft rock over a very long time. Some caves have long, skinny tunnels and big rooms. Water dripping in caves can make pointy rocks that look like icicles. Some caves have pretty paintings on the walls from long ago. Many animals live in caves, like bats, mice, and spiders. Bats like to hang upside down from the ceiling. People sometimes explore caves for fun. They wear helmets with lights so they can see in the dark.
Venom\n\nVenom is a special poison that some animals make inside their bodies. They use it to hurt other animals. A snake can bite and put venom into another animal. A bee can sting and put venom into you. Some animals use venom to catch food to eat. Other animals use venom to protect themselves from danger. Venom is not the same for every animal.
Magnetic field\n\nA magnetic field is the space around a magnet where the magnet can pull or push things. You cannot see it, but you can feel it when a magnet sticks to your fridge. The field has lines that go from one end of the magnet to the other. If you put tiny iron pieces near a magnet, they line up along these lines. The closer the lines are, the stronger the magnet. Magnets always have two ends: a north end and a south end. Opposite ends pull together, and same ends push apart.
Amplifier\n\nAn amplifier is a thing that makes sound louder. It is used with electric guitars, radios, and TVs. The amplifier takes a small sound and makes it big so you can hear it. It needs electricity or a battery to work. The big sound goes to a speaker. Some amplifiers use old glass tubes, and some use new parts called transistors. Tube amplifiers are heavy and get hot. Transistor amplifiers are lighter and cheaper. If an amplifier tries to make sound too loud, the sound gets scratchy. That is called distortion. Some people like the scratchy sound from tubes.
Calgary\n\nCalgary is a big city in Canada, in a place called Alberta. It is near the Rocky Mountains, which are very tall. Many people live in Calgary. The city has tall buildings called skyscrapers because there are many oil and gas businesses. Around Calgary there are farms with cows. In the winter, it is cold and dry, but sometimes a warm wind called a chinook blows through and makes it less cold. In the summer, it is warm and rainy. Every year, Calgary has a big party called the Calgary Stampede. There are rides, a festival, and cowboys race with horses and carts. In 1988, the Winter Olympics were held in Calgary. The city also has museums and an ice hockey team called the Calgary Flames.
Moulting\n\nMoulting is when an animal gets rid of its old skin, fur, feathers, or shell. It happens at certain times of the year or as the animal grows. Birds lose old feathers and grow new ones. Dogs and other furry animals shed their old hair. Snakes and lizards crawl out of their old skin. Bugs and crabs grow a new hard shell after they shed the old one. The new covering is soft at first but gets hard later.
Tango\n\nTango is a dance that people do with a partner. It was first made in Buenos Aires, a big city in Argentina. The music for this dance is also called tango. Today, there are two main ways to dance tango. One way is called Argentine tango, and it is very old. The other way is called international tango, and it is danced in contests all over the world. Both ways are fun and special.
Patent\n\nA patent is a special paper from the government that says an inventor made something new. It stops other people from making or using that thing without asking. The inventor can sell the patent to someone else. A patent lasts for up to 20 years. After that, anyone can copy the invention. To get a patent, the inventor must write down how the invention works and send it to the government. The government checks if the idea is really new. If it is, the government gives the inventor a patent. The inventor must pay money to get and keep the patent. The patent owner can let other people use the invention if they pay money. Patents cover many things like toys, medicines, and machines.
Patagonia\n\nPatagonia is a place at the bottom of South America. Two countries, Argentina and Chile, share this land. It has big mountains called the Andes and very pretty views. The name Patagonia comes from a word used long ago for the people who lived there. Those people were very tall. Many animals live in Patagonia. You can find guanacos, cougars, and foxes on the plains. In the water, there are whales, penguins, and orcas. Some parts of Patagonia are special nature places that people keep safe.
Sea of Okhotsk\n\nThe Sea of Okhotsk is a big body of water next to the Pacific Ocean. It is near Russia and Japan. In winter, the water gets very cold and big pieces of ice make it hard for boats to travel. Some islands in this sea have no people living on them. Seals, sea lions, and seabirds like to live there and have their babies.
Triangle\n\nA triangle is a shape with three straight sides and three corners. The three sides are all straight lines. The three corners are called vertices. If you add up the three angles inside a triangle, they always make 180. That is like a half turn. A triangle is the shape with the fewest sides of any shape with straight sides. Some triangles have two sides that are the same length. Some triangles have all three sides the same length. Some triangles have one square corner. Computers use many small triangles to draw pictures on a screen. You can find the area of a triangle by multiplying the bottom side by the height and then taking half.
Cube\n\nA cube is a shape that looks like a box. It has six flat sides, and all sides are the same size. Each side is a square. A cube has 8 corners, 12 edges, and 6 faces. A dice is a cube. You can hold a cube in your hand. It is not flat like a square; it is a 3D shape.
Tortoise\n\nA tortoise is a reptile that lives on land. It has a hard shell on its back to keep it safe. Most tortoises are small, but some that live on islands can be very big. The tortoises on the Galapagos islands are famous for being large. Tortoises move very slowly. Their shells take a very long time to break down after they die.
Capital (economics)\n\nCapital is something people use to make things or start a business. It can be money, tools, or machines. For example, a baker uses an oven to bake bread. The oven is capital. People also use capital to build houses or make toys. Without capital, it is hard to make new things.
Amman\n\nAmman is a big city and the capital of a country called Jordan. It is the largest city in that country and many people live there. Amman sits on 20 hills in the middle of Jordan. It is a very old city, one of the oldest in the world. People have lived there for thousands of years. Today, Amman is a busy place where people go for work, school, and to see doctors. Many visitors from other countries come to Amman. The city has a special day on March 2 called "city of Amman day" to celebrate.
Sunbird\n\nA sunbird is a small bird with a long, curved beak. Many sunbirds have bright, shiny feathers, especially the boy birds. They live in warm places near the middle of the world. Sunbirds like to drink sweet water from flowers. They also eat little bugs and spiders. Some sunbirds can flap their wings very fast and stay in one spot in the air, like a hummingbird. But most of the time, they sit on a branch to eat.
Instinct\n\nAn instinct is something animals are born knowing how to do. They do not learn it. A baby sea turtle hatches on the beach and walks to the ocean all by itself. A baby kangaroo climbs into its mother's pouch right after it is born. Birds know how to build nests without anyone teaching them. Some instincts are like reflexes, like when a baby roots for milk. Animals follow their instincts without thinking about it.
Keyboard instrument\n\nA keyboard instrument is something you play by pressing keys. The keys are usually white and black. When you press a key, it makes a sound. Some keyboard instruments are very old, like the harpsichord. Others are new and use electricity, like the synthesizer. People call an electronic keyboard just a "keyboard." You can play many different sounds on it. Some keyboards can even play drum sounds and help you make songs. Many people use keyboards to play music alone or in a band.
Tower Bridge\n\nTower Bridge is a bridge in London that can open up to let big boats pass. It goes over the River Thames. The bridge has two tall towers and a walkway high up. When a tall ship comes, the middle part of the bridge lifts up like a seesaw. This happens about 900 times each year. Many people visit London to see Tower Bridge. You can go inside the walkway and look out over the city. The bridge was built a long time ago, in 1894. It is made of steel and covered with stone. The bridge used steam engines to lift, but now it uses oil and electricity.
Moat\n\nA moat is a deep, wide ditch filled with water around a castle. It helped keep enemies out. Enemies could not swim across easily, and they could not dig under the castle walls. Moats also stopped fires from reaching the castle. Some moats were dry and had no water. In stories, moats have alligators, but that is not true. Sometimes people put fish in moats for food.
Musical instrument\n\nA musical instrument is something people use to make music. You can blow into it, hit it, or shake it to make sounds. Some instruments have strings you pluck or rub. A big group of instruments playing together is called an orchestra. Your own voice can also make music when you sing, and that does not need any instrument at all.
Thunderstorm\n\nA thunderstorm is a big storm with strong wind, heavy rain, lightning, and loud thunder. Thunderstorms happen when warm, wet air near the ground rises up fast into the sky. The air turns into big, tall clouds that can look like a mushroom. Lightning is a big flash of light that jumps between clouds or from a cloud to the ground. Thunder is the loud boom that comes after lightning, because light travels faster than sound. Thunderstorms can be dangerous. They can bring very strong winds, big hail that is like hard ice balls, and too much rain that causes floods. Lightning can start fires and hurt people. But thunderstorms also help us. They give water to plants and animals, cool down hot days, and clean the air. Lightning even helps make food for plants. After a thunderstorm, you might see a rainbow in the sky.
Arabian horse\n\nThe Arabian horse is a special kind of horse that is very old and comes from the desert. It has a triangle-shaped head, big eyes, large nostrils, and a small nose. Its tail is held up high. Arabian horses are very fast and can run for a long time without getting tired. They are also very friendly and learn to love people easily. Long ago, people called Bedouins lived in the desert and kept these horses close, even inside their tents. Today, Arabian horses live all over the world. They can be many colors like bay, gray, chestnut, black, white, or brown. They are used for racing, shows, and riding for fun. Some famous people like George Washington and Napoleon had Arabian horses.
Hill\n\nA hill is a big bump of land that goes up high. It is not as tall as a mountain. Hills are not very steep, so you can walk up them. Some hills are covered with grass and trees. Long ago, people built forts on top of hills to stay safe.
Textile arts\n\nTextile arts are crafts where people use threads or fibers to make things like clothes, blankets, or pretty decorations. People have been doing this for a very long time, even since the first cities were built. Long ago, special colors and fabrics were very expensive, so only rich people could wear them. People traded these fabrics across countries on roads like the Silk Road. Later, machines were invented to make cloth faster, but some workers were sad because they lost their jobs.
Accordion\n\nAn accordion is a musical instrument that you can hold in your hands. It has keys like a piano or buttons to press. When you push and pull the middle part, called bellows, air goes through and makes sounds. The accordion was first made a long time ago in Germany and Austria. People play it in many kinds of music.
Cumulus cloud\n\nCumulus clouds are big white clouds that look like cauliflower. They have flat bottoms and bumpy tops that keep changing shape. When you see a cumulus cloud, it means the air is moving up and down. If a cumulus cloud grows very tall, it can turn into a storm cloud called a cumulonimbus.
Archive\n\nAn archive is a place where old papers, pictures, and other things are kept safe for a long time. These things are special because they are the only ones like them. People called archivists take care of the archive. They make sure the old things do not get lost or broken. Big groups like companies and governments have archives too. An archive is different from a library because the things in an archive are not books you can buy in a store.
Compass\n\nA compass is a tool that helps you find your way. It has a little arrow that always points to the north. When you hold a compass, you can see which way is north, south, east, and west. This helps you know where to go, even in a big forest or on a wide ocean. A long time ago, people in China made the first compass out of a special rock that could point north.
Baltic Sea\n\nThe Baltic Sea is a big body of water in northern Europe. It sits between countries like Sweden, Finland, Russia, Poland, and Germany. Many rivers from nearby lands flow into this sea. The Baltic Sea is only connected to the big ocean by narrow, shallow waterways. Because of that, the water has very little salt. In winter, the northern part of the sea freezes into ice. The ice is so thick that cars can drive on it. Every winter, people make roads on the ice between islands near Sweden and Finland. For thousands of years, the Baltic Sea has helped people travel and trade between the countries around it. That is why those countries share many of the same customs and ways of life.
Swamp\n\nA swamp is a wet, muddy place on land. It is like a forest that is covered with water. Many trees and water plants grow there. Birds and other animals make their homes and raise their babies in swamps. The water in a swamp can be fresh or salty. Swamps help keep the ground clean and stop floods. Some swamps are very big and are found near big rivers like the Amazon.
European honey bee\n\nThe European honey bee is a small bug that makes honey. It lives in a hive with many other bees. The bees work together to find food. When a bee finds sweet juice from flowers, it flies back to the hive and does a special dance to show the other bees where the food is. The bees use the sweet juice to make honey, which people like to eat.
Port-au-Prince\n\nPort-au-Prince is a big city and the capital of Haiti. It is the largest city in Haiti, and many people live there. The city has a big port where ships bring things like coffee and sugar to other countries. There is also an airport near the city. In 2010, a very strong earthquake hurt the city and many people died. The city is still fixing the broken buildings.
Submarine\n\nA submarine is a boat that can go underwater. Big submarines are used by the army. Small ones help scientists look at fish and rocks under the sea. Some people buy their own submarine to explore. Early submarines were moved by hand because engines were not invented yet. They were used in wars to try to sink enemy ships. Later, submarines used a diesel engine to make electricity and fill a battery. The battery let the submarine move underwater. Today, many big submarines use a special power called nuclear. This lets them stay underwater for a very long time. Submarines can shoot torpedoes or big missiles. Some submarines are small and fast. Others are big and slow.
Spear\n\nA spear is a long stick with a sharp point at one end. Long ago, people used spears for hunting animals and for fighting. You can hold a spear in your hand and stab with it. Some spears are light and can be thrown far. A special kind of spear called a lance was used by knights riding horses. Another kind called a pike was very long and used to stop horses in battle.
Alexandria\n\nAlexandria is a big city in Egypt. It sits next to the Mediterranean Sea. Many people live there. Long ago, a man named Alexander the Great started this city. It had a huge library with many books. Some smart people lived there and studied. Ships carried food from Alexandria to Rome. Later, the city became smaller and less important.
Canning\n\nCanning is a way to keep food good for a long time. People put food into a jar or can and close it tight so no air can get in. This makes the food last for a year or even longer. Some canned food can stay safe to eat for 30 years. Long ago, people used glass jars for canning, but they were heavy and broke easily. Later, people started using metal cans, which are cheaper and do not break. To open the first cans, people had to hit them with rocks or cut them with knives because can openers were not invented yet. Today, we use can openers to open cans. Some foods, like fruits and pickles, can be canned with just boiling water. Other foods, like meat and vegetables, need to be heated very hot in a special pot to kill tiny germs that can make you sick.
Impact crater\n\nAn impact crater is a big hole in the ground made when a rock from space, called a meteorite, hits the Earth. The rock comes very fast and smashes into the ground, making a round dent. Some craters are very big, but many get worn away by rain and wind over a long time. The Moon has many craters because there is no wind or rain to erase them.
Machu Picchu\n\nMachu Picchu is a very old city high up in the mountains of Peru, in South America. The Incas built it a long time ago, between 1200 and 1450. They cut the mountain rock to make flat places for houses, fields, and temples. They also made places to look at the stars. When the Spanish came, the Incas left the city. No one knows exactly why. The Spanish never found Machu Picchu. It is very hard to get to because it is so high. There is only one way in and a stone wall to protect it. Most people did not know about it until 1911, when a man named Hiram Bingham found it again. Today, people can visit by road, by walking the Inca Trail, or by train. Machu Picchu has more than 150 buildings and over 100 staircases. In the Quechua language, its name means "Old Mountain."
Jainism\n\nJainism is a religion that started a long time ago in India. It teaches that every living thing has a soul. The soul can learn and grow. People who follow Jainism try to be kind to all animals and bugs. They do not hurt any living thing. They also try not to want too many things or be too proud. Some people in this religion are called monks and nuns. They wear simple clothes and walk very carefully so they do not step on tiny bugs.
Jet aircraft\n\nA jet aircraft is a flying machine that uses a special engine called a jet engine. This engine pushes the plane very fast through the air. Jet aircraft fly very high in the sky, much higher than planes with propellers. They can fly for a long time without stopping. You can see jet aircraft in the sky, and they make a loud roaring sound.
Mechanics\n\nMechanics is about how things move. It looks at what makes a toy car roll or a ball fly through the air. A long time ago, a man named Aristotle watched things move. Later, other smart people like Galileo and Newton learned more about moving things. Newton said three important rules about how things move. Mechanics also studies big things like planets and small things like tiny bits of matter.
Leopard\n\nA leopard is a big cat with spots on its fur. It lives in Africa and Asia. Leopards have tan fur with dark spots called rosettes. Some leopards are all black; these are called black panthers. Leopards are very good at climbing trees. They often carry their food up a tree to keep it safe from other animals like lions and hyenas. Leopards like to be alone, unlike lions that live in groups. They hunt at night or in the afternoon. They hide and then jump out to catch their prey. Leopards eat many kinds of animals, like gazelles, birds, and even monkeys. They do not usually eat people, but a sick or hungry leopard might.
Professional wrestling\n\nProfessional wrestling is a show where people pretend to fight. It is like a play, not a real sport. The wrestlers train very hard to do their moves safely. They wrestle inside a ring with ropes around it. The best wrestlers win special belts called championship titles. Some famous wrestlers are Hulk Hogan, The Rock, and John Cena. You can watch professional wrestling on TV or at a big building called an arena. Every year, there is a very big wrestling show called WrestleMania.
Space station\n\nA space station is a big home in the sky that people can live in. It goes around the Earth very high up. Spaceships can visit it to bring food, toys, and new people. The biggest space station right now is called the International Space Station. People live there for many weeks or months. They do science experiments and learn how to stay healthy in space. The first space station was called Salyut 1. Other space stations were Skylab and Mir. Someday there will be a new Chinese space station.
Xylophone\n\nA xylophone is a musical instrument that you hit with a special stick called a mallet. It has wooden bars that are different lengths. When you hit the bars, they make different sounds. The bars are lined up like the keys on a piano. Under the bars there are long tubes that make the sound last longer. The xylophone comes from Africa and Asia. People play it in orchestras. The sound is short and fast, so it is good for quick tunes. Some xylophones have softer sounds and more bars; those are called marimbas. Players usually use two mallets, but very good players can use four.
Alps\n\nThe Alps are a big group of very tall mountains in Europe. They stretch across many countries, like France, Italy, Switzerland, Germany, Austria, and Slovenia. The highest mountain in the Alps is called Mont Blanc. It is so high that snow stays on top all year. People love to visit the Alps. In winter, they go skiing and snowboarding. In summer, they hike and ride bikes on the trails. Many animals live in the Alps, like ibex, chamois, and marmots. The mountains have pretty lakes and green meadows with flowers. Some parts of the Alps have forests with trees like pine and spruce. The weather gets colder as you go higher up the mountain.
Bog\n\nA bog is a wet, spongy place on the ground. It is like a big, soft, muddy field. Bogs are made of old dead plants that pile up very slowly. The water in a bog is not clean like a lake; it is brown and sour. Special moss called Sphagnum grows there. The ground is so wet that old plants do not rot away fast. They stay and turn into a dark, soft material called peat. Bogs are home to special plants and animals that like wet, sour places. The biggest bog in the world is in Africa, and it is as big as a whole country.
Property\n\nProperty is something that belongs to someone. If you buy a toy, that toy is your property. People also call houses and apartments property. Even a story or a song you make can be your property.
Porcelain\n\nPorcelain is a special kind of cup and plate material. It is made from a white clay called kaolin. People heat the clay very hot in a big oven called a kiln. Porcelain is hard and smooth. It can be white or painted with pretty colors. Long ago, people in China first made porcelain. They sent it to other countries. Later, people in Europe learned how to make it too. Some porcelain is so thin you can see light through it. People use porcelain for cups, plates, and little statues.
Village\n\nA village is a small place where people live, usually in the countryside. It is bigger than a tiny hamlet but smaller than a town or city. The houses in a village are close together, not far apart. Long ago, most people lived in villages. They grew their own food and lived near each other. Many villages have a church. Some villages grow bigger and become towns or cities. In some places, a village is a kind of local government. In other places, it is just a name for a group of houses.
Accounting\n\nAccounting is a job where people write down how a business spends and gets money. People who do this job are called accountants. They write in special books called ledgers. Every time money comes in or goes out, they write it down. The ledgers show if the business made more money than it spent. Banks and other people look at these books to decide if they should give the business money. Accounting is very old. People have been doing it for thousands of years, since the time of ancient farms and cities.
Non-fiction\n\nNon-fiction is writing about real things. It tells you facts that are true. Books that teach you about animals, places, or how things work are non-fiction. Some non-fiction books have pictures and words. People write non-fiction to help you learn.
Sydney Opera House\n\nThe Sydney Opera House is a famous building in Australia. It sits next to the water in a place called Sydney Harbour. The building looks like big white sails on a boat. Many people go there to watch shows and listen to music. Every year, there are many concerts and plays inside. The Opera House is a special place that people from all over the world come to see.
Syphon\n\nA syphon is a tube shaped like an upside-down U. It moves water from one place to another without a pump. The water goes up the tube and then down, like going over a little hill. This works because gravity pulls the water down on the other side. People use syphons to water plants in gardens.
Brain\n\nThe brain is the part of your body that helps you think. It tells the rest of your body what to do. Almost all animals have a brain. The brain is made of special cells called nerves. These nerves talk to each other and to other parts of your body. Your brain gets information from your eyes, ears, nose, tongue, and skin. It uses that information to help you see, hear, smell, taste, and feel things. Your brain also tells your muscles to move and your heart to beat. The brain is protected by the hard bones of your skull. It has three main parts: the cerebrum, the cerebellum, and the brainstem. The cerebrum is the biggest part and helps you think and learn. The cerebellum helps you keep your balance and move your muscles together. The brainstem controls things that happen without you thinking, like breathing and blinking. Your brain is very wrinkly, which gives it a big surface. It uses a lot of energy even though it is small.
Sanitation\n\nSanitation is about keeping things clean and safe. It means taking away poop and pee so people do not get sick. It also means throwing away trash and cleaning water. Long ago, sanitation just meant being healthy. Today, many places have toilets that flush away waste. Some toilets do not need water, like dry toilets. Good sanitation keeps germs away and helps everyone stay healthy.
Ross Sea\n\nThe Ross Sea is a big, cold part of the ocean near Antarctica. It is very far away and very cold. Big pieces of ice float in the water. In summer, tiny plants and animals called plankton grow in the water. Fish, seals, and whales eat the plankton. Penguins live on the ice near the Ross Sea. A very big squid was once caught there. The Ross Sea is one of the cleanest seas on Earth because not many people go there.
Lacrosse\n\nLacrosse is a game played by two teams with sticks that have a net on the end. The first people to play lacrosse were Native Americans. They used the game to solve arguments between groups. Now many people play lacrosse in North America. Each team has ten players. One player is the goalie, who stops the ball from going into the goal. The other players try to throw the ball into the other team's goal to score points. The team with the most points at the end wins. The game starts with a face-off, where two players try to get the ball first.
Minimalism\n\nMinimalism is a way of making art or music that uses simple ideas, sounds, or shapes. It became popular in America in the 1960s and 1970s. In music, a short tune or beat is repeated many times, and each time it changes just a little bit. Sometimes two people start playing together, but one goes a tiny bit faster, so they get out of step, and then later they come back together. This music can make you feel like you are in a dream. In art, minimalism uses simple shapes like stripes or squares. The artist Frank Stella painted stripes that were as wide as the wood behind the canvas. Minimalist art does not have a lot of extra stuff. It is simple and clean.
Global Positioning System\n\nThe Global Positioning System, or GPS, is a way to find where you are on Earth. It uses special machines in space called satellites. There are 31 satellites that go around the Earth. A GPS receiver, like the one in a phone or a car, talks to these satellites. It can tell you where you are, how fast you are going, and which way you are moving. Many cars have GPS to help find roads and places to eat. Boats use GPS to stay away from rocks and shallow water. Phones also have GPS to help you find your way. The satellites send signals that the receiver uses to figure out its spot. It needs at least four satellites to work well. GPS was first made for the military, but now everyone can use it.
Romanticism\n\nRomanticism is a way of making art, stories, and music that started a long time ago in Europe. People who liked Romanticism thought feelings and imagination were very important. They loved nature and old stories like fairy tales. They did not like big machines or factories. Some artists and writers from this time are still famous today.
History of North America\n\nThe history of North America is about the people who lived there long ago. The first people came to North America many, many years ago. They were called Native Americans. They lived in different groups, some small and some big. Some groups hunted animals like bison, and others grew food like corn, tomatoes, and squash. Later, people from Europe came on big ships. First came the Vikings, then Christopher Columbus in 1492. Then more people came from Spain, England, and France. They started towns and took land from the Native Americans. There were many wars between the countries. Later, the United States and Mexico became their own countries. People kept moving west, and more towns were built.
Iberian Peninsula\n\nThe Iberian Peninsula is a big piece of land in the southwest part of Europe. It is mostly surrounded by water. To the south and east is the Mediterranean Sea. To the north and west is the Atlantic Ocean. It is the third biggest peninsula in Europe. The name Iberia comes from a very old name used by the Greeks and Romans. Today, Spain is on this peninsula, but the whole piece of land is called Iberia.
Russian literature\n\nRussian literature is made of stories and poems written in the Russian language or by people from Russia. Some famous Russian writers are Leo Tolstoy, Dostoevsky, and Nikolai Gogol. They wrote long books about people, feelings, and adventures. Many people all over the world still read these stories today.
Chicken\n\nA chicken is a bird that people keep on farms. A male chicken is called a rooster, and a female chicken is called a hen. A baby chicken is called a chick. Hens lay eggs, and chicks hatch out of the eggs. People eat chicken eggs for breakfast. They can boil or fry the eggs. People also eat chicken meat. Chicken meat is not very expensive, so many people eat it. Chickens live in a little house called a coop. They sleep there at night. They also need a yard to run around and take dust baths. Farmers use fences to keep chickens safe from animals like foxes and hawks. Some chickens can fly a short distance. Some like to sleep in trees if there are trees nearby.
Archery\n\nArchery is a way to shoot arrows with a bow. A person who does archery is called an archer. Long ago, people used bows and arrows to hunt for food and to fight in battles. Today, archery is a sport where people try to hit a target far away. An archer pulls back the string on the bow and lets the arrow fly. It takes practice to aim well.
String instrument\n\nA string instrument is a thing that makes music when its strings shake. You can pull the strings with your fingers or rub them with a stick called a bow. A violin is a small string instrument. You play it with a bow made of horse hair. When you move the bow across the strings, the strings shake and make sound. You can change the sound by pushing your fingers down on the neck. A viola is like a violin but a little bigger. A cello is even bigger and you play it sitting down. A guitar is a string instrument you strum with your hand or a pick. You hold down strings on the neck to make different notes. People play guitars in rock bands. Some string instruments you pluck, like a banjo.
Boot\n\nA boot is a kind of shoe that covers your foot and goes up your leg. Boots are taller and bigger than regular shoes. Some boots go all the way up to your knee. They keep your feet warm and dry. Many boots have laces to tie them on tight. The bottom of a boot is thick and strong so you can walk on rocks or in mud. People wear boots when it rains, when it snows, or when they work outside.
Krill\n\nKrill are tiny animals that look like small shrimp. They live in all the oceans of the world. Krill are very small, only about as long as your finger. They swim together in huge groups called swarms. Krill eat tiny plants and animals in the water. Many big animals eat krill, like whales, seals, penguins, and fish. Krill can make their own light, like a firefly. They have special spots on their body that glow in the dark.
Convection\n\nConvection is how heat moves through air or water. When something is hot, it rises up. When something is cold, it sinks down. This makes the air or water move around. For example, warm air from a heater goes up to the ceiling. Cold air near the floor moves down. A fan pushes air around, which is another way to move heat. In a pot of water on the stove, the hot water at the bottom rises to the top, and the cool water at the top sinks down. This moving around is called a convection current. Wind outside is also made by warm air rising and cool air moving in to take its place.
Art\n\nArt is something people make to show their ideas or feelings. People who make art are called artists. Art can be a drawing, a painting, a song, a dance, or a story. Some art is a bowl or a pot that you can use. That kind is called a craft. Art can make you feel happy, sad, or excited. Long ago, people painted on cave walls. Today, people make art with paint, clay, or even computers. Art is all around you.
Competition (economics)\n\nCompetition is when two or more people or companies want the same thing, like selling toys. If one company sells more toys, the other sells fewer. Long ago, a man named Adam Smith said that when people try to get the most money, they work harder and make better things. Sometimes, only one company sells something, and that is called a monopoly. The government can also help or stop competition by giving money or making rules.
Reality television\n\nReality television is a kind of TV show that shows real people doing real things, not actors. The people are not pretending to be someone else. Some shows have people living in a house together, like "Big Brother." Other shows have people playing games or doing funny things. But sometimes the shows are not exactly real because the people are told what to do or the show is cut to look different.
Jacob\n\nJacob is a man from a very old story. He lived a long, long time ago. Jacob had a brother named Esau. Their mother was Rebecca and their father was Isaac. One day, Jacob made some red stew. Esau was very hungry and wanted some. Jacob said, "Give me your special family right, and I will give you stew." Esau said yes. Later, Jacob tricked his blind father into giving him a special blessing. Esau got angry, so Jacob ran away. Jacob worked for his uncle Laban so he could marry Rachel. But Laban tricked Jacob into marrying Leah first. Jacob had many children. He was very sad when his son Joseph was taken to Egypt. When there was no food, Jacob moved to Egypt. He died there and was buried in Canaan.
Singapore\n\nSingapore is a small country that is also a city. It is an island in Southeast Asia, near the equator. About 5.7 million people live there. Most people are Chinese, Malay, or Indian. Singapore is called the 'Lion City' and the 'Garden City' because there are many plants everywhere. The country has four official languages: English, Chinese, Malay, and Tamil. English is the main language used in schools and government. Singapore was started as a trading place by a man named Stamford Raffles in 1819. It was part of the British Empire for a long time. During World War II, Japan took over Singapore for a few years. After the war, Singapore joined Malaysia in 1963 but became its own country in 1965. Singapore has very good schools, hospitals, and houses. It is a very safe place with strict rules. People who break the rules have to pay fines. Singapore is also known for its good food and many different kinds of people living together.
Sled\n\nA sled is a thing you sit on to slide over snow or ice. It does not have wheels. You can sit on a sled and go down a snowy hill very fast. Some sleds are pulled by dogs or horses. People use sleds in cold places where there is lots of snow.
FIFA World Cup\n\nThe FIFA World Cup is a big soccer game that happens every four years. Many countries send their best teams to play. People all over the world watch it on TV. Brazil has won the most times. The games last for four weeks in the summer. The winning team gets a big trophy.
Tableware\n\nTableware is the name for the things we use when we eat. It includes plates, bowls, cups, forks, spoons, and knives. Some people call it dishes or silverware. Different families use different tableware. Some people eat with their hands or use bread instead of a plate. For special parties, people might use fancy dishes that look very pretty.
Denmark\n\nDenmark is a country in northern Europe. It is next to Germany, Sweden, and Norway. The capital city is Copenhagen. Denmark is a kingdom with a king named Frederik X. The people vote to choose who runs the country. Denmark is known as a very happy place. The land is mostly flat with many small hills, lakes, and farms. There are many islands, and no one lives far from the sea. The weather is often windy and rainy. In winter it is not very cold, and in summer it is not very hot. Long ago, the Vikings lived in Denmark. Today, Denmark is part of a group called the European Union.
Eurasian Steppe\n\nThe Eurasian Steppe is a very big, flat piece of land covered in grass. It is in the north part of the world, from Europe all the way to China. Long ago, people called nomads lived there and moved around on horses. The horse may have come from this grassy land. The steppe was like a road that helped people travel from China to Europe. Many different groups of people ruled the steppe at different times.
Galaxy\n\nA galaxy is a big group of stars, gas, and dust in space. Our Sun and Earth are inside a galaxy called the Milky Way. There are many different kinds of galaxies. Some look like a spinning pinwheel with arms, and those are called spiral galaxies. Others look like a round or stretched ball, and those are called elliptical galaxies. Galaxies come in different sizes. Some are small with only a few million stars, and some are giant with many trillions of stars. Gravity holds all the stars in a galaxy together. Sometimes galaxies bump into each other, and that can make new stars. There are more galaxies in the sky than we can count.
Africa\n\nAfrica is a very big piece of land on Earth. It is the third biggest continent. Many countries are in Africa, and lots of people live there. Africa has a very hot, dry desert called the Sahara. It also has big forests and grasslands. Many wild animals live in Africa, like lions, elephants, giraffes, and zebras. People in Africa speak many different languages. The first people on Earth came from Africa.
So Paulo\n\nSão Paulo is a very big city in Brazil. It is the biggest city in South America. More than 11 million people live there. The city has many tall buildings, cars, and buses. Many people work in shops, factories, and offices. São Paulo has a big underground train called the Metro. People also travel by bus and helicopter. The city has many people from different places, like Italy, Japan, and Portugal. Football is very popular, and there are big football teams like Corinthians, Palmeiras, and São Paulo. The city also has a car race every year. São Paulo is very busy, and sometimes the traffic is very slow. People can spend a long time in traffic every day.
Hyrax\n\nA hyrax is a small, round animal with thick fur and a very short tail. It lives in Africa and a tiny part of Asia. Hyraxes eat plants and have small hooves on their feet. They are about as long as a ruler and weigh as much as a big bag of sugar. Some people call them dassies. A long time ago, people thought rabbits were a kind of hyrax.
Roman mythology\n\nRoman mythology is a big set of stories from long ago in a place called Ancient Rome. These stories tell about the world and about many gods and goddesses. The gods and goddesses have magic powers. They can become invisible and move very fast. They can turn people into animals. They never get sick and cannot die. The Romans also took some stories from Greek myths and made them their own.
Language family\n\nA language family is a group of languages that are like cousins. They come from one old language that people spoke a long time ago. For example, French and Spanish both came from Latin. That is why some words in French and Spanish sound a little alike. Most languages belong to a language family, but a few languages do not. Those are called language isolates. Some languages are made up by people on purpose, like Esperanto. There are many big language families in the world.
Yam\n\nA yam is a vegetable that grows under the ground. It looks like a sweet potato but is not the same. The outside of a yam is rough and hard to peel. The inside can be white, yellow, orange, purple, or pink. Yams can be very big and heavy. People cook yams in many ways: they can bake, boil, fry, or grill them. Yams grow in Africa, Asia, and other warm places. Most yams come from West Africa. Some people in the United States call sweet potatoes yams, but that is a mistake.
Political party\n\nA political party is a group of people who work together to run a country. They try to win elections so they can make the rules. In many countries, people vote for the party they like best. The party that gets the most votes gets to be in charge. The next biggest party is called the opposition. Sometimes two or more parties join together to run the government. Some parties have ideas about how to take care of nature or how to share money. In some places, only one party is allowed. In other places, all parties are banned.
Automation\n\nAutomation is when a machine can do its job all by itself without a person helping it. For example, a special part called a governor can make a steam engine work on its own. Machines that are automated make things that look the same every time. They also do boring or dangerous jobs so people do not have to. With automation, people do not need to lift heavy things or do scary work.
Sugarcane\n\nSugarcane is a tall plant that grows in warm places. It first grew in Asia, and now people grow it in many countries. The biggest place for sugarcane is Brazil. The stalks of sugarcane can be as tall as a house. Inside the stalks there is sugar. People use the sugar to make food and drinks sweet. You can also press the stalks to get sugarcane juice. After the sugar is taken out, the leftover parts can be burned to make heat and electricity, or made into paper and boxes. Sugarcane needs a lot of sun and water to grow well.
Cooking oil\n\nCooking oil is a clean fat that comes from plants or animals. It is a liquid that people use to cook food. You can put it in a pan to fry eggs or make vegetables taste good. Some cooking oils come from seeds, nuts, or fruits. They help food not stick to the pan and make it yummy.
Golden Temple\n\nThe Golden Temple is a very special place for Sikh people. It is in a city called Amritsar, in India. The temple has a big pool of water around it, and the top part is covered with shiny gold. People from all over the world come to visit. Inside, there is a holy book called the Guru Granth Sahib. The temple has four doors, so everyone can come in. There is also a kitchen where anyone can eat a free meal. Many people go there to pray and feel happy.
Shape\n\nA shape is how something looks on the outside. Some shapes are flat, like a square or a circle. Those are called 2D shapes. Other shapes are not flat, like a ball or a box. Those are called 3D shapes. Shapes can be big or small, and you can turn them around. Triangles and squares are shapes with straight sides. Circles have a round side. Some shapes are very hard to see, like 4D shapes, but people still think about them.
Scouting\n\nScouting is a group where kids learn to work together and help others. It started a long time ago, in 1907, by a man named Robert Baden-Powell. He was a soldier who taught boys how to survive outside. Scouts spend a lot of time outdoors, in the woods or fields. They learn to tie knots, build fires, and find their way. Scouts also make a promise to be kind and helpful. At first, only boys could be Scouts. Later, girls joined too. Today, millions of kids all over the world are Scouts. They wear special uniforms and earn badges for learning new things.
Battleship\n\nA battleship is a very big and strong boat that fights in the water. It has thick metal skin to keep it safe, and huge guns that shoot far away. Battleships were made a long time ago, from about 1880 to the 1940s. They were the biggest and most expensive war boats. Many countries like Britain, France, Germany, and the United States built them. In World War I and World War II, battleships fought in big battles. But later, planes from aircraft carriers became better at fighting, so battleships were not used as much. Today, some old battleships are in museums where people can visit them.
Venus de Milo\n\nThe Venus de Milo is a very old stone statue from Greece. It is made of white marble and is as tall as a grown-up person. The statue shows a woman who is a goddess of love. It was found on a Greek island a long time ago, broken into pieces. Now it lives in a big museum in Paris, France, where many people go to see it.
Armenia\n\nArmenia is a country in the Caucasus mountains, between Europe and Asia. It does not touch any ocean. The capital city is Yerevan. A long time ago, Armenia was the first country in the world to make Christianity its main religion. People in Armenia speak Armenian and use a special alphabet made long ago. Armenia has ten parts called provinces. Many people in Armenia go to church. Some people called Yazidis also live there. Armenia became its own country again in 1991.
Animal\n\nAnimals are living things that can move around. They eat other living things for energy. Some animals eat plants, some eat meat, and some eat both. Animals need air to breathe. They live in many different places, like water, land, and trees. There are many kinds of animals, like fish, birds, and mammals. Some animals have a backbone, and some do not.
Swimsuit\n\nA swimsuit is a piece of clothing you wear when you go swimming. It is also called a bathing suit. Some swimsuits cover your whole body like a one-piece, and some are two pieces called a bikini. Swimsuits can be tight or loose. They are made so they do not show your skin when they get wet. Germs can grow on a wet swimsuit, so you should take it off and put on dry clothes right away. Do not share a swimsuit with a friend unless it is washed first.
Household\n\nA household is a group of people who live together in the same home. They share things like food, money, and chores. Often a household is a family, but it can also be friends or other people. Living together helps everyone because they can share the cost of things like rent and food. People in a household take care of each other.
Starling\n\nA starling is a small to medium-sized bird that can sing many different songs. Starlings live in Europe, Asia, and Africa, and some were brought to North America, Hawaii, and New Zealand. They have strong feet and fly fast and straight. Starlings like to be together in big groups called flocks. These flocks can be huge, with thousands or even millions of birds. They fly in the sky and make shapes that change all the time. Starlings eat insects and fruit. They have dark feathers with shiny spots. Some starlings can copy sounds they hear, like car alarms or people talking. Many starlings build nests in holes and lay blue or white eggs.
Perseus\n\nPerseus is a hero from old Greek stories. His father was Zeus, a god, and his mother was a princess named Dana. When Perseus was a baby, his grandfather put him and his mother in a box and threw it into the sea. A god helped them float to an island, where a kind man named Diktys took care of them. When Perseus grew up, a king named Polydectes sent him to kill a monster called Medusa. Medusa had snakes for hair, and anyone who looked at her turned to stone. Perseus got help from the gods: Hermes gave him flying shoes, Hades gave him a hat that made him invisible, and Athena gave him a shiny shield. He used the shield to see Medusa without looking at her, and he cut off her head. On his way home, he saved a princess named Andromeda from a sea monster and married her.
Electronic music\n\nElectronic music is music made with machines like computers and synthesizers. People use these machines to make new sounds that are different from regular instruments like drums or guitars. Sometimes they record sounds from everyday life, like water or birds, and change them with a tape recorder. They can make sounds play faster, slower, backwards, or over and over. Many musicians use electronic sounds in pop, rock, and rap music. Some electronic music is made for dancing, and it is called EDM. Today, electronic music is very common and many artists use it.
Tasmanian devil\n\nA Tasmanian devil is a meat-eating animal that lives in Tasmania, an island in Australia. It is about the size of a small dog and has black fur, a wide head, and a short tail. It sleeps during the day and is awake at night. It makes a loud, scary screeching sound. It hunts other animals and also eats dead animals. It has very strong teeth and jaws and can eat everything, even bones and fur. A mother Tasmanian devil carries her babies in a pouch on her belly. These animals are in danger because of a sickness that gives them big bumps on their faces. People are trying to help them stay safe.
Action figure\n\nAn action figure is a small toy that looks like a person. It is made of plastic and can move its arms, legs, and head. You can make it stand in different poses. Action figures are often based on characters from movies, TV shows, comic books, or video games. One famous action figure is G.I. Joe, who looks like a soldier. Action figures were first made in 1964 by a company called Hasbro. They wanted to make a toy for boys, like how Barbie was a toy for girls. Later, superheroes from Marvel and DC Comics became action figures. Today, both kids and grown-ups collect action figures. Some people keep them in boxes to save them. Action figures can be of movie characters, musicians, or athletes.
Silver\n\nSilver is a shiny, soft metal that is bluish-white. It is very special because it shines more than most other metals and can carry electricity and heat better than any other metal. People have used silver for a very long time to make jewelry, coins, and pretty things. You can bend silver easily and make it into thin wire or flat sheets. Silver does not get rusty like iron, but it can turn black if there is a bad smell in the air. Some silver is used to kill tiny germs and help burns get better. Silver is found in rocks in places like Canada, Mexico, Peru, and the United States.
Meditation\n\nMeditation is a quiet time when you sit still and pay attention to your breathing or to a calm thought. It helps your mind feel peaceful and less busy. Many people do meditation to feel relaxed and happy. Some people who follow religions like Buddhism or Hinduism use meditation as part of their prayers. In Buddhism, people focus on their breath or on loving everyone, even people they do not like. In Christianity, people sometimes think about a short part of the Bible or say a prayer over and over. Meditation can help you feel less worried or sad. You can do it anywhere, even at home, by sitting quietly and taking slow breaths.
Bomb\n\nA bomb is a thing that goes BOOM very fast. It breaks things apart. Bombs have been used for a long, long time. Some bombs throw sharp pieces of metal. Some bombs make fire. Bombs are filled with special stuff that makes a big bang. Airplanes drop bombs to break things far away. Bad people sometimes use bombs to hurt others. But the same stuff used in bombs can also be used to break rocks in mines.
Intellectual disability\n\nIntellectual disability is a problem with the brain that makes it hard for a person to learn and do everyday things. People with this disability may need help from others to get through the day. It starts when a person is a child. Some people have a mild form and can learn many things with help. Others have a more serious form and need more help. There is no cure, but with good teaching and support, people with intellectual disability can learn to do many things.
The Scream\n\nThe Scream is a famous painting by an artist named Edvard Munch. The picture shows a creature with its mouth and eyes wide open. Munch got the idea when he was walking with friends at sunset and the sky was red. He heard a sound in his ears, like nature screaming. The painting was made with paint and pastel on cardboard. It is in a museum in Oslo, Norway. Munch made four paintings of The Scream. In 1994, thieves stole one painting, but it was found three months later.
Beef\n\nBeef is a type of meat that comes from cows. People cook beef in many ways. Some beef is cut into steaks, and some is ground up to make hamburgers. Beef has protein and iron, which help your body grow strong. Eating too much beef can be bad for your health and for the planet. Making beef uses a lot of land and water, and it creates gases that warm the Earth. Beef is very popular in a country called Argentina.
Clarinet\n\nA clarinet is a musical instrument that you blow into to make sounds. It is long and black, made of a special wood or plastic. The clarinet has a thin piece called a reed that shakes when you blow, and that makes the sound. You cover holes with your fingers to play different notes. There are also little buttons for your pinkie finger. The clarinet is used in bands and orchestras. It is easier to play than many other wind instruments, so kids can learn it when their big teeth grow in. A famous song for the clarinet was written by Mozart a long time ago.
Blood test\n\nA blood test is a way doctors look at your blood to see if you are healthy. A nurse uses a small needle to take a little bit of blood from your arm or finger. The blood goes to a special room where machines check it. The test can show if you have a sickness, if your body has enough vitamins, or if your medicine is working.
Genie\n\nA genie is a make-believe creature that looks like a person but is invisible. Genies live in groups, eat, drink, and have feelings, just like people. They are stronger than people. Long ago, stories about genies came from the Middle East, especially Arabia. In some stories, genies can turn into snakes or disappear. In Islam, genies are made from fire or smoke, and they can be good or bad. In movies from the West, genies live in bottles and grant wishes. In movies from the Middle East, genies are scary like demons.
Armour\n\nArmour is a special covering that keeps people, animals, or things safe from getting hurt. A long time ago, armour was made from animal skin or metal. Today, some armour is made from strong plastic that does not break. People wear armour in some sports like ice hockey and American football. Tanks and cars can also have armour to protect them. Even dogs and horses can wear armour to stay safe.
Coelacanth\n\nA coelacanth is a big fish that lives in the deep ocean. It has been around for a very long time, even before dinosaurs. People thought it was gone forever until one was caught in 1938. Now we know there are still coelacanths swimming in the Indian Ocean. They are dark blue or brown and can be as long as a grown-up person. Their fins look like little legs. Fishermen do not like to eat them because they taste bad.
Endangered species\n\nAn endangered species is a kind of animal or plant that might go away forever. This can happen if there are not many left, if other animals eat too many of them, if the weather changes, or if the places where they live get broken. Many countries have rules to keep these animals and plants safe. People are not allowed to hunt them or build on their homes. Some animals that are in danger are big cats, whales, and some birds. We need to take care of them so they do not disappear.
Io (moon)\n\nIo is a moon that goes around the planet Jupiter. It is a little bigger than our own Moon. Io has many volcanoes that shoot hot lava and gas into the sky. There are about 400 volcanoes on Io. The volcanoes change how Io looks all the time. Io is very dry and has almost no water. One side of Io always faces Jupiter, just like our Moon always faces Earth.
Day\n\nA day is the time it takes for the Earth to spin all the way around once. When your part of the Earth faces the Sun, it is daytime and you see light.
