You have five ways to perceive: seeing with your eyes, hearing with your ears, touching with your skin, tasting with your tongue, and smelling with your nose. When light goes into your eyes, your brain makes a picture. When sound waves go into your ears, your brain makes what you hear. Your skin feels if something is hot, cold, or hard. Your tongue tastes if food is sweet or sour. Your nose smells flowers or food. Your brain uses what you already know to help you understand things fast. For example, if you see half of a cat, you know it is a cat because you have seen one before.
Rock art\n\nRock art is pictures or marks that people made on big stones a long, long time ago. Some rock art is carved into the stone, and some is painted on it. You can find rock art on cave walls or on rocks outside. People used sharp tools or colored paint to make these pictures. The pictures can show animals, people, or shapes. Some rock art is very old and helps us learn about how people lived long ago.
Mind\n\nThe mind is the part of you that thinks, remembers, and feels. It is inside your head. Your mind helps you make choices, like what to eat or play. It also lets you imagine things, like a castle in the sky. You can keep memories in your mind, like your birthday party. Your mind is private — no one else knows what you are thinking. Sometimes people say "make up your mind" when you need to decide. A healthy mind helps you feel happy and handle problems.
Peat\n\nPeat is a soft, wet, brown stuff that comes from old plants. It forms in wet, swampy places called bogs. The plants in the bog do not rot all the way because there is no air. Peat is like the first step to making coal. People in some countries, like Ireland and Scotland, dig up peat and dry it. Then they burn it for heat and cooking. It makes a smoky smell. Peat is also used to make a special drink called Scotch whisky taste smoky. But peat can be dangerous because it can catch fire and burn for a very long time, even under the ground.
Hatred\n\nHatred is a very strong feeling of not liking someone or something. It makes you want to stay away from that person or thing. Some people think hatred is the opposite of love. When you feel hatred, you might feel angry or mean. It is not a nice feeling to have.
Handicraft\n\nHandicraft is when people make things with their hands and simple tools. These things are pretty and can be used for something. Handicraft is not made by big machines. In Bangladesh, some people make handicraft things to earn money. Making handicraft helps people think of new ideas and be creative. It also helps keep old traditions alive.
Wallet\n\nA wallet is a small flat thing that people use to hold money and cards. It can be made of leather or cloth. Men often keep a wallet in their pocket. Women often put a wallet inside a bigger bag called a purse. Some wallets have a special place for coins. A wallet can close with a snap or a band.
Engraving\n\nEngraving is a way to make a picture or pattern by cutting into a hard, flat surface. People use a special tool called a burin to carve lines into metal like copper or silver. Long ago, before cameras were invented, engraving was used to make pictures for books and newspapers. Today, engraving is still used to make money and stamps because the tiny lines are very hard to copy. Some artists also use engraving to make beautiful prints on paper.
Slime mould\n\nA slime mould is a living thing that lives on the ground in forests. It looks like a yellow or orange blob and slides slowly over leaves and tree trunks to find food. It can be just one tiny cell, or many cells that come together to make a bigger blob. When it is time to make new slime moulds, it grows little stalks that hold tiny seeds called spores. The spores float away and grow into new slime moulds. Slime moulds are not plants or animals, but they are alive and move very slowly.
Solar energy\n\nSolar energy comes from the sun. The sun gives us heat and light. People use the sun's heat to cook food, warm water, and make electricity. Solar cookers use mirrors to focus sunlight and get very hot. Solar panels on roofs catch sunlight and turn it into electricity for lights and TVs. Solar energy is always there, so we can use it again and again. It is better for the Earth than burning coal or oil.
Social equality\n\nSocial equality is when all people are treated the same and get the same chances. No one is left out because of how they look or where they come from. Everyone can go to school, play, and have friends. It means being fair to everyone.
Pop music\n\nPop music is a kind of music that many people like to listen to. It has a strong beat that is good for dancing. Pop music started a long time ago, around the 1950s, with rock and roll. Famous singers like Elvis Presley and The Beatles made pop music popular. Today, pop music includes many styles like rock, hip hop, and electronic dance music. Pop singers sing into microphones that make their voices louder. Many people work behind the scenes to make pop music, like people who help record songs, sell CDs, and set up concerts. Some pop stars you might know are Ariana Grande, Katy Perry, and Lady Gaga.
Martial arts\n\nMartial arts are ways of fighting that people learn and practice. They come from many different countries. People do martial arts to protect themselves, to get stronger, to stay healthy, and to have fun. Some martial arts use punches, like boxing. Some use kicks, like taekwondo. Some use holds and throws, like judo. Some use swords or sticks. There are many kinds of martial arts, and each one has its own moves. People who practice martial arts train hard and learn to be brave and calm.
Quebec\n\nQuebec is a big part of Canada. It is the largest province in Canada by size. Many people live in Quebec, but not as many as in Ontario. Most people in Quebec live near the Saint Lawrence River. The people in Quebec speak French. That is different from most of Canada, where people speak English. The capital city of Quebec is Quebec City. It is one of the oldest cities in North America. The biggest city in Quebec is Montreal. It is the second biggest city in Canada. Quebec has many trees, water, and rocks that people use to make things. Some people in Quebec want to leave Canada and become their own country. They had two votes about it, in 1980 and 1995. In 1995, almost half the people wanted to leave, but more people wanted to stay.
Gaborone\n\nGaborone is a big city in Africa. It is the capital of a country called Botswana. Many people live there, and the city is growing very fast. Gaborone sits next to a river called the Notwane. It is close to the border of South Africa. There is a big university in Gaborone, and an airport where planes come and go. Long ago, the city was called Gaberones. It was named after a chief named Gaborone. People sometimes call it "Gabs" or "G-City" for short. The city was built in just three years, with houses, schools, a hospital, and a power station. Botswana became its own country in 1966, and Gaborone was ready for that big day.
Acropolis of Athens\n\nThe Acropolis of Athens is a big hill in the middle of a city called Athens. On top of the hill, there are old stone buildings that people made a long, long time ago. The most famous building there is called the Parthenon. Many people visit the Acropolis to see the old buildings and look at the city from up high.
Camping\n\nCamping is when people leave their home and sleep outside for one or more nights. They sleep in a tent, a campervan, or right under the sky when the weather is nice. People go camping in summer when school is out. They like to see nature and have adventures. Campers make easy food to eat. Sometimes they cook fish or meat over a fire. Camping can be fun, but you have to be careful of wild animals and only drink clean water.
Ancient philosophy\n\nAncient philosophy is about very old ideas from long ago. People in China, Greece, Rome, India, and other places thought about big questions like 'What is good?' and 'How should we live?' These ideas were written down and some are still studied today in schools. Many of these old thoughts were forgotten for a while, but later people learned about them again from books.
Lake Malawi\n\nLake Malawi is a very big lake in Africa. It sits between three countries: Malawi, Mozambique, and Tanzania. It is one of the deepest lakes in Africa and the ninth biggest lake in the whole world. Many fish live in this lake.
Fog\n\nFog is a cloud that sits on the ground. It is made of tiny water drops in the air. Fog can be on land or over the sea. When it is foggy, you cannot see very far. Fog happens when the air gets cold and wet. Sometimes fog is very thick, and sometimes it is thin. Fog can look like a soft white blanket.
Society\n\nSociety is all the people living together and helping each other. People in a society talk, play, and work together. They make rules so everyone can be safe and happy. Some animals, like wolves, also live in a society. A society can be a town, a country, or even the whole world.
Robotics\n\nRobotics is about making robots. A robot is a machine that can do jobs for people. Some robots help find and take away bombs. Other robots go to very hot or very small places where people cannot go. Some robots look like people, but most look like machines. Some robots can move on their own, and some need a person to tell them what to do. People who work on robotics learn about machines, electricity, and computers.
Root\n\nRoots are the part of a plant that usually stay under the ground. They take water and food from the soil for the plant. Roots also hold the plant tight in the ground so it does not fall over. Some roots, like carrots, are thick and we can eat them. Other roots are thin and spread out like a web. Roots grow longer from the tip, and the tip has a hard cap that pushes through the dirt. Some plants have roots that grow above the ground, like on trees in the rainforest. These are called aerial roots. Roots are not green because they do not have the green stuff that leaves have.
Samba\n\nSamba is a kind of music, dancing, and singing from Brazil. People dance samba with fast, happy steps. There are two main types: the ballroom samba danced with a partner, and the traditional samba danced alone at Carnival. The dance has a bouncing move made by bending and straightening the knees. The music uses drums, bells, and a whistle. The whistle tells dancers when to start and stop. Samba started in Brazil in the 1920s and is now danced all over the world.
Nurse\n\nA nurse is a person who helps sick or hurt people get better. Nurses work with doctors to take care of patients. They work in hospitals, at doctor's offices, and even visit people at home. Nurses talk to patients, give them medicine, and watch to make sure they are okay. Some nurses help during surgery. Some nurses teach people about healthy food and how to stay well. Nurses train for a long time to learn how to help. Both men and women can be nurses. Many people need nurses, so nurses are very important.
Kitchen\n\nA kitchen is a room in a house where people cook food. Sometimes people eat in the kitchen, too. Kitchens have a stove for cooking, a sink with water, and a refrigerator to keep food cold. Long ago, kitchens had open fires and were separate from the rest of the house. Today, many kitchens are part of the living room. Some kitchens are outside for cooking on a grill. People use knives, pots, and pans to make meals. A person who works in a kitchen is called a chef or a cook.
Realism\n\nRealism is a way of making art or thinking about things that tries to show the world just as it really is. Artists who use realism paint or write about everyday life, like people working or playing, without adding magic or make-believe. Realism started a long time ago, in the 1800s, when some artists wanted to show nature and regular people instead of just kings or fairy tales. In philosophy, realism means that things are real even if nobody is looking at them or thinking about them. For example, a rock is still a rock even if you close your eyes.
Mole\n\nA mole is a small animal that lives under the ground. It digs tunnels with its strong front paws. Moles have very soft fur and an extra thumb to help them dig. They eat bugs, worms, and other tiny creatures. Moles live in North America, Europe, and Asia. They cannot see very well. Some moles are very small, and some are a little bigger.
Guatemala\n\nGuatemala is a country in Central America. It is next to Mexico, Belize, Honduras, and El Salvador. It also touches the Pacific Ocean. Many people live there—more than fourteen million. Some people are Mayan, some are mixed, and some came from Europe long ago. The capital is Guatemala City. Long ago, the capital had to move because a volcano erupted and because of big earthquakes.
Mathematics\n\nMathematics is about numbers, shapes, and patterns. It helps us count, add, and take away. People use math to solve problems in real life, like building houses or making things. Mathematicians use thinking and rules to find answers. Some math problems are adding, subtracting, multiplying, and dividing. Math helps us understand the world better.
Elasticity (physics)\n\nElasticity is when something can be stretched or squished and then go back to its first shape. A rubber band is a good example. When you pull it, it gets longer, and when you let go, it goes back to how it was. Some things, like clay, can be squished but stay that way. That is not elastic. Elastic things try hard to go back to their old shape.
Etymology\n\nEtymology is learning where words come from. It tells us how a word started and what it used to mean. For example, the word 'etymology' came from old Greek words that mean 'true word' or 'true meaning'. Some words come from other languages like Latin or French. Knowing etymology helps us understand why we say things the way we do.
Candy\n\nCandy is a sweet food that people like to eat. It is made from sugar and water, with flavors added. You can find candy in almost any store. Some people make candy at home. Candy comes in many shapes, colors, and sizes. It has a lot of sugar, so it is not very healthy, but you can eat it sometimes. Some candy is sweet, and some candy can be spicy. Many companies make candy, like Hershey and Haribo.
Sea of Japan\n\nThe Sea of Japan is a big body of salt water next to Japan, Korea, and Russia. It is part of the Pacific Ocean. The water is very deep in some places. Many fish live there. People in different countries call it different names. Some call it the East Sea.
Aquarium\n\nAn aquarium is a place where fish and other water animals live. It can be a small glass box in your home or a big building with many tanks. People like to watch the fish swim around. Some people keep an aquarium as a hobby. They give the fish clean water, light, and food. Big public aquariums have large tanks with many kinds of fish. People visit them to see the fish and learn about them. Some aquariums help protect animals that are in danger of disappearing.
Opossum\n\nAn opossum is a small animal that carries its babies in a pouch on its belly. It is a marsupial, like a kangaroo. Opossums live in North and South America. They have a long pointy nose, a hairless tail, and gray or white fur. Opossums eat many things: bugs, worms, small animals, plants, and even garbage. Some people think opossums eat lots of ticks, but scientists now say that is not true. Baby opossums are born very tiny and must crawl into their mother's pouch to drink milk and grow big.
Tendon\n\nA tendon is a strong, stretchy band inside your body. It connects muscle to bone. When you move, your muscle pulls on the tendon, and the tendon pulls on the bone to make it move. Tendons are tough and do not stretch very much. They help your arms and legs bend and straighten.
Gulf of Thailand\n\nThe Gulf of Thailand is a big, shallow arm of the sea. It touches three countries: Cambodia, Thailand, and Vietnam. The water is warm and not very deep, only about as deep as a tall building. Many rivers pour fresh water into the gulf, making it less salty. There are pretty coral reefs under the water, and people like to visit the beaches and islands there. Some famous places in the Gulf of Thailand are Ko Samui, Pattaya, and Hua Hin.
Scissors\n\nScissors are a tool for cutting things like paper and cloth. They have two sharp edges that move together to cut. Some scissors are not very sharp and are safe for children to use. These are called safety scissors. Scissors can be made for left-handed or right-handed people. There are many kinds of scissors for cutting different things.
Rotation\n\nRotation is when something moves around and around in a circle. A toy top spins around a point in the middle. The Earth spins around like a ball, and that is called rotation. You can spin a ball on your finger. Some things spin to the right, and some spin to the left. Big wheels at a park, like a Ferris wheel, also spin around. In sports, players make balls spin when they hit them.
Missouri River\n\nThe Missouri River is a very long river in the United States. It is the longest river in North America. The river starts high up in the Rocky Mountains in Montana. It flows east and then south through many states like North Dakota, South Dakota, Iowa, Nebraska, Missouri, and Kansas. Finally, it joins the Mississippi River near Saint Louis. The Missouri River is sometimes called "Big Muddy" because it carries a lot of dirt and makes the water look muddy. Long ago, Native American people lived near this river. Later, explorers named Lewis and Clark traveled on the Missouri River to learn about the land.
Refraction\n\nRefraction is when light bends as it moves from one thing to another, like from air into water. When you put a straw in a glass of water, the straw looks like it bends at the water's top. That is because the light slows down and changes direction when it goes into the water. Light also bends when it goes through a prism, and then it splits into all the colors of the rainbow.
Biology\n\nBiology is the science that studies life and living things. Living things include animals, plants, mushrooms, and tiny living things like bacteria. People who study biology are called biologists. They look at how animals and plants behave and work. Biologists also study how living things react with each other and the world around them. All living things are made of tiny building blocks called cells. Cells are like little rooms that make up your body. Water is very important for life. Most of your body is made of water. Living things also need food to grow and have energy. Biology helps us understand how our bodies work and how plants grow.
Sierra Leone\n\nSierra Leone is a country in West Africa. Its capital is Freetown. The country was first made as a place where freed slaves could live. There was a war there from 1991 to 2000, but now the war is over. Sierra Leone has many diamonds, but some were used to buy weapons during the war. The country is hot and rainy most of the year. It has a rainy season from May to November and a dry season from December to May. Many people in Sierra Leone eat rice with every meal. They also like snacks like mangoes, oranges, and fried plantains. Football is the most popular sport. The national team is called the Leone Stars.
Map projection\n\nA map projection is a way to draw the round Earth on a flat piece of paper. The Earth is like a ball, and paper is flat, so drawing it is hard. When you try to make a round thing flat, some parts get stretched or squished. That is called distortion. People who make maps choose different ways to draw the Earth so that the important parts look right. One way to think about it is like shining a light on a ball and seeing its shadow on a wall. The shadow is flat, just like a map.
Poultry\n\nPoultry are birds that people keep on farms. These birds give us eggs to eat and meat to cook. Chickens are the most common poultry. Turkeys and ducks are poultry too. People also use their soft feathers for pillows. Poultry live in coops or barns and eat grain. The meat from poultry is a food that many people around the world like to eat.
Nelumbo\n\nNelumbo is a water plant also called lotus. Lotus flowers are big and smell sweet. Some lotus flowers are pink, and some are yellow. The flowers grow above the water. The leaves float on top of the water. The roots are in the mud under the water. The stems and roots have air spaces so the plant can breathe underwater. People can eat the roots and seeds. Cows like to eat the leaves and flowers. Lotus is the national flower of India and Vietnam.
Vishnu\n\nVishnu is a very important god in the Hindu religion. He is the god who takes care of the world and keeps it safe. People say he protects everything that lives. Vishnu has four hands. In his hands he holds a conch shell, a round disc, a mace, and a flower called a lotus. Sometimes he comes to Earth in different forms called avataras. Two famous avataras are Rama and Krishna. Many people pray to Vishnu and visit his temples.
Mineral\n\nA mineral is a special kind of stuff that comes from the ground. It is made by nature, not by people. Minerals are solid, like a rock, and they have a special shape inside. Some minerals are very common, like quartz and feldspar. Others are rare and found only in a few places. People use minerals every day. The salt you eat is a mineral called halite. The copper in wires that bring electricity to your house comes from a mineral. Even the powder in baby powder is made from a mineral called talc. Rocks are made of minerals, but a rock can have many different minerals mixed together.
Slalom skiing\n\nSlalom skiing is a race down a snowy hill. Skiers go between poles called gates. The gates are close together, so skiers make quick turns. It is part of the Winter Olympics. Skiers wear special skis that are shorter for slalom. The fastest skier wins.
Detroit\n\nDetroit is a big city in the state of Michigan, in the United States. It is called the "Motor City" because many cars are made there. Companies like Ford, General Motors, and Chrysler have their offices and factories in and around Detroit. The city was started by a man from France in 1701. Detroit has many sports teams, like the Detroit Tigers for baseball and the Detroit Lions for football. Many people live in Detroit and the towns around it. The city is next to Canada, and the border between Detroit and Windsor is one of the busiest in the world.
Dye\n\nDye is something that puts color on things. People use dye to color cloth for making clothes. Some dye comes from plants like berries and leaves. That is called natural dye. Other dye is made by people in factories. That is called artificial dye. Dye sticks to the cloth and makes it a new color.
Levee\n\nA levee is a big wall of dirt or stone built next to a river. It helps keep water from flooding houses and roads when the river gets too full. Some levees are made by people, and some are natural hills. Long ago, people in Holland built levees to keep the sea out. The land behind a levee can be safe and dry. But sometimes, the river bed gets higher over time, and then the levee might not be tall enough.
Guitar\n\nA guitar is a thing you play music with. It has a long neck and a big body. You use your fingers to pull on the strings to make sounds. Most guitars have six strings. Some are made of wood or plastic. The strings can be made of steel or nylon. There are two main kinds: acoustic and electric. An acoustic guitar makes its own sound. An electric guitar needs a plug to make the sound louder. People use guitars in many kinds of music, like rock and classical. A person who plays a guitar is called a guitarist.
Halloween\n\nHalloween is a fun night on October 31. Children wear costumes and go to houses saying "Trick or treat!" People give them candy. Many children dress up as ghosts, witches, or other fun scary things. People also carve pumpkins into jack-o'-lanterns with a light inside. Some homes have decorations like pumpkins and scarecrows. Halloween started a long time ago in Ireland. People believed that on this night, the souls of dead people could come back to Earth. Now it is a happy holiday with games like bobbing for apples. Black and orange are the colors of Halloween.
J-pop\n\nJ-pop is music that many people in Japan like to listen to. J-pop is a short name for Japanese pop music. It sounds different from music in other countries. Some J-pop songs are fast and fun, and some are slow and pretty. People in Japan listen to J-pop on the radio, on TV, and on their phones. Many singers and bands make J-pop songs. Some J-pop singers are young, and some are older. The music has changed over time, so new J-pop sounds different from old J-pop.
Cymbal\n\nA cymbal is a round metal disc that makes a crashing sound. It looks a little like a pot lid. You can hold one in each hand and bang them together to make a loud noise. You can also hit one cymbal with a stick. Cymbals come in different sizes. Some are small, some are big. They are used in bands, orchestras, and drum sets. When you hear a big crash in music, that is often a cymbal.
Chinese calendar\n\nThe Chinese calendar is a special way to keep track of days and months. It uses the moon and the sun to tell time. Long ago, people in China used this calendar for everything. Now, people in China use a different calendar for most things, but they still use the Chinese calendar for fun holidays like Chinese New Year and the Mid-Autumn Festival.
Integer\n\nAn integer is a whole number. Whole numbers are numbers like 1, 2, 3, and also zero and numbers like -1, -2, -3. Integers do not have parts like a half or a quarter. You can put integers on a number line. There is no biggest or smallest integer because you can always find a bigger or smaller one. When you add, subtract, or multiply two integers, you always get another integer. But when you divide one integer by another, you might not get an integer.
Cyprus\n\nCyprus is an island country in the Mediterranean Sea. It is a place with warm weather and many beaches. The capital city is Nicosia. People there speak Greek and Turkish. Many tourists visit Cyprus every year to enjoy the sun and the sea. The island has mountains and a long river. Cyprus is part of the European Union and uses the euro as money.
Drama\n\nDrama is a story that people act out on a stage or in a movie. It is about people and how they feel and talk to each other. Dramas are usually serious, not funny like a comedy. Sometimes a drama can have funny parts too. A long time ago, a man named Shakespeare wrote many dramas that people still watch today.
Rock (geology)\n\nA rock is a hard, solid thing that comes from nature. Rocks are made of tiny pieces called minerals that stick together. The outside of the Earth is made of rock, but it is often covered by dirt or water. You can find rocks in many places like the park, the beach, or the forest. Some rocks are made when hot melted rock from deep inside the Earth cools down and gets hard. Other rocks are made from layers of sand and mud that get squished together over a long time. Some rocks are changed by heat and pressure deep underground. People have used rocks for a very long time to build houses, roads, and other things.
Plateau\n\nA plateau is a big piece of land that is flat on top and high up. It looks like a table on a hill. Some plateaus are very tall, like the Tibetan Plateau, which is the biggest and tallest in the world. Other plateaus are under the ocean. Plateaus can be made by volcanoes or by the ground pushing up. They often stand alone, sometimes on top of mountains.
Pecan\n\nA pecan is a nut that grows on a big tree. The tree lives in the middle and south of the United States and in Mexico. The nut has a hard shell. You need a stone or a tool to crack it open. Inside is a yummy part that people eat. In the southern part of the United States, people make a sweet pie with pecans. It is called pecan pie.
Physical examination\n\nA physical examination is when a doctor or nurse looks at your body to see if you are healthy. They check your eyes, ears, heart, and tummy. They also listen to your breathing with a special tool. This helps find if you are sick or hurt. It is like a check-up to make sure your body is working well.
Oak\n\nAn oak is a big, strong tree that grows very slowly. It can live for a very long time, even up to 1000 years. Oak trees have leaves with round edges, and some have leaves with jagged edges. In spring, the tree makes tiny flowers. The fruit of an oak tree is a nut called an acorn. Acorns grow inside a little cup on the tree. Each acorn has one seed inside. Many animals live in an oak tree. Birds, bugs, and moths make their homes there. Caterpillars eat the leaves. Some leaves have little bumps on the bottom. Those bumps are called galls, and tiny animals live inside them. Oak wood is very hard. People used to cut down oak trees to make ships and furniture. Now the wood is rare and expensive. Oak trees grow in many places, especially in forests where they are the biggest trees.
Dumpling\n\nA dumpling is a small piece of food made from dough. Dough is a soft mixture of flour and water. Dumplings can be sweet or salty. Some dumplings have meat or vegetables inside. People cook dumplings by boiling them in water or steaming them in a basket. In Asia, people use bamboo baskets to steam dumplings. In Africa, people cook dumplings in a pot with a tight lid. When dumplings cook, they get bigger and puff up. Dumplings are yummy to eat.
Binary number\n\nA binary number is a way to write numbers using only two digits: 0 and 1. Computers use binary because electricity can be on (1) or off (0). In binary, each digit's place value is two times the last digit. For example, the binary number 101 means 1 four, 0 twos, and 1 one, which is 5 in the numbers we use every day. You can add, subtract, multiply, and divide with binary numbers just like with regular numbers.
Caecilian\n\nA caecilian is an animal that looks like a worm or a snake. It has no legs and lives underground. Its skin is smooth and usually dark, but some are colorful. Its eyes are small and covered with skin, so it can only tell light from dark. It has two little feelers on its head to help it smell. Most caecilians have lungs, but some use their skin to breathe. They live in warm, wet places in South America, Africa, and Asia. They eat bugs and worms. Some caecilians lay eggs, and the mother guards them. Other caecilians have babies that grow inside the mother. Some caecilians have poison in their skin to keep other animals away.
Personal computer\n\nA personal computer is a machine that helps people work and play. It has a screen, a keyboard, and a mouse. You can use it to write stories, draw pictures, play games, and talk to friends far away. Inside the computer there is a brain called the CPU that follows instructions. There is also memory to hold information while you use it, and a hard drive to save your work even when the computer is off. Some personal computers are big towers on a desk, and some are laptops that you can carry around.
Scale (music)\n\nA scale in music is a set of notes that go up or down in order. When the notes go from low to high, it is called an ascending scale. When they go from high to low, it is called a descending scale. The most common scales have five, six, or seven different notes. On a piano, if you start on the note C and play all the white keys up to the next C, you play the C Major scale. It sounds like "do, re, mi, fa, so, la, ti, do." There are also minor scales that sound a little different.
Locomotive\n\nA locomotive is the part of a train that makes it move. It is the first car and has a strong engine. There are different kinds of locomotives. A steam locomotive burns coal to make steam, which pushes the wheels. A diesel locomotive uses a diesel engine to make power. An electric locomotive gets power from wires above the tracks. Most trains today use diesel or electric locomotives. Some trains have motors in every car and do not need a separate locomotive.
Dress\n\nA dress is a piece of clothing that girls and women wear. It has a top part and a skirt part all in one piece. Dresses can be many colors and styles. People wear dresses to special events like weddings or dances. In summer, dresses help keep you cool. Long ago, women wore long dresses that touched the ground. Over time, dresses changed. Some had big skirts held up by hoops underneath. Others had high necklines or low necklines. Today, girls and women wear dresses for many reasons.
Carnivorous plant\n\nA carnivorous plant is a plant that eats bugs and small animals. Most of these plants catch insects, so they are also called insect-eating plants. They grow in places where the dirt does not have enough food for them, like wet, swampy ground or rocky areas. Some have leaves shaped like cups or jars that trap bugs inside. Others have sticky leaves that bugs get stuck on. The Venus flytrap has leaves that snap shut very fast when a bug touches it. These plants use the bugs for food to help them grow.
Feather\n\nFeathers are the soft things that cover birds. They keep birds warm and safe. Big feathers on wings help birds fly. Some feathers are stiff and have a hard center called a quill. Baby birds have very soft feathers called down. Down keeps them warm but cannot help them fly. Birds lose old feathers and grow new ones once a year. Feathers come in many colors. People use feathers to make pillows, blankets, and warm coats. Long ago, people used quills as pens to write.
Physical exercise\n\nPhysical exercise means moving your body to stay strong and healthy. You can run, jump, swim, or play outside. Exercise helps your heart, muscles, and bones grow strong. It also makes you feel happy and less tired. When you exercise, you build up your muscles and have more energy to play. It is good to exercise every day, even just for a little while.
Curry\n\nCurry is a kind of food with many spices. It comes from India and other countries in Asia. People make curry with different vegetables, meat, or beans. Curry can be yellow, red, or green. It is often eaten with rice or flat bread called naan. Some people like curry very hot, and some like it mild. Many people around the world eat curry for dinner.
Leek\n\nA leek is a vegetable that looks like a tall, skinny green stick. It is in the same family as onions and garlic. People cook leeks in soups and other dishes. Leeks grow best in deep holes in the ground so the sun does not hurt them. The dirt they grow in must be soft and let water move through it easily. Leeks take a long time to grow, about 100 to 120 days. They come from Europe and Asia.
Circulatory system\n\nThe circulatory system is how your body moves blood around. The heart is a pump that pushes blood through tubes called blood vessels. Some tubes, called arteries, carry blood away from the heart. Other tubes, called veins, bring blood back to the heart. Very tiny tubes called capillaries connect arteries and veins. Blood carries food and air to all parts of your body. It also takes away the stuff your body does not need. Your blood goes through your lungs to get fresh air. Then it goes to the rest of your body. The heart works all the time, even when you sleep.
Pendulum\n\nA pendulum is a weight on a string or stick that hangs from a point. When you push it to one side, it swings back and forth. It keeps swinging at the same speed. The weight does not change how fast it swings. People use pendulums in some clocks to help them keep the right time.
East Asia\n\nEast Asia is a big part of the continent Asia. It has six countries and two territories. Many, many people live there, and most of them live in China.
Perfume\n\nPerfume is a liquid that makes people, things, and rooms smell good. It is made from oils that come from plants or are made in a factory. People put perfume on their neck, wrist, and behind their knees because those spots are warm and make the smell stronger. Some perfumes are made from flowers like roses and lavender. Others are made from fruit peels like lemon and orange. A long time ago, people made perfume by mixing crushed flowers and oil. Today, we can make many different smells. Perfume has been used for thousands of years.
Mackerel\n\nMackerel is a kind of fish that lives in the sea. It has stripes on its back and a tail that splits in two. Mackerel swims very fast. Bigger fish like cod and sharks eat mackerel. People can eat mackerel too. It has special oil that is good for your body. But mackerel goes bad quickly, so you must eat it the same day it is caught or keep it cold.
Mandarin Chinese\n\nMandarin Chinese is a language that many people use to talk and write. It is the main language of schools and government in China and Taiwan. More than 800 million people around the world speak Mandarin. That is more than any other language. Mandarin is written with special pictures called characters. Each character stands for one idea. Some characters started as simple drawings of things like the sun or a tree. People learn Mandarin in school so they can talk to others from different parts of China. Mandarin is also one of the six languages used at the United Nations.
United Kingdom\n\nThe United Kingdom is a country in Europe. It is made up of four parts: England, Scotland, Wales, and Northern Ireland. The big city called London is the capital. The UK has a king. Many people live there and speak English. The flag is called the Union Jack. It has red, white, and blue colors. The UK is near the ocean and has many green hills and old castles.
Miami\n\nMiami is a big city in Florida, a state in the United States. It is warm and sunny there most of the year. Many people visit Miami for fun and to see the beaches. The city has lots of people from Cuba, Puerto Rico, and Haiti. They speak Spanish and English. Miami is called "The Magic City" because it grew very fast. There are many tall buildings, hotels, and sports teams. The Miami Heat play basketball, and the Miami Dolphins play football. Many kids go to school in Miami.
Date palm\n\nA date palm is a tall tree that grows in hot, dry places. It has a long trunk and big leaves that look like feathers. The leaves have sharp points on them. The tree grows sweet fruit called dates. People have grown date palms for a very long time to eat the fruit. The dates are brown and sticky and taste very sweet.
Pheasant\n\nA pheasant is a big bird. The boy pheasant is bigger and has bright feathers and a long tail. The girl pheasant is smaller and has plain feathers. Pheasants live in many parts of the world. People sometimes hunt them for food. Some kinds of pheasants are in danger because of hunting.
Past\n\nThe past is everything that has already happened. It is not happening now, and it is not going to happen later. Things that have not happened yet are called the future. People who study the past and try to understand why things happened are called historians. Some books and movies tell made-up stories about the past, and those are called historical fiction. Other stories are about traveling back to the past in a time machine.
Chemical reaction\n\nA chemical reaction is when one thing changes into something else. For example, when you bake a cake, the ingredients change into a cake. Some reactions are fast, like when a firecracker pops. Some are slow, like when a nail gets rusty. When wood gets very hot, it burns and turns into ash and smoke. That is a chemical reaction. Some reactions give off heat, and some need heat to happen. Mixing baking soda and vinegar makes bubbles — that is a chemical reaction too.
Pier\n\nA pier is a walkway that goes out over water. It is raised up so people can walk on it. Some piers are made of wood, and some are made of concrete. People use piers to get on boats, to fish, or just to look at the water. A pier can be short or very long, even as long as a mile.
Political freedom\n\nPolitical freedom is when people can choose who makes the rules for their country. People can say what they think and meet with others to talk about ideas. In some places, people vote to pick their leaders. Political freedom means no one can stop you from having your own thoughts or telling others about them.
Child development\n\nChild development is how children grow and change from babies to grown-ups. Children learn new things every day, like how to walk, talk, and play. Every child grows at their own speed. Some children may need extra help to learn new things. Long ago, people thought children were born bad and needed to be taught to be good. Later, a man named John Locke said children are born with empty minds, like a blank paper, and learn from what they see and do. Another man named Jean-Jacques Rousseau said children are born good, but the world can make them bad. A doctor named Sigmund Freud thought children have three parts in their mind: the part that wants things right away, the part that knows what is real, and the part that knows right from wrong. He said children go through five stages as they grow. Another man named Erik Erikson said children go through eight stages, and at each stage they learn to solve a problem between two feelings.
Radio wave\n\nRadio waves are a kind of energy that travels through the air. They are like light waves, but much longer. You cannot see radio waves, but they are all around you. Radios use these waves to send music and talk shows to your home. A radio wave looks like a hill and a valley that repeats over and over. The distance from one hill top to the next is called the wavelength. Some radio waves are as short as a few centimeters, and some are as long as a few meters. Antennas on cars and houses catch radio waves so the radio can play. People also use radio waves to talk on mobile phones and to send messages to computers. Big dish-shaped antennas called radio telescopes catch radio waves from space to learn about stars and planets.
Zipper\n\nA zipper is a thing that holds two pieces of cloth together. It has two long strips with little teeth made of metal or plastic. A small part called the slider moves up and down to push the teeth together or pull them apart. When you move the slider down, the zipper opens. When you move it up, the zipper closes. Zippers are on jackets, pants, bags, and many other things. They make a buzzing sound when you move them.
Auk\n\nAn auk is a bird that lives in the northern part of the world. It stays near the ocean. Auks have long, thick bodies, small wings, and short legs with webbed feet. They are black on the back and white on the belly, so they look a little like penguins. But auks can fly, and penguins cannot. Auks flap their wings very fast to fly. They are very good at swimming and diving in the water. Most auks live on the ocean far from land for many months. They come to land only to build nests and lay eggs. Some kinds of auks are puffins, murres, and razorbills.
Plant\n\nA plant is a living thing that grows in the ground. Plants need sunlight, water, and soil to live. Most plants have roots that go into the ground, a stem that stands up, and leaves that are often green. The leaves use sunlight to make food for the plant. This is how plants eat. Plants can be big like trees or small like grass. Some plants have pretty flowers that smell nice. Bees and other bugs visit flowers to get sweet nectar. When a bee goes from flower to flower, it helps the plant make seeds. Seeds can grow into new plants. Some seeds travel on the wind or stick to animals. Plants are very important because they give us food and clean air.
Judo\n\nJudo is a sport where two people try to throw each other to the ground. It started in Japan a long time ago. People who do judo wear special white or blue clothes and a belt. They learn how to fall safely and how to hold someone down. In a judo match, you get points for throwing your friend on the mat. If you hold them down for 20 seconds, you get a point. The person with the most points wins a medal. Girls and boys can both do judo. Girls must tie their hair back. Everyone plays barefoot.
Lusaka\n\nLusaka is a big city in Africa. It is the capital of a country called Zambia. Lusaka is the largest city in that country. It sits on high, flat land. Many people live there.
Spanish moss\n\nSpanish moss is a plant that grows on trees. It lives in warm, wet places like swamps and marshes. You can see it in the southern part of the United States. Spanish moss hangs down from tree branches like long gray hair. It does not hurt the tree. It gets water and food from the air and rain. People have used Spanish moss to stuff pillows and mattresses.
German literature\n\nGerman literature is the stories and poems written in the German language. People in Germany, Austria, and other places write these books. Some German stories are very old and famous, like fairy tales about princesses and dragons.
Peach\n\nA peach is a sweet fruit that grows on a tree. The tree has green pointy leaves and small pink flowers. People keep the tree short so they can pick the fruit easily. The peach has orange or yellow skin with tiny soft hairs, called fuzz. Inside, the fruit is golden and tastes sweet and sticky. There is a hard shell around the seed, so peaches are called stone fruits. Peaches come from China and are a symbol of long life there. The tree can live about 10 to 12 years if it is healthy.
Lawyer\n\nA lawyer is a person who knows a lot about rules called laws. If someone has a problem with the law, they can ask a lawyer for help. The lawyer talks to the judge in court and tries to show that their side is right. Some lawyers help people who are in trouble for doing something wrong. Other lawyers help people buy a house or write a will. Lawyers work in offices or by themselves. They usually get paid for their work, but sometimes they help for free.
Geneva\n\nGeneva is a city in Switzerland. It is the second biggest city in that country. Geneva sits where a big river leaves a huge lake. Many important groups have offices there, like the United Nations and the Red Cross. People in Geneva speak French. The city has a cold winter and a warm summer. Sometimes it rains hard in May. There are over 1,000 places to eat in Geneva. Every year, people watch a special tree to see when spring starts.
Digital camera\n\nA digital camera is a box that takes pictures and saves them as computer files. It does not use film like old cameras. You can take many pictures, even hundreds or thousands, and keep them on a small card called a memory card. Most digital cameras can also record videos. You can connect the camera to a computer with a cable to move the pictures to the computer. Many phones have a small digital camera inside, but a big separate camera usually makes better pictures, especially when it is dark.
Yokohama\n\nYokohama is a big city in Japan. It is near Tokyo and has a big port where ships bring things from other countries. Many cars and machines are sent from this port to other places. Yokohama has a fun area called Minato Mirai with amusement parks and shopping malls. It also has the biggest Chinatown in Japan, where you can see different shops and foods. Long ago, Yokohama was one of the first places in Japan where people from other countries could come and trade.
Rock dove\n\nA rock dove is a kind of bird. Wild rock doves live on faraway islands and rocky cliffs. They have light grey bodies and two black stripes on their wings. Their heads are dark blue-grey, and the feathers on their necks shine green and purple in the sun. Many rock doves live in cities and towns all over the world. People call them pigeons. Pigeons walk on the ground and pick up dropped food in streets and parks. Some pigeons are pets. People have kept pigeons for a very long time, even thousands of years. Some pigeons can find their way home from far away. Pigeons come in many colors, like white, pink, and brown.
Fir\n\nA fir is a tall tree that stays green all year long. It has needles instead of flat leaves. The needles stick to the branches with a little round base. Fir trees grow very tall, up to 80 meters. They have cones that hold seeds. The cones stand up on the branches. Male cones are small and let the wind carry pollen to the female cones. Fir trees have sticky sap inside. People use fir wood to make thin sheets for building things. Fir trees are also planted in gardens to block the wind or look pretty.
Wind\n\nWind is moving air. You cannot see wind, but you can feel it on your skin. Wind can be soft like a breeze or very strong like a storm. Strong wind can blow leaves, hats, and even big trees. Wind helps move clouds and makes kites fly high. Sometimes wind can be so strong that it hurts houses. Wind comes from the sun heating the air. Hot air rises and cool air moves in to take its place. That moving air is wind.
Skunk\n\nA skunk is a small animal with black fur and a white stripe down its back. It has a fluffy tail. When a skunk is scared, it can spray a very bad smell from under its tail. The smell keeps other animals away. Skunks eat plants like berries and nuts, and also small animals like worms and frogs. Sometimes they eat food from trash cans. Most skunks live in the United States and Canada. Some people keep skunks as pets, but it is not allowed in many places because of the smell.
Lighting\n\nLighting is when we use light to see things. We can get light from the sun during the day. Windows let sunlight into a room so we can see without turning on lights. At night, we use lamps and lights on the ceiling to make the room bright. Lighting helps us take pictures and make movies.
Fairy\n\nA fairy is a make-believe creature that can fly in the air. Fairies are often drawn as tiny girls or women with wings. Some fairies have special jobs, like the Tooth Fairy, who leaves a coin or a treat under a child's pillow when a tooth falls out. You can read about fairies in stories like Peter Pan. People in Ireland and Scotland tell old tales about fairies who live in caves underground.
Variable\n\nA variable is a special kind of number or thing that can change. In math, a variable is often a letter like "x" or "y" that stands for a number we do not know yet. In science, a variable can be something like how far you are from a tree. If you walk away, the distance gets bigger, so it changes. In computers, a variable is a place to store something that can change, like a word or a number. Programmers give variables names like "age" or "name" to remember what is inside.
Atlas\n\nAn atlas is a book full of maps. Maps show pictures of places like countries, oceans, and mountains. An atlas can help you find where different cities are. Long ago, people made atlases by hand. Today, atlases show many things, like where people live or what the land looks like. Some atlases are on computers too.
Aggression\n\nAggression is when someone tries to hurt another person or animal on purpose. It can be hitting, pushing, or saying mean things.
Meander\n\nA meander is a curve in a river. Rivers do not go straight; they bend like a snake. The water moves fast on the outside of the bend and cuts away the dirt. On the inside, the water moves slow and drops dirt. Over time, the curves get bigger. Sometimes two curves meet and make a new lake.
Sloth\n\nA sloth is a slow animal that lives in trees in Central and South America. It has long arms with hook-like claws that help it hang upside down from branches. Sloths sleep during the day and are awake at night. They curl up into a ball or hang upside down to rest. Their fur looks like tree bark, so big cats like jaguars cannot see them. Sloths hardly ever come down from the trees. When they do, they crawl very slowly on the ground. But they are good swimmers and can hold their breath underwater for a long time. Sloths eat leaves and flowers, which take a long time to digest. They can live for up to 30 years.
Centaurus\n\nCentaurus is a group of stars in the night sky. It is named after a make-believe creature that is half man and half horse. You can see Centaurus if you live in the southern part of the world. A long time ago, a man named Ptolemy wrote about it. Today, scientists say there are 88 groups of stars in the sky, and Centaurus is one of them.
Solomon Islands\n\nSolomon Islands is a country made of many islands in the South Pacific Ocean. The islands are very pretty and have lots of different languages. The capital city is Honiara. Long ago, the islands were ruled by Britain. During a big war, soldiers from Japan and the United States fought there. Later, there was some fighting between groups of people on the islands. In 2007, a very big earthquake shook the ground and made a huge wave called a tsunami. The wave hurt many people and broke many houses. The ground even pushed up so much that one island got bigger and new rocks showed up near the water.
Lavender\n\nLavender is a plant with pretty purple flowers. It grows in many places around the world. People like to plant lavender in gardens because it smells nice. The flowers can be dried and put in little bags to make clothes smell good. You can also eat lavender! It is used in cakes, cookies, and tea. Some people put lavender in medicine to help with headaches or bug bites. Lavender tea can help you feel calm before bed. The purple color is so special that it has a name: lavender.
Vaccine\n\nA vaccine is a special medicine that helps your body stay healthy and not get sick from certain bad germs. It is usually given as a shot in your arm. When you get a vaccine, your body learns how to fight that germ. Then if the germ tries to get you later, your body can stop it. For example, the flu vaccine helps you not get the flu. Some vaccines have a tiny bit of weak germ that cannot make you sick. Others have dead germs. Your body still learns from them. Vaccines have helped stop many bad sicknesses like measles and polio. Most doctors say vaccines are very safe and good for you.
Mid-Atlantic Ridge\n\nThe Mid-Atlantic Ridge is a long mountain range under the Atlantic Ocean. It is the biggest mountain range in the world, but most of it is underwater. Only a little bit of it sticks up above the water, like in Iceland. The ridge is where the ocean floor slowly pulls apart. Every year the two sides move about as far as your thumb is wide. Hot melted rock comes up from deep inside the Earth and makes new ocean floor. This ridge was found by scientists on a big ship in 1872. They used a special machine to see it under the water. The ridge has a deep crack in the middle, and sometimes earthquakes happen there.
Bat\n\nA bat is a mammal that can fly. Bats sleep during the day and are awake at night. They live in caves, trees, or old buildings. Most bats eat bugs like mosquitoes and moths. Some bats eat fruit. Bats use sound to find their way in the dark. They make high squeaks that bounce off things and come back as echoes. This helps them catch food and not bump into things. Bats have wings made of thin skin stretched between long finger bones. They can fly very fast and change direction quickly. Bats are not blind; they can see well. Some bats live for a very long time, even up to forty years.
Toothache\n\nA toothache is a hurt feeling in your tooth. It happens when a tooth is broken or has a little hole called a cavity. The hurt can come and go. Cold or hot food can make the hurt feel stronger. If your tooth hurts, a grown-up can take you to a tooth doctor to help fix it.
Amaterasu mikami\n\nAmaterasu is a sun goddess in Japanese stories. She is the most important god in the Shinto religion. Her name means "she who lights up the sky." She has a special shrine at Ise. Amaterasu is the sister of Susanoo, the god of the sea and storms, and Tsukuyomi, the god of the moon. One time, Susanoo did bad things like breaking her rice fields and throwing a dead pony into her loom. Amaterasu got very sad and hid in a cave. The world became dark. The other gods tried to get her out. A happy goddess named Ama-no-Uzume danced and made everyone laugh. Amaterasu heard the laughter and came out to see. Then light came back to the world.
Skin\n\nSkin is the outside covering of your body. It keeps bad germs out and helps you stay warm or cool. Skin can be different colors like light or dark. It is the biggest part of your body. Skin stops germs from getting inside and making you sick. It also keeps the sun's strong rays from hurting you. You should keep your skin clean. Some animals have fur, feathers, or scales on their skin. People use animal skin to make leather for shoes and bags.
Jewellery\n\nJewellery is something people wear to look pretty. It has no other job than to be nice to look at. The most common kinds are necklaces, rings, and earrings. People have made jewellery for a very long time. The first jewellery was made from bones, animal teeth, wood, or stone. Today, jewellery can be made from many things, like shiny stones and special metals. Some jewellery is made just for fun and is not expensive.
Chicory\n\nChicory is a plant with bright blue flowers. It grows wild on roadsides in Europe and also in North America, China, and Australia. People use chicory in many ways. They can eat the leaves in salads. The root can be baked and ground up to make a drink that tastes like coffee. Sometimes chicory is used to make a sweet powder called inulin, which is added to food. Animals like cows and sheep also eat chicory as food.
Economics\n\nEconomics is about how people choose to use things like money, time, and stuff. People have to make choices because there is not enough of everything for everyone. For example, if you have one cookie, you have to decide if you eat it now or save it for later. Economics also looks at how people make, sell, and buy things. Families, companies, and the government all make choices about money. Some people study big things like why a whole country gets richer or poorer. That is called macroeconomics. Other people study small things like how a family spends its money. That is called microeconomics.
Gulf of Saint Lawrence\n\nThe Gulf of Saint Lawrence is a big body of salt water in Canada. It is where the Saint Lawrence River meets the Atlantic Ocean. Many rivers pour into this gulf. It has islands like Prince Edward Island and Anticosti Island. Some parts of the gulf are protected parks where birds live. Ships have to be careful because there are many rocks and shipwrecks.
Limpopo River\n\nThe Limpopo River is a long river in Africa. It flows through South Africa, Botswana, Zimbabwe, and Mozambique. The river helps make the border between some of these countries. At the end, the river water goes into the big Indian Ocean.
Railway track\n\nA railway track is a path made of two long steel bars that sit side by side. Trains ride on these bars to carry people and things from one place to another. The steel bars are held up by strong blocks called sleepers, which are made of wood or concrete. Small rocks called ballast are packed around the sleepers to keep the track steady. The train wheels have a special shape and a little lip on the edge so the train stays on the track and does not fall off.
Hispaniola\n\nHispaniola is an island in the Caribbean Sea. It is a big island with two countries on it. One country is called Haiti, and the other is called the Dominican Republic. The island has many mountains and tall peaks. The highest mountain is called Duarte Peak. There are also rivers and lakes. A long time ago, people called the Taíno lived there. Then Christopher Columbus came to the island in 1492. He named it Hispaniola. Now many people live on the island.
Woodwind instrument\n\nA woodwind instrument is something you blow into to make music. Long ago, people made these instruments from wood. Now some are made from metal or plastic. In an orchestra, there are four main kinds: flute, oboe, clarinet, and bassoon. The flute is the highest sounding. You blow across the top of it, like blowing across a bottle top. The oboe and bassoon have a double reed, which is like blowing through a drinking straw. The clarinet has a single reed that shakes when you blow. The saxophone looks like a brass instrument, but it is played like a clarinet, so it is a woodwind. The recorder is a simple woodwind that many children learn to play. Woodwind players shape their mouth in different ways to make different sounds.
Elm\n\nAn elm is a big tree that grows in many cold and warm places around the world. Its leaves are shaped like a pointy oval with little teeth on the edges, and one side is bigger than the other. The tree makes tiny flowers that turn into round, flat seeds that fly in the wind. It takes many years for an elm to grow up tall.
Munich\n\nMunich is a big city in Germany. It is the third biggest city in the country, after Berlin and Hamburg. Many people live there, about one and a half million. Munich has a big airport and trains that go under the ground. It is famous for its soccer team, FC Bayern Munich, which wins many games. The city also has a big park and a river where people can swim. In summer, it is warm, and in winter, it can be cold and snowy.
Persian literature\n\nPersian literature is stories and poems from Iran. People in Iran have been writing poems and stories for a very long time. Some of the poems are about love, nature, and brave heroes. Persian books also tell about history and science. Many people around the world love to read Persian poems.
Tin\n\nTin is a metal that looks silver and is a little soft. You can bend it, and it makes a crackling sound called "tin cry." Tin can melt easily in a flame. People mix tin with copper to make bronze, which is a strong metal used for tools and weapons long ago. Tin is also used to cover other metals, like steel, to keep food safe in cans. Tin foil was used before aluminum foil. Tin is not poisonous, but some tin mixtures can be bad for fish.
Giant tortoise\n\nA giant tortoise is a very big turtle that lives on islands. It can weigh as much as a big sofa and grow longer than a bathtub. Some giant tortoises live on the Galapagos Islands, and some live on Aldabra Atoll in Seychelles. They have a hard shell on their back to protect them. They can live for more than 100 years, which is longer than any other animal that lives on land. The oldest one ever was about 255 years old. Long ago, people caught and ate many giant tortoises, so there were almost none left. Now people protect them, and their numbers are growing again.
Roman art\n\nRoman art is the art made by people who lived in Ancient Rome a long time ago. They made big buildings, statues, and pictures with tiny colored stones called mosaics. Most of their paintings are gone now, but we can still see some of their beautiful statues and buildings.
Bangkok\n\nBangkok is a big city and the capital of Thailand. It is one of the most popular places for people to visit. Many millions of people live there. The city has a warm and sunny weather most of the year. People call it "Krung Thep" for short, which means "city of angels." The full name is very long and hard to say. Many visitors come to Bangkok to see temples, eat food, and shop.
Video\n\nVideo is a way to record and show moving pictures. A video camera takes many pictures very fast to make a video. You can watch videos on a screen like a TV or a computer. Videos can be short, like a music video, or long, like a movie. People use videos to tell stories, learn new things, and have fun.
Fashion\n\nFashion is the way people dress and look. It includes clothes, shoes, hats, and even how you fix your hair. Fashion changes with the weather and where you live. In cold places, people wear warm coats. In hot places, people wear thin clothes. Fashion also changes over time. Long ago, people wore different clothes than today. You can choose your own fashion to show what you like.
Supernatural\n\nSupernatural is a word for things that some people think are real but we cannot see or prove with science. It is not part of nature like trees or animals. Some people believe in ghosts, magic, or other things that are not normal. We cannot say for sure if these things are real, so people have different ideas about them.
Madurai\n\nMadurai is a city in India. It is in a place called Tamil Nadu. Long ago, it was the capital of a kingdom. Many people visit Madurai to see a big, beautiful temple called Meenakshi Amman Temple. There is also a hall with one thousand pillars. Madurai has many other special places like a palace, a big water tank, and a museum. The city has festivals almost every day, so people call it the City of Festivals. It is also called the Non-sleeping city because it is always busy. You can buy good food from shops on the street. A cool drink called Jigardhanda is famous there. Madurai is also known for pretty jasmine flowers.
Synagogue\n\nA synagogue is a place where Jewish people go to pray and worship God. It is like a special house for gathering together. Inside, there is a big room for prayers and sometimes smaller rooms for learning. The front of the room faces a city called Jerusalem. There is a special closet called the Ark that holds the Torah scrolls, which are the holy writings. A light called the Eternal Lamp always shines above the Ark to show that God is always there. There is also a raised platform called the Bimah where someone reads from the Torah. In some synagogues, men and women sit in different places. Jewish people can also pray at home or anywhere with ten grown-ups.
Puerto Rico\n\nPuerto Rico is a place in the Caribbean Sea that belongs to the United States. It is not a state, but people who live there are citizens of the United States. The main island is big, and there are also smaller islands like Vieques and Culebra. The biggest city and capital is San Juan. Most people speak Spanish at home, and many also learn English in school. The money they use is the United States dollar. The name Puerto Rico means "rich port" in Spanish. The island has warm weather, beaches, and forests. Some people want Puerto Rico to become a state, and some want it to be its own country.
Cactus\n\nA cactus is a plant that lives in hot, dry places like deserts. It has thick stems that store water, so it can go a long time without rain. Most cacti have sharp thorns called spines that keep animals from eating them. Cacti come in many shapes and sizes. Some are short and round; others are tall and thin. Many cactus flowers are big and beautiful. Some bloom at night and are pollinated by moths and bats. Some cactus fruits are brightly colored and good to eat. People grow cacti as houseplants because they are pretty and easy to take care of. The fruit of some cacti, like dragonfruit and prickly pear, is eaten by people.
Shrub\n\nA shrub is a plant that is like a small tree but with many stems coming from the ground. Shrubs are usually shorter than trees, often less than 2 meters tall. Some shrubs lose their leaves in winter, and some stay green all year. People plant shrubs in gardens to make them look pretty. Small shrubs like lavender and thyme are called subshrubs.
Cup\n\nA cup is a container that holds liquid for drinking. You can drink water, milk, or juice from a cup. Cups come in many shapes and sizes. Some cups have handles, and some do not. Cups can be made of glass, plastic, or clay.
Power station\n\nA power station is a big building where electricity is made. Inside, a big wheel spins very fast to make the electricity. Some power stations burn coal or gas to make steam that spins the wheel. Others use wind or water to spin the wheel. A few use the sun's light to make electricity without any moving parts. Power stations are all over the world because we need electricity for lights, computers, and many other things.
Virus\n\nA virus is a very tiny thing that can make you sick. It is so small you can only see it with a special microscope. A virus needs to get inside a living thing, like a person, an animal, or a plant, to make more copies of itself. When it does that, it can cause diseases like a cold or the flu. Viruses are not alive like we are; they are like little packages with a coat of protein around some genetic material. They are everywhere, but your body has ways to fight them off. Sometimes you get a shot called a vaccine to help your body learn how to beat a virus before it makes you sick.
Petroleum\n\nPetroleum is a thick, black liquid that comes from deep underground. It is made from tiny sea plants that lived a very long time ago. People drill holes in the ground or under the ocean to find it. Petroleum is used to make fuel for cars, trucks, and airplanes. It is also used to make roads. But there is only so much petroleum in the world, and once it is gone, we cannot get more. When we burn it, it makes the air dirty.
Memory card\n\nA memory card is a tiny flat thing that goes inside a camera, a phone, or a game machine. It keeps your pictures, songs, and saved games safe. Memory cards have no moving parts, so they are hard to break. You can take them out and put them in another device. Some memory cards can hold a lot of pictures, and some hold only a few. The most common kind is called an SD card.
Chinese martial arts\n\nChinese martial arts are special ways of moving your body that come from China. People also call them kung-fu or wushu. These are fighting styles that people have learned for a very long time. Some styles copy how animals move, like a tiger or a crane. Some styles help you breathe and feel calm inside. Other styles make your muscles strong and your heart healthy. People practice them to stay fit and to learn how to protect themselves.
Lullaby\n\nA lullaby is a soft song that people sing to help a baby or small child fall asleep. The song has a gentle, rocking beat that feels calm and cozy. Many mothers sing lullabies at bedtime. Two well-known lullabies are "Rock-a-bye Baby" and "Hush Little Baby." Some music writers also made lullabies for instruments like the piano.
Place value\n\nPlace value is a way to know how much a number is worth. In our number system, where we write numbers from 0 to 9, each spot in a number has a different value. The first spot on the right is for ones. The next spot to the left is for tens. The next spot is for hundreds. For example, in the number 123, the 3 means 3 ones, the 2 means 2 tens (which is 20), and the 1 means 1 hundred (which is 100). So place value helps us understand big numbers.
Aral Sea\n\nThe Aral Sea was a big lake in Central Asia. It is between two countries called Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan. Long ago, it was one of the biggest lakes in the world. But starting in the 1960s, the lake got smaller and smaller. People used the rivers that filled the lake to water cotton plants. Now most of the lake is gone. The water that is left is very dirty. People are trying to save the northern part of the lake by building a wall to hold the water. The wall broke once, but they fixed it again. The lake used to have an island where bad germs were tested, but now that island is connected to the land.
Shogi\n\nShogi is a board game from Japan. Two people play it on a board with flat pieces. Each player starts with 20 pieces. The game is like chess but different. When you take a piece from the other player, you can put it back on the board as your own piece. This makes the game very exciting. People in Japan love to play shogi.
Lake Ontario\n\nLake Ontario is a big lake in North America. It is the smallest of the five Great Lakes, but it is still very deep. The lake sits between Canada and the United States. Water comes into Lake Ontario from Niagara Falls. Then water leaves the lake through the Saint Lawrence River. Many people live near Lake Ontario.
Jackal\n\nA jackal is a wild animal that looks a bit like a dog. Jackals live in Africa, Asia, and Europe. They eat meat from small and medium-sized animals. They can run for a long time without getting tired. Jackals often hunt in pairs or groups. They also eat food that other animals leave behind. A mother and father jackal stay together for a long time. They mark their home with pee and poop to keep other jackals away. Baby jackals sometimes stay with their parents until they grow up. There are three kinds of jackals.
State\n\nA state is a group of people who live together in one place and have a government that makes rules for them. The government controls the land and the people. A state has things like laws, police, and an army to keep everyone safe. Some states are ruled by a king or queen, and some states let the people vote for their leaders. Long ago, many states were small and run by kings who fought each other. Today, states have borders that show where one state ends and another begins. Different states can have different kinds of government, like democracy or dictatorship. In a democracy, people get to choose their leaders. In a dictatorship, one person makes all the rules. Some people believe that a state should help workers and make sure everyone is treated fairly. Other people think that a state should not exist at all, and that people can take care of themselves.
Marsh\n\nA marsh is a place where the ground is wet and shallow. It has lots of grass, reeds, and other soft plants growing in the water. The water can be fresh or salty. Many animals live in marshes and use them as homes. Birds, fish, and bugs like to stay there. Marshes are different from swamps because swamps have more trees and deeper water.
Verbena\n\nVerbena is a kind of plant. Some verbena plants grow in Europe. People call one type of verbena "vervain." Some verbena plants are weeds that grow in the wild. Verbena is not the same as lantana, which is another plant that looks a little like it.
Black Sea\n\nThe Black Sea is a big body of saltwater between Europe and other lands. Many big rivers like the Danube and Dnieper flow into it. The sea is connected to the ocean through a long path of other seas. Most of the deep part of the Black Sea has no oxygen, so fish cannot live there. Its water is less salty than the ocean. Long ago, during the ice age, it was a lake of fresh water. The sea is divided by a piece of land called Crimea.
Germanic languages\n\nGermanic languages are a group of languages that people speak. They all started from one old language a long time ago. English is a Germanic language, and many people speak it. Other Germanic languages are German, Dutch, and the languages people speak in countries like Sweden and Norway. Some Germanic languages are not spoken anymore.
Ham\n\nHam is meat that comes from the leg of a pig. People eat ham for meals like breakfast or lunch. Ham can be salty and is often pink or light red in color. Some ham is made by rubbing salt on the meat. Other ham is made with salty water. You can find ham in sandwiches or on a plate with eggs.
Telescope\n\nA telescope is a tool that makes faraway things look bigger and closer. You can use it to look at stars, planets, and the Moon. Some telescopes use curved mirrors, and some use curved lenses to gather light. The first telescope was made in the Netherlands a long time ago. A man named Galileo was the first to point a telescope at the sky. Big telescopes are used by scientists to study space. Small telescopes can be used by anyone to look at the night sky. Some telescopes are even put in space so they can see things that our eyes cannot.
Parenting\n\nParenting is how grown-ups take care of a child and help them grow up. When a baby is very small, parents give the baby food, keep the baby clean and warm, and let the baby sleep a lot. Since babies cannot talk, parents watch them closely and help them learn words. As the child gets bigger, parents teach them things like brushing their teeth and being nice to other people.
History of India\n\nThe history of India is a very long story about people who lived there many, many years ago. A long time ago, early people lived in India and used stone tools. Later, people learned to grow food and build cities. The first big cities were near the Indus River. People there made things from metal and built houses with bricks. Then, people called the Aryans came and wrote the Vedas, which are old teachings. Later, kings from Persia and Greece came to India. One big kingdom was called Magadha. From Magadha came the Maurya Empire, which had a king named Ashoka who helped spread Buddhism. After that, the Gupta Empire was a time of great learning in science and math. Many different kings ruled different parts of India over thousands of years.
Republic of the Congo\n\nThe Republic of the Congo is a country in Africa. Its capital city is Brazzaville. The country has big rainforests in the north and many farms in the south. People grow bananas and peanuts there. The country is near the middle of the world, along the Equator. It has a short coast on the Atlantic Ocean. The Congo River flows through the capital, and across the river is another country called the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
Libya\n\nLibya is a country in Africa. It is next to the Mediterranean Sea. The capital city is Tripoli, which sits on the sea. Most of Libya is very dry desert. Not many people live there because it is so hot and sandy. Most people live in cities near the coast. The people are called Libyans. They speak Arabic and most are Muslim. Libya has a lot of oil under the ground. Oil is the main thing the country sells to other countries. Libya also grows food like wheat, olives, and dates. The money used in Libya is called the dinar.
Empire\n\nAn empire is a very big group of lands and people ruled by one strong leader. Long ago, there were many empires like the Roman Empire and the British Empire. Some empires grew fast by fighting and taking over new places. Other empires grew by sailing across the sea to find new lands. The leader of an empire is called an emperor. Today, there is only one emperor left, the Emperor of Japan, but he does not make the rules.
Squash (sport)\n\nSquash is a game where two people hit a ball with a racket. The ball is made of rubber and is hollow. When the ball gets warm from hitting, it bounces more. The racket is smaller and lighter than a tennis racket. Players hit the ball against the front wall. They try to make the ball bounce two times on the floor before the other player can hit it back. The game goes to 11 points, and you must win by 2 points. The first player to win three games wins the match. If a player gets in the way, they can ask for a "let" and play the point again. If a player blocks the other from swinging, the other player can win the point.
Modern art\n\nModern art is a kind of art that people made from a long time ago until about the 1970s. Artists tried new ways to paint and draw. They did not always paint things the way they look in real life. Some artists used bright colors and wild shapes. Others made pictures that look like puzzles. A famous artist named Pablo Picasso made pictures with cubes and triangles. Another artist named Henri Matisse painted people dancing with bright colors. Modern art can be big paintings or small drawings. Some modern art is very famous and costs a lot of money.
Hibernation\n\nHibernation is when some animals sleep for a long time in winter. They do this because there is not much food to eat. Before winter, they eat a lot of food to get fat. Then they find a safe place to sleep. While they sleep, their body gets very cold and they breathe very slowly. They use the fat in their body to stay alive.
