Bats, hedgehogs, and ground squirrels hibernate. Bears sleep in winter too, but their sleep is not as deep as hibernation.
Forbidden City\n\nThe Forbidden City is a very old palace in the middle of Beijing, China. It was the home of the emperors of China for almost 500 years. The name means that no one could go in or out without the emperor saying yes. Today it is a museum where people can visit and see old buildings and art. The palace is very big and has many rooms. It took over 14 years and more than a million workers to build it.
Colorado River\n\nThe Colorado River is a very long river that flows through the United States and Mexico. It starts high up in the Rocky Mountains and runs through states like Colorado, Utah, Arizona, Nevada, and California. The river is used to water farms and give people water to drink. Big dams on the river make electricity and help stop big floods. Sometimes the river does not reach the ocean anymore because people use so much of its water.
Malaria\n\nMalaria is a sickness that comes from tiny bugs called parasites. These parasites get into your blood when a mosquito bites you. The mosquito that carries malaria is called Anopheles. Only girl mosquitoes bite people because they need blood to make eggs. Boy mosquitoes do not bite. When the parasite gets in your blood, it makes you very sick with a high fever. You might feel hot and cold, have a headache, and feel very tired. The sickness can be very dangerous, especially for little kids and pregnant women. Many people who get malaria live in warm places like Africa. Doctors can test your blood to see if you have malaria. They give medicine to help you get better. But some mosquitoes are hard to kill, and some parasites are hard to stop with medicine.
Mount Vesuvius\n\nMount Vesuvius is a big mountain that can shoot hot ash and fire into the sky. It is in Italy, near a city called Naples. A long, long time ago, in the year 79, it erupted very strongly and covered two towns, Pompeii and Herculaneum, with ash. The ash buried the towns so deep that people forgot about them until they were found many years later. Today, many people live near Mount Vesuvius, and it is still a dangerous volcano. It has erupted many times since then, and the last time was in 1944.
Building\n\nA building is a place with walls and a roof that people make. People live in some buildings, like houses and apartments. Other buildings are for working, like stores and offices. Some buildings are for praying, like churches and temples. Buildings can be tall or short. They have doors to go in and out, and windows to let light inside. A tall building has stairs or an elevator to go up and down. Some buildings have rooms under the ground, called basements. Buildings are made of wood, stone, concrete, or steel. Architects are people who plan how a building will look.
Passover\n\nPassover is a special holiday for Jewish people. They celebrate it to remember a long time ago when God helped Moses free the people from being slaves in Egypt. During Passover, families eat special foods, do special things, and sing songs. It happens in March or April every year.
Netball\n\nNetball is a sport where two teams of seven players try to throw a ball through a hoop. You cannot bounce the ball or walk with it. You must pass the ball to your teammates. Each player stays in a special part of the court. The court is a big rectangle with lines on the ground. The hoop is at each end of the court. When you throw the ball through the hoop, your team gets a point.
Sock\n\nA sock is something you wear on your feet. Socks keep your feet dry and warm. They are often made of cotton or wool. Some socks are short and cover only your foot and ankle. Other socks are long and go up to your knee. Toe socks wrap each toe by itself, like gloves for your feet. Socks come in many colors. White socks are for playing and sports. Dark socks like black or brown are for fancy clothes. Some socks have patterns on them. People also call a cover for a phone a "sock." Phone socks help keep the phone safe.
Tongue\n\nYour tongue is the soft, strong muscle inside your mouth. It helps you taste food, mix it with spit, and move it around so you can eat. Your tongue also helps you talk and make sounds. It is very bendy and can move a lot. Some people can roll their tongue into a tube shape. If your mom or dad can roll their tongue, you might be able to do it too. People who can roll their tongue can sometimes make a funny high sound by blowing through it.
Garter snake\n\nA garter snake is a long, thin animal that slides on the ground. It lives in many places across North America, from cold Alaska to warm Central America. You can tell it by the stripe that runs down its back. The stripe can be different colors. Garter snakes like to hide under leaves, rocks, and sticks. They eat small animals like worms, bugs, and tiny fish. They are not dangerous to people. If they bite, it feels like a little scratch. They can also spray a bad smell. Many garter snakes live in backyards and woods.
Blackcurrant\n\nBlackcurrant is a small fruit that tastes a little bit bitter. It grows in Europe and Asia. The fruit is dark in color, which is how it got its name. Blackcurrant has a lot of vitamin C, which is good for your body. People use it to make jelly, ice cream, and a sweet drink called cordial. In the United Kingdom, blackcurrant is a very popular flavor. You can also put blackcurrants in salads or bake them in cakes, just like raisins.
Electric guitar\n\nAn electric guitar is a musical instrument that makes sound using electricity. It has strings, and when you pluck them, the sound goes to a box called an amplifier that makes it loud. Electric guitars come in many colors and shapes. They have a long neck with metal lines called frets. You press the strings on the frets to make different notes. Many people play electric guitars in bands and rock music. Some famous companies that make them are Fender and Gibson.
Wolf\n\nA wolf is a wild animal that looks a bit like a big dog. It has a long nose, short ears that stand up, long legs, and a bushy tail. Wolves can be gray, white, black, or brown. They live in groups called packs. A pack is usually a mom, a dad, and their babies. Baby wolves are called pups. Pups are born blind and cannot hear at first. Wolves howl to talk to each other from far away. They can run very fast and far. Wolves eat meat like deer, moose, and small animals. They have sharp teeth to tear meat. Wolves live in forests, mountains, and cold places like the Arctic. Some people think wolves are mean, but they are usually gentle and only fight to protect their family.
Institution\n\nAn institution is a set of rules that people follow. Some rules are written down, like laws. Other rules are just things people do, like shaking hands. Families and money are big institutions. Institutions last a long time and help people know how to act.
Tyrannosaurus\n\nTyrannosaurus was a very big dinosaur that lived a long, long time ago. It had a huge head, strong jaws, and tiny arms with two fingers. Its teeth were sharp and could break bones. Tyrannosaurus walked on two big legs and had a long tail to help it balance. Some people call it the king of the dinosaurs. It ate meat and might have hunted other dinosaurs or eaten dead ones. The most famous kind is Tyrannosaurus rex. Scientists have found many of its bones. You can see them in museums. Tyrannosaurus also appears in movies like Jurassic Park.
Voice\n\nA voice is the sound a person makes when they talk or sing. The sound travels through the air so other people can hear it. Your voice comes from your throat, where two small parts called vocal cords help make the sound. When you speak, air passes over them and makes a noise. If a person cannot make any sound with their voice, that is called being mute. The part of a song that people sing with their voice is called vocals. Animals also make sounds, but we usually call those animal sounds instead of voices.
Rhea (bird)\n\nA rhea is a big bird that cannot fly. It lives in South America. The rhea is the biggest bird in all of the Americas. It runs very fast, and when it runs, it holds its neck out flat. Rheas like to stay in groups of 20 to 30 birds. They eat plants, fruits, seeds, nuts, and sometimes bugs or small animals like lizards. The mother rhea lays 12 to 30 eggs. The father rhea makes a nest on the ground, sits on the eggs for 6 weeks, and takes care of the babies.
Inanna\n\nInanna is a make-believe queen from a very old story. People long ago in a place called Sumer thought she was a goddess. They believed she was in charge of love and war. She was also called Ishtar. Her special signs were a lion, a dove, and a star with eight points. Many people liked her and told stories about her.
Grape\n\nA grape is a small fruit that grows on a vine. Grapes can be red, purple, white, or green. You can eat them raw, or make them into juice, jelly, or wine. Some grapes have no seeds inside. When grapes are dried, they become raisins. Grape leaves can also be eaten. Many people like grapes because they taste sweet and are good for you.
Henna\n\nHenna is a plant with flowers. People use it to make a special color. They put the color on their skin to make pretty pictures that wash off after a while. Henna is also used to color hair and fingernails. It has been used for a very long time in places like India and the Middle East. Sometimes people wear henna pictures at weddings.
Leisure\n\nLeisure is free time when you can choose what to do. You do not have to go to school or work. You can play, do fun things with your family, or work on a hobby. Some people go on vacation to a new place and stay in a hotel. Other people stay home and play in their own town. In many countries, people do not work on Saturday and Sunday, so they have more free time.
Disgust\n\nDisgust is a feeling you get when something seems yucky or nasty. You might feel it when you see something dirty or smell something bad. It can also happen when you taste food that does not taste good. Some people feel disgust more than others. You can even make someone feel disgust on purpose.
Florida\n\nFlorida is a state in the southeast part of the United States. It is a peninsula, which means water is on three sides. To the west is the Gulf of Mexico, to the east is the Atlantic Ocean. Florida is called the Sunshine State because it is sunny a lot. It has warm weather and beaches where people like to swim and play. Many people visit Florida for fun. There are big cities like Miami, Orlando, and Tampa. Orlando has theme parks like Walt Disney World and Universal Studios. Florida also has a swamp called the Everglades where alligators live. The capital is Tallahassee.
Industrial park\n\nAn industrial park is a special area where big buildings like factories and warehouses are built. These buildings make things like toys, cars, and food. The park is usually far away from where people live, so the noise and smoke do not bother homes. Trucks and trains bring things to and from the park.
Silent movie\n\nA silent movie is a movie that has no sound. Long ago, cameras could not record sound, so movies were made without talking or noise. People would watch the movie while music played in the room. Sometimes words would appear on the screen to tell the story. A funny man named Charlie Chaplin was a big star in silent movies. He made people laugh without saying a word.
Dentures\n\nDentures are fake teeth that people can put in their mouth to help them eat and talk. They are also called false teeth. Dentures can be made of plastic, nylon, or metal. Some people need all their teeth replaced, and some need only a few. A dentist makes them fit just right so they look like real teeth. You should not wear them when you sleep at night. They help keep your face from looking droopy and help you chew food better.
Suez Canal\n\nThe Suez Canal is a long water path in Egypt. It is like a big ditch filled with water. Ships use it to travel from Europe to Asia without going all the way around Africa. That saves a lot of time. The canal is 163 kilometers long. It was finished in 1869. Many ships go through it every year. In 2021, a big ship got stuck in the canal and blocked it for a while.
Male\n\nMale is one of the two kinds of people or animals. A male human is called a man or a boy. Male and female have different body parts. A male's body can help make a baby with a female's body. Long ago, men often went hunting for food, but today men and women can do many of the same jobs.
Pumpkin\n\nA pumpkin is a fruit that grows on a vine. It is usually orange, but it can also be purple, red, blue, or white. Pumpkins are round or oval. People can eat pumpkins. They make pumpkin pie and pumpkin soup. You can also eat the seeds. People use pumpkins for decoration, like making jack-o-lanterns for Halloween.
Stand-up comedy\n\nStand-up comedy is a show where one person tells funny stories and jokes to people watching. That person is called a comedian. The comedian talks into a microphone so everyone can hear. They tell many short jokes very fast. Sometimes they use music, toys, or magic tricks to be extra funny. You can see stand-up comedy at clubs, bars, schools, or theaters. Some places let new comedians try their jokes in front of a small crowd to get better.
Chichen Itza\n\nChichen Itza is a very old city made by the Maya people a long time ago. It is in Mexico. The most famous building there is a big pyramid called El Castillo. It has four sides and each side has 91 steps. People used to climb the pyramid, but the steps are very steep and small, so now no one is allowed to climb it. There is also a big temple called the Temple of the Warriors. It has many stone columns with pictures of warriors wearing feathers. The Great Ballcourt is a huge field where people played ball games long ago. If you whisper at one end, someone at the other end can hear you. There is a deep hole in the ground called a cenote, which is like a lake underground. The Maya gave gifts to the gods there. Chichen Itza is one of the seven wonders of the world.
Domestic worker\n\nA domestic worker is a person who works in someone else's home and gets paid for it. They can choose to leave their job if they want. Some domestic workers wear a special uniform. Long ago, there were many different kinds of domestic workers. A butler was the most important man servant. A valet took care of his master's clothes. Women workers were maids who cleaned, cooks who made food, and nannies who watched children. Gardeners took care of the yard. Today, some people from poorer countries work as domestic workers in richer countries.
Pakistan\n\nPakistan is a country in Asia. It is next to India, Iran, Afghanistan, and China. Many people live there. The capital is Islamabad. Pakistan has a long coast along the Arabian Sea. It has high mountains, deserts, and flat lands. The Indus River flows through the country. Pakistan has four seasons: cool winter, hot spring, rainy summer, and dry autumn. Earthquakes sometimes happen there. Pakistan became its own country in 1947.
Thai language\n\nThai language is the main language spoken in Thailand, a country far away. People in Thailand use Thai to talk to each other. Thai sounds like music because the same word can mean different things if you say it in a high or low voice. Thai has its own special letters that look different from English letters. There are 44 consonant letters in Thai. Thai is a lot like the Lao language, so people who speak Thai can understand some Lao words.
Gladiator\n\nA gladiator was a fighter in old Rome. They fought other people or wild animals in a big round place called an arena. People came to watch the fights for fun. Many gladiators were slaves or people who lost a war. Some free men chose to become gladiators to become famous. They used swords, spears, or axes. A few gladiators became very rich and well-known.
Potato\n\nA potato is a vegetable that grows under the ground. It has light-brown or yellow skin and is white or yellow inside. People eat potatoes all over the world. Potatoes can be boiled, baked, roasted, or fried. French fries are long strips of potato that are fried until soft. Potato chips are very thin round slices that are fried until hard. Potatoes have a lot of starch, which gives you energy. If a potato gets light on it, it turns green and is not safe to eat. Potatoes first grew in the mountains of South America a long time ago. People brought them to Europe, and now they grow in many places.
Odin\n\nOdin is a make-believe god from old stories. He is the king of all the gods and lives in a place called Asgard. Odin has only one eye because he gave away the other eye to learn many things. He has two pet ravens named Huginn and Muninn that fly around the world and tell him what they see. Odin rides a horse with eight legs called Sleipnir. He carries a special spear that always hits what he aims at. The day Wednesday is named after Odin.
Solid\n\nA solid is a kind of stuff that keeps its own shape. You can hold a solid in your hand, and it does not spill like water. The tiny pieces that make up a solid are stuck close together, so they can only wiggle a little bit. A rock is a solid. A toy block is a solid. When you heat a solid, it can melt and become a liquid. When you cool a liquid, it freezes and becomes a solid. Some solids, like dry ice, can turn into a gas without melting first. Metals are a kind of solid. Metals are strong and heavy. They can carry electricity and heat. People use metals to make buildings, cars, tools, and wires. Iron and aluminum are two common metals. Minerals are another kind of solid. They are found in the ground and have a special shape inside.
Multimedia\n\nMultimedia is when a computer shows you many kinds of things at once, like words, pictures, sounds, and moving videos. It can tell you a story or help you learn something new. You can see a picture and hear a sound at the same time. Some games and shows on a computer use multimedia to be more fun.
Port\n\nA port is a place by the water where big boats called ships can stop. Ships bring things to the port, like food, toys, and other stuff people need. People can also get on or off ships at a port. A port is often called a harbor. Some ports are on the ocean, some are on rivers, and some are on lakes. A good port is safe from big waves and strong wind. Some ports are for fishing boats, and some are for big ships that carry people on trips. The Port of Miami is a very busy port for cruise ships.
Lhasa\n\nLhasa is a city in a place called Tibet. It is very high up in the mountains, one of the highest cities in the world. In Lhasa, there are special buildings where people go to pray and be quiet, like the Potala Palace. The city is very old and has many beautiful temples.
Friction\n\nFriction is a push that slows things down when they rub together. When you slide on the floor, friction makes you stop. It also makes heat, like when you rub your hands together fast. Car brakes use friction to stop the car. Shoes use friction so you do not slip. Friction can be strong enough to keep things from moving at all.
Wheelchair\n\nA wheelchair is a special chair with wheels. People who cannot walk use a wheelchair to move around. Some wheelchairs have big wheels that the person pushes with their hands. Other wheelchairs have a motor and run on a battery. Sometimes another person pushes the wheelchair from behind. Wheelchairs can have soft cushions to make sitting more comfortable. The first wheelchair was made a long time ago by a man who could not use his legs.
Pig\n\nA pig is a mammal with a big round body and short legs. Pigs live on farms and in the wild all over the world. Some people keep pigs as pets. Baby pigs are called piglets. Pigs eat both plants and animals. They are very smart and can even learn to play simple games. Pigs roll in mud to keep cool and to protect their skin from bugs and the sun. Many pigs are pink, but some pet pigs can be other colors. People eat pig meat, which is called pork. Some religions say it is not okay to eat pork. Pigs need a clean place to sleep, lots of water, and food like corn.
Snow\n\nSnow is frozen water that falls from the sky. It is made of tiny ice crystals that are all different shapes and sizes. Snow comes from clouds when it is very cold. When snow gets warm, it melts into water. Sometimes snow turns into water vapor without melting first. People use snow for fun things like skiing and sledding. They also build snowmen and snow forts. Snow can be dangerous because it makes it hard to see and hard to drive. Trucks called snow plows push snow off the roads. Salt is put on roads to help the snow melt faster. A blizzard is a big snowstorm with strong winds.
Mantis\n\nA mantis is a kind of insect. It has long front legs that it holds up like it is praying. That is why it is called a praying mantis. Mantises are very good at hunting. They wait very still and then grab other bugs very fast with their front legs. They eat flies, bugs, and sometimes even small lizards or frogs. Mantises can turn their heads almost all the way around to see things. They are often green or brown to hide in leaves and look like a stick or a leaf. Mantises do not have poison and are not dangerous to people. They can bite, but it does not hurt much.
Ketchup\n\nKetchup is a thick, red sauce that tastes sweet and a little sour. It is made from tomatoes, vinegar, and sugar. People like to put ketchup on burgers, french fries, sausages, hot dogs, and fish sticks. A long time ago, a man named Heinz made ketchup famous. Now you can find ketchup in many stores and restaurants. Some ketchup comes in small packets that you tear open and squeeze out. There was even colored ketchup that was green, purple, or blue, but that is not sold anymore.
Lake Huron\n\nLake Huron is a very big lake in North America. It is one of the five Great Lakes. Lake Huron is very long and deep. Many boats carry things like iron ore across the lake. The lake sits between Canada and the United States. There are no big cities on Lake Huron, but there are small cities like Sarnia and Bay City. Water from Lake Huron flows through a river past Detroit and into Lake Erie. In 1996, a big storm like a hurricane happened on Lake Huron, and people called it Hurricane Huron.
Protestantism\n\nProtestantism is a way of following Jesus. It started a long time ago in Europe. Some people thought the church should follow the Bible more closely. A man named Martin Luther helped start this. He wrote down his ideas on a paper. Many churches today are Protestant. They believe in God and read the Bible.
Stroke\n\nA stroke is when part of the brain stops getting blood. Blood brings food and air to the brain. If a tube that carries blood gets blocked or breaks, the brain cannot work right. A person having a stroke may not be able to move one arm or leg. They might have trouble talking or seeing. Strokes are very serious and need help fast. Doctors can look at the brain with a special machine to see if someone had a stroke. To help stop a stroke, people should eat healthy food and not smoke.
Holi\n\nHoli is a fun festival with lots of colors. People in India and Nepal celebrate it. The festival is about good winning over bad. A long time ago, a bad king tried to hurt a good boy named Prahlad. The king's sister Holika had a magic robe that kept her safe from fire. She sat in fire with Prahlad, but the magic went wrong. Holika got burned and Prahlad was safe. That is why people celebrate Holi. On Holi, people throw colored powder and water on each other. They sing and dance. Families get together and have a happy day.
Ankara\n\nAnkara is a big city in the country of Turkey. It is the capital, which means the most important city where the leaders work. Ankara is in the middle of Turkey. It is a modern city with tall buildings and wide streets. Many people live there. Ankara has a big building called Anitkabir, which is a special place built to remember the first president of Turkey. The city also has places where people watch dances, listen to music, and see plays. Long ago, many different groups of people came to Ankara and lived there.
Theme park\n\nA theme park is a fun place with rides like roller coasters and water slides. It also has shops, restaurants, and shows. Kids, teenagers, and grown-ups can all enjoy theme parks. Some parks are about movies or toys. Long ago, people dressed up fancy to go to theme parks. Now people wear comfortable clothes and sneakers. Rides used to be made of wood, but now they are made of steel and are safer. Some famous theme parks are Disneyland and Universal Studios.
Holy Grail\n\nThe Holy Grail is a special cup from a very old story. People in the Christian religion tell a story about it. They say Jesus used it at his last dinner with his friends. Later, someone used it to catch his blood. The story says the cup has special powers. Many old stories about knights talk about looking for the Holy Grail. A cup that might be the Holy Grail is kept in a big church in Spain. Today, people use the words "Holy Grail" to talk about something very important that is hard to find.
Gorilla\n\nA gorilla is a big, strong ape that lives in Africa. Gorillas have black skin and hair. They have a wide chest, short legs, and long arms. Older male gorillas have silver hair on their backs, so they are called silverbacks. Gorillas live in family groups called troops. They walk on their feet and knuckles. They eat plants like leaves, vines, and bamboo shoots. Sometimes they also eat ants or termites. Gorillas are usually gentle, but they can be scary if they feel in danger. The silverback protects the troop by standing up and beating his chest. Gorillas sleep in nests made of leaves and branches on the ground. Baby gorillas hold onto their mothers for the first few years. Gorillas can live for 35 to 50 years.
Plastic surgery\n\nPlastic surgery is a kind of doctor's work that changes how a person's body looks or works. Doctors can fix parts that got hurt, like skin from a burn. They can also change how a body part looks, like making a face look younger by pulling the skin tight. This work can be done on bones, skin, and other parts of the body.
Drainage\n\nDrainage is how extra water is taken away from land. Sometimes the ground has too much water, and people help move it away so plants can grow. A long time ago, people in a place called the Indus Valley made special paths for water to flow out of their cities. These paths were under the ground and covered up. In the Netherlands, people used windmills to pump water out of lakes and make new land for farms and houses.
Personality\n\nPersonality is what makes you you. It is the way you think, feel, and act most of the time. Your personality includes what you like and what you do not like. It can change a little as you grow up, but that takes a long time. Knowing someone's personality can help you guess how they will act in different situations.
Homelessness\n\nHomelessness means not having a place to live. Some people sleep on the street, in shelters, or in cars. It can happen when people cannot pay for a home. Many homeless people live in cities like San Francisco, Dublin, and Tallinn. Being homeless can make people sick because they cannot wash or see a doctor. It is hard to find good food. Some people use mean words for homeless people, but it is better to say 'unhoused person' or just 'person'.
Reflection (physics)\n\nReflection is when light hits something and bounces back. When you look in a mirror, you see your face because light bounces off the mirror and goes to your eyes. The light bounces the same way every time. People use reflection to make things like mirrors and shiny signs on the road so cars can see them at night.
Taboo\n\nA taboo is something that people in a group or society say you should not do or talk about. Different groups have different taboos. Some taboos are against the law, and breaking them can get you in trouble. The word 'taboo' comes from a language in Tonga, where it means 'not allowed' or 'forbidden'. For example, eating certain foods is taboo in some religions. In many places, doing private things like burping or picking your nose in public is taboo. Taboos help people know what is okay and what is not okay to do.
Dodo\n\nA dodo is a bird that lived long ago but is now gone forever. It lived on an island called Mauritius. The dodo was a big bird with grey feathers and yellow feet. It had a big hooked beak that was green and yellow. Its wings were very small, so it could not fly. The dodo ate fruit, seeds, and nuts. It was not scared of people, so people could catch it easily. Dogs, cats, rats, and pigs also hurt the dodos by eating their eggs. People cut down the forests where the dodos lived. After about 80 years, there were no more dodos left. Today we can see dodo bones in museums.
Southern Africa\n\nSouthern Africa is the part of Africa that is farthest south. It is a big area with many countries. Some of those countries are South Africa, Botswana, and Zimbabwe. The weather there can be hot and dry, and there are big deserts and grasslands. Many wild animals live there, like lions, elephants, and zebras. People in Southern Africa speak different languages and have many different ways of life.
Horizon\n\nThe horizon is the line where the sky meets the ground. When you look far away, the sky and the earth seem to touch each other. That line is the horizon. Sometimes trees, houses, or hills hide the horizon, so you cannot see it clearly. The horizon looks flat, but the earth is round.
Cattle\n\nCattle are big animals that live on farms. They have four legs and a big body. Some cattle are called cows, some are called bulls, and baby cattle are called calves. Cattle eat grass. They have a special stomach that helps them eat grass. They live in groups called herds. Cows give us milk to drink. People also use cattle for meat and to pull heavy things. Cattle can be many colors like black, white, or brown. They say "moo" to talk to each other.
Toxicity\n\nToxicity is how much a thing can hurt you if you eat it, touch it, or breathe it. Almost everything can be bad for you if you have too much of it. Even water can hurt you if you drink too much. But a little bit of something that is very bad might not hurt you at all. Something that is bad for one animal might not be bad for another. Some things hurt you right away, and some things hurt you only after a long time. People do not test things on humans on purpose, but sometimes they learn from accidents.
Hephaestus\n\nHephaestus is a Greek god who made things out of metal and fire. He was born weak and his mom Hera threw him off a cloud because she did not like how he looked. He fell into the sea and ocean animals saved him. He lived on an island under a volcano and made pretty jewelry, golden robots, and thrones for the gods. He made a special golden chair that trapped Hera when she sat on it. He married Aphrodite, but she did not love him. Hephaestus liked to work alone in his workshop.
Bedroom\n\nA bedroom is a room in a house where people sleep. It has a bed and places to keep clothes, like drawers or a closet. Some bedrooms have a small table next to the bed called a nightstand. A house can have more than one bedroom. The biggest bedroom is called the master bedroom, and it sometimes has its own bathroom.
Emergency department\n\nAn emergency department is a special part of a hospital. It is for people who get hurt or sick very suddenly. They do not need to make a plan to come. They can just go to the hospital right away. Many people come in an ambulance. The doctors and nurses there work all day and all night, every day of the week. They help fix broken bones, stop bleeding, and make sick people feel better. Sometimes people call it the emergency room, or ER for short.
History of agriculture\n\nAgriculture is when people grow plants and take care of animals for food, clothes, and other things. A long, long time ago, people started to plant seeds from wild plants and keep wild animals near them. This helped people have more food and build big towns and cities. Farmers grow different plants and animals depending on where they live. Over time, people learned new ways to farm, like using water from rivers to water plants and using horses to help plow fields. Now, farmers use big machines like tractors and special tools to grow lots of food.
Yogurt\n\nYogurt is a food made from milk. It is thick and a little bit sour. To make yogurt, milk is heated up and then special tiny living things called bacteria are added. The bacteria change the milk into yogurt. Yogurt can be made from cow milk, almond milk, soy milk, or coconut milk. It has been eaten for a very long time, all over the world. Yogurt is good for you because it has protein and calcium, which help your bones grow strong. Some people who cannot drink milk can eat yogurt instead. You can eat yogurt for breakfast or as a snack.
Veterinary medicine\n\nVeterinary medicine is a kind of doctor work for animals. People who do this job are called vets. Vets help sick or hurt animals get better. They take care of pet dogs, cats, and also farm animals and wild animals. Vets give animals medicine, fix broken bones, and check if animals are healthy. They also help keep people safe from sicknesses that can pass from animals to humans.
Food poisoning\n\nFood poisoning is when you get sick after eating food or drinking something that has gone bad. It can make your tummy hurt, make you throw up, or give you a fever. Most people get better in a few days. But babies and old people need to be extra careful. To stay safe, always wash your hands before eating and keep food in the fridge.
Shame\n\nShame is a feeling you get when you think you did something wrong. It can happen when you break a rule that people around you follow. Sometimes you feel ashamed even if no one else knows what you did. Grown-ups sometimes tell children to feel ashamed when they make a mistake. As children get older, they learn to tell the difference between things they did on purpose and things that just happened. Then they start to feel a different feeling called guilt.
Moscow\n\nMoscow is a big city and the capital of Russia. It sits next to the Moskva River. Many people live there, more than in most other cities in Europe. Moscow has a big walled place called the Kremlin where the leader of Russia works. There is also a famous red square and a pretty church with colorful onion-shaped tops. The city has a big train system under the ground called the Metro. It is very busy and takes people all around the city. Moscow has cold winters with lots of snow and warm summers. Long ago, Moscow was the capital of a big country called the Soviet Union. Today it is still the most important city in Russia.
Pegasus\n\nPegasus is a make-believe horse with big white wings. He can fly high up in the sky. Pegasus is very beautiful and strong. A long time ago, a man named Bellerophon wanted to ride Pegasus. A goddess named Athena gave him a special golden rope to help catch Pegasus. Together, they fought a scary monster called the Chimera. But when Bellerophon tried to fly to the home of the gods, a little bug bit Pegasus and made him jump, so Bellerophon fell off. Pegasus is a famous flying horse from old stories.
Ironing\n\nIroning is a way to make clothes smooth after washing. You use a tool called an iron. The iron gets hot, and you push it over the clothes. This takes out the wrinkles and makes the clothes look nice. Some clothes have a label that tells you if you can iron them. People often use a special board to put the clothes on while ironing.
Passport\n\nA passport is a special book that lets you travel to other countries. It has your picture, your name, and when you were born. The passport shows that you belong to your home country. When you go to another country, the people there look at your passport and let you in. Then when you come back home, your passport helps you get back in. Many passports now have a secret chip that makes sure it is really you. Some passports let you visit many places without extra papers, and some let you visit only a few.
Forest\n\nA forest is a big piece of land with many trees. Forests grow in many places around the world. They are home to many plants and animals. Some forests are cold, and some are warm. In cold forests, trees have needles and cones. In warm forests, trees have leaves and flowers. Rain forests are very wet and hot. Many animals live in forests, like bears, deer, birds, and squirrels. Forests are important because they give us clean air and wood.
Durian\n\nA durian is a big fruit with a hard shell covered in soft thorns. It has a very strong smell that some people like and others do not. The fruit grows in hot, wet places. Inside, the soft part is used to make food in some countries. You can also eat the seeds after they are cooked. Some people call durian the "King of Fruits."
Electron\n\nAn electron is a very tiny piece of matter that has a negative charge. It is smaller than an atom. Every atom has electrons that go around its center. Electrons are so small that you cannot see them. They help make electricity flow through wires to power your TV and toys. Electrons push away from each other because they have the same charge. But they are pulled toward the center of an atom because that part has a positive charge. When many electrons move together, we call it electricity.
Coin\n\nA coin is a small, flat piece of metal that people use as money. Coins are usually worth less than paper money. Most coins have a picture of a person's head on one side and a different picture on the other side. You can toss a coin in the air and catch it to make a random choice. This is called heads or tails. Some people like to collect old coins. Old coins can cost a lot or a little, depending on how rare they are.
Economic growth\n\nEconomic growth is when a country makes more things to sell or use. This can happen when more people work or when people find better ways to make things. When there is economic growth, people often have more money to buy food, toys, and other things they need.
Obesity\n\nObesity means a person is much too heavy for their height, and it can make them sick. It is also called being very overweight. The most common reason is eating more food than the body uses up. Some people are more likely to be obese because of their family. Being very heavy can cause health problems like diabetes. Doctors help people lose weight by eating healthy food and moving more. Sometimes doctors do surgery to make the stomach smaller. Some people think being very heavy is bad, but in some places people think it means you are rich or beautiful.
Room\n\nA room is a space inside a building. Walls keep it apart from other rooms. A door lets you go in and out. Rooms have different jobs. A bedroom is for sleeping. A kitchen is for cooking food. A bathroom has a toilet and a bath. People have used rooms for a very long time. Long ago, houses had bedrooms, kitchens, and closets, just like today. Some rooms were built on top of other rooms, with stairs to go up and down.
Physics\n\nPhysics is the science that studies how things move and how the universe works. It looks at big things like stars and planets, and tiny things like atoms. Physics helps us understand why a ball rolls, why a magnet sticks to the fridge, and why the sun shines. People who study physics are called physicists. They use math to figure out how things work. Physics also helps make cool things like airplanes, computers, and light bulbs.
Postage stamp\n\nA postage stamp is a small piece of paper that you put on an envelope. It shows that you paid to send the letter. The stamp goes on the top right corner of the envelope. The first stamp was made in Britain a long time ago. It was called the Penny Black. Many countries have their own stamps with different pictures. Some people like to collect stamps and put them in a book called a stamp album. Sometimes a stamp has a mistake, like a picture printed upside down. That makes it very special.
Tennis\n\nTennis is a sport where you hit a ball over a net with a racket. The ball is made of rubber and covered with soft felt. You play on a court, which can be grass, clay, or hard ground. Two or four people can play. When two play, it is called singles. When four play, it is called doubles. The goal is to hit the ball so the other player cannot hit it back. That way you win a point. Points are counted as love, 15, 30, and 40. If both players have 40, it is called deuce. Then you need two more points to win the game. A game is part of a set. A set is won when a player wins six games. A match is won by winning two sets. There are big tournaments like Wimbledon and the U.S. Open. Tennis is also played at the Olympics.
Archimedes' screw\n\nArchimedes' screw is a machine that moves water up. It looks like a big screw inside a tube. When you turn the screw, water goes up and comes out at the top. People use it to water plants in fields. You can turn it by hand, or a windmill can turn it. It is still used today all over the world.
Scale model\n\nA scale model is a small copy of something big. It looks just like the real thing but is much smaller. People make scale models to show what a big building or a car will look like. Some people collect scale models for fun. You can also use a scale model to learn about math and sizes.
Cartoon\n\nA cartoon is a kind of picture or drawing. Some cartoons are funny pictures in newspapers. Some cartoons are moving pictures on TV or in movies. A person who draws cartoons is called a cartoonist. Long ago, cartoon meant a big drawing that helped an artist make a painting or a rug. Now, cartoons can be short funny movies with characters like Mickey Mouse or Bugs Bunny. Many children watch cartoons on television for fun.
Bay of Biscay\n\nThe Bay of Biscay is a big part of the ocean near France and Spain. It is next to the Atlantic Ocean. The water there can get very rough and stormy, especially in winter. Long ago, big storms would break ships, but now boats are stronger and people can tell when a storm is coming. Many kinds of whales and dolphins live in the bay. Some whales that are hard to see in other places can be found here.
Lynx\n\nA lynx is a wild cat that looks like a big house cat. It has short fur, a short tail, and pointy ears with little tufts of hair on top. Its paws are big and fluffy so it can walk on snow. Lynxes live in forests high up in the mountains. They hunt animals like rabbits, birds, and mice. They are very good at climbing trees and can swim too. A mother lynx has two to four babies, called kittens, and they stay with her for about nine months. Lynxes are usually alone, but sometimes a few travel together. Some kinds of lynx are very rare and people try to protect them.
Pacifism\n\nPacifism is when someone thinks fighting and war are not good ways to solve problems. People who believe in pacifism want peace instead of hitting or hurting others.
Foot (unit)\n\nA foot is a way to measure how long something is. It is about as long as your own foot. One foot is the same as 12 inches. People use feet to tell how tall a person is. If someone is 5 feet tall, that means they are as tall as five feet laid end to end. In some countries, people still use feet to measure things like how high a door is or how tall a building is.
Landscape architecture\n\nLandscape architecture is a job where people plan and design outdoor spaces like parks, gardens, and playgrounds. The person who does this job is called a landscape architect. They decide where to put trees, flowers, paths, and benches so that people can enjoy being outside. They also think about how buildings and nature can look nice together.
Russia\n\nRussia is a very big country. It is the biggest country in the whole world. Russia is in two parts of the world: Europe and Asia. The capital city is Moscow. Moscow is a very big city. People in Russia speak Russian. Russia has a lot of land and many forests and rivers. Some parts of Russia are very cold. The leader of Russia is called the president. The current president is Vladimir Putin. Russia has a long history. Long ago, it was part of a bigger country called the Soviet Union. Russia has many different kinds of people and places.
Sugar\n\nSugar is something that tastes sweet. You can find it in many foods, or people add it to make food sweeter. Sugar comes from plants like sugarcane and sugar beets. The human body changes sugar into smaller parts to use for energy. Sugar can be white or brown. Brown sugar has molasses in it and is often used for baking. Fruits have a kind of sugar called fructose. Sugar is a kind of carbohydrate, which means it gives your body energy.
Triton (moon)\n\nTriton is a big moon that goes around the planet Neptune. It is the biggest moon of Neptune and the seventh biggest moon in our whole solar system. Triton is a little smaller than our own Moon. It is very, very cold there, colder than anywhere else in the solar system. The ground is made of ice and frozen gas. Sometimes the ice melts and turns into gas, making geysers that shoot up. Triton has a thin layer of air around it. It spins so that one side always faces Neptune, just like our Moon always faces Earth. Triton was found by a man named William Lassell in 1846, just a few days after Neptune was discovered.
Anatomy\n\nAnatomy is learning about the bodies of people and animals. It looks at the inside and outside of the body. It finds where things like muscles, bones, and other parts are. A person who studies anatomy is called an anatomist. There are big parts you can see, like your arm, and tiny parts you need a special tool to see. Your body has many parts that work together, like your heart that pumps blood, your muscles that help you move, your brain that thinks, and your bones that hold you up.
Palm tree\n\nA palm tree is a kind of plant that grows in hot places. It has a long, straight trunk and big leaves at the top. The leaves can look like a fan or like feathers. Palm trees grow in warm parts of the world, like near the ocean. Some palm trees give us food, like coconuts and dates. People also use palm leaves to make roofs and baskets. Palm trees are very tall and can live for many years.
Amphibian\n\nAn amphibian is an animal that lives both in water and on land. Frogs, toads, salamanders, and caecilians are all amphibians. They are cold-blooded and have four legs. Amphibians lay eggs in water. The babies, called tadpoles, live in water and have gills to breathe. As they grow, they change into adults with lungs and legs. Adult amphibians can also breathe through their skin. They like to live near fresh water in warm places. Some amphibians are brown or green to hide from animals that want to eat them. Others have bright colors to warn that they are poisonous. Amphibians are found all over the world except Antarctica.
Writing\n\nWriting is a way to put words down so other people can read them later. People use special marks, like letters or pictures, to show what they want to say. Long ago, people wrote on clay, stone, or animal skin. Today, we mostly write on paper or on computer screens. Writing helps us remember things and share ideas with people far away or from long ago. Some writing uses pictures, like the old Egyptian way called hieroglyphs. Other writing uses letters, like the ABCs we use in English. Writing is very old—people started writing more than 5000 years ago in a place called Mesopotamia. Now, many people around the world write every day.
Geometry\n\nGeometry is about shapes and sizes. It helps us understand how big or small things are. Flat shapes like squares, circles, and triangles are part of geometry. Solid shapes like cubes, balls, and cones are also part of geometry. People use geometry to measure land and build houses. A long time ago, a man named Euclid wrote the first book about geometry. Geometry is a very old kind of math.
Sichuan\n\nSichuan is a big place in western China. Its main city is called Chengdu. Many people live there, more than in most other parts of China. Most of the people are Han Chinese, but there are also Tibetans and other groups. The food from Sichuan is famous for being very spicy and making your mouth feel tingly. Some well-known dishes are Kung Pao chicken and Twice Cooked Pork. Sichuan also has a special kind of opera with music and dancing. People there play music with bamboo flutes, gongs, and drums.
Dutch language\n\nDutch is a language that people speak in the Netherlands, a country in Europe. It is also spoken in Belgium and in a country called Suriname. About 22 million people speak Dutch. Dutch uses the same letters as English. Some Dutch words are "hallo" for hello and "ja" for yes. Numbers in Dutch are "een" for one, "twee" for two, and "drie" for three.
Oscillation\n\nOscillation is when something moves back and forth or up and down, like a swing. A toy on a spring bounces up and down, and that is oscillation. A guitar string wiggles back and forth when you pluck it. Many things in nature do this, like a tree branch blowing in the wind. After a while, the moving part slows down and stops because of rubbing.
Mauritania\n\nMauritania is a country in northwest Africa. It is next to the Atlantic Ocean. The biggest city and capital is Nouakchott. The land is mostly flat. Many people in Mauritania are Muslim. They speak Arabic and French. Some people also speak other languages like Wolof and Pulaar. Mauritania has a lot of iron ore, which is a kind of rock used to make metal. Many people there work on farms or take care of animals.
Cod\n\nCod is a fish that lives in the ocean. It is big and likes to eat other fish. People catch cod for food because it tastes good. Cod is used to make fish and chips. The liver of cod is used to make oil that is good for you. Cod can grow very long, as long as a tall kid. The biggest cod ever caught was very heavy.
Ocean\n\nAn ocean is a very big body of water that covers most of our Earth. There are five main oceans: the Pacific, Atlantic, Indian, Southern, and Arctic. The Pacific is the biggest and deepest. Many animals live in the ocean, like fish, crabs, whales, and sharks. The water looks blue because it takes in red light and shows blue and green light. Some parts of the ocean are very cold and dark, and special animals live there without sunlight. People catch fish from the ocean for food.
Love\n\nLove is a warm feeling you have for someone you like very much. You can love your mom and dad, your friends, or even a pet. Love makes you want to care for them and be nice to them. When you love someone, you feel happy when they are happy. Sometimes love makes your heart feel full and your tummy feel funny. There are different kinds of love. The love you have for your family is different from the love you have for a friend. Some people fall in love when they grow up and want to be together forever. Love is a very special feeling.
Eel\n\nAn eel is a fish with a long, thin body that looks like a snake. Some eels are as short as your hand, and some are as long as a big car. Eels have fewer fins than other fish. They hatch from eggs. Baby eels are flat and see-through, and they look very different from grown-up eels. Most eels live at the bottom of the ocean, sometimes in holes. Some eels live in rivers and lakes. Eels eat other animals. People catch eels with nets and cook them for food. The skin of eels can be used to make wallets and purses.
Geography\n\nGeography is about the Earth and the people who live on it. It looks at big things like continents, seas, rivers, and mountains. It also looks at things that happen, like tides, storms, and earthquakes. People who study geography are called geographers. They use maps to help them understand the world. Maps show where things are. Some geographers study the natural world, like mountains and rivers. Other geographers study people, like how many people live in a place or what they do.
Ganges\n\nThe Ganges is a very big river in India. It starts high up in the mountains from a big ice block called a glacier. The river flows through many towns and cities. Many people live near the Ganges. They use its water for farming and fishing. The Ganges is special to many people because they think it is holy. They believe bathing in the river can clean away bad things. Some people keep its water in their homes. The river has many boats and people go rafting on it for fun. But the river also gets dirty because some people throw trash into it, which can make people sick.
Injury\n\nAn injury is a hurt on your body. It happens when something outside your body hurts you. You can get an injury by accident, like falling down or bumping into something. Sometimes a person hurts another on purpose, but that is not nice. A cut, a bruise, or a broken bone are all kinds of injuries. When you get an injury, it can hurt and you might need a bandage or help from a grown-up.
Silicon Valley\n\nSilicon Valley is a place in California, in the United States. It is where many smart people make computers and other high-tech things. Long ago, the land had many fruit trees. Then people started building companies that make computer parts. Some of the first companies started in a garage. Today, many big computer companies are in Silicon Valley. People from all over the world visit to see the technology.
E-mail\n\nE-mail is a way to send letters over the Internet. You need a computer or phone to use it. The letters go very fast, even to faraway places. It is usually free to send e-mail. Sometimes people get unwanted e-mail, which is called spam. Some e-mail programs can stop spam. You can send e-mail from websites like Gmail or Yahoo. E-mail addresses look like name@place.com.
Stage (theatre)\n\nA stage is a special place in a theater where actors stand and act out a story. The people watching sit in front of the stage. The stage can have lights, curtains, and things like tables or chairs to help tell the story. Sometimes the stage is high up so everyone can see.
Sonnet\n\nA sonnet is a special kind of poem. It has 14 lines that rhyme in a pattern. The first sonnets were made a long time ago in Italy. Many poets wrote sonnets about love. William Shakespeare wrote very famous sonnets in English. Some sonnets tell a story. The last two lines often finish the poem with a rhyming pair. Some sonnets have a turn in the middle where the feeling changes. Poets still write sonnets today, but they sometimes change the old rules.
Mount Kenya\n\nMount Kenya is a very tall mountain in Africa. It is the highest mountain in Kenya and the second highest in all of Africa. Long ago, it was a volcano that is now asleep. Mount Kenya sits right on the equator, which is an imaginary line around the middle of Earth. It is northeast of a big city called Nairobi. The top of Mount Kenya is covered with snow and ice.
South Sudan\n\nSouth Sudan is a country in East Africa. It is a landlocked country, which means it does not touch the ocean. South Sudan used to be part of another country called Sudan, but it became its own country in 2011. Many people there are young. The main language is English, and most people are Christian. The country has oil and wood from trees. South Sudan is very poor and has had wars that hurt the country.
Lace\n\nLace is a special kind of cloth with lots of little holes in it. The holes make pretty patterns. Lace is very light and airy. People make lace by hand or with a machine. They use knitting, crocheting, or weaving to make it. Lace has frills and looks fancy. You might see lace on a dress or a tablecloth.
Impala\n\nAn impala is a medium-sized animal that lives in Africa. It has reddish-brown fur, white on its belly and chin, and black marks on its legs and back. Male impalas have curved black horns that look twisted. Female impalas do not have horns. Impalas can jump very far and high, and run very fast to get away from animals that want to eat them. They live near grass and trees, close to water.
Monorail\n\nA monorail is a kind of train that rides on just one rail. Most trains have two rails, but a monorail balances on one. Monorails carry people around cities. Some monorails use magnets to float above the rail, which makes them go very fast. The first monorail was made a long time ago. Monorails are hard to build and cost a lot of money, so not many places have them.
Urinary system\n\nThe urinary system is the part of your body that makes pee and takes it out. Pee is watery waste that your body does not need. Your kidneys are two organs inside you that clean your blood and make pee. The pee goes through thin tubes called ureters into a soft bag called the bladder. When the bladder gets full, you feel like you need to pee. Then the pee goes out of your body through a tube called the urethra. Boys and girls have different urethras. The urinary system works with the parts that help make babies.
Banana\n\nA banana is a fruit that grows on a big plant. The plant looks like a tree but is not a tree. Bananas grow in bunches that hang down. Each banana has a yellow skin you peel off. Inside is soft, sweet, and white. You can eat it as a snack. Bananas grow in warm places like India, Brazil, and China. They are good for you because they have vitamins. Some bananas are green and are used for cooking. Those are called plantains. People also use banana plants to make cloth and paper.
Medieval music\n\nMedieval music is music from a very long time ago, from about 400 to 1400. People back then used music for fun and for church. Some musicians called troubadours or minstrels traveled around singing and playing instruments. They made up their own songs but did not write down the tunes, so we do not know how they sounded. Other musicians worked for one rich person and went with them to battles. Minstrels also sang long story songs called ballads. People danced in lines or circles to music. Some instruments were quiet and used inside, like the recorder and harp. Others were loud and used outside, like bagpipes. Church music was very serious, and only singing was allowed at first. Later, organs and bells were used. Carols became popular, and people sang them at Christmas. We know about medieval music from a few written pieces that survived.
Dignity\n\nDignity is a feeling that every person is important and should be treated nicely. All people are born free and should be kind to each other. Sometimes people are not treated with dignity, and that is not fair. Everyone deserves to be treated with care and respect.
El Salvador\n\nEl Salvador is a small country in Central America. It is next to Honduras, Guatemala, and the Pacific Ocean. The capital city is San Salvador. About 6 million people live there. El Salvador has only two seasons: a dry season with no rain and a rainy season when it rains every day. The country has many volcanoes and rivers. There are also many birds, butterflies, and sea turtles. El Salvador was the first country in the world to use Bitcoin as money.
Alloy\n\nAn alloy is a mix of two or more things, and at least one of them is a metal. To make an alloy, people melt the metals, stir them together, and let them cool until they become hard. An alloy can be stronger or different from the metals it is made from. For example, steel is an alloy made from iron, and it is stronger than iron. A long time ago, people made an alloy called bronze from copper and tin. They used bronze to make tools and weapons. Now, bronze is used for making statues and bells. Brass is another alloy made from copper and zinc.
Interior design\n\nInterior design is about making rooms inside buildings nice and easy to live in. People who do this job are called interior designers. They pick colors for walls, choose furniture, and decide where things go. They also think about lights and sounds. Interior designers help make homes, offices, stores, and hospitals feel good. They talk to people to find out what they like and need. Then they make a plan and show pictures of how the room will look. Good interior design makes a space pretty and useful.
Cranberry\n\nA cranberry is a small red fruit. It grows on a low bush that stays green all year. The bush has thin stems and tiny leaves. Cranberries grow in wet, muddy places called bogs. They live in cold parts of the world like North America and Europe. People eat cranberries at special dinners like Thanksgiving and Christmas. You can drink cranberry juice or eat cranberry sauce. The fruit tastes a little sour, so people often add sugar to make it yummy.
Fishing\n\nFishing is when people try to catch fish. You can fish in the sea, a lake, or a river. You can fish from a boat or from the shore. People use different things to catch fish, like a fishing rod with a line and a hook, or a net. Some people fish for money, and that can be a dangerous job. They go far into the ocean to catch many fish. Other people fish for fun, which is called sport fishing. Sometimes fishermen let the fish go after catching it, to help keep fish safe. But fishing too much can be bad because there may not be enough fish left.
Denali\n\nDenali is a very tall mountain in Alaska. It is the highest mountain in the United States and all of North America. The mountain is covered with snow and ice. It is very cold at the top. People who climb mountains try to reach the top of Denali, but it is a hard climb. The mountain is in a big park where animals like bears and moose live.
Skink\n\nA skink is a small lizard. Skinks have very short legs and a short neck. Some skinks have no legs at all and move like snakes. Their tails can grow back if they get cut off. Most skinks are only as long as a ruler. They like to dig and live underground. Skinks use their tongues to smell the air and find food. They eat bugs like worms, slugs, and cockroaches. Some skinks also eat fruit and vegetables.
Role-playing game\n\nA role-playing game is a game where you pretend to be a character in a made-up world. You can play with friends around a table or on a computer. One person called the game master tells the story and plays all the other people and monsters. You try to do hard things, and sometimes you roll dice to see if you succeed. As you play, your character gets better at things. Some people dress up and act out their character, like in a play.
Swallowtail butterfly\n\nA swallowtail butterfly is a big, pretty butterfly with bright colors. It has wings that look like a swallow bird's tail. These butterflies live in warm places all over the world, except very cold places like Antarctica. Some of them are the biggest butterflies in the world. They fly around flowers and drink sweet juice from them.
Sense\n\nA sense is a way your body learns about the world around you. People have six senses: seeing with your eyes, hearing with your ears, smelling with your nose, tasting with your tongue, touching with your skin, and feeling where your body is in space. Some animals have other senses, like fish that can feel water moving around them.
Niagara Falls\n\nNiagara Falls is a big waterfall on the border between the United States and Canada. It is made of three waterfalls: the Horseshoe Falls, the American Falls, and the Bridal Veil Falls. The Horseshoe Falls is the biggest and looks like a horse's shoe. Many people visit Niagara Falls because it is beautiful and very wide. The water falls down with a loud roar and makes a lot of mist. At night, lights shine on the falls and make them look colorful.
Pencil\n\nA pencil is a tool for writing and drawing on paper. The inside of a pencil is made of a special black material called graphite, which is mixed with clay. The outside is made of wood. You hold the pencil and rub the tip on paper to make marks. You can erase pencil marks with an eraser. Some pencils have an eraser on the end. Pencils can be different shapes, like round or with six flat sides. Colored pencils have colorful insides instead of black graphite. People use pencils in school, at home, and at work.
Karaoke\n\nKaraoke is when you sing along to music that has no words. The music comes from a machine, and the words show up on a screen so you can read them. People do karaoke for fun with their friends. It started in Japan a long time ago.
Jujutsu\n\nJujutsu is a way of fighting from long ago in Japan. It does not use swords or other weapons. People who do jujutsu learn how to throw someone down, hold them still, and stop them from moving. A long time ago, warriors called samurai used jujutsu when they did not have their swords. Today, people still practice jujutsu for fun and to stay strong.
Impartiality\n\nImpartiality means being fair and not picking one side over another. In court, judges and juries must be impartial. They cannot like one person more than the other. They listen to both sides and decide what is true. This helps make sure everyone gets a fair chance.
Nicaragua\n\nNicaragua is a country in Central America. It is next to El Salvador, Honduras, and Costa Rica. The big water on one side is the Pacific Ocean, and on the other side is the Caribbean Sea. The biggest city is Managua. Many different kinds of people live there. Most people speak Spanish. Some people speak other languages like Miskito or English Creole. Baseball is the most popular sport, not soccer. Nicaragua has warm weather, volcanoes, and many animals. People like to visit Nicaragua to see these things.
Twin\n\nTwins are two babies that are born at the same time. They grow together inside their mom before they are born. There are two kinds of twins. Fraternal twins are like regular brothers and sisters who are born together. They can look different and can be a boy and a girl. Identical twins come from one egg that splits into two. They look very much alike because they have the same genes. Some animals like cats, sheep, and cows can also have twins.
Tamarind\n\nTamarind is a tree that grows in Africa. Its fruit tastes very sour. People use the fruit as a spice to make food sour, like in some recipes.
World peace\n\nWorld peace is when everyone in the world is happy and safe. It means no fighting between countries and no hurting each other. People who want world peace try to help everyone get along. Many people hope for world peace so that all children can grow up without being scared.
Anchovy\n\nAn anchovy is a small fish that lives in the ocean. It has a green body with a shiny silver stripe along its side. Anchovies swim together in big groups called schools. They eat tiny floating plants and animals called plankton. Many bigger fish, birds, and sea animals eat anchovies for food. People also eat anchovies. They are very salty and have a strong taste. You can find them on pizza or in salads. Anchovies are often sold in small cans or jars.
Industrialisation\n\nIndustrialisation is when a country starts using machines to do work that people used to do by hand. Before, people made things one at a time, like a shoe maker making one whole shoe. After industrialisation, many people work in factories, and each person does just one small job, like cutting the shoe's bottom or sewing it. Machines help them make many more things much faster. This made towns grow bigger because people moved from farms to work in factories. Industrialisation started in England a long time ago and then spread to other countries.
Red algae\n\nRed algae are plants that live in water. They are red because they have a special color inside them. Most red algae grow in the ocean near warm shores. Some live in rivers and lakes. People use red algae to make a food called nori, which is the green paper wrapped around sushi. Red algae are big and have many cells. They can make their own food from sunlight, just like other plants.
Watermelon\n\nA watermelon is a big, sweet fruit that grows on a vine. It has a hard green outside called the rind, and a soft red or pink inside with little brown seeds. Some watermelons have yellow inside, and some have no seeds at all. The inside tastes sweet because it has sugar. People eat watermelon on hot days to feel cool. The green rind is not usually eaten, but it can be cooked. Watermelons can be round or long like a ball. In Japan, farmers grow watermelons in fun shapes like hearts and squares. Watermelon is good for you because it has vitamins that help your body stay strong.
Capybara\n\nA capybara is a big animal that lives in South America. It is the biggest rodent in the world. A capybara looks like a giant guinea pig. It has brown or reddish-brown fur. It has webbed feet and can swim very well. Its eyes, ears, and nose are on top of its head so it can see and breathe while swimming. Capybaras eat grass and live near rivers or in wet grasslands. They live in groups of 10 to 30. They make sounds like clicks, grunts, whistles, and barks. Baby capybaras are born in litters of four. They drink milk from their mothers and start eating grass when they are one week old. Many animals like jaguars and eagles eat capybaras. People sometimes keep capybaras as pets.
Cichlid\n\nA cichlid is a kind of fish. There are many, many kinds of cichlids, more than 2500. Some cichlids are very small, and some are as long as a big ruler. Cichlid parents take care of their babies. Some cichlids keep their eggs safe in their mouth. Many cichlids live in big lakes in Africa.
Election\n\nAn election is a way people choose who will be in charge. In many countries, grown-ups go to a special place to vote. They pick the person they want to lead them. Sometimes they vote for a group of people called a party. After everyone votes, the person with the most votes wins. Elections happen every few years. In some places, you can vote when you are 18 years old. In a few countries, you can vote at 16. Voting is important because it lets people have a say in how things are run.
Aloe\n\nAloe is a plant with thick, juicy leaves. The most famous kind is called Aloe vera. People grow it in pots inside their homes. The leaves hold water inside, so the plant can live in dry places. If you cut a leaf, a clear gel comes out. This gel can be put on dry or sore skin to make it feel better. Aloe vera is safe for all skin types and does not sting.
Memory\n\nMemory is how your brain keeps things you have learned or seen. It is like a special box in your head that holds onto stories, songs, and faces. There are two kinds of memory. One kind keeps things for a little while, like a phone number you just heard. The other kind keeps things for a very long time, like how to ride a bike or the name of your best friend. Without memory, you could not learn new things or remember fun times.
Diplomacy\n\nDiplomacy is how countries talk to each other. People called diplomats do this job. They help countries make agreements, like promises to be friends or to trade toys and food. Sometimes they talk about how to stop fighting. Diplomats use kind and polite words. An ambassador is a special diplomat who lives in another country to help with talking.
Stadium\n\nA stadium is a big building where many people go to watch games. People watch football and races there. Sometimes a company pays to put its name on the stadium, like Comerica Park. A small stadium inside a building is called an arena. People go to arenas for sports and music shows.
Animal colour\n\nAnimal color is the way light bounces off an animal's body. Animals have colors to help them stay safe. Some animals use color to hide from animals that want to eat them. This is called camouflage. Other animals use bright colors to scare away animals that want to eat them. For example, a butterfly might have big spots that look like eyes to frighten a bird. Animals get their colors from tiny things in their skin called pigments. The colors help animals find food and find friends to have babies with. Over a long time, animals with the best colors for staying safe have more babies, and that is why animals look the way they do.
History of Spain\n\nSpain is a country in Europe. A long time ago, different groups of people lived there, like the Romans and the Visigoths. Then people from Africa called Muslims came and ruled for many years. In 1492, the Christians took back the last part of Spain. That same year, Spain sent Christopher Columbus on a boat trip. He found new lands across the ocean, which became the Americas. Spain took a lot of gold from those lands and became very rich. But many native people were hurt or died. Later, Spain had wars and a dictator named Franco. After Franco died, Spain became a democracy and now works with other countries.
Computer monitor\n\nA computer monitor is a screen that shows you what your computer is doing. It looks like a small TV, but it cannot change channels like a TV can. The screen can show very small letters and tiny pictures clearly. You look at the monitor to see games, videos, and words.
Brain stem\n\nThe brain stem is a small part of your brain at the back. It is very important because it connects your brain to the rest of your body. The brain stem helps you do things without thinking, like breathing, making your heart beat, and sweating. It also helps you move your face and neck. Even though it is tiny, you need it to live.
Gaur\n\nA gaur is a very big animal that looks like a bison. It is the biggest kind of cow that lives in the wild. Gaurs live in South Asia and Southeast Asia. They have big bodies and short horns that curve a little. A baby gaur is called a calf. The mother gaur leaves the herd to have her baby. The calf can walk just a few minutes after it is born. The mother takes good care of her calf. After a few days, they go back to the herd. Gaurs are big and strong, and they eat grass and plants.
Amsterdam\n\nAmsterdam is a big city in the Netherlands. It is the capital of that country. Amsterdam is famous for its canals, which are like water streets. Many people live there from all over the world. The city has a big airport called Schiphol. Long ago, people built a dam in the river Amstel, and that is how the city got its name. The city is very old and has many houses on wooden poles. Today, Amsterdam is a place where many different people live together.
Disco\n\nDisco is a kind of music that people like to dance to. It was very popular a long time ago, in the 1970s. The music has a strong beat that makes you want to move your body. People dance to disco music at special places called disco clubs. These clubs have a big dance floor and colorful lights that flash with the music. There is also a shiny ball with mirrors that spins and makes sparkles on the walls and dancers. People wear fun clothes to go disco dancing, like shiny shirts and tight pants. A famous movie called "Saturday Night Fever" showed people doing disco dances. Disco music is still fun to listen to today.
Genealogy\n\nGenealogy is learning about your family from long ago. It is like a puzzle where you find out who your parents, grandparents, and great-grandparents were. Many people do this as a fun hobby. You can draw a family tree with lines to show how everyone is connected. Some people use a computer to keep track of names, birthdays, and where people lived. You can also save old photos and stories that your family tells. Learning about your family helps you know where you come from.
Embarrassment\n\nEmbarrassment is a feeling people can have. It can feel bad. You might feel embarrassed if you think you did something wrong or broke a rule. Sometimes you feel embarrassed even when someone says something nice about you. When you feel embarrassed, your face might turn red if your skin is light. You might sweat, smile, or hide your face.
Dalian\n\nDalian is a big city in China. It sits next to the sea and has a port where ships come and go. Ships bring things from other countries like Russia, Japan, and Korea. The port stays open all year because the water does not freeze. Long ago, Russia and Japan both wanted to control this city.
Hip hop\n\nHip hop is a kind of music and art that started in the 1970s in a place called The Bronx in New York City. It was made by people from different backgrounds. Hip hop music has a beat made by a drum machine, and a person called a rapper says words in a rhythm that rhymes. The words often tell about life in big cities. Hip hop also has a special way of dressing, like baggy pants and big shirts, a dance called breakdancing, and painting on walls called graffiti. Some famous hip hop musicians are LL Cool J, Snoop Dogg, Jay-Z, Eminem, and Lil Wayne. Rapping is like talking with a beat, and it started from a Jamaican tradition called 'toasting'. In the 1980s, some rappers made songs about tough street life, called gangsta rap. The fastest rapper is Twista, who can say many words very quickly.
Deer\n\nA deer is a wild animal with four long legs and a short tail. Most male deer have antlers on their heads, which are like hard branches that fall off and grow back every year. Deer live in forests and grassy places in many parts of the world. They eat grass, leaves, mushrooms, and small branches. A baby deer is called a fawn, and it has white spots on its back to help it hide. Deer can run very fast and jump high. They are always watching and listening for danger. The most famous make-believe deer is Bambi.
Frigatebird\n\nA frigatebird is a big bird that lives near the ocean. It has very long wings and can fly for a long time without stopping. The frigatebird has a red pouch on its neck that it puffs up to look big. It eats fish but does not like to get its feathers wet. Sometimes it chases other birds to steal their food.
Persian Gulf\n\nThe Persian Gulf is a big body of salt water in the Middle East. It sits between Iran and the Arabian Peninsula. The water is not very deep, and it is full of fish and beautiful coral reefs. Many pearl oysters live deep in the water. People find pearls there. Many countries touch the Persian Gulf, like Iran, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, and Kuwait. Big ships carry oil from this area to other places. The water connects to the Gulf of Oman through a narrow part called the Strait of Hormuz.
Wind instrument\n\nA wind instrument is a thing you blow into to make music. Some wind instruments are made of metal, like a trumpet or a tuba. Others are made of wood, like a flute or a clarinet. When you blow air into them, they make different sounds. You can play high notes or low notes by covering holes or pressing buttons. People play wind instruments in bands and orchestras.
Soup\n\nSoup is a kind of food that people make by boiling things in water. You can put vegetables like carrots and potatoes in soup. You can also put meat in soup. The water in soup is called broth. Some soups are thick like stew, and some are thin. People eat soup warm, often with bread or toast. A favorite soup is tomato soup with grilled cheese.
Latin American literature\n\nLatin American literature is stories and poems written by people who live in Latin America. They write in Spanish or Portuguese. Some stories mix real things with magic, like a girl who flies or a town where it rains flowers. This is called magic realism. Many writers wrote about being alone, missing home, and remembering their families. Some famous writers are Jorge Luis Borges, Gabriel García Márquez, and Pablo Neruda. They wrote books and poems that people all over the world love to read. Some women writers, like Gabriela Mistral and Isabel Allende, wrote about children, love, and magic.
