Underwear\n\nUnderwear are clothes you wear under your other clothes, right next to your skin. They keep your outer clothes clean from sweat. Some underwear helps hold parts of your body in place. In cold weather, long underwear keeps you warm. Boys and men often wear boxers or briefs. Girls and women often wear bras and panties. Some people wear special underwear for sports. You can also wear some underwear as pajamas or swimsuits.
Checkers\n\nCheckers is a game you play on a board with squares. Two people play. One has dark pieces, and one has light pieces. You move your pieces across the board. You can take the other player's piece by jumping over it. If you can jump, you must jump. The game ends when one player takes all the other player's pieces or blocks them so they cannot move. Some people call it 'draughts.'
Fraction\n\nA fraction is a part of something whole. If you cut a pizza into four pieces and take one piece, you have one fourth of the pizza. Fractions help us share things fairly. They are written with a number on top and a number on the bottom, like 1/2 or 3/4.
Torpedo\n\nA torpedo is a big, fast thing that moves underwater all by itself. It has a propeller that spins to push it through the water. A torpedo carries a big bang inside. When it hits a boat or a ship, it goes boom. Torpedoes can be shot from boats that go underwater, called submarines, or from boats on top of the water, and even from helicopters and airplanes. A man named Robert Whitehead made the first torpedo a long time ago, in 1866.
Moss\n\nMoss is a tiny green plant that grows in soft, fuzzy patches. It does not have roots or flowers. Moss soaks up water like a sponge, so it lives in wet places like near rivers, springs, or where it rains a lot. When it dries out, it can stop growing and wait for water. Moss does not make seeds. Instead, it makes tiny dust-like spores that float away to grow new moss. The biggest moss is only as tall as a ruler.
Public health\n\nPublic health is about keeping many people healthy, not just one person. It helps stop sickness from spreading. People in public health teach us to wash our hands and get shots to stay well. They also make sure the water we drink is clean. Long ago, people learned that dirty water can make everyone sick. Today, public health workers help stop diseases like the flu and help people live longer. They work in many countries to keep communities safe and healthy.
Chivalry\n\nChivalry is a word that means being kind and polite, especially when a man is nice to a woman. A long time ago, it was about knights on horses. Knights were brave and helped people. Today, if someone is chivalrous, they hold the door open or help others.
Swift\n\nA swift is a bird that is very good at flying. It spends almost all its time in the air. Swifts have long, curved wings and a tail that looks like a V. They are small birds and can fly very fast. Swifts catch bugs while flying. They have very small, weak feet. Swifts use their feet to hold onto walls or cliffs. They do not like to land on the ground. Swifts live all over the world. They like warm places and fly to different places each year. Swifts make nests out of mud and spit. Some swifts make nests only from spit. People in Asia use those nests to make soup.
Strawberry\n\nA strawberry is a small, sweet, red fruit that grows on a short plant. The tiny dots on the outside are the real fruits, and the red part we eat is the plant's stem that got big and sweet. Strawberries taste yummy and are good for you because they have vitamin C. People grow strawberries on farms, and bees help the flowers make the fruit. The plant makes long stems called runners that grow new plants.
Pear\n\nA pear is a fruit that grows on a tree. It is shaped like a teardrop and has a green, red, yellow, or brown skin. Pears are juicy and taste best when they are cool. You can eat them fresh, bake them, or make them into jam, jelly, or juice. Pears are mostly water. The tree has dark green leaves and pink or white flowers. Pear trees can live for about 65 years.
Game show\n\nA game show is a TV show where people play a game to win money or prizes. The players answer questions or do fun challenges. Some game shows have one player against another. Other game shows have teams. Sometimes regular people play, and sometimes famous people play. The winners can get money, a car, or a trip. Many game shows are on a channel called the Game Show Network. The first game shows were on the radio.
Hygiene\n\nHygiene is about keeping your body clean. You wash your hands and body to get rid of dirt and germs. You brush your teeth to keep them clean and strong. Using the toilet the right way and wearing clean clothes are also part of hygiene. When you learn to be clean when you are little, it becomes a habit. If you do not keep clean, you might smell bad, get sick, or lose your teeth.
Work (physics)\n\nWork in physics is what a force does when it moves something. If you push a toy car and it rolls, you are doing work. If you push a wall and it does not move, no work is done. Work is bigger when you push harder or move something farther. When you lift a book up, you do work. When you hold a book still, you are not doing work. Work is measured in something called joules.
Battle-axe\n\nA battle-axe is a kind of axe that people used long ago in fights. It looks like a big tool with a sharp metal head on a long wooden stick. Some battle-axes were small enough to hold in one hand, and some were so big that people had to use both hands. They were heavy, from about as heavy as a bag of sugar to as heavy as a big bag of potatoes. People used them to chop and hit in battles. Axes were cheaper and easier to find than swords, so many soldiers used them.
Extinction\n\nExtinction is when a kind of animal or plant is all gone and no more are alive. This happens to every kind of living thing sooner or later. It can happen because the place where they live gets destroyed, or because people hunt them too much. An example is the Dodo bird, which is gone because people hunted it. Dinosaurs are also extinct. Some animals are in danger of becoming extinct, and we call them endangered. People can help by not cutting down forests where animals live.
Ginseng\n\nGinseng is a plant that grows very slowly. It has a thick, soft root that looks like a little person. Ginseng grows in cool places in Asia, like China and Korea. People use the root to make tea or medicine.
Woodworking\n\nWoodworking is a skill where people make things out of wood. You can cut wood or make it smooth with sandpaper. There are many kinds of wood, like softwood and hardwood. People use tools like saws to cut wood and sandpaper to make it smooth. You have to be careful and wear safety goggles so your eyes stay safe. Some kids learn woodworking in school.
Silk Road\n\nThe Silk Road was a very long path that connected China to faraway places like the Middle East and Europe. People used it to trade things with each other. The most special thing they traded was silk, which is a soft, shiny cloth that was only made in China. Silk was very rare and expensive in Europe, so having it showed you were rich and important. Traders also brought other things like chess pieces from India to China. Most traders did not travel the whole road alone. They would trade goods at stops along the way. The Silk Road helped people share ideas about art, food, and religion too.
Liver\n\nThe liver is a part inside your body, near your tummy. It works like a little factory. It cleans bad things out of your blood. It helps you digest food. If the liver gets sick, your skin and eyes can turn yellow. That is called jaundice. Some liver sickness can be fixed with medicine. Sometimes a doctor has to put a new liver inside you. That is called a transplant. People also eat liver from animals. It is a kind of meat.
Bumblebee\n\nA bumblebee is a big, fuzzy bee that flies from flower to flower. It has a round body covered in soft hairs, and it can be black, yellow, red, or white. Bumblebees live in small groups called colonies, with a queen bee and worker bees. The queen starts a new nest in the spring, often underground in an old mouse hole. Worker bees collect pollen and nectar from flowers to feed the baby bees. Bumblebees can fly very high, even higher than tall mountains. They have a sting but only use it if they feel very scared. Unlike honeybees, a bumblebee can sting more than once. Some bumblebees are called cuckoo bees because they take over other bumblebees' nests.
Fossil\n\nA fossil is the remains of a very old plant or animal that lived a long, long time ago. Fossils are found in rocks. They look like bones, shells, or footprints that have turned into stone. It takes many thousands of years for a fossil to form. The hard parts of animals, like bones and shells, make the best fossils. Dinosaur bones are famous fossils that you can see in museums. Some fossils are tiny and can only be seen with a special tool. People study fossils to learn about animals and plants that lived long ago.
Katana\n\nA katana is a long sword from Japan. Samurai warriors used it a long time ago. The katana has a curved blade that is very sharp on one side. It is made from special steel that is folded many times to make it strong. Samurai wore the katana on their left side, with the blade facing up. They could pull it out fast to cut or stab. The katana was very important to samurai. They thought it held the soul of its owner. Only samurai were allowed to have a katana. Today, people practice using a katana in martial arts like kendo.
Circle\n\nA circle is a round shape. It is flat, like a plate or a coin. Every point on the edge of a circle is the same distance from the middle. The middle is called the center. A line from the center to the edge is called the radius. A line all the way across through the center is called the diameter. The diameter is two times the radius. The line around the circle is called the circumference. The number pi (say "pie") is special. It is about 3.14. You can use pi to find how far around or how much space is inside a circle.
Truth\n\nTruth is what is real and correct. If something is true, it really happened or it really is that way. If something is not true, it is false or made up. When you say something that is true, you are telling the truth. When you say something you know is not true, that is a lie. A person who tells lies is called a liar. Sometimes people mix a little truth with a lie, and that is called a half truth. True things exist; false things do not.
Alternative medicine\n\nAlternative medicine is a way people try to get better that is different from the medicine doctors use. Some people use it along with regular medicine. It includes things like putting tiny needles in the skin, or using very small amounts of plants. But alternative medicine does not make sick people well. Regular medicine that doctors use has been tested and is proven to work.
Mouth\n\nYour mouth is an opening in your face. It is where food goes in to be chewed. Your teeth help chew the food into small pieces. Your tongue helps you taste and move food around. Your mouth also helps you talk and make sounds. You use your lips and tongue to say words. People also use their mouths to kiss and show how they feel.
Museum of Modern Art\n\nThe Museum of Modern Art is a big building in New York City where people go to see new kinds of art. It is on 53rd Street. The museum shows paintings and sculptures made by famous artists like Vincent van Gogh and Andy Warhol. Some of the art looks like splashes of paint or bright colors. Many people visit the museum to look at the pictures and learn about art.
Mount Fuji\n\nMount Fuji is the tallest mountain in Japan. It is a volcano, but it has not erupted for a very long time. The last time it erupted was a long time ago, in the years 1707 to 1708. Many people climb Mount Fuji every summer. The best time to climb is from July 25 to August 25. At the very top of the mountain, there is a post office that is open only in summer. It is the highest post office in Japan. Mount Fuji is very famous, and many artists have painted pictures of it. It is a special place for the Shinto religion, and there are small temples at the bottom of the mountain.
Dung beetle\n\nA dung beetle is a bug that eats poop from animals like cows and horses. Some dung beetles roll the poop into a ball and push it away. They use the poop ball for food or to lay their eggs inside. Other dung beetles dig a hole and bury the poop where they find it. Some just live in the poop. Dung beetles are very strong. A male dung beetle can pull more than one thousand times its own weight. That is like you pulling six big buses full of people! Dung beetles live in many places like farms, forests, and deserts. They do not like very cold weather. They use their nose to find poop. Some dung beetles even use moonlight to help them roll their ball in a straight line. When a dung beetle has a poop ball, other beetles may try to steal it. So the beetle must roll away fast. Baby dung beetles hatch from eggs inside the poop ball and eat the poop until they grow up.
Tent\n\nA tent is a small house made of cloth that you can take with you. It keeps you safe from wind, rain, and cold. The cloth is held up by sticks or poles and tied to the ground with ropes and little stakes. People use tents when they go camping or hiking. Big tents are used for parties or circuses. Some people sleep in tents when they have no other place to stay.
Great Zimbabwe\n\nGreat Zimbabwe is an old city in Africa that is now broken and empty. Long ago, it was a big and important city where a king lived. The city was built with tall stone walls, and the stones were stacked together without any sticky stuff like glue. Some walls were taller than a grown-up. Many people lived there, maybe as many as 18,000. The people who lived there traded with faraway places, and they had things from China. The country of Zimbabwe got its name from this old city. Today, people visit Great Zimbabwe to see the old stone walls and learn about how people lived long ago.
Giza\n\nGiza is a city in Egypt. It sits next to a big river called the Nile. Many people live there. Giza is famous for the Giza Plateau, where you can see very old and big stone buildings. The biggest one is the Great Pyramid of Giza. There is also a giant statue called the Great Sphinx. These were built a long, long time ago by the ancient Egyptians. Many people visit Giza to see these amazing old buildings.
Weighing scale\n\nA weighing scale is a machine that tells you how heavy something is. To use an old scale, you put the thing you want to weigh on one side and add heavy stones on the other side until both sides are even. Then you know the weight. New scales are easier: you just put the item on top, and the number shows up on a screen or a dial. Some scales can even count small things like screws by weighing them.
Secret society\n\nA secret society is a group of people who meet in secret. No one outside the group knows what they do. Some people think a secret society called the Illuminati used to exist a long time ago. Some people still believe it is around today, but there is no proof.
Bangladesh\n\nBangladesh is a country in South Asia. It is next to India and Myanmar. Many, many people live there. The capital city is Dhaka. People in Bangladesh speak Bengali. The country has big rivers and a large forest. Bangladesh used to be part of Pakistan, but it became its own country in 1971 after a war. Now it has its own government and leaders. The weather is hot and rainy. Rice grows well there.
Communication\n\nCommunication is how people share ideas and feelings with each other. You can talk to someone, smile, or wave your hand. Even animals communicate, like a dog wagging its tail. Sometimes people send messages without thinking, like when they stand a certain way. For communication to work, both people need to understand the same words. A word can mean different things, so you have to be careful. Good communication means being clear and listening well.
Yarn\n\nYarn is a long, thin string made of soft fibers. People use yarn to make clothes like hats, scarves, and socks. You can knit or crochet with yarn to make things. Yarn comes in many colors and thicknesses. Some yarn is thin like thread, and some is thick and fluffy. Yarn can be made from wool from sheep, cotton from plants, or other soft materials. It is often sold in a round bundle called a skein so it does not get tangled.
Broadway theatre\n\nBroadway theatre is a place in New York City where people put on plays and shows. There are 41 big theatres there, each with more than 500 seats. The shows have actors, music, and dancing. Many people go to see them. Broadway is one of the most famous places for live shows in the world.
The Thinker\n\nThe Thinker is a statue made of bronze. It shows a man sitting down and thinking very hard. His arm is bent on his leg, and his chin rests on his hand. A man named Auguste Rodin made this statue a long time ago. He first called it "The Poet." The statue was part of a big door with many other statues. The man in the statue is thinking about a poem. Many copies of The Thinker are in museums all over the world. Some copies are bigger than the first one.
Work\n\nWork is something you do to get something done. When your mom or dad goes to a job, that is work. When you help clean up your toys, that is work too. Work can be hard or easy. Sometimes work is fun, like making a drawing. Sometimes work is tiring, like carrying heavy things. People work to earn money to buy food and clothes. Even animals work, like a dog that helps a farmer.
Cricket\n\nCricket is a sport played outside on a big grassy field. Two teams of eleven players take turns. One team hits the ball with a bat, and the other team throws the ball and tries to catch it. The hitter tries to hit the ball far away and run to score points called runs. The thrower tries to hit a wooden thing called a wicket. If the wicket gets hit, the hitter is out. The team with the most runs wins. Players wear special clothes to stay safe, like pads on their legs and a helmet on their head. Cricket is very popular in many countries like England, Australia, and India.
Brooklyn Bridge\n\nThe Brooklyn Bridge is a very old bridge in New York City. It goes over a big river called the East River. The bridge connects two parts of the city: Manhattan and Brooklyn. It is long and hangs from strong ropes. Many people walk or drive across it every day. The bridge is a famous landmark, which means many people know about it and visit it.
Humanities\n\nHumanities are about people and how they think, feel, and make things. They include stories, music, painting, and history. People who study humanities learn about different languages, old and new ideas, and how people lived long ago. They also learn about plays, dancing, and art. Humanities help us understand each other better.
Snack\n\nA snack is a small amount of food you eat between meals. You might eat a snack when you are hungry but it is not time for breakfast, lunch, or dinner. Some snacks are potato chips, fruit, candy, muffins, ice cream, and popcorn. Many people buy snacks that come in bags or boxes from the store.
Stew\n\nStew is a food that you cook for a long time. It has meat and vegetables in a yummy sauce. You cook it on the stove in a pot. The meat gets very soft. People have made stew for a very long time, even thousands of years ago. Some stews have beef or lamb. Some have carrots and potatoes. Stew is warm and good to eat on a cold day.
Shower\n\nA shower is a place where you stand up and clean your body with water. Water comes out from a shower head above you. You do not wear clothes in the shower. Some showers have water spraying from many sides. You can find a shower in a bathroom. People use it to get clean.
Heat treating\n\nHeat treating is a way to make metal stronger or softer. You heat the metal up very hot, then let it cool down. This changes how the metal feels and works. People do this to make tools, knives, and other things out of metal. Some plastics can also be heat treated. It is like cooking metal to make it just right.
Time travel\n\nTime travel is the idea of going back to the past or forward to the future. We always go forward to the future, but going back to the past is not something we can really do. Many stories and movies talk about time travel. One famous story is 'The Time Machine' by H. G. Wells. Another is the movie 'Back to the Future,' where a professor builds a machine that can take people to the past or future. The TV show 'Doctor Who' is about an alien who travels through time in a spaceship. Some shows use magic instead of machines to travel in time.
Cologne\n\nCologne is a big city in Germany. It sits next to a long river called the Rhine. Many people live there. A long time ago, the Romans built the city. The most famous thing in Cologne is a very big church called the Cologne Cathedral. It has a golden box with the gifts from the Three Wise Men inside. The city has many museums and a big university. People in Cologne speak a special way called Kölsch. Cologne is also known for a special smell called Eau de Cologne.
Chocolate\n\nChocolate is a food made from cacao beans. It can be a solid candy bar or a warm drink like hot chocolate. There are three kinds: white chocolate, milk chocolate, and dark chocolate. White chocolate is very sweet. Milk chocolate is sweet but not as sweet. Dark chocolate is not very sweet and tastes a little bitter. People use chocolate in cakes, pudding, ice cream, and candy. Long ago, people in Mexico made a bitter drink from cacao beans. Only important people could drink it. Later, people added sugar and made it sweet. Now many people all over the world enjoy chocolate. Most cocoa beans today come from Africa. Chocolate is safe to eat, but dogs and cats can get sick if they eat it.
Pampas\n\nThe Pampas is a big, flat piece of land in South America. It is in parts of Argentina, Uruguay, and Brazil. The ground is very low and flat, with some small hills. The weather is warm and not too hot or cold. Many people live there, especially near the big city of Buenos Aires. Long ago, big animals like pumas and deer lived there, but now most of them are gone because people use the land for farms and ranches.
Maize\n\nMaize is a tall plant that grows in many warm places. People also call it corn. It has a long stalk with green leaves and yellow kernels that grow in rows on a cob. People first grew maize a long time ago in Central America. Today, farmers grow lots of maize all over the world. Some people eat sweet corn or popcorn. Most maize is used to feed animals or make things like corn syrup and corn starch. Maize can be ground into flour to make tortillas and cornbread.
Iran\n\nIran is a big country in Asia. It used to be called Persia. The capital city is Tehran. Many people live there, and most of them speak Persian. Iran has tall mountains and dry land. It is famous for beautiful carpets, poems, and old art. The country has a lot of oil and gas. The leader of Iran is called the Supreme Leader. Iran has a long history, and many old things are still there.
Recycling\n\nRecycling is when you take old things like paper, glass, plastic, and cans and turn them into new things. Instead of throwing trash away, you put it in a special bin. Then a truck takes it to a place where it gets cleaned and made into something new. For example, old plastic bottles can become park benches or flower pots. Recycling helps keep the Earth clean and saves energy. The three R's are Reduce, Reuse, and Recycle. Reduce means using less. Reuse means using something again. Recycle means making old things into new things.
Blue\n\nBlue is a color you can see in the sky and in the ocean. It is one of the colors in a rainbow. The sky looks blue during the day. The ocean looks blue too. When people go up in space and look back at Earth, it looks like a big blue ball. Blue can also mean feeling sad, like when someone says they have "the blues." Many boys like the color blue, but girls can like it too.
Mercury (planet)\n\nMercury is a planet. It is the smallest planet in our solar system. It is also the closest planet to the Sun. Mercury looks like our Moon. It has many round holes called craters and flat, smooth areas. Mercury has no moons. It is very hot during the day and very cold at night. Mercury is hard to see from Earth because it is so close to the Sun. You can only see it just after sunset or just before sunrise. Two spaceships have visited Mercury. The first one was Mariner 10, and the second one was MESSENGER. They took pictures of Mercury's surface.
Clove\n\nA clove is a dried flower bud from a tree. It smells strong and is used in cooking. People put whole cloves in ham to give it flavor. Ground cloves are a spice used in India. Cloves come from Indonesia and other warm places. Long ago, cloves were very expensive and worth as much as gold.
Chemistry\n\nChemistry is the science that studies what everything is made of and how it changes. It looks at matter, which is anything that takes up space. Tiny bits called atoms and molecules come together to make everything around us. Chemistry helps us understand why iron gets rusty, how soap cleans our hands, and how food gives us energy. People have used chemistry for a very long time. Long ago, people learned to make fire, cook food, and shape clay into pots. They also learned to get metal from rocks to make tools and jewelry. Today, chemistry helps us make medicine, clean water, and new materials. It is connected to other sciences like physics and biology.
Horse fly\n\nA horse fly is a kind of insect that looks like a big fly. Some are as small as a housefly, and some are as big as a bumblebee. Their eyes are shiny and colorful. The female horse fly bites horses and other animals. The bite can hurt and make the animal feel bad.
Barents Sea\n\nThe Barents Sea is a big body of water in the very cold north. It sits next to Norway and Russia. The sea is named after a man named Willem Barents. Part of the sea stays open all year because warm water comes from the ocean. Many fish live there, like cod and capelin. Big animals like whales and seals eat the fish. People from Norway and Russia catch fish from this sea.
Authoritarianism\n\nAuthoritarianism is a way of running a country where people must do what the leader says without asking questions. The leader has all the power, and people cannot choose what to do or say. There are no votes for the people, and the leader makes all the rules. This is different from places where people can vote and share their ideas.
Scale (zoology)\n\nA scale is a small, hard plate that grows out of an animal's skin to keep it safe. Fish and reptiles have scales all over their bodies. Some insects like butterflies and moths have tiny scales on their wings. These scales can be very colorful and pretty.
Muscat\n\nMuscat is a big city in a country called Oman. It is the capital city, which means the leader of the country lives there. Many people live in Muscat, more than one million. The city is very hot and dry. In summer, the sun makes it very warm. In winter, it is cooler but still not cold. Almost no rain falls there. Muscat is next to the sea, so it has beaches where people can swim and play. There are also old forts, museums, and a big opera house to visit. People come from far away to see the city and have fun.
Monsoon\n\nA monsoon is a wind that blows from the ocean to the land for many months. It brings lots of rain. The land gets very hot, and the hot air goes up. Then cool air from the ocean comes in to take its place. That cool air has water in it, and when it gets to the land, the water falls as rain. Monsoons happen in places like India, where they bring rain for a long time. The rain helps plants grow and fills rivers with water.
Indonesia\n\nIndonesia is a country with many, many islands. It has more than 17,000 islands! The biggest islands are Java, Bali, Kalimantan, Sulawesi, and Sumatra. The capital city is Jakarta, on the island of Java. Indonesia is home to many people—it is the fourth most crowded country in the world. Most people live on the island of Java. The main language is Indonesian, but people also speak many other languages like Javanese and Balinese. Indonesia has lots of volcanoes that can shoot hot lava. It also has earthquakes and big waves called tsunamis. Most people in Indonesia follow the religion of Islam. The country became free from other countries on August 17, 1945, and that day is a big holiday. Indonesia has many different groups of people and many kinds of dances, like the Piring dance from West Sumatra. The national bird is the Javan hawk-eagle. People like to visit Indonesia to see its beautiful nature and learn about its culture.
Economic inequality\n\nEconomic inequality is when some people have a lot more money than other people. It can mean some people can buy good food and live in nice houses, while others cannot.
Concerto\n\nA concerto is a piece of music where one instrument plays a solo part and an orchestra plays along. The solo instrument can be a violin, a piano, or many other instruments. The soloist decides how fast or slow to play, and the orchestra follows. The word "concerto" comes from an Italian word that means "playing together." Some concertos have more than one soloist. A famous set of concertos is called "The Four Seasons" by Vivaldi, with one concerto for each season: spring, summer, autumn, and winter. Many other composers like Mozart and Beethoven wrote concertos too. In a concerto, there is often a part called a cadenza where the soloist plays alone and shows off their skill. Some modern concertos use unusual sounds, like water.
Maldives\n\nThe Maldives are a group of many small islands in the Indian Ocean. They are near India. There are over 1,200 islands, but people live on only about 200 of them. The islands are very flat. In fact, the Maldives is the flattest country in the world. The highest place is only a little bit above the sea. The weather is hot and wet most of the year. There is a dry season and a rainy season. The capital city is called Malé. Many people there are Muslim.
Human migration\n\nHuman migration is when people move from one place to another. Sometimes people choose to move, and sometimes they have to move because of bad things like war, hunger, or storms. People who are forced to move are called refugees. Many refugees are children and women. They may not have enough food, a safe place to sleep, or a doctor. Some people move from the countryside to big cities to find better jobs and schools. But moving can be hard, and some people do not have a home when they arrive. People have been moving from place to place for a very long time.
Lake Nicaragua\n\nLake Nicaragua is a very big lake in a country called Nicaragua. It is the biggest lake in all of Central America. The lake has three islands and two volcanoes inside it. There are also over 400 tiny islands called islets. A river connects this lake to the Caribbean Sea. Another river connects it to a smaller lake called Lake Managua.
Yemen\n\nYemen is a country in the Middle East, on the Arabian Peninsula. It is next to Saudi Arabia and Oman. The Red Sea is on one side, and the Gulf of Aden is on the other. The capital city is Sana'a. Yemen has many mountains and some islands in the sea. The weather is hot and dry in many places. Most people in Yemen speak Arabic. Many children live there, and almost half of the people are younger than 15 years old. Football is the most popular sport. People also like to climb rocks and swim in the sea.
Privacy\n\nPrivacy is when you get to choose what things about you are secret and who knows them. Everyone has some things they want to keep just for themselves. Some people want to keep their beliefs or feelings private so they don't get in trouble. On the internet, some people can see what you do online and even sell that information. For example, someone who sends you an email can sometimes tell when you open it.
Slovakia\n\nSlovakia is a country in the middle of Europe. It does not touch any ocean. The capital city is Bratislava. Slovakia has many mountains, especially the Tatra mountains with the highest peak called Gerlachov Peak. The big rivers are the Danube, Vah, and Hron. The weather is warm in summer and cold and snowy in winter. People in Slovakia use money called Euro. Slovakia is part of the European Union. Long ago, Slovakia was part of a bigger country called Czechoslovakia. In 1993, Slovakia became its own country.
Volcano\n\nA volcano is a mountain that can shoot hot, liquid rock called lava. The lava comes from deep inside the Earth. When a volcano erupts, lava, ash, and steam come out of the top. Some volcanoes are tall and steep, like Mount Fuji. Others are wide and flat, like Mauna Loa in Hawaii. Volcanoes can be awake and erupting, sleeping but could wake up, or dead and never erupt again. The biggest volcano on Earth is under the ocean, near Japan. It is called Tamu Massif.
Kosovo\n\nKosovo is a small country in Europe. It is near Serbia, Albania, North Macedonia, and Montenegro. Kosovo used to be part of Serbia, but in 2008 it said it was its own country. Many other countries agree that Kosovo is a country. Most people in Kosovo speak Albanian. The money they use is called the euro. Kosovo has mountains and flat fields. The weather is cold in the mountains and warm in the south.
Astronaut\n\nAn astronaut is a person who goes into outer space. The first person to go to space was Yuri Gagarin from Russia. The first people to walk on the Moon were Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin from the United States. Astronauts live and work on the International Space Station, which is a big home in space. They wear special suits to stay safe. Astronauts fly to space in rockets. Some rockets are made by the United States, Russia, and China. A company called SpaceX is building a big rocket that could take people to Mars one day.
Civics\n\nCivics is learning about how a country is run. It helps people know how to be good helpers in their town or country. In school, children learn about rules and how people vote. This way, everyone can help make the country fair and safe.
Moon landing\n\nA moon landing is when a spaceship lands on the Moon. The first time people landed on the Moon was in 1969. Two men named Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin walked on the Moon. They wore big suits to stay safe. No one has walked on the Moon since 1972.
Jakarta\n\nJakarta is a big city in Indonesia. It is the capital, which means it is the most important city in the country. Jakarta is on an island called Java, right next to the sea. Many, many people live there — more than ten million! The city is very crowded. Jakarta has a warm, rainy climate. One problem is that the city is slowly sinking into the ground. Because of this, the government decided to move the capital to a different place on another island called Borneo.
Train\n\nA train is a long line of cars that move on tracks. Trains carry people and things from one place to another. Some trains carry people in seats or beds. Other trains carry boxes, food, or big machines. A train stops at a station so people can get on or off. The first trains were pulled by horses. Then steam engines made trains go fast. Today, many trains use diesel or electricity. Some very fast trains float on magnets and go super fast.
Muscle\n\nMuscle is the part of your body that helps you move. Muscles are like stretchy bands inside you. They can get shorter and thicker, and that makes your arms, legs, and other parts move. Some muscles you can control, like the ones in your arms and legs. Those are called skeletal muscles. Other muscles work without you thinking, like the muscle in your heart that pumps blood. When you exercise, your muscles get bigger and stronger. If you do not move much, your muscles get smaller and weaker. All animals have muscles, but plants do not.
Nitrogen\n\nNitrogen is a gas that you cannot see or smell. Most of the air around us is nitrogen. It is in the sky and in the ground. Nitrogen helps plants grow. It is also in the food we eat, like meat and beans. Liquid nitrogen is very, very cold and can freeze things fast. Some bags of chips have nitrogen inside to keep them fresh.
Tropical climate\n\nA tropical climate is a kind of weather that is hot and wet all year. It is always warm, never cold, and snow never falls. Some places with this climate have rain every day, often in the afternoon. Other places have a rainy season and a dry season. The Amazon rainforest is a famous place with a tropical climate. Many different plants and animals live there.
Green iguana\n\nThe green iguana is a lizard that lives in warm places like Central and South America and some islands. It has green skin and a long tail. Green iguanas like to climb trees and eat plants like leaves and flowers. They can be very big for a lizard. You can find them in Florida, Hawaii, and Texas too.
Cockroach\n\nA cockroach is a small insect with six legs and a flat body. Most cockroaches live outside in the dirt and leaves. Only a few kinds of cockroaches come into people's houses. Cockroaches can eat almost anything. They are very tough and hard to kill. A cockroach can live for two weeks without its head. Baby cockroaches grow into adults in about 3 or 4 months. Some cockroaches can live for one whole year. In some places, people eat cockroaches as snacks.
Ottawa\n\nOttawa is a city in Canada. It is the capital, which means the leader of the country works there. Ottawa is in the province of Ontario, next to a big river called the Ottawa River. Many people live in Ottawa. The city has lots of parks, museums, and government buildings. There is a market downtown where people shop. Every year, Ottawa has fun festivals like Winterlude in February, the Tulip Festival in May, and a big party on July 1st for Canada Day. Some sports teams play in Ottawa, like the Ottawa Senators for ice hockey and the Ottawa Redblacks for football. Ottawa gets rain and snow every year.
Swedish language\n\nSwedish is a language that people speak in Sweden and in parts of Finland. More than nine million people speak it. Swedish sounds a lot like Norwegian and Danish, so if you know one, you can understand the others. It is a little like English too, because long ago Vikings came to England. Swedish has three special letters that English does not have: å, ä, and ö. They make different sounds, like the 'o' in 'for' or the 'e' in 'bed'. In Swedish, you add a little word to the end of a noun to say 'the'. For example, 'a house' is 'ett hus', and 'the house' is 'huset'.
Metropolitan Museum of Art\n\nThe Metropolitan Museum of Art is a big place in New York City where you can see many beautiful paintings and statues. It is sometimes called The Met. The Met sits next to a big park called Central Park. Inside, there are more than two million works of art from all over the world. You can see art from long ago, like from Egypt and Europe, and also new art from America and other places. There are also old musical instruments, fancy clothes, and armor that knights used to wear. The Met is very popular, and many people visit it every year. There is another, smaller part of the museum called the Cloisters, which has art from the Middle Ages. When you go to the Met, you can choose to give money to help the museum, but you do not have to.
Colour vision\n\nColor vision is how your eyes see different colors. Your eyes have special parts called cones that help you see red, blue, green, and other colors. When light bounces off a toy or a flower, your eyes tell your brain what color it is. Color vision helps you find ripe fruit to eat and see animals hiding in the grass. At night, it is harder to see colors because there is not enough light. Some animals, like dogs, see fewer colors than people. Other animals, like bees, can see colors that people cannot see, like ultraviolet light.
Coyote\n\nA coyote is a wild dog that lives in North America. It looks like a small wolf with grayish-brown fur, a white belly, and long pointy ears. Coyotes can live in many places like prairies, forests, mountains, and even cities. They eat many things: fruits, grass, rabbits, mice, birds, snakes, and bugs. In cities, they sometimes eat from garbage cans. Coyotes usually hunt alone but may join small groups. They dig tunnels under the ground to make dens where they sleep and have babies. A mother coyote can have up to six pups at a time. Coyotes are scared of wolves, bears, and big cats, but their biggest enemy is people. They rarely hurt people but might eat small pets like cats. In old stories from Native American people, the coyote is a tricky character who plays jokes.
Pinball\n\nPinball is a game you play inside a big box with glass on top. You push buttons to hit a metal ball around the box. The ball bounces off bumpers and lights up things. You try to keep the ball from falling down. If you are good, you can play longer and get more points. A long time ago, some cities said pinball was not allowed. But a very good player showed that pinball is a game of skill, so now people can play it again.
Warship\n\nA warship is a big boat that carries weapons. It is used by the navy to protect the country. Some warships are so big that airplanes can land on them. These are called aircraft carriers. Warships come in many sizes. Big warships never travel alone because they need help from other ships and planes to stay safe. Smaller warships bring food and supplies to the big ones. Some warships have special radios to listen to other ships.
Biofuel\n\nBiofuel is fuel that comes from plants or other living things. It can be solid, liquid, or gas. People use biofuel to power cars, heat homes, and cook food. Some plants like sugar cane and corn can be turned into fuel. Other plants like palm oil and soybeans can also be used. Wood has been used as fuel for a very long time. Biofuel is different from fuel that comes from old dead things underground.
Ulaanbaatar\n\nUlaanbaatar is the biggest city and the capital of Mongolia. It is a very cold city, the coldest capital in the whole world. About half of all the people in Mongolia live there. The city sits in a valley next to a river. It has many museums, temples, and a big library. People can travel to other towns by road or by train. The city was first built a long time ago as a place for monks. Its name means "red hero" in Mongolian.
Star system\n\nA star system is a group of stars that stay together in space. The stars go around each other because they pull on each other. Two stars together are called a binary star. Some star systems have three, four, or even five stars. Most star systems have three stars. The stars in a system can be close together or far apart. A star system is different from a planetary system, which has planets going around a star.
Salamander\n\nA salamander is a small animal that lives in water and on land. It has four legs and a long tail, like a lizard. Baby salamanders hatch from eggs in the water and have gills to breathe. When they grow up, most salamanders live on land in wet places. Some salamanders can grow back a lost leg or tail. They eat bugs and other small creatures. Many salamanders have poison in their skin to keep predators away. Some are bright colors to warn others, and some are hidden colors to blend in.
New Guinea\n\nNew Guinea is a very big island north of Australia. It is the second biggest island in the world. The island has two parts. The east side is a country called Papua New Guinea. The west side belongs to Indonesia. Many different groups of people live there, and they speak over 1000 languages. That is more languages than any other place on Earth. The island has special animals like birds of paradise, wallabies, possums, and echidnas. Echidnas are mammals that lay eggs. There are also small meat-eating animals called quolls. New Guinea is very important for its nature and animals.
Woman\n\nA woman is a grown-up female person. When a female is little, she is called a girl. Women have a body that can grow a baby inside them. They have a special place called a uterus where the baby grows. After the baby is born, women can feed it milk from their breasts. Women are usually shorter than men. Long ago, women could not do many things that men could do, like vote or go to school. Now in many places, women have the same rights as men. Women can be doctors, teachers, and leaders. Some women choose to have babies, and some do not. Every woman is different and special.
Pilgrimage\n\nA pilgrimage is a long trip to a special place. People go to a church or a holy place that is far from their home. They travel to pray or to feel close to God. Sometimes people walk for many days to get there. A pilgrimage is a very important journey for them.
Airplane\n\nAn airplane is a machine that flies in the sky. It has wings and a body that carries people and things. Airplanes can go very fast, much faster than cars or trains. They fly between cities all over the world. Big cities have airports where airplanes take off and land. Some airplanes are very big because they need to carry lots of fuel and people. Most airplanes have a pilot who flies them. Airplanes are safer than cars. The wings are shaped like a bird's wings to help the airplane lift up into the air. Airplanes are used to take people on trips, to carry packages, and by the military.
Mixture\n\nA mixture is when you put two or more things together, like sand and water. The things in a mixture stay the same. You can sometimes see the different parts, like in a salad. If you put sugar in water and it disappears, that is called a solution. If it does not disappear, it is called a suspension. Many rocks and soils are mixtures of different minerals.
Kabaddi\n\nKabaddi is a team sport from India. Two teams play on a small field. One player, called a raider, runs into the other team's side. The raider tries to touch players on the other team and run back. While running, the raider holds their breath and says "Kabaddi" over and over. If the raider touches someone, that person is out and the raider's team gets a point. If the raider gets caught, they are out. The team with the most points wins. There are seven players on each team, and the game has two halves of 20 minutes each.
Lady beetle\n\nA lady beetle is a small round bug with a hard shell. Many lady beetles are red with black spots, but some are orange, yellow, or even black with red spots. They live all over the world. Lady beetles eat tiny bugs called aphids that hurt plants. That helps farmers and gardens. A lady beetle starts as an egg, then becomes a baby bug that eats a lot, then turns into an adult. Some lady beetles live for one or two years. When scared, they can make a bad-smelling liquid to keep animals from eating them.
Universe\n\nThe universe is everything there is: all the space, stars, planets, and clouds of gas. It is very, very big. The universe started with a big bang a long time ago and has been getting bigger ever since. Stars and planets are far apart from each other. Our Earth is inside a big group of stars called the Milky Way. There are many other groups of stars, called galaxies, far away. Scientists use special tools called telescopes to look at stars and learn about the universe. Some parts of the universe are so far away that we can never see them.
Newspaper\n\nA newspaper is a stack of paper that comes out every day or every week. It tells you about things that are happening in your town, your country, and the world. You can get a newspaper at a store or have it brought to your house. Newspapers have stories about sports, weather, and fun things like comics and puzzles. Some parts of the newspaper tell you what the people who write it think. Other parts have letters from people who read it. Long ago, newspapers were written by hand for just a few people. Later, they were printed so many people could buy them.
European badger\n\nThe European badger is a wild animal that lives in Europe. It digs holes in the ground to make its home, called a burrow. The badger is very clean and goes to the bathroom in special spots away from its home. It eats many different plants and small animals. When a badger family member dies, they bury it. Badgers are usually calm and peaceful, but they can be fierce if they get scared. Sometimes other animals like rabbits and foxes live in the same burrow with the badger.
Kohlrabi\n\nKohlrabi is a vegetable that looks like a round ball with green leaves on top. It is a kind of cabbage. You can eat it raw or cooked. The round part and the leaves are both good to eat. People in Germany, Hungary, and other places like to eat kohlrabi.
Government\n\nA government is a group of people who make rules and take care of a place like a country, a state, or a city. There are different kinds of government. In a democracy, people vote to choose who will lead them. In a monarchy, a king or queen is the leader, and their family passes the job down. In a dictatorship, one person has all the power and makes all the rules. In an oligarchy, a small group of people rule together. Governments collect money called taxes to pay for things like roads, schools, and hospitals. Almost every place on Earth has a government.
Rock music\n\nRock music is a kind of music that people play with electric guitars, a bass guitar, a singer, and drums. It started a long time ago in the United States. Rock music has a strong beat that makes you want to tap your feet. Many people like to listen to rock music and dance to it. Some rock songs are about love, and some are about being happy or sad. Rock music can be loud and fast, or slow and soft. There are many different kinds of rock music, like punk rock, heavy metal, and alternative rock. People all over the world enjoy rock music.
Phase change\n\nA phase change is when something changes from one kind of stuff to another. For example, an ice cube is a solid. When it gets warm, it melts into liquid water. That is called melting. When water gets very hot, it turns into steam, which is a gas. That is called evaporation. When steam cools down, it turns back into water drops. That is called condensation. When water gets very cold, it freezes back into ice. That is called freezing. Heat makes things change from solid to liquid to gas. Cold makes them change back.
Catalonia\n\nCatalonia is a place in Spain. It is near the mountains called the Pyrenees and has a border with France. The biggest city in Catalonia is Barcelona, which is by the sea. Many people visit Barcelona in the summer. People in Catalonia speak Catalan, Spanish, and a little Occitan. Catalonia has its own government and police. In 2017, Catalonia said it wanted to be its own country, but most other countries did not agree. Catalonia has a lot of factories and farms. It gets more rain than southern Spain, so it is greener and not as hot.
Arapaima\n\nThe arapaima is a very big fish that lives in rivers in South America. It eats other fish, bugs, fruits, and even small animals near the water. When it feels scared, it can jump out of the water. Arapaima do not swim far away, so scientists think there are more kinds of arapaima they have not found yet.
Carnival\n\nCarnival is a big party with parades, music, and costumes. It happens in many cities around the world. Long ago, people had a big feast before a quiet time called Lent. During Lent, many people give up treats like cake or chocolate. Carnival is the fun party before that. Today, people dress up in bright clothes and masks. They dance in the streets to loud bands. Some parades have big floats with lots of decorations. In Venice, people wear fancy masks. In Uruguay, people sing and play drums in groups called murga. Carnival can last for many days. It is a time for everyone to have fun together.
Plant stem\n\nA plant stem is the part of a plant that holds up the leaves and flowers. Stems are like the body of the plant. They carry water and food from the roots to the leaves. Most stems grow above the ground, but some grow under the ground. Stems can be soft like a flower stem or hard like a tree trunk. Some stems we eat, like potatoes, asparagus, and sugar cane. Wood from tree trunks is used to make houses, furniture, paper, and many other things. Some stems give us medicine, spices, and rubber.
American football\n\nAmerican football is a game played by two teams with 11 players on each side. The ball has pointy ends. Players try to get the ball into the other team's end zone to score points. They wear helmets and padding to stay safe. The game is played on a long grass field. A team has four chances to move the ball forward. They can throw it or run with it. If they get the ball to the end zone, that is a touchdown and gives 6 points. They can also kick the ball through tall yellow poles for 3 points. After a touchdown, they can try for 1 or 2 extra points. The game lasts 60 minutes with four parts called quarters. The team with more points at the end wins.
Aesthetics\n\nAesthetics is about art and beauty. It asks what people like to see, hear, feel, smell, or taste. Some people think beauty is different for each person, like when someone says 'Beauty is in the eye of the beholder.' Others think there are rules for what is beautiful. Aesthetics helps us think about why we like some things and not others.
Soap\n\nSoap is something you use to get clean. It helps wash away dirt and germs from your hands and body. Soap makes bubbles called suds. The bubbles grab the dirt and germs, and then water washes them away. Soap can be made from fat or oil. People have used soap for a very long time, even thousands of years ago. Some people like to make their own soap at home.
Sanitary sewer\n\nA sanitary sewer is a pipe that goes underground. It takes dirty water from houses and buildings to a place that cleans the water. The dirty water is called sewage. Cleaning the water helps keep rivers and lakes safe. Long ago, dirty water made people very sick. Now we clean the water before it goes back outside.
Moldova\n\nMoldova is a country in Eastern Europe. It is next to Ukraine and Romania. The people there speak Romanian. The big city where the government works is called Chișinău. A long time ago, Moldova was part of a bigger country called the Soviet Union. Now it is its own country. Many people in Moldova work hard but do not get a lot of money. Russia used to send gas to Moldova, but in 2024 it stopped.
Milkfish\n\nA milkfish is a kind of fish that lives in the ocean. It is the national fish of the Philippines, where people call it bangus. Milkfish have shiny scales and a long body. People like to eat milkfish because it tastes good. Some people also call it other names like bandeng or gorillafish, but in the Philippines it is always called bangus.
Northeast India\n\nNortheast India is a part of the country of India. It is on the east side of Bangladesh. This place has seven states that are called the "seven sister states." Their names are Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, and Tripura. Sometimes Sikkim is also counted. These states are next to each other like sisters.
Woodpecker\n\nA woodpecker is a bird that pecks on trees with its strong beak. It has a long sticky tongue to catch bugs hiding inside the tree. Woodpeckers live in forests and woodlands all over the world, except in Australia, New Zealand, Madagascar, and Antarctica. They have special feet with four toes that help them hold onto tree trunks. Their stiff tail feathers help them stay upright while pecking. Woodpeckers have a strong skull that protects their brain from getting hurt when they hammer on wood. They also have a special flap that covers their eyes to keep out wood chips. Some woodpeckers are called wrynecks. They have shorter beaks and like to eat ants. Wrynecks can turn their heads almost all the way around and make a hissing sound to scare away animals.
Magnet\n\nA magnet is a special piece of metal that can pull some other metals toward it. Magnets have two sides called poles: a north pole and a south pole. If you put two different poles together, they pull each other close. If you put two same poles together, they push each other away. Magnets only stick to metals like iron, steel, and nickel. They do not stick to wood, glass, or plastic. Some magnets are natural rocks called lodestone. A compass uses a magnet to point north. You can play with magnets on your fridge or with toy trains.
Oceania\n\nOceania is a big area in the Pacific Ocean. It has many islands and 14 countries. Some people say Oceania is one of the continents of the world. The islands in Oceania are far apart, and the water around them is very blue. People live on some of these islands, and they have their own ways of life. The biggest country in Oceania is Australia.
Metamorphic rock\n\nA metamorphic rock is a rock that has been changed by very high heat and strong squeezing deep underground. The word 'metamorphic' means 'changed shape.' The old rock can be a sedimentary rock, an igneous rock, or another metamorphic rock. When the Earth pushes rocks together or heats them up, they twist and change. Sometimes the rock looks like a giant twisted it and heated it over a fire. Metamorphic rocks do not have fossils because the heat melts them away. You can find metamorphic rocks in mountains and deep inside the Earth.
Corporation\n\nA corporation is a big group of people who work together to run a business. The law sees it as its own thing, separate from the people who own it. This means the business can own things, sign papers, and go to court just like a person. People who own part of the company are called shareholders. They get a share of the money the company makes. The people who run the company every day are chosen by the shareholders. A corporation has a name, and it must pay taxes to the government. Some corporations are for making money, and some are for helping people, like churches or schools.
Popular culture\n\nPopular culture is the stuff that many people like. You can see it on TV, hear it on the radio, or play it in video games. It includes popular songs, movies, and books. Sometimes grown-ups do not like popular culture because they think it might be bad for people. But in some places, people are free to make and enjoy popular culture.
Insurance\n\nInsurance is something people buy to keep from losing money. You pay a little money every month. If something bad happens, the insurance company gives you money to help. There are different kinds of insurance. Life insurance pays money when someone dies. Other insurance pays for things like car crashes or doctor visits. People called actuaries figure out how much you should pay.
Ovary\n\nAn ovary is a part of a girl's body. Girls have two ovaries inside their belly. Ovaries are shaped like little ovals. They make tiny egg cells. Each month, one ovary lets an egg go. The egg can grow into a baby if it meets a seed from a daddy. Ovaries also make special helpers called hormones. These help a girl grow into a woman.
Zeus\n\nZeus is a make-believe king of the gods in old Greek stories. He lived on a tall mountain called Mount Olympus. Zeus was the god of the sky, lightning, and thunder. He had a special weapon called a thunderbolt that could make big flashes and loud booms. When he was a baby, his mom hid him in a cave so his dad would not eat him. When he grew up, he fought a big war and became the boss of all the gods. Zeus had many children, and some of them were gods too. People in old Greece had games every four years to honor him. His favorite animals were the eagle and the bull.
Papaya\n\nPapaya is a fruit that grows on a tall plant that looks like a tree. The plant has a soft green stem and big leaves at the top. The fruit is oval or round and can be as big as a football. The skin is green at first and turns yellow when the fruit is ready to eat. Inside, the fruit is yellow, orange, or pink, with many small black seeds. You can eat ripe papaya fresh after taking off the skin and seeds. People also make juice or mix it with other fruits. Green papaya is used in salads and soups in some countries. Papaya has vitamins that are good for your body.
Entertainment\n\nEntertainment is something fun that you do or watch. It can be a game, a movie, or a show. Some entertainment makes you laugh, like funny shows. Some entertainment can make you feel scared or sad, like scary movies. Entertainment helps you feel happy and forget about things that worry you.
Panama Canal\n\nThe Panama Canal is a water path in the country of Panama. It connects two big oceans: the Atlantic Ocean and the Pacific Ocean. The canal is 77 kilometers long. It has special gates called locks that lift boats up and down. Boats use the canal to go from one ocean to the other without going all the way around South America. That saves a very long trip. Many ships go through the canal every year. The canal was finished in 1914. The United States built it, and now Panama takes care of it.
Ship\n\nA ship is a very big vehicle that moves on water. It is bigger than a boat. Ships carry things like toys, food, and clothes from one country to another. Some ships carry people on trips or holidays. Long ago, ships used big cloth sails to catch the wind and move. Later, ships used steam engines. Today, many ships use diesel engines. The biggest ship in the world is called the "Prelude". It is as long as four big football fields. It collects gas from under the sea and turns it into liquid.
Cavalry\n\nCavalry are soldiers who ride horses into battle. Long ago, people fought on horses or in carts pulled by horses. Horses are strong, so cavalry can wear heavy clothes and carry big tools. Horses are fast, so cavalry can get to the fight quickly. Today, some cavalry ride in big cars called tanks instead of horses.
Grassland\n\nA grassland is a big open place where grass grows more than trees. Many grasslands have rivers and a few trees. Grasslands are in Africa, Asia, North America, South America, and near the coast of Australia. The biggest grasslands are in East Africa. Some grasslands are called savannas, prairies, or steppes. Grass can be short or tall. In tall grass, small animals can hide. Many animals live in grasslands, like zebras, giraffes, elephants, buffalo, deer, rabbits, snakes, and birds. These animals eat grass or eat other animals. Grasslands do not get much rain, so trees are few. Fires can happen in grasslands, but grass grows back.
Name\n\nA name is a word that tells who or what something is. People have names, like "Aarav" or "Ananya." Animals have names too, like "cat" or "dog." Your name is special to you. Some people have a first name and a last name. Your last name is often the same as your family's name. Sometimes people change their name when they get married. Names can be short or long. Some names come from old stories or from what parents hope their child will be like.
Telephone\n\nA telephone is a tool that lets people talk to each other when they are far away. Long ago, telephones had wires that connected one phone to another. Today, many telephones are mobile phones that you can carry around. Mobile phones use radio waves instead of wires. A man named Alexander Graham Bell made the first telephone a long time ago. Most telephones have their own number, and you can call someone by pressing their number. Some telephones are payphones where you put in coins to make a call. People use telephones every day to talk to friends and family.
Timbuktu\n\nTimbuktu is a city in a country called Mali, in Africa. It is a very old and famous city. Long ago, people came to Timbuktu to learn and to pray. There are three big mosques there, which are special buildings for prayer. The city is near a big river called the Niger River. People from different groups live there, like the Songhay and Tuareg. Timbuktu is a place where people trade things like salt. The salt comes from far away and is sold in Timbuktu. Many years ago, people in Europe thought Timbuktu was a very far and exciting place. It is very hot there, and the desert is slowly getting closer to the city.
Republic of Ireland\n\nIreland is a country in Europe. It is on an island called Ireland. The country shares the island with Northern Ireland, which is part of the United Kingdom. The capital city is Dublin. Cork is the second biggest city. About 4.9 million people live there. Most people speak English, but many also learn Irish in school. In some parts, called the Gaeltacht, people speak Irish as their first language. A long time ago, England ruled Ireland. Ireland became its own country in 1922. The leader of the country is called the President, but the President does not have a lot of power. The people vote for their leaders. The head of the government is called the Taoiseach. Ireland uses the euro as money. There are not many forests in Ireland, only about 10 percent. Many fields are used for farming.
Kuala Lumpur\n\nKuala Lumpur is a big city and the capital of a country called Malaysia. It is very hot there all year long. It rains a lot, almost every day. The city has one of the tallest buildings in the world, called the Petronas Twin Towers. They are two very tall towers that stand next to each other.
Condiment\n\nA condiment is a food you put on other food to make it taste better. It can be a sauce or a powder. Salt and pepper are condiments. Ketchup, mustard, and mayonnaise are also condiments. You might put ketchup on your fries or mustard on a hot dog.
Pyramid\n\nA pyramid is a big building made of stone that looks like a triangle from the side. Long ago, kings and queens called pharaohs in Egypt were buried inside pyramids. The biggest pyramid is the Great Pyramid of Giza. It was the tallest building in the world for a very long time. Workers built it with big stone blocks. Some pyramids are in other places like Mexico and Central America. There is even a glass pyramid in Paris, France.
Oceanic trench\n\nAn oceanic trench is a very deep, narrow valley on the ocean floor. It has steep sides like a big crack in the ground under the water. These trenches happen when one big piece of the Earth's crust slides under another piece. The Mariana Trench is the deepest trench in the world. It is near the island of Guam. In 1960, two men went all the way down to the bottom of the Mariana Trench in a special boat. Trenches can cause earthquakes and big waves called tsunamis.
Thai boxing\n\nThai boxing is a kind of fighting sport from Thailand. It is also called Muay Thai. In this sport, you can use your hands, elbows, knees, and feet to hit. That is why people call it the art of eight limbs. Before a fight, the fighters do a special dance and ceremony. Long ago, Thai boxing was used in wars. Now it is a sport. Fighters wear gloves to stay safe. They train very hard to be strong and fast. Thai boxing is known all over the world.
Cassiopeia (constellation)\n\nCassiopeia is a group of stars in the night sky. It looks like a letter W or M made of five bright stars. You can see it in the fall. A long time ago, a very bright star suddenly appeared there and then faded away.
Pangaea\n\nPangaea was a giant land that was made of all the land on Earth a very long time ago. It was like one big piece of land with all the countries stuck together. A huge ocean called Panthalassa was all around it. Then, after many, many years, Pangaea started to break apart into smaller pieces. Those pieces moved away from each other and became the continents we have today, like North America, Africa, and Australia. The breaking is still happening in some places, like in East Africa.
Cycle sport\n\nCycle sport is when people ride bicycles in races. There are different kinds of bike races. Some races are on roads, some on bumpy dirt paths, and some on special tracks with jumps. People also do tricks on bikes or play games like bike polo. Bike racing is in the Olympics. Many people in Europe, like in France and Italy, love to watch bike races. The first bike race was in 1868 in Paris, France. A man from England won that race on a wooden bike with hard rubber wheels.
Rio de Janeiro\n\nRio de Janeiro is a big city in Brazil. It is the second biggest city in that country. The city sits next to the ocean and has many beaches, like Copacabana and Ipanema. There is a big statue of Jesus called Christ the Redeemer on a tall mountain. Another mountain looks like a sugar loaf. Many people live and work in Rio. The city makes things like clothes and food. In 2016, the Olympic Games were held there. A big forest called Tijuca National Park is inside the city. You can ride an old tram to a neighborhood called Santa Tereza.
Slovenia\n\nSlovenia is a small country in the middle of Europe. The biggest city is Ljubljana, and people there speak Slovenian. About 2 million people live in Slovenia. It makes things like toys and metal to sell to other countries. A long time ago, different groups of people lived there, and then it was part of a bigger country called Yugoslavia. In 1991, Slovenia became its own country after a short war. Now it is part of a big group of countries called the European Union.
X-ray\n\nAn X-ray is a kind of invisible wave that can go through things. It has more energy than light we can see. X-rays can pass through skin and muscle, but not through bone. That is why doctors use X-rays to take pictures of the bones inside your body. The picture shows the bones as white shapes. X-rays are made by hitting metal with very fast tiny bits. They can be dangerous if you get too many, so doctors are careful. Sometimes X-rays are used to help sick people get better.
Currency\n\nCurrency is the money people use to buy things. Different countries have different kinds of money. For example, the United States uses dollars, and Japan uses yen. Some money is tied to another country's money, so if that money changes, it changes too. Long ago, some money was tied to gold or silver, but most countries do not do that anymore.
Peafowl\n\nA peafowl is a bird that is a relative of the pheasant. The male is called a peacock and has long, colorful tail feathers that can be blue and green. The female is called a peahen and has shorter, brown feathers. Peafowl live in Asia, like India and Pakistan. They eat plants, bugs, and small animals. The peacock shows off his big tail to make the peahen like him. The peahen lays eggs and sits on them for about thirty days. Baby peafowl are called peachicks and learn what to eat from their mother.
Porpoise\n\nA porpoise is a mammal that lives in the ocean. It looks like a dolphin but is smaller and rounder. A porpoise has a blunt nose, a triangle fin on its back, and spade-shaped teeth. There are six kinds of porpoise. Some porpoises live near China. People at special places teach porpoises and learn about them.
Deafness\n\nDeafness is when a person cannot hear sounds or cannot hear well. Some people cannot hear any sounds at all. Other people can hear some sounds but not all. People who cannot hear well may use their eyes to watch hands move and talk that way. Some famous people like Beethoven were deaf. There are many reasons why someone might be deaf.
Sediment\n\nSediment is tiny bits of dirt, sand, or rock that fall to the bottom of water or land. Wind or water can move these bits from one place to another. Over a very long time, many layers of sediment get pressed together and turn into hard rock. You can see sediment at the bottom of a glass of water or in a muddy puddle.
Golf\n\nGolf is a game where you hit a small ball with a long stick called a club. You try to get the ball into a hole in the ground. The game is played outside on a big field with grass. Each hole has a number that tells you how many hits you should need. If you use fewer hits, that is good. If you use more, that is not as good. There are different clubs for hitting the ball far or close. People play golf for fun or in contests.
Montenegro\n\nMontenegro is a small country in Europe. Its name means Black Mountain. It sits next to the sea called the Adriatic Sea. The country has mountains and forests. The capital city is Podgorica. The old capital is Cetinje. Many people in Montenegro speak a language called Montenegrin. Most people follow the Christian religion, and some follow Islam. Montenegro used to be part of a bigger country called Yugoslavia. In 2006, the people voted to become their own country. The money they use is called the euro.
Snake\n\nA snake is a reptile with a long, thin body and no legs. Snakes live in many warm places around the world. Most snakes live on the ground or in trees. Some live in water or under the soil. Snakes eat other animals. Some snakes have poison to catch their food. Other snakes squeeze their food to death. Snakes can open their mouths very wide to swallow food whole. They do not chew. Snakes move without legs by wiggling their bodies. They can move on the ground, in water, and in sand. Snakes shed their skin when they grow. They rub against a rock or wood to split the old skin and crawl out. Most snakes are not dangerous to people.
Rajasthan\n\nRajasthan is a big state in the northwest part of India. It is the largest state in India by land. A big desert called the Thar Desert covers most of Rajasthan. The capital city is Jaipur. Many people live there, and they have a rich history and colorful culture.
Ganymede (moon)\n\nGanymede is a big moon that goes around the planet Jupiter. It is the biggest moon in our whole solar system. Ganymede is even bigger than the planet Mercury, but it is lighter because it is made of rock and ice. Under its icy outside, there is a big ocean of water that might have more water than all the oceans on Earth. Ganymede has dark and light spots on its surface. The dark spots are very old, and the light spots have lines and grooves. Ganymede is the only moon that has its own magnet.
Caiman\n\nA caiman is a kind of animal that lives in the water. It is like an alligator. Caimans live in South America and some live in Central America. They move slowly and grow old. There are six kinds of caimans.
Fable\n\nA fable is a short story that teaches a lesson. The characters in a fable are often animals that talk and act like people. For example, a clay pot might say it is scared of breaking. Fables are simple, so you do not need to know a lot about the characters. The most famous fables are by a man named Aesop. One well-known fable is "The Boy Who Cried Wolf." In that story, a boy shouts "Wolf!" for fun, and when a real wolf comes, no one believes him.
Jerusalem\n\nJerusalem is a very old city that people have lived in for a long time. It is a hilly city with many valleys around it. Jerusalem is important for three big religions: Judaism, Christianity, and Islam. For Jewish people, it is where the Temple once stood, and the Western Wall is a special place for prayer. For Christians, many things in the life of Jesus happened there, like the Last Supper and where he died. For Muslims, it is where Muhammad went up to heaven, and the Dome of the Rock and Al-Aqsa Mosque are there. The city has old stone walls around the Old City, and new buildings outside. Many buildings are made of a special cream-colored stone called Jerusalem stone. Today, both Israel and Palestine say Jerusalem is their capital, but many countries do not agree.
Pagoda\n\nA pagoda is a tall tower with many roofs stacked on top of each other. You can find pagodas in Asia, especially in countries like China and Japan. People build pagodas as special places for their religion. Some pagodas are very old and hold special things inside. The roofs curve up at the edges and look like wings.
Palau\n\nPalau is a small country made of many islands in the big Pacific Ocean. It is near the Philippines. Palau is very warm all year, with temperatures around 82 degrees. The capital city used to be Koror, but now it is Melekeok. Palau has sixteen parts called states. The people there sometimes call their country Belau.
Coral Sea\n\nThe Coral Sea is a small sea near the northeast coast of Australia. It has warm weather and lots of rain. The Great Barrier Reef is in this sea. Many sea animals live there, like sharks, manta rays, tuna, turtles, and whales. There are also many small islands in the Coral Sea. Only one island has people living on it, and only four people live there. A long time ago, during a big war, a battle happened in the Coral Sea. Airplanes from ships fought each other, and the battle helped keep Australia safe.
Breast\n\nA breast is a part of the body on the upper chest. People have two breasts, one on each side. Boys and girls are born with small breasts. When girls grow up, their breasts get bigger. A mother can feed her baby with milk from her breasts. That is called breastfeeding. The middle of the breast is the nipple. Around the nipple is a darker circle called the areola. Breasts can be different sizes. One breast may be bigger than the other, and that is okay. Breasts are soft and can feel touch.
Damascus\n\nDamascus is a big city in a country called Syria. It is one of the oldest cities in the world where people still live. Many, many years ago, people started living there. Damascus is near the sea. Long ago, people came to Damascus to buy and sell things. Now, the city makes things that go to other countries. There are schools called universities in Damascus. The city has very old buildings, like a big mosque and a market with small shops. Some old parts of the city are underground now.
Magic (illusion)\n\nMagic is when a person called a magician does tricks that look like they cannot be real. The magician might pull a rabbit out of a hat or make a coin disappear. These tricks are not real magic, just clever ways to make people smile and wonder. People watch magic shows to have fun and be surprised.
Small intestine\n\nThe small intestine is a long, thin tube inside your belly. It sits between your stomach and your large intestine. Most of the food you eat gets broken down and turned into energy here. The small intestine is very long, but it is narrow, like a skinny straw. It has three parts with special names, but you can just call it the small intestine.
Kingston, Jamaica\n\nKingston is a big city in a country called Jamaica. It is the most important city there, where the leaders work. Kingston sits by the ocean on the southeast side of the island. It has a big harbor where boats can come in safely. Many people live in Kingston, more than six hundred thousand. The city has an airport where planes land and take off. People in Kingston speak English.
Tide\n\nA tide is when the ocean water goes up and down. The Moon pulls on the water, making it rise and fall. When the water comes up high on the beach, that is high tide. When it goes back down, that is low tide. Most places have two high tides and two low tides every day. Sometimes the tides are extra high, and sometimes they are not as high. The Sun also helps pull the water a little bit. The part of the beach that is wet at high tide and dry at low tide is a special place where small animals live.
Chinese language\n\nThe Chinese language is a group of languages that people in China and other places use to talk and write. There are many kinds of Chinese, like Mandarin, Wu, and Yue.
