The cake gets bigger in the oven because tiny air bubbles inside it grow. Some cakes are made with butter, and some are made with eggs and no butter. You can put frosting, chocolate, or fruit on top of a cake. Birthday cakes often have candles on them. A cake can be tall with layers of cake and frosting in between. Some cakes have fruit on the side.
Soul\n\nA soul is a word people use to talk about the part of a person that feels and lives. Some people believe the soul does not die when the body dies. Many religions have different ideas about the soul. In some religions, the soul goes to heaven or hell after death. In other religions, the soul is born again in a new body. Some people think there is no soul at all. The word 'soul' can also mean deep feeling, like in soul music.
Paint\n\nPaint is a wet, colored liquid that you put on things to make them look pretty or to keep them safe. You can use a brush or a roller to put paint on walls, wood, or metal. Paint comes in many colors. Some paint dries fast, like watercolor, and some takes a long time to dry, like oil paint. Paint can protect wood from rain and sun, and it can stop metal from rusting. People also use paint to make pictures, called paintings. Some paintings are very old and famous.
Pretoria\n\nPretoria is a city in South Africa. It is one of the three capital cities of the country. The other two are Cape Town and Bloemfontein. Pretoria is in a warm valley surrounded by hills. Many people live there, about 1.9 million. They speak different languages like Tswana, Ndebele, Afrikaans, and English. The city was started a long time ago by a man named Marthinus Pretorius. He named it after his father. Pretoria has factories that make things like cars and trains.
Kennedy Space Center\n\nThe Kennedy Space Center is a place in Florida where rockets go up into space. It is run by NASA, a group that studies space. Big rockets like the Saturn V and the Space Shuttle took off from here. People called astronauts ride in the rockets to go to the Moon or to the space station. The center has a very tall building where rockets are put together. There is also a place where visitors can learn about space and see real rockets. The first people to walk on the Moon, Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin, started their trip from here.
Alpaca\n\nAn alpaca is a soft, fluffy animal that looks a little like a small llama. Alpacas live in South America and are kept by people for their warm wool. They eat hay and grass, and they like to chew on things. Baby alpacas are born after almost a year, and they can live up to 20 years. There are two kinds of alpacas: huacaya, which has fluffy, curly wool, and suri, which has long, silky wool. People use alpaca wool to make warm clothes like sweaters and hats. Alpacas also help guard other animals like sheep and goats by chasing away foxes.
Commutative property\n\nThe commutative property is a rule about adding and multiplying numbers. It says you can change the order of the numbers and still get the same answer. For example, 2 plus 3 is the same as 3 plus 2. Both equal 5. And 4 times 5 is the same as 5 times 4. Both equal 20. But this rule does not work for taking away or sharing. For instance, 5 take away 2 is not the same as 2 take away 5. So you can only switch numbers when you add or multiply.
Lord's Prayer\n\nThe Lord's Prayer is a special prayer that people in the Christian religion say. It is also called the Our Father. Long ago, Jesus' friends asked him how to pray, and he taught them this prayer. Many people still say it today. Some people have made music for this prayer.
Lithuania\n\nLithuania is a country in Europe. It is next to Latvia, Belarus, Poland, and Russia. The capital city is Vilnius. About 2.8 million people live there. The flag has three colors: yellow for the sun, green for the fields, and red for the blood of people who fought for the country. The people speak Lithuanian. Lithuania is part of the European Union and NATO. The country has forests, lakes, and farms. The biggest lake is Drūkšiai. The highest hill is Aukštojas. Children start school at age 7. They learn reading, writing, and math. Many people watch TV and use the internet for news.
Ancient Greek philosophy\n\nAncient Greek philosophy is a way of thinking about the world that started a long time ago in Greece. It is one of the first times people asked big questions like 'What is good?' and 'How should we live?' Some famous Greek thinkers were Socrates, Plato, and Aristotle. Socrates liked to ask many questions to help people learn. Plato wrote stories about Socrates and thought about perfect shapes and ideas. Aristotle studied plants, animals, and how people should act. He taught a famous king named Alexander the Great. Greek philosophy helped shape how people think in many places, like Rome and later in Europe.
Unit of measurement\n\nA unit of measurement is a way to say how big, how heavy, or how long something is. When you measure something, you use numbers and a unit. For example, a ruler has marks for centimeters and inches. A centimeter is a unit for length. A kilogram is a unit for weight. Different places use different units. In the United States, people often use inches, feet, and pounds. In many other countries, people use meters and kilograms. Time is also measured in units like seconds, minutes, and hours.
Braille\n\nBraille is a way of writing that uses little bumps on paper. Blind people touch the bumps with their fingers to read. A man named Louis Braille made this system a long time ago. Each bump is a dot, and groups of dots stand for letters and numbers. The dots are in a small box with two rows of three dots. Different dots are raised to make different letters. People can write Braille with a special tool that pokes dots into paper. Some Braille books use short forms of words to save space and help people read faster. Braille helps blind people read books and write just like everyone else.
Density\n\nDensity is how much stuff is packed into something. If a thing has a lot of stuff in a small space, it has high density. If it has only a little stuff in the same space, it has low density. For example, a rock is denser than a sponge. You can change density by heating or pressing something. When water freezes into ice, it gets bigger and less dense, so ice floats. People also talk about population density, which is how many people live in a place. A city has high population density because many people live close together.
Pangolin\n\nA pangolin is an animal that lives in Africa and Asia. It has hard scales all over its body, like a pine cone. Pangolins eat ants and termites with their long tongues. When they are scared, they curl up into a ball. Their scales are sharp and protect them. Baby pangolins are born with soft scales that get hard after two days. Pangolins walk on their back legs and use their tail to balance. Some people hunt pangolins for their scales and meat, so there are not many left.
Immune system\n\nYour immune system is like a team of helpers inside your body. It fights off germs that can make you sick, like viruses and bacteria. Your skin is the first shield—it keeps most germs out. If a germ gets in through a cut, special cells called phagocytes eat it up. Your body also makes antibodies to remember the germ, so next time it can fight it faster. That is why shots (vaccines) help you stay healthy. Sometimes the immune system gets confused and attacks your own body, which is called an autoimmune disease.
Dance\n\nDance is when people move their bodies to music. You can dance alone or with a group. People dance to feel happy, to tell a story, or just for fun. There are many kinds of dance, like ballet, hip hop, and tap. Some dances are done by one person, some by a couple, and some by a big group. People have been dancing for a very long time, even thousands of years ago. You can learn to dance at a dance school. Dancing is good exercise and helps you stay healthy.
Tapestry\n\nA tapestry is a big piece of art made with threads. People weave the threads together by hand on a special frame. The threads that go up and down are hidden, so you only see the colorful threads that make a picture. Most tapestries are made with wool or cotton. Long ago, kings and rich people used tapestries to cover the cold stone walls of their castles. They could roll them up and take them to another house. Some tapestries were hung in churches on special days. The famous Bayeux tapestry is not really a tapestry, but a decorated cloth made in England.
Mozambique\n\nMozambique is a country in Africa. It is next to the ocean. The capital city is Maputo. Many people live there, about 31 million. The people speak Portuguese. Mozambique was ruled by Portugal for a long time, but it became its own country in 1975. The weather is warm, with a rainy season and a dry season. There are big rivers and lakes. People like to play football. They also make music with drums and a wooden instrument called a marimba. Some people carve wood into statues and masks. The food includes things like cassava, cashew nuts, and chicken with spicy sauce.
Hydrogen\n\nHydrogen is the lightest thing in the whole universe. It is a gas that you cannot see, smell, or taste. Hydrogen is very easy to burn. When it burns with oxygen, it makes water. That is how its name came from a word that means "water-maker." Most of the stars, including our Sun, are made of hydrogen. On Earth, hydrogen is mostly found in water. Every water drop has hydrogen inside it. Hydrogen is also in your body, in food, and in many things around you. People use hydrogen to make rocket fuel and to make electricity in special machines called fuel cells. Hydrogen can be dangerous because it can explode if it gets too hot or if it mixes with air.
Dishwasher\n\nA dishwasher is a machine that cleans dirty plates, cups, and forks. You put the dirty dishes inside, close the door, and push a button. The machine sprays hot water and soap all over the dishes to make them clean. A long time ago, people had to wash dishes by hand with a sponge. The first dishwasher was made of wood and had a handle you turned by hand. Later, a woman named Josephine Cochrane made a better dishwasher to keep her pretty plates from breaking. Now many homes have a dishwasher to help with the cleaning.
Moose\n\nA moose is a very big animal that looks like a deer. It has long legs, a big nose, and dark brown fur. A boy moose is called a bull, a girl moose is called a cow, and a baby moose is called a calf. Moose live in cold places like Canada, Alaska, and northern Europe. They like to be near lakes and forests. Moose eat grass, leaves, and twigs from trees. They are awake during the day and usually live alone. In winter, they sometimes stay in small groups. A mother moose takes care of her baby for one year. Moose can live to be fifteen years old. They are very strong and can run fast. People need to be careful driving cars because moose are hard to see at night.
Creation myth\n\nA creation myth is a story that tells how the world and people began. Many different groups of people have their own creation myths. In one story from the Cherokee people, at first there was only water. A water beetle went down and brought up mud, and the mud grew into the Earth. In another story from the Apache people, a small man called the Creator made light and then made the Earth from a small brown ball. In the Judeo-Christian-Islamic story, a being called God made the universe in six days. Some people believe the world is very old, and others believe it is only a few thousand years old. There are many other kinds of creation myths too. Some say the world came from an egg, or from a god or goddess, or from a man and a woman god. Others say the world was made from the body of a dead god. All these stories try to answer the question of how everything started.
Rattlesnake\n\nA rattlesnake is a kind of snake that lives in dry places in North and South America. It has a special tail with parts that make a loud buzzing sound when it shakes. This sound warns other animals to stay away. Rattlesnakes have a venomous bite that can hurt other animals. They use special pits on their heads to feel heat from other animals, even in the dark. They eat small animals like birds and mice. Baby rattlesnakes are often eaten by birds. Big rattlesnakes have to watch out for kingsnakes, which can eat them.
Primary school\n\nA primary school is a place where children go to learn. It is for kids who are about five to eleven years old. After preschool, children start primary school. They learn to read, write, and do math. They also learn about nature, their body, and how to ride a bike safely. In some countries, children eat a free lunch at school. When they finish primary school, they go to a bigger school called secondary school.
Carriage\n\nA carriage is a kind of vehicle that people used before cars were made. It has four wheels and is pulled by horses. Some carriages are very fancy and used for weddings.
Machine\n\nA machine is something people make to help them do work. Some machines have moving parts, like a bicycle or a clock. Some machines do not have moving parts, like a computer or a telephone. People have used machines for a very long time. A machine can change one kind of energy into another kind. There are six simple machines, like a lever or a wheel. A compound machine is made of two or more simple machines.
Kathmandu\n\nKathmandu is a big city in a country called Nepal. It is the most important city in Nepal, where the country's leaders work. Many people live there, more than eight hundred thousand. Kathmandu has many old temples and palaces that people visit. The weather is warm in summer and cool in winter. Sometimes it rains a lot in summer. The city is high up on a mountain, so the air is cool. People in Kathmandu like to visit the temples and pray. There is also a place where people learn to sit quietly and think.
Lyre\n\nA lyre is a musical instrument that looks a bit like a harp and a guitar. You hold it in one hand and pluck the strings with the other hand. It has two arms and a bar across the top, with strings that go from the bar down to a box that makes the sound. People played the lyre a very long time ago, over 4,500 years ago, in places like Egypt and Greece. They used it to make music for songs, poems, and dancing. The strings are made of different things, and when you pluck them, the sound is soft and pretty.
Sponge (tool)\n\nA sponge is a tool you use for cleaning. It has many tiny holes. When you rub a sponge on a dirty thing, the dirt comes off. Some sponges are made by people. Some sponges come from the sea. Sponges from the sea are found in the Mediterranean and the Caribbean. Dolphins in Australia use sponges to help them find food.
Fahrenheit\n\nFahrenheit is a way to measure how hot or cold something is. It uses a little circle and the letter F. A German man named Daniel Gabriel Fahrenheit made it a long time ago. Today, people in the United States still use Fahrenheit to tell the temperature outside. Most other places use a different way called Celsius. Fahrenheit is an old way to measure temperature.
Hubble Space Telescope\n\nThe Hubble Space Telescope is a big camera that floats in space. It takes pictures of stars and planets far, far away. Hubble is as big as a school bus. It moves very fast, 5 miles every second. Hubble can see better than telescopes on the ground because it is above the air. The air makes stars look blurry from Earth. When Hubble first took pictures, they were blurry because its mirror was a little bit wrong. Astronauts went up in a space shuttle to fix it. They put small mirrors inside to make the pictures clear again. Hubble has been fixed five times. Now a new telescope called James Webb takes even better pictures.
Valley of the Kings\n\nThe Valley of the Kings is a place in Egypt where very old kings were buried. It is a valley next to a river called the Nile. Long ago, people dug big holes in the ground to put the kings' bodies inside. The valley is very famous, and people from all over the world go to see it. It almost never rains there, but sometimes a big flood comes and fills the tombs with mud.
Jewel\n\nA jewel is a pretty stone that comes from the ground. Jewels can be many colors like red, blue, green, or clear. They start out as rough rocks, but people cut and polish them to make them shiny and smooth. Jewels are hard and rare, which makes them special. People use jewels to make pretty things like rings and necklaces. Some jewels are called diamonds, rubies, sapphires, and emeralds.
Liberia\n\nLiberia is a small country in West Africa, on the coast of the Atlantic Ocean. It has borders with Sierra Leone, Guinea, and Ivory Coast. The capital city is Monrovia. About 5 million people live in Liberia. Most of the land is covered with rainforest. There are also low mountains and swamps near the coast. The name Liberia means "Land of the Free" in Latin. The country became free on July 26, 1847. Many people speak English there. In the past, two big wars hurt the country. Today, people work on rubber tree plantations and try to protect the rainforest.
Competition\n\nA competition is when people get together to see who is the best at something. The people who take part are called competitors. They try to do better than each other. The winner may get a prize, like a trophy or money. Competitions can be for many things, like sports, music, dancing, or science. Sometimes a referee makes sure everyone follows the rules.
Video camera\n\nA video camera is a tool that takes moving pictures and sound. It can show what is happening right now or save it to watch later. Long ago, video cameras were big and cost a lot of money. Only grown-ups who worked on TV used them. Now video cameras are small and cheap. Many phones have a video camera inside. People use video cameras to make movies, record fun times, and help catch cars that do not pay on some roads.
Milky Way\n\nThe Milky Way is our home in space. It is a huge group of stars, and our Sun is one of them. At night, you can see the Milky Way as a soft, milky band of light across the sky. The Milky Way has a flat part called a disk, a bumpy middle part called a bulge, and a big round part around it called a halo. It is not perfectly flat—it is a little bit twisted. The Milky Way has many, many stars—maybe 400 billion! That is a lot of stars. Our Sun and all the planets, including Earth, are inside the Milky Way. The Milky Way is part of a group of galaxies called the Local Group. It is one of the biggest galaxies in that group. A long time ago, a Greek story said the Milky Way was made from milk that spilled from a goddess.
Tower\n\nA tower is a very tall thing that people build. Towers are different from houses because people do not live inside them. Long ago, castles had towers. Today, towers can be used to send messages through the air, to look far away, or to help hold up a bridge.
The Blue Marble\n\nThe Blue Marble is a picture of the Earth taken from far away in space. It was taken by astronauts on a spaceship going to the Moon. In the picture, the Earth looks like a round blue ball with white swirls. The blue is the water, and the white is the clouds. This picture is very famous and many people have seen it.
Bear\n\nA bear is a big animal with thick fur and a short tail. Bears live in many places around the world, like forests and mountains. They have a big body, short legs, and five claws on each foot that they use for digging and climbing. Bears can stand on their back legs and are good at swimming and climbing trees. Most bears are brown, black, or reddish. They have a very good sense of smell and can see colors. Bears eat plants and meat, like berries, grass, and fish. Some bears sleep all winter, which is called hibernating. Mother bears take care of their babies, called cubs, and teach them how to find food. You might know some bears from stories, like Winnie the Pooh or the Berenstain Bears. There are also teddy bears, which are soft toys that look like bears.
Hyaena\n\nA hyaena is a wild animal that lives in Africa and parts of Asia. It looks a bit like a dog, but it is actually more like a cat. Hyaenas have strong jaws that can crush bones. Their front legs are longer than their back legs, so they walk like a bear. Most hyaenas hunt at night. They are very smart and work together to catch food like zebras and wildebeests. Spotted hyaenas are the bossy ones: the girl hyaenas are in charge, and the boys do what they say. Hyaenas can make a sound that is like laughing.
Eye examination\n\nAn eye examination is a check-up for your eyes. A doctor looks at your eyes to see if you can see clearly. You might look at letters on a big chart. The doctor finds out if you need glasses to help you see better.
Kaaba\n\nThe Kaaba is a very special building in a city called Mecca. It is the holiest place for people who follow Islam. Muslims believe it is the House of God. The Kaaba is a big square building made of blue-gray stone. It is covered with a black cloth that has gold writing on it. Every year, the cloth is changed by many workers. Muslims all over the world face the Kaaba when they pray. Once in their life, many Muslims travel to see the Kaaba. That trip is called a pilgrimage.
Ra\n\nRa is a make-believe sun god from a long time ago in Egypt. People thought he was the most important god. They said he was born every morning in the east and died every night in the west. At night he traveled through a dark place under the ground. Ra looked like a man with the head of a falcon bird. He had a round sun above his head. Sometimes he looked like a beetle or a ram. People called him by many names, like Amun-Ra.
Extended family\n\nAn extended family is a big family that has more people than just a mom, a dad, and kids. It also includes aunts, uncles, and cousins. Sometimes grandparents live with the family too. In an extended family, many people live together or near each other. They help take care of each other.
Diaper\n\nA diaper is a piece of clothing that people wear when they cannot control their pee or poop. Babies wear diapers until they learn to use the toilet. Some older people or sick people also wear diapers. Diapers can be made of cloth that you wash and use again, or they can be made of plastic and thrown away after one use. In some countries, a diaper is called a nappy.
Yellow River\n\nThe Yellow River is a very long river in China. It is the second longest river in that country. The river is so long that it is one of the longest rivers in the whole world. The water from the river flows into the sea. People in China call it the "Mother River" because it helped their country grow. A long time ago, people built homes and farms near the river. The river has a yellow color because it carries lots of dirt and sand.
Vacuum\n\nA vacuum is a place with no air inside. Sound cannot travel in a vacuum because there is no air to carry the sound. Even in outer space, there is a little bit of air, but not much. Machines called vacuum pumps can take most of the air out of a box called a vacuum chamber. Scientists use vacuum chambers for experiments where air would get in the way.
Mollusc\n\nMolluscs are animals that live mostly in the ocean. Some live in fresh water or on land. Many molluscs have a hard shell on their body, but some do not. Octopuses, squid, and snails are all molluscs. Snails and slugs are the most common kind. Molluscs have a soft body and a strong foot that helps them move. They eat by scraping food with a special tongue. Some molluscs can be dangerous. The blue-ringed octopus has a bite that can hurt people. Some snails can make people sick. But most molluscs are safe and fun to look at.
Song\n\nA song is a piece of music with words. People who write songs are called songwriters. Some songs are very old and have been sung for a long time. When two people sing together, it is called a duet. When three people sing together, it is called a trio. Sometimes people change the words of a song to make it funny. That is called a parody. A song without words is called an instrumental.
Weasel\n\nA weasel is a small animal with a long, skinny body and short legs. It has brown or red fur on top and white fur on its belly. Its tail is short. Weasels live in many places around the world, but not in Antarctica or Australia. They are very good at hunting and can squeeze into small holes to catch rabbits. Even though a weasel looks a little like a cat, it is actually more like a dog.
Crayfish\n\nA crayfish is a small animal that lives in water. It looks like a tiny lobster and has a hard shell. Crayfish live in rivers, streams, ponds, and swamps. They have ten legs and two claws. Some crayfish dig holes in the ground to find water. They eat plants, bugs, worms, and small fish. Crayfish are most active at night. People sometimes keep them as pets in a fish tank. You can also call them crawfish.
Sense of smell\n\nYour sense of smell helps you notice things in the air. It starts in your nose. When you breathe in, tiny bits of smell go into your nose. Special cells inside your nose catch these bits and send messages to your brain. Your brain figures out what the smell is. Smell helps you enjoy food. When you eat, the smell of the food goes up your nose and helps you taste it. That is why food tastes plain when your nose is stuffy. Smell can also keep you safe. It warns you about smoke, gas, or bad food. Some smells bring back memories, like the smell of cookies or flowers. Different people smell things in different ways. Some people smell very well, and others do not. Your sense of smell can change as you get older or when you are sick. Animals use smell too. Dogs have a very strong sense of smell. They can find people or food by following smells. Insects use their feelers to smell. Ants leave smell trails for other ants to follow. Fish can smell underwater. Smell is one of the five main senses.
Peasant\n\nA peasant is a person who worked on a farm for other people and did not have much money. They wore rough clothes and lived in small houses. Most peasants could not read or write. They worked all the time, except sometimes on Sundays and after the harvest. Men, women, and children all helped with the farm work. Women also cooked, cleaned, made clothes, and took care of children.
Point (geometry)\n\nA point is a tiny spot in space. It has no size, but it has a place. We draw a point as a small dot or a little cross 'X'. Points are named with big letters like A, B, or C. Two points can make a line between them. Points are the building blocks of shapes.
States of matter\n\nEverything around you is made of stuff called matter. Matter can be in different forms called states. The four main states are solid, liquid, gas, and plasma. A solid keeps its own shape, like a rock or a toy. A liquid flows and takes the shape of its container, like water in a cup. A gas spreads out to fill any space, like the air you breathe. Plasma is like a gas but very hot, and it can carry electricity. Lightning is plasma. Stars, including our Sun, are made of plasma. You can change matter from one state to another by heating it up or cooling it down. When ice (a solid) gets warm, it melts into water (a liquid). When water gets very hot, it turns into steam (a gas). When steam cools, it turns back into water. That is called condensation.
Java\n\nJava is a big island in Indonesia. It is one of the Sunda Islands. Many people live there, more than on any other island in the world. The capital city of Indonesia, Jakarta, is on Java. The island has tall mountains that are volcanoes. The ground is good for growing food because of the volcanoes. Most people on Java speak Javanese and follow the religion of Islam.
Parliament\n\nA parliament is a group of people who talk and make rules for a country. The word 'parliament' comes from a French word that means 'a talk'. In a parliament, people called members meet to decide new laws. The leader of the parliament is called the Prime Minister. The parliament can ask the Prime Minister to leave if they think he is not doing a good job. Some parliaments have two parts: one that makes the laws and one that checks the laws. The oldest parliament in the world is in Iceland, and it started a very long time ago.
Mahjong\n\nMahjong is a game with special tiles that people play on a square table. It was made in China. Four people play together. Each player sits on one side of the table, and they are called by the direction they face: East, South, West, or North. The game is about skill and luck. There is also a one-player version called Mahjong Solitaire. In that game, you take away matching tiles from a big pile shaped like a pyramid. You win when you take away all the tiles.
Alchemy\n\nAlchemy is a very old kind of science. People called alchemists tried to change plain metals like lead into gold. They also looked for a special stone that could make sick people better. Alchemists thought that magic and stars were connected to metals. Later, scientists learned to study things by doing experiments. Now we call that science chemistry.
Asteroid\n\nAn asteroid is a small rock that goes around the Sun. It is like a tiny planet but much smaller. Some asteroids are as small as a car, and some are very big. Most asteroids live in a big ring between Mars and Jupiter. They are leftover pieces from when the Solar System was made. Some asteroids are made of metal, some are made of stone, and some are made of carbon. Asteroids do not make their own light. They look like little stars in the sky, but they move around the Sun. A few asteroids have their own tiny moon. Sometimes an asteroid comes close to Earth. Long ago, a big asteroid may have hit Earth and killed the dinosaurs. In 2025, scientists found special stuff on an asteroid called Bennu, including the building blocks of life.
Gulf of Guinea\n\nThe Gulf of Guinea is a big part of the ocean near West Africa. It is warm and sits where the middle line of the Earth meets another line. Many rivers, like the Niger and the Volta, pour water into it. There are islands in the gulf, like Bioko and So Tom and Prncipe. Some islands have volcanoes. People live on some of these islands.
Sentence\n\nA sentence is a group of words that tell you something. It is a whole idea. A sentence has a naming part and a doing part. For example, "The dog runs." The first word of a sentence starts with a big letter. At the end, there is a dot, a question mark, or an exclamation mark. Some sentences tell you something, some ask a question, and some show strong feeling.
Pipeline\n\nA pipeline is a very long tube made of metal. It carries water, gas, or oil from one place to another far away. Some pipelines carry mud mixed with rocks. Building a pipeline costs a lot of money, but using it is cheap. Big sports places have pipelines that bring beer from a big tank to the bars.
Mumbai\n\nMumbai is a big city in India, next to the ocean. It is the biggest city in India and one of the biggest in the world. Many people live there, more than 13 million. Mumbai is where many rich people live and where big companies have their offices. It is also where Bollywood movies are made. The city has trains and buses to help people get around. Long ago, Mumbai was made of seven small islands where fishermen lived. Later, people from other countries came and built a big trading town. Today, Mumbai is a busy place with lots of shops, buildings, and people.
Equilibrium\n\nEquilibrium is when everything is balanced and nothing changes. Imagine a seesaw with two kids sitting on it. If both kids weigh the same, the seesaw stays still. That is like equilibrium. In science, equilibrium can happen with chemicals. When chemicals mix and finish changing, they stop moving around. The amount of each chemical stays the same. Sometimes a reaction can go both ways, like a door that swings forward and backward. If you push the door harder on one side, it swings more that way. Scientists use rules to guess which way the door will swing.
Go (board game)\n\nGo is a board game for two people. Players take turns putting black or white stones on a board with lines. The board has 19 lines going one way and 19 lines going the other way. The player with black stones goes first. The goal is to surround more empty spaces than the other player. If a stone has no empty space next to it, it is taken off the board. The game ends when both players say they are done. Go is very old and was first played in China a long time ago. Many people play it in Japan, Korea, and China. You can also play Go on a computer or at a club.
Imam\n\nAn imam is a leader in the Muslim religion. The imam leads prayers at a special building called a mosque. People in the community can ask the imam questions about their religion. In some groups, the imam is the most important leader of all the people who follow that faith.
Cuneiform\n\nCuneiform is a very old way of writing. People long ago made marks that look like little wedges on soft clay. They used a special stick to press the marks into the clay. Then they let the clay dry in the sun to make it hard. This writing was used in a place called Sumer a very long time ago. At first, the marks were pictures of things. Later, the pictures got simpler. People used cuneiform to write about their lives, their stories, and their rules. After many years, people stopped using cuneiform and forgot how to read it. Then, not too long ago, smart people figured out how to read it again.
Choir (music)\n\nA choir is a group of people who sing together. They practice with a leader and sing at concerts or in church. Some choirs are for grown-ups who get paid, and some are for anyone who wants to join. The singers are split into groups by how high or low their voice is. The highest voice is called soprano, then alto, then tenor, and the lowest is bass. Children's choirs often sing all the same notes, but older kids can sing different parts. The word "choir" can also mean the part of a church where the singers sit, between the main room and the altar. Some choirs are very famous and sing for many people.
Warehouse\n\nA warehouse is a big building where things are kept. It is like a giant storage room. Trucks bring boxes and goods to the warehouse. The boxes are stacked high on shelves. Workers use special machines called forklifts to move heavy boxes around. Warehouses are often in places where many trucks and trains come and go.
Literature\n\nLiterature is stories and poems made with words. Some are written in books, and some are told by talking. There are many kinds of literature, like poems, plays, and novels. Long ago, people told very long stories about heroes and adventures. Those are called epic poems. Some famous ones are the Iliad and the Odyssey. People still read and enjoy literature today.
Attention\n\nAttention is when you look at something and think about it. It is like pointing your eyes and your mind at one thing at a time. When you pay attention, you can learn new things and play games better.
Peccary\n\nA peccary is an animal that looks like a pig. It lives in Central and South America. Peccaries have a strong smell and can tell each other apart by that smell. They live in groups called squadrons, with six to nine animals in each group. Peccaries eat roots, bugs, and many other foods. Some people keep them as pets or raise them for food.
Hummingbird\n\nA hummingbird is a very small bird. It can fly in one place without moving, like a tiny helicopter. Its wings move so fast they make a humming sound. Hummingbirds can also fly backward, which most birds cannot do. They drink sweet water from flowers called nectar. They like red flowers best. When they drink, their head gets covered in yellow dust called pollen. This helps flowers make new seeds. Hummingbirds eat tiny bugs and spiders too. They sit still most of the day to rest and digest their food.
Airship\n\nAn airship is a big thing that floats in the sky like a balloon. It stays up because it is filled with a special gas that is lighter than air. An airship has an engine to move and a way to steer where it goes. A balloon does not have an engine or a way to steer. There are three kinds of airships. Blimps are one kind. They were used long ago to watch for submarines in the ocean. Now blimps are used for advertising and to look down at sports games. The most famous airship was called the "Hindenburg." It was very big and could carry many people. One day, when it was landing, it caught fire. The fire hurt many people.
Quinoa\n\nQuinoa is a small seed that people eat like rice. It is not a real grain, but it comes from a plant that is like spinach and beets. Quinoa is very healthy and has lots of good stuff for your body. Some people call it a superfood. You can cook quinoa and eat it for breakfast, lunch, or dinner. It tastes a little bit like nuts.
Wall\n\nA wall is a flat, tall part of a building that goes straight up. Walls hold up the roof and keep the inside rooms apart. They also keep the weather and bad things outside. Most walls are made of stone or brick. Some walls are inside a house and just make rooms. Other walls are outside and protect the whole building. Long ago, cities had big walls all around them to keep people safe. Today, most of those walls are gone.
Law\n\nLaw is a set of rules that tell people how to behave. The rules help keep everyone safe and peaceful. If someone breaks a law, they might have to pay money or go to jail. Long ago, kings wrote the rules. Today, people vote for leaders who make the rules. Police officers make sure people follow the law. Lawyers are people who know a lot about the law and help others in court. Judges decide if someone broke a law. Some laws come from religion, like the Ten Commandments. Laws can be changed if people think they are not fair.
Bandung\n\nBandung is a big city in Indonesia. It is the capital of a place called West Java. Many people live there, more than two million. Bandung is called the "City of Flowers" because lots of pretty flowers and trees grow there. A long time ago, many countries had a big meeting in Bandung to talk about being free. The city is also known for its nice views.
Finance\n\nFinance is about money. It is how people, businesses, and groups make and use money. Some people save money in a bank. A bank takes money from people who save and lends it to people who need money. Businesses use money to make things and sell them. They try to make more money than they spend. People also use money for things they need and want. Finance helps everyone decide how to use money wisely.
Scallop\n\nA scallop is a sea animal with a hard shell that looks like a fan. It lives in the ocean all over the world. The shell has two parts that open and close. Scallops can swim by clapping their shells together fast. This helps them get away from animals that want to eat them, like starfish. Scallops have many tiny eyes around the edge of their shell. These eyes can see light and moving things. Most scallops eat tiny plants and animals from the water. People like to eat scallops. The white part is the muscle that helps them swim. The orange or white part is the roe. Scallops can be cooked in butter or fried. Some scallops live a short time, and some can live for 20 years or more.
Drilling\n\nDrilling is making a hole in something hard. People drill into rock, dirt, metal, and wood. They use special tools to make the hole. Long ago, people used sticks and stones to drill. Later, they made a tool called a bow drill. It had a rope around a stick to make drilling easier. Today, drilling helps build houses, get oil from the ground, and make things in factories.
Square\n\nA square is a shape with four sides that are all the same length. It has four corners, and each corner makes a straight angle like the corner of a book. A square looks the same when you turn it around. You can see squares on a checkerboard or on a window. A square is also the flat side of a cube.
Onion\n\nAn onion is a plant that people eat as a vegetable. It has a round bulb that grows under the ground. Onions have a strong taste and a very strong smell. When you cut an onion, it can make your eyes sting and water. That happens because tiny bits from the onion float up to your eyes. You can put the onion in cold water or wear goggles to stop the sting. People have been eating onions for a very long time, maybe since Ancient Egypt. You can eat onions raw, cooked, or fried. They are used in many foods around the world.
Millipede\n\nA millipede is a very long bug with many legs. Its body is made of many parts, and each part has two pairs of legs. Millipedes live under rocks, leaves, and in dark, wet places in forests. They eat old leaves and dead plants. When scared, they curl up into a tight circle to protect themselves. Some millipedes can spray a bad-smelling liquid to keep enemies away. Millipedes do not bite people, but their spray can hurt your skin or eyes. They are slow and gentle creatures.
Denver\n\nDenver is a big city in the middle of the United States. It is the capital of the state of Colorado. Denver sits right next to the Rocky Mountains, which are very tall and rocky. The city is called the "Mile High City" because it is one mile above the ground. That is very high up! The top of the big government building in Denver is covered in shiny gold. Denver has many sports teams. People there love to watch football, basketball, baseball, hockey, and soccer.
Nobel Prize\n\nThe Nobel Prize is a big award given every year to people who do great things. It was started by a man named Alfred Nobel a long time ago. The prizes are for science, books, medicine, and helping the world be peaceful. People who get a Nobel Prize are called Nobel laureates. Each winner gets a gold medal, a paper, and some money. The prizes are given out in a city called Stockholm on December 10 every year.
Holiday\n\nA holiday is a special day when people do not go to work or school. Many holidays happen every year. Some holidays are for fun, and some are for remembering important things. People often spend holidays with their family and friends. They might eat good food, play games, or give presents. Some holidays come from old stories about gods or saints. In some places, the word holiday also means a trip away from home.
Kuwait City\n\nKuwait City is a big city by the water. It is the capital of Kuwait, which means it is the most important city in that country. Many people live there. The city has very hot summers and not much rain. Sometimes dust storms blow through. A long time ago, some soldiers came and broke many buildings. Now the city is fixed and people live and work there again.
Metamorphosis\n\nMetamorphosis is how some animals change their bodies as they grow up. A caterpillar turns into a butterfly. A tadpole turns into a frog. First, the animal is a baby that looks very different. Then it changes into a grown-up. Some insects start as eggs, then become larvae that look like worms, then pupae that rest, and finally adults with wings. Other insects just grow bigger and get wings later. Frogs start as eggs in water, then hatch into tadpoles with tails, and later grow legs and lose their tails to become frogs.
Particle\n\nA particle is a very tiny piece of stuff. Everything in the whole world is made of particles. Some particles are so small you cannot see them, even with a strong magnifying glass. Atoms are tiny particles. Inside atoms there are even smaller particles called protons, neutrons, and electrons. Protons and neutrons are in the middle of the atom. Electrons go around the outside. Protons and neutrons are made of even smaller things called quarks. There are six kinds of quarks. Some particles are bigger than atoms, like dust or powder. You can see dust floating in the air when the sun shines in.
Musical genre\n\nA musical genre is a way to talk about different kinds of music. Some music is fast and loud, like rock. Some music is slow and soft, like lullabies. There is also music for dancing, music for church, and music that tells a story. People like different genres, and that is okay.
Heredity\n\nHeredity is how parents pass things to their children. You get your hair color, eye color, and how tall you will be from your mom and dad. That is why you might look like your family. Some things are born in you, like the shape of your nose or the color of your skin. Scientists study heredity by looking at families and twins.
Paper\n\nPaper is a thin, flat material that people use to write on. It is made from tiny wood fibers that are pressed together. You can write on paper with a pencil or a pen. Books, magazines, and newspapers are made of paper. Paper can also soak up water, so people use it to clean things. Some paper is used for money, and some is used to wrap presents. There are many kinds of paper, like copy paper and craft paper. Paper can be made from old paper too; that is called recycling.
Cooling tower\n\nA cooling tower is a very tall building that helps machines stay cool. It looks like a big chimney with a wide top. Inside, water or air takes away the heat from the machines. You can see cooling towers at power plants that make electricity. They are the tallest part of the plant and let out white steam that is not dangerous.
Shrew\n\nA shrew is a very small animal that looks a bit like a mouse, but it is not a mouse. Shrews have long noses and sharp teeth. They live almost everywhere in the world, except in Australia, New Guinea, and New Zealand. Most shrews are no bigger than a mouse. The smallest shrew is the Etruscan shrew, which is only as long as your finger and very light. Shrews live on the ground and look for seeds, bugs, and worms to eat. They have small eyes and cannot see well, but they have good ears and a good nose. Shrews are very active and eat a lot—almost all their own weight in food every day. They do not sleep through winter, but they can get very small and slow down. Shrews are very bossy about their home and do not like other shrews nearby.
Recreation\n\nRecreation is time when you rest your body and mind and have fun. There are many ways to have fun, like reading a book, playing music, watching a movie, gardening, playing sports, or going on a trip. Parks and beaches are good places for fun. Some people travel to new places just to have fun there.
Oboe\n\nAn oboe is a musical instrument that you blow into to make sounds. It is long and thin, and it has a special part called a reed at the top. The reed is made of two thin pieces that shake together when you blow. This makes the sound. The oboe looks a little like a clarinet, but it sounds different. It has four parts: the bell, the lower joint, the upper joint, and the reed. A person who plays the oboe is called an oboist. You can see oboes in orchestras, where two to four people play them. One of them might also play a bigger oboe called the cor anglais. Before a concert, the main oboist plays a note called A for everyone else to tune their instruments.
Exploration\n\nExploration is when people go to new places to learn about them. People explore even when they have everything they need. Long ago, explorers sailed big ships to find new lands. They discovered new people and animals. Some explorers went to space. People also explore ideas and art. Exploring helps us learn new things.
Soft drink\n\nA soft drink is a drink that has bubbles in it. People also call it soda or pop. It is made with water, sugar, and flavor. The bubbles come from a gas that is added to the drink. Some soft drinks taste like lemon, orange, or cola. Many children like soft drinks, but they have a lot of sugar and are not good for your body.
Chimpanzee\n\nA chimpanzee is a kind of ape that lives in Africa. It is very smart and looks a lot like a person. Chimpanzees have long arms and no tail. They are covered in dark hair. Their hands and feet look like human hands and feet. Chimpanzees live in groups with many other chimps. They eat fruits, leaves, and sometimes small animals like monkeys. They use sticks and rocks as tools to get food. Chimpanzees can be friendly, but they can also be mean and fight each other. Baby chimps stay with their mothers for many years. Chimpanzees are in danger because people cut down their forests and hunt them.
Landfill\n\nA landfill is a place where trash is put. The trash is buried in the ground. First, people take out things that can be used again. Landfills smell bad and look ugly, so they are far away from houses. The trash is crushed into tiny pieces and then covered with dirt. When trash is buried without air, it makes a gas that can be used to make power.
Publishing\n\nPublishing is when people make books, newspapers, or other things for everyone to read. A publisher is a person or company that makes these things. Sometimes the writer gets money from the publisher, and sometimes the writer pays the publisher. Long ago, publishing was only for paper books and newspapers. Now, people can also publish on the internet. A thing that is published is called a publication. Publications can be books, magazines, or things you read on a computer.
Solar wind\n\nThe solar wind is a stream of tiny bits that come from the Sun. These bits are very small and move very fast. They can travel all the way across our solar system. The solar wind is dangerous for astronauts and spaceships. Earth's magnetic field catches most of the solar wind. This makes the pretty lights in the sky called the Northern Lights and Southern Lights. Sometimes the solar wind gets very strong and causes a solar storm. A big solar storm can make electricity go out on Earth. The solar wind also makes the tail of a comet. When a comet gets close to the Sun, some of its ice turns into gas. The solar wind blows that gas and dust away from the Sun, so the comet's tail always points away from the Sun.
Grimms' Fairy Tales\n\nGrimms' Fairy Tales is a big book of stories. Two brothers named Jacob and Wilhelm Grimm wrote it a long time ago. The book has many famous stories like Snow White, Hansel and Gretel, and Rumpelstiltskin. The stories have kings, queens, witches, and talking animals. Some stories are scary, but the good people always win in the end. Many children love to hear these tales before bed.
Mammal\n\nA mammal is an animal that has fur or hair on its body. Most mammals give birth to live babies, not eggs. All mammal mothers make milk for their babies to drink. Mammals take care of their babies for a long time. Mammals live in many places: on land, in water, and in the air. Some mammals, like bats, can fly. Some mammals, like whales and dolphins, live in the ocean. Many mammals have four legs and a tail. Mammals can be very small, like a mouse, or very big, like an elephant. Mammals are warm-blooded, which means their body stays the same temperature even when it is cold outside.
Botswana\n\nBotswana is a country in Africa. It is in the southern part of Africa. The capital city is Gaborone. Botswana is very dry and has a big desert called the Kalahari Desert. There is also a special place called the Okavango Delta where water and animals are found. People from Botswana are called Batswana. They speak two languages: Setswana and English. Botswana has a lot of diamonds, which are sparkly stones used in jewelry. Many people visit Botswana to see wild animals like elephants and lions. The money in Botswana is called the pula, which means rain.
Harp\n\nA harp is a musical instrument. It is big and shaped like a triangle. The harp has many strings. You pluck the strings with your fingers to make sounds. Each string makes a different note. The strings are tied to a wooden frame. The frame must be very strong so the strings do not break it. Some harps are small and can be held. Other harps are very tall and stand on the floor. People play harps in orchestras. Some people draw angels playing harps in Heaven.
Prejudice\n\nPrejudice is when someone decides they do not like another person before they even know them. They might not like someone because of the color of their skin, or because of their religion, or where they come from. This is not fair. It is important to keep an open mind and treat everyone kindly, just like a judge in a court who must be fair to everyone.
Food\n\nFood is what people, animals, and plants eat to live. It gives us energy to run, play, and grow. Food comes from animals and plants. It has things like protein, fat, and vitamins that keep us healthy. People get food from farms or gardens. Some food is cooked at home in a kitchen. People use pots and pans to cook. Food can also be bought at a store or restaurant. Different countries have different kinds of food. Eating too much or too little food can make people sick. Some people do not eat meat because of their beliefs.
Equestrianism\n\nEquestrianism is the sport of riding horses. People ride horses in many different contests. Some riders jump over fences on horses. Some riders make horses walk and trot in pretty patterns. Some riders race horses very fast. Other riders ride horses just for fun on trails in the woods. Horses that do jumping are often big and strong. Riders wear special clothes like tight pants and a hat. Riding a horse takes a lot of practice.
Basketball\n\nBasketball is a game where two teams try to throw a ball through a hoop. Each team has five players on the court. The hoop is high up on a backboard. Players bounce the ball, pass it to friends, and shoot it at the hoop. A basket is worth two points, or three points if shot from far away. The team with more points at the end wins. The game was invented by James Naismith in 1891. He used a peach basket as the first hoop. Now basketball is played all over the world.
Sea cucumber\n\nA sea cucumber is an animal that lives on the floor of the ocean. It has a long, soft body and leathery skin. Sea cucumbers eat tiny bits of food they find on the ocean floor. They can make their body soft to squeeze through small spaces, then hard again to stay safe. Some sea cucumbers shoot sticky threads to protect themselves from animals that want to eat them. People in China eat sea cucumbers as food.
Mimosa\n\nMimosa is a kind of plant. There are many types of mimosa, and they grow in warm places. One special mimosa is called the shy plant. When you touch its leaves, they fold up fast. It does this to protect itself. Mimosa has round, fluffy flowers that are made of many tiny flowers together. Some mimosa plants have roots that make a special chemical to keep animals from eating them.
Lyrebird\n\nA lyrebird is a bird that lives on the ground in Australia. It lives in forests, especially rainforests, in the eastern part of Australia. Lyrebirds are very good at copying sounds they hear. They can copy other birds, car alarms, camera clicks, and even chainsaws. The male lyrebird sings and shows off to find a mate. The female builds a messy nest low to the ground and lays one egg. She takes care of the egg and the baby bird all by herself. Lyrebirds can live for a very long time, up to thirty years.
Zombie\n\nA zombie is a made-up monster that looks like a dead person who can walk again. People tell stories about zombies from a place called Haiti. In those stories, a zombie does not have its own thoughts and does what a magic person tells it to do. In movies and books, zombies walk slowly, have rotten skin, and try to eat people's brains. They are not real, but many people like to watch scary movies about them.
Samurai\n\nA samurai was a warrior from Japan, a long time ago. Samurai were very good at fighting and used swords. They believed their swords held their soul. Samurai had to be brave and loyal to their leader. If a samurai lost honor, they would hurt themselves to show they were sorry. Some samurai women also learned to fight with long sticks and short knives to protect their homes. Today, there are no more samurai, but people still remember them.
Arch\n\nAn arch is a curved opening in a building. It can be round like part of a circle or pointy like two circles touching. Arches are used in buildings made of small stones or bricks. The top stone, called the keystone, holds all the other stones up. Arches can be over doors and windows. Many bridges are arch bridges. A row of arches is called an arcade. Arches can also be found in nature, like in cliffs where wind and water wear away the rock.
Gulf of Carpentaria\n\nThe Gulf of Carpentaria is a big, shallow sea in northern Australia. It is surrounded by land on three sides. The water is not very deep, only about as deep as a tall tree. A long time ago, when the earth was colder, this place was dry land. The land around the gulf is flat and low. The weather is hot and wet for half the year, and dry for the other half. During the wet season, many places get flooded. Sometimes big storms called cyclones start here. In the morning, you can see a special long cloud called the Morning Glory. The first person from far away to see this gulf was a Dutch explorer named Willem Janszoon.
Ishmael\n\nIshmael was a boy from a very old story. His father was Abraham and his mother was Hagar. When Ishmael was a baby, he and his mother had to leave home. They walked in the desert with only a little water. When the water was gone, Ishmael got very thirsty. An angel showed Hagar a well, and Ishmael drank and got better. Ishmael grew up and had twelve sons and one daughter. After Abraham died, Ishmael helped his brother Isaac bury him.
Dental fillings\n\nA dental filling is something a dentist puts in your tooth to fix a hole. First, the dentist takes out the bad part of the tooth with a special tool. Then, they fill the hole with a special material to make the tooth strong again. This helps your tooth feel better and stay healthy.
Vertebrate\n\nA vertebrate is an animal that has a backbone inside its body. The backbone is made of many small bones called vertebrae. Birds, fish, frogs, snakes, and mammals like dogs and people are all vertebrates. Animals without a backbone, like bugs and worms, are called invertebrates. Vertebrates live almost everywhere on Earth. Some are very big, like elephants and whales. They have a special way to stay healthy and fight germs.
Pizza\n\nPizza is a food that comes from Italy. It is made with a flat piece of bread called a crust. On top of the crust, there is sauce, often made from tomatoes. Then cheese and other toppings are added. Some common toppings are cheese, sausage, pepperoni, vegetables, and herbs. Pizza is cooked in a very hot oven. People all over the world like to eat pizza. You can buy pizza at a store or make it at home. Some pizza places will bring it to your door.
Celsius\n\nCelsius is a way to measure how hot or cold something is. Most countries use Celsius to tell the temperature. Water freezes and turns into ice at 0 degrees Celsius. Water boils and turns into steam at 100 degrees Celsius. A man named Anders Celsius made this scale a long time ago. He was a scientist who studied the sky.
Daikon\n\nDaikon is a white vegetable that grows in the ground. It looks like a big, long carrot but is white. People eat it raw or cooked. It tastes a little spicy but not too strong. Daikon is a kind of radish. You can find it in salads or soups.
Movie theatre\n\nA movie theatre is a big room where people go to watch movies on a giant screen. You sit in a comfy chair and look at the front wall. The movie is shown by a special machine called a projector. You can hear the people talking and the music from speakers on the walls. Some movie theatres have many screens, so you can choose different movies. You can buy popcorn, candy, and drinks at the snack counter. The first movie theatre opened a long time ago in New York City.
Sound\n\nSound is something you hear with your ears. It happens when things shake or move back and forth very fast. When you hit a drum, the drum shakes and makes the air around it shake too. These shakes travel through the air to your ears. Your ears feel the shakes and you hear the sound. Sound can travel through air, water, and even solid things like a wall. It travels fastest through solid things. Sound cannot travel in space because there is no air there. That is why astronauts use radios to talk to each other. Some sounds are high like a tiny bell, and some sounds are low like a big drum. Very loud sounds can hurt your ears. Some animals like bats can hear sounds that people cannot hear.
Father\n\nA father is a man who is a parent. You might call him dad or daddy. Most people have a mother and a father. A father helps take care of his child. He gives food, a home, and love. He plays with his child and teaches them new things. Some fathers are not the one who helped make the child, but they still raise the child like a dad. In many places, fathers are seen as protectors who keep the family safe.
Frost\n\nFrost is ice that looks like white powder. It forms on things outside when the air is very cold. Frost can hurt plants and make them die. A greenhouse can keep plants safe from frost.
Garage\n\nA garage is a place where people keep cars. Some garages are part of a house, and some are separate. A garage has a big door that opens to let cars go in and out. Some garages are big buildings with many floors for lots of cars. Other garages are shops where people fix cars that are broken.
Jealousy\n\nJealousy is a feeling people get when they want what someone else has. It is not a happy feeling. When you feel jealous, you might not like the other person very much. This feeling happens when you think you do not have something that you really want. But jealousy is not a good way to think, because everyone has different things that make them special.
Anime\n\nAnime is a kind of cartoon from Japan. Some anime are drawn by hand, and some are made on a computer. You can watch anime on TV, on a computer, or at the movies. There are many kinds of anime, like stories about sports, magic, or love. Many anime are based on Japanese comic books called manga. People all over the world like to watch anime. Sometimes people dress up as their favorite anime characters at big parties called conventions.
Tyrant flycatcher\n\nA tyrant flycatcher is a kind of bird that lives in North, South, and Central America. There are more than 400 different kinds of these birds. They catch bugs to eat, and some also eat fruit or small animals like frogs. Some tyrant flycatchers are called kingbirds, and they can be very brave and fight to protect their home.
Cinematography\n\nCinematography is how people make movies. A person called a cinematographer uses a special camera to take many pictures very fast. When you watch a movie, the pictures move because they are shown one after another. The camera uses light to make the pictures. Sometimes the pictures are saved on film, and sometimes they are saved as computer files. Movies are made for fun, for learning, and for telling stories.
Sandwich\n\nA sandwich is a food made by putting different foods between two pieces of bread. People often put vegetables, meat, or cheese inside. The sandwich is easy and quick to make. Many children eat sandwiches for lunch at school. You can hold a sandwich in one hand and eat it. Some sandwiches have more than two pieces of bread. A sandwich with one piece of bread is called an open sandwich. A toasted sandwich is made with toast or heated in a special machine. There are many kinds of sandwiches, like a BLT with bacon, lettuce, and tomato.
Sadness\n\nSadness is a feeling. It is the opposite of being happy. You feel sad when something bad happens, like when a pet goes away or a friend moves far away. Sometimes people feel sad in winter because there is less sunshine. That is called SAD. If someone feels very sad for a long time, they might have a sickness called depression. But you can feel happy and sad at the same time, like when you miss someone but are glad to see them again.
Multilingualism\n\nMultilingualism is when someone can speak more than one language. If you can speak two languages, that is called bilingualism. Many people who move to a new country learn the new language and still speak their old one. Speaking more than one language helps people talk to more friends and do many kinds of jobs. Most people learn their first language as a baby. They learn other languages later. Some people can speak many languages, and they are called polyglots. Learning a new language can be hard, but it can also be fun.
Peace\n\nPeace is a time when there are no fights or wars. It is a quiet and calm feeling, like a still pond with no ripples. Many people and groups want peace. Some people work hard to stop fights between countries. Others try to help people feel calm inside. When you feel peaceful, you are not scared or angry. You feel safe and happy. Some people pray or sit quietly to feel peace. Peace is good for everyone.
Air mass\n\nAn air mass is a big bunch of air that is all the same temperature and wetness. It can cover a very large area, like many miles. Some air masses are cold, and some are warm. When a cold air mass meets a warm one, it can make clouds and rain.
Liquid\n\nA liquid is a kind of stuff that can pour and flow. It is not hard like a rock and not floaty like air. A liquid takes the shape of whatever you put it in, like a cup or a bowl. If you pour it, it moves and spreads out. Water is a liquid. So is oil and the red stuff in your body called blood. If you make a liquid very cold, it turns into a solid. If you heat it up, it turns into a gas.
Melody\n\nA melody is a group of sounds that go up and down, one after another, like words in a sentence. It is the part of a song you can hum or sing. Some melodies are easy to sing, and some are hard. People who make music often think of a melody first, then add other sounds to go with it. Sometimes two melodies happen at the same time, like in a round where everyone sings the same tune but starts at different times.
Shot put\n\nShot put is a sport where a person pushes a heavy ball as far as they can. The ball is called a shot. You hold the ball near your neck and push it into the air. You cannot throw it or wear gloves. The sport is played outside on a field. It is in the Olympics. The ball can be heavy, like a big rock. Long ago, people threw stones for fun. Now the ball is made of metal.
High-rise building\n\nA high-rise building is a very tall building. People live or work in them. Some are homes for many families. Others are offices or hotels. Very tall ones are called skyscrapers. They are made of strong materials like steel and concrete. Elevators help people go up and down.
Sandstone\n\nSandstone is a kind of rock made from tiny grains of sand that have been pressed together. Sand is made of very small pieces of rocks and minerals. Sandstone can be hard and is used to make flat stones for walking paths. It often looks red because of iron in it. Sandstone forms when sand piles up in layers, like at a river or in a desert, and then gets squished and glued together over a long time.
Greenland Sea\n\nThe Greenland Sea is a big body of cold water. It sits next to Greenland, Iceland, and some islands far north. The water is very cold, and ice forms on top in winter. Many animals live in and near this sea. Seals and whales swim in the water. Fish like cod and herring live there too. On the land nearby, deer and musk oxen eat plants, and polar bears hunt them. People have hunted seals in this sea for a very long time.
Skate (fish)\n\nA skate is a fish that lives in the ocean. It has a flat body and looks like a stingray, but it is smaller. A skate does not have a stinger on its tail. Instead, its tail is thick and has little bumps along the edges. Skates lay eggs, and the eggs come out of the mother's body. There are many kinds of skates, and they live in water all over the world.
Road\n\nA road is a long piece of land that helps people go from one place to another. Roads are made flat and smooth so cars, buses, and bikes can travel on them easily. Some roads are made of dirt or gravel, and some are made of hard concrete or bricks. People have been building roads for a very long time. Roads help us get to school, the store, or a friend's house. Sometimes many cars use a road at once, and that is called a traffic jam. To fix that, people can make the road wider or build new roads.
Dresden\n\nDresden is a city in Germany, in the southeast part of the country. It sits next to a big river called the Elbe. A long time ago, people lived there even before there were written records. The city was bombed a lot during a big war, and many buildings were broken. After the war, people built them again. In 2002, the river flooded and water covered parts of the city. Dresden has an airport where planes fly to other cities like Frankfurt and London. It also has a big train station with trains that go to other places in Germany and to other countries like the Czech Republic and Austria. The city has many people, about 488,000, and it is an important place for culture and learning.
Aircraft carrier\n\nAn aircraft carrier is a very big ship that carries airplanes and helicopters. It is like a small airport that floats on the ocean. The top part is called the flight deck, where airplanes take off and land. Some airplanes use a hook to grab wires on the deck to stop. Others use a big slingshot to help them take off fast. Many sailors live and work on the ship. Aircraft carriers are used by navies to fight from the sea.
Mali\n\nMali is a country in West Africa. It is surrounded by other countries and has no ocean nearby. The north part of Mali is the Sahara Desert, which is very hot and sandy. The Niger River flows in the south, where most people live. The capital city is Bamako. Long ago, big kingdoms like the Mali Empire ruled this land. The city of Timbuktu was a place where people traded and learned. France took over Mali in 1880, but Mali became free in 1960. Today, Mali is one of the poorest countries. Many people work as farmers or fishers near the river. Some people are nomads who move from place to place. Most people follow the religion of Islam. The main language is French, but many people speak Bamanakan. Famous musicians from Mali play the kora and guitar.
Bacon\n\nBacon is a kind of meat that comes from pigs. It is cut into thin slices and cooked in a pan or on a grill. Bacon has a lot of fat, which makes it taste salty and crunchy. Some people do not eat bacon because of their religion. You can also find bacon made from turkey or chicken, which has less fat.
Deccan Plateau\n\nThe Deccan Plateau is a very big, flat piece of land in South India. It looks like a triangle and is surrounded by mountains on three sides. The mountains on the west are called the Western Ghats, and the ones on the east are called the Eastern Ghats. The plateau covers a lot of India and has many different kinds of forests, animals, and weather. Long, long ago, there were huge volcanoes here that poured out hot lava. The lava cooled into hard rock and made step-like hills. Some scientists think the volcanoes might have helped make the weather change and maybe even helped the dinosaurs go away.
Donkey\n\nA donkey is an animal that people use for work. It has long ears that stand up. Donkeys can be gray, brown, black, or white. They make a loud sound called a bray that goes "EAW EAH." Donkeys eat grass and hay. They should not eat too much or they get fat. A baby donkey is called a foal. Some donkeys have a baby with a horse, and that baby is called a mule.
Magma\n\nMagma is hot, melted rock that is under the ground. It is like liquid rock, and it can have bits of solid rock and gas mixed in. There are different kinds of magma. Some magma is thick and makes light-colored rocks. Other magma is runny and makes dark-colored rocks. When magma stays under the ground and cools slowly, it turns into hard rock like granite. When magma comes out of a volcano, it is called lava. Lava cools fast and makes rocks like basalt. Magma comes from deep inside the Earth, where it is very hot. It can move up through cracks and fill big spaces under the ground. Sometimes it stays there and cools, and sometimes it comes out of a volcano.
Lyon\n\nLyon is a big city in France. It is the third biggest city in the country, after Paris and Marseille. Many people live there. The city sits between two rivers. A long time ago, Lyon was called Lugdunum. The middle part of Lyon is a special place that people from all over the world come to see. Some famous sports teams come from Lyon.
Chili pepper\n\nA chili pepper is a fruit that grows on a plant. It comes from Mexico, but now people grow it all over the world. Some chili peppers are very hot, and some are not. People use them to make food taste spicy. You can eat them fresh, dried, or cooked. The word "chili" can be spelled in different ways, like chili, chilli, or chile.
Floodplain\n\nA floodplain is the flat land next to a river. When the river gets too full and overflows, the water spreads out over this flat land. The water leaves behind soft, rich dirt that helps plants grow very well. That is why farmers like to grow food on floodplains. Sometimes the dirt builds up on the sides of the river and makes the banks higher.
Hydrosphere\n\nThe hydrosphere is all the water on our planet. It includes the big oceans, rivers, and lakes. Water is also in the air and under the ground. The hydrosphere covers most of the Earth. Some people use water from the hydrosphere to make electricity.
Income tax\n\nIncome tax is money that people pay to the government from what they earn. If you have a job, your boss takes a little bit of your pay and gives it to the government. People who own their own business also pay some of their money. The government uses this money to pay for things like schools, roads, and hospitals. Not everyone pays the same amount. People who earn more money pay a bigger part of it. This kind of tax started a long time ago in a country called Great Britain.
Crux\n\nCrux is a group of stars in the sky that looks like a cross. People in the southern part of the world can see it. The four brightest stars make the shape of a cross. Long ago, sailors used these stars to help them find their way across the ocean. Today, the Southern Cross is on the flags of Australia, New Zealand, and other countries.
Vegetable\n\nVegetables are plants that people eat as food. They can be roots, leaves, stems, flowers, or seeds. Carrots and potatoes are roots that we eat. Tomatoes are actually fruits because they have seeds, but people call them vegetables. Vegetables are good for you because they have vitamins that help your body stay healthy. Eating vegetables every day is important. You can eat them raw or cooked. Some vegetables grow in gardens, and farmers grow many vegetables on big farms.
Argument\n\nAn argument is when you tell someone why you think something is true. You give reasons to help them agree with you. A good reason is called a strong argument. A bad reason is called a weak argument. Sometimes people argue to decide what to do.
Haiti\n\nHaiti is a country on an island in the Caribbean Sea. It shares the island with another country called the Dominican Republic. The capital city of Haiti is Port-au-Prince. Many people in Haiti speak French and a language called Haitian Creole. Haiti has a hot and rainy climate. There are many mountains in Haiti. The country used to have lots of forests, but many trees were cut down. Haiti is the poorest country in the Americas. Many people there grow food like mangoes and coffee to eat and sell. A big earthquake hit Haiti in 2010 and caused a lot of damage. Haiti has many holidays, and the biggest one is called Mardi Gras.
Plant reproduction\n\nPlant reproduction is how plants make new plants. Some plants make seeds with help from bees or wind. Other plants can grow a whole new plant from just a piece of the old plant, like a leaf or a stem. People can also help by taking a cutting from a plant and putting it in soil to grow a new one.
Umbrella\n\nAn umbrella is a tool you hold in your hand to keep rain or sun off you. It has a cloth top that opens up like a round roof. The cloth is held up by thin sticks called ribs, and there is a long stick in the middle. You push a button or slide a thing to open it. When you are done, you close it and it gets small to carry. People use umbrellas when it rains or when the sun is very hot. Long ago, umbrellas were used only for shade from the sun. Now they are used for rain too. Some umbrellas are made of cloth that keeps water out. The handle can be made of wood, plastic, or metal. Umbrellas come in many colors and can have pictures on them.
Tilapia\n\nTilapia are fish that live in warm water. People grow them on fish farms for food, and some people keep them in fish tanks at home. They come from Africa, America, India, and Sri Lanka. Tilapia can be a problem because they take over rivers and push out other fish.
Blues\n\nThe blues is a kind of music that started in the United States a long time ago. It began with songs that African American people sang. The first blues songs came from near the Mississippi River. Later, people moved to other cities and made new kinds of blues. One important kind is Chicago Blues, which uses electric guitars. Blues songs often tell about sad or hard times. The music uses a simple pattern of chords and notes. Many other types of music, like rock and roll and country, come from the blues.
Kremlin\n\nA Kremlin is a big, strong castle in Russia. The most famous one is in Moscow, the capital city. It has tall walls and towers. Important people work inside the Kremlin. It is where the government of Russia meets. There is also a special place for leaders who died a long time ago.
New York City\n\nNew York City is a very big city in the United States. It is made of five parts called boroughs: Manhattan, Brooklyn, Queens, the Bronx, and Staten Island. More than 8 million people live there. Many people from all over the world live in New York City, and they speak many different languages. The city has tall buildings called skyscrapers, and a big park called Central Park. There is a big statue called the Statue of Liberty that stands on an island. Many people visit New York City every year to see Times Square, which is a very bright and busy place. The city also has a subway that runs under the ground and takes people to different places.
Oil\n\nOil is a word for many different kinds of liquids. Some oils come from plants, like olive oil and sunflower oil. People use these oils for cooking food. Other oils come from deep under the ground. People drill big holes to get this oil out. The oil is sent in big ships or pipes to factories. There it is made into things like gasoline for cars and fuel for trucks. Some oils help machines move smoothly without getting stuck. Oil is also used to make plastics, medicines, and soap.
Metal\n\nMetal is a kind of stuff that comes from the ground. Many things are made of metal. Most metals are hard and shiny. They feel heavy and make a ringing sound when you hit them. Heat and electricity can go through metal easily. You can bend metal into thin sheets or pull it into long wires. People use metal to make tools, pots, coins, and jewelry. Some metals are gold, silver, copper, and iron. When you mix metals together, you get an alloy like bronze or steel. Metals are very useful for building things like bridges and ships.
