Wave\n\nA wave is a moving wiggle that travels from one place to another. Waves carry energy, like the energy that makes light and sound. Some waves need something to travel through, like air or water. Sound is a wave that travels through air. Ocean waves are waves that move across the water. Other waves, like light, can travel through empty space. Waves help us see and hear things far away.
Machete\n\nA machete is a big knife with a long blade. People use it in jungles to cut through plants and vines. It can open coconuts and cut down small trees. Some machetes have a saw on the back for cutting wood. It is bigger than most knives and can be used for many jobs.
Yoruba religion\n\nYoruba religion is a way of believing from West Africa, mostly from a country called Nigeria. It is the religion of the Yoruba people. In this religion, people think that things in nature, like trees, rivers, stones, and iron, have a spirit inside them. This religion has spread to other places like Cuba and the United States. In Cuba, it is sometimes called 'regla d'ocha,' which means 'the way of the spirits.' Some people who follow this religion also go to a Catholic church.
Seabed\n\nThe seabed is the bottom of the ocean, way down deep under the water. It is like the ground at the bottom of the sea. The seabed is dark and cold because sunlight cannot reach it. Some parts are flat and sandy, and other parts have big mountains and deep valleys. Submarines and divers have gone down to look at the seabed. Many fish and other sea animals live near the seabed.
Dome\n\nA dome is a round roof that looks like the top half of a ball. Some buildings have a dome on top, like temples and palaces. When you talk under a dome, your voice sounds louder. Big sports places with a roof are also called domes.
Landslide\n\nA landslide is when dirt, rocks, or mud slide down a hill or mountain. This happens because of gravity, which pulls things down. Sometimes rain or shaking makes the ground soft and slippery, and then the ground moves very fast. A landslide can happen suddenly and cover roads or houses. Big landslides can even happen on volcanoes.
Hajj\n\nHajj is a special trip that many Muslim people take to a city called Mecca. They go there because it is a very holy place. Muslims believe they should go on this trip at least once in their life if they are healthy and have enough money. During Hajj, people wear simple white clothes and walk around a big black cube-shaped building called the Ka'aba. They also walk between two hills, drink water from a special well, and throw stones at three pillars. After that, they have a big celebration called Eid al-Adha. Many people go to Mecca at the same time, so it is a very big gathering.
Seed\n\nA seed is a tiny part of a plant that can grow into a new plant. Seeds are often hard and very small, but some are big like a coconut. Inside a seed is a baby plant and food for it to eat. Seeds sleep for a while until they get water, air, and warmth. Then they wake up and start to grow into a little plant called a seedling. The seedling uses the food inside the seed until it can make its own food from sunlight. Many seeds are good food for animals and people, like rice, wheat, and corn. Seeds are often found inside fruits.
Bowling\n\nBowling is a game where you roll a heavy ball down a long, smooth floor. The ball has three holes for your fingers and thumb. At the end of the floor are ten big wooden pins standing up. You try to knock all the pins down with the ball. If you knock them all down on your first try, it is called a strike. If you knock them down on your second try, it is called a spare. You get points for each pin you knock down. The highest score you can get is 300. People take turns rolling the ball, and the person with the most points wins. Some bowling alleys have smaller pins called duck pins or candle pins.
Rock climbing\n\nRock climbing is a sport where you use your hands and feet to climb up a big rock or a special wall. It is hard because you need strong arms and legs. Rock climbers wear a special belt called a harness and use long ropes to stay safe. They also use metal clips called carabiners to hold the rope. Some people climb on real rocks outside, and other people climb on fake rocks inside a building.
Pelican\n\nA pelican is a big bird that lives near water. It has a very long beak with a big pouch underneath, like a bag. The pelican uses its pouch to scoop up fish from the water. It tips its head to let the water out, then swallows the fish. Pelicans are usually white or brown. Their beaks and faces can be bright colors when it is time to have babies. Pelicans live in many warm places around the world, but not in very cold places or in the middle of the ocean.
Snow leopard\n\nA snow leopard is a big cat that lives in the cold mountains of central Asia. It has thick gray and white fur with dark spots, and a long tail that helps it balance on rocks. Its big furry feet help it walk on snow without sinking. Snow leopards are very good at hiding and like to hunt at dawn and dusk. They eat animals like mountain sheep and goats. They can live on one sheep for two weeks. Snow leopards live alone and have 2 or 3 babies at a time. People sometimes hunt them for their fur, but many countries protect them.
Artificial intelligence\n\nArtificial intelligence is a computer program or a machine that can learn and think like a person. It can understand things around it, learn from them, and use what it learned to do jobs. AI is used in many ways, like helping phones understand your voice, finding faces in pictures, driving cars by themselves, and playing games like chess. In 1997, a computer named Deep Blue beat the best chess player in the world. In 2011, a computer named Watson won a game show called Jeopardy! In 2016, a computer named AlphaGo beat the best Go player. AI can also help doctors find sicknesses and help people translate languages. Someday, researchers hope to make AI that can think and feel like a person.
Spaceflight\n\nSpaceflight is when a machine made by people flies into outer space. Some spaceflights have people inside, and some do not. The machine that goes into space is called a spacecraft. A big rocket pushes the spacecraft up into the sky. Once in space, the spacecraft can go around Earth or fly to other planets. People on Earth watch the spacecraft and tell it what to do. Some spacecraft come back to Earth with a parachute to land softly. Spaceflight helps us learn about space and send messages around the world.
Weed\n\nA weed is a plant that grows where people do not want it. Some weeds are small and grow in gardens or on the grass. They can be hard to stop once they start growing. People often pull them out because they take space from flowers or food plants. Some weeds are just wild plants that no one planted.
South Asia\n\nSouth Asia is a big part of the world. It is the southern part of Asia. There are eight countries in South Asia. Many people there are farmers. They grow rice, tea, peanuts, and other food. Some people raise cows and sheep. Cows give milk and help carry things. The weather is hot and rainy in some parts. Strong winds called monsoons bring a lot of rain. Sometimes big storms called hurricanes come and break things. The land is very good for growing food.
Cable television\n\nCable television is a way to watch TV shows without using an antenna on the roof. The TV shows come through a special wire that goes into the TV. People have to pay money each month to get cable TV. With cable TV, you can watch many different channels with lots of shows. Some channels are regular TV stations, and others are made just for cable. In many places, only one or two companies bring cable TV to your house.
House\n\nA house is a building where people live. It has walls to keep out wind and cold, and a roof to keep off rain and sun. Houses have windows to let in light and doors to go in and out. A house can be big or small. Some houses are made of wood, brick, or stone. Inside a house there are rooms like a kitchen for cooking, a bedroom for sleeping, and a bathroom for washing. A house is called a home when people live there for a long time.
Seoul\n\nSeoul is the biggest city in South Korea and its capital. It is a very big city with 10 million people living there. Seoul is in the middle of Korea, and a big river called the Han River flows through it. Many important things happen in Seoul, like the 1988 Olympic Games. There are tall buildings like the 63 building and N Seoul Tower, where you can see the whole city. Seoul also has old castles like Gyeongbokgung and a big door called Sungnyemun. People in Seoul love sports, and there are soccer and baseball teams that play in big stadiums.
Knife\n\nA knife is a tool with a sharp metal part that cuts things. People use knives in the kitchen to cut food like bread and vegetables. Hunters and campers also carry knives. Some knives are very old, even older than your grandparents. Knives can be small or big. You must be careful with a knife because it is sharp. In some places, it is not allowed to carry a knife outside.
Scientific law\n\nA scientific law is a rule that tells how something in nature always works. It comes from doing many tests and watching what happens over and over. A law says what happens, but not why it happens. For example, a law can tell how a ball rolls or how planets move. Scientists use laws to guess what will happen next and to make new things. Laws can change if new facts are found.
Green algae\n\nGreen algae are tiny green plants that live in water. You can find them in the ocean, in lakes, and in ponds. Some green algae are so small you need a microscope to see them. They can be one single cell or many cells stuck together like a long string. Green algae are special because they helped make the first plants that grow on land. There are many kinds of green algae, and they come in different shapes and sizes.
Surrealism\n\nSurrealism is a kind of art and writing that started a long time ago. Artists who made surrealist art painted dream-like pictures. They put strange things together, like a clock that melts or a fish with legs. This art was meant to surprise people and make them think about dreams and feelings. Some famous surrealist artists were Salvador Dali and Joan Miro.
Human rights\n\nHuman rights are special rules that say every person should be treated fairly. These rules are for everyone, no matter what color their skin is, what they believe, or where they come from. Long ago, some people started saying that everyone should be able to choose their own religion and leaders. Today, many countries make laws to protect these rights. The United Nations made a list of human rights in 1948. Some rights are: the right to live, the right to be free, and the right to be safe. When someone hurts another person and takes away their rights, that is called a human rights abuse. Some groups, like Amnesty International, work to stop these abuses.
Spin (physics)\n\nSpin is a word scientists use for something very small, like an electron. It is not really spinning like a top. But it acts a little bit like it has a north and south pole, just like a magnet. This helps scientists understand how tiny things work.
Fault (geology)\n\nA fault is a crack in the ground. The ground is made of big pieces of rock called plates. Sometimes the plates move and push against each other. When they move, the ground can shake. That shaking is called an earthquake. A fault can make a cliff or a steep hill where the crack shows on top.
Globalization\n\nGlobalization is when people and countries all over the world start to do things the same way. It means things like toys, food, and movies can travel from one country to another. People can buy things from far away places. Some people like globalization because it helps countries share ideas and make friends. Other people do not like it because they think it helps rich people more than poor people. Sometimes, people in one country lose their jobs when work moves to another country. But some people say it helps poor countries get richer and live better.
Weight loss\n\nWeight loss is when a person weighs less than before. A person can lose weight by running, swimming, or doing other activities. Eating less sugar and more vegetables, fruits, and lean meat also helps. Some people get help from doctors or take special medicine. Not getting enough sleep can make a person eat more, so sleeping well helps with weight loss. Sometimes a person loses weight without trying, which can be a sign of being sick. It is important to eat healthy foods and move your body every day.
Sinhala language\n\nSinhala is a language that people speak in Sri Lanka. Many people there use it to talk to each other. It has two ways: one for talking and one for writing. The talking way is easier to learn. Sinhala has its own special letters that look different from English letters. The words are built by adding small parts to the main word. For example, 'pusa' means kitten, and 'pusath' means kitten also. Sinhala is one of the main languages of Sri Lanka, along with Tamil.
Sewing\n\nSewing is using a needle and thread to put pieces of cloth together. You can sew by hand or with a sewing machine. People sew to make clothes, curtains, sheets, and other things for the house. Some people sew to fix a hole in a shirt or to put on a new button. Sewing can also be used to make pretty pictures on cloth, like in embroidery. When you sew, you push the needle in and out of the cloth, and the thread holds the pieces together.
Sea turtle\n\nA sea turtle is a turtle that lives in the ocean. Sea turtles can be found in all the big oceans of the world except the very cold Arctic Ocean. Some sea turtles swim from one ocean to another. Sea turtles have been on Earth for a very long time, even longer than snakes or crocodiles. There are seven kinds of sea turtles. The biggest one is called the leatherback sea turtle. It can be as long as a tall grown-up and weigh as much as a small car. Most other sea turtles are smaller, about as long as a big dog. One kind, the flatback turtle, only lives near the coast of Australia.
Grenada\n\nGrenada is a small island country in the warm Caribbean Sea. Its capital city is St. George's. Long ago, people from France and then the United Kingdom lived there. In 1974, Grenada became its own country. It is called the Spice Island because it grows a spice called nutmeg. A big storm named Ivan hurt the island in 2004. The king of the United Kingdom, Charles III, is also the king of Grenada. The people of Grenada vote for some of their leaders.
Jupiter\n\nJupiter is the biggest planet in our Solar System. It is the fifth planet from the Sun. Jupiter is made mostly of gas, so it is called a gas giant. It is so big that more than 1,300 Earths could fit inside it. Jupiter has a big red spot on its surface. That spot is a giant storm that is bigger than Earth. The storm has been going for hundreds of years. Jupiter has many bands of clouds that go around the planet. The clouds are made of ammonia. Jupiter spins very fast, once every 10 hours. That makes it look a little squished at the top and bottom. Jupiter has a thin ring around it, but it is hard to see. It also has a very strong magnetic field that is 10 times stronger than Earth's. Jupiter has many moons that go around it. The planet gives off more heat than it gets from the Sun. Jupiter was named after the king of the Roman gods.
Chengdu\n\nChengdu is a big city in China. It is the fifth largest city in the country. Chengdu is the capital of Sichuan province. The city sits on a flat plain. Chengdu is famous for giant pandas. There is a special place where people take care of baby pandas. The city is also known for its yummy food. People there like to eat hot pot and spicy food with chili peppers. They also love to drink tea in teahouses. A group called UNESCO said Chengdu has very good food.
Borneo\n\nBorneo is a very big island. It is the third biggest island in the whole world. Three different countries share this island: Indonesia, Malaysia, and a small country called Brunei. Borneo has some of the oldest rainforests on Earth. Many animals live there, like orangutans, monkeys, elephants, snakes, and parrots. Some people cut down trees in the rainforest, which is not good for the animals. Many people live on Borneo too.
Jesus\n\nJesus was a man who lived a long time ago. He was a teacher and a healer. Many people follow his words today. Jesus was born in a small town called Bethlehem. His mother was Mary. When he was born, he was placed in a box where animals eat. Shepherds and wise men came to see him. Jesus grew up and taught people to love God and love each other. He told stories to help people understand. He did amazing things like giving food to hungry people and making sick people well. Some leaders did not like what Jesus taught. They had him put on a cross to die. But his friends said he came back to life after three days. People who follow Jesus are called Christians. They celebrate his birthday on Christmas.
Civilization\n\nA civilization is a big group of people who live together in an organized way. They have rules called laws, a way to get food, and people who lead them. Most civilizations have cities, writing, and teach their children what they need to know. Long ago, the Romans had a big civilization with many people. They spoke Latin and built strong roads and buildings. Other old civilizations are the Incas and Aztecs, who had big cities and grew lots of food. Sometimes a civilization ends when another group takes over, or when people go back to a simpler way of life.
Palace of Versailles\n\nThe Palace of Versailles is a very big and fancy castle in France. A long time ago, a king named Louis XIV lived there with his family. The castle has many beautiful rooms with gold and shiny mirrors. There is also a huge garden with pretty flowers and fountains. Many people visit Versailles to see how kings and queens used to live.
Air conditioner\n\nAn air conditioner is a machine that makes a room cooler. It takes warm air inside and blows out cool air instead. Many homes and cars have air conditioners. They help people feel comfortable when it is very hot outside. The machine uses a special liquid that gets cold and takes the heat away. Some air conditioners are big and sit on the ground, and some are small and fit in a window. They can also help people who have trouble breathing in hot weather. But if an air conditioner is not cleaned, it can make people sick. So it is important to keep it clean.
Set\n\nA set is an idea from math. Think of a set like a bag. You can put things in the bag, and those things are called members. A set cannot have the same thing more than once. The order of things in the bag does not matter. A set can be empty, like an empty bag. That is called the empty set. You can compare two sets. If they have the same things, they are the same set. You can also count how many things are in a set. That is called the size of the set. Some sets are very big and go on forever. Those are called infinite sets. You can also take parts of a set. A part of a set is called a subset. You can combine sets in different ways. The intersection is the things that are in both sets. The union is all the things from both sets together. The complement is the things not in a set. People draw sets with circles called Venn diagrams.
Strait\n\nA strait is a narrow path of water between two pieces of land. It connects two big bodies of water, like two seas. Big boats use straits to travel from one sea to another. Some straits are very important for ships. People have fought wars to control them. A strait is not a river because the water does not flow just one way.
Naval mine\n\nA naval mine is a bomb that sits in the water. It waits for a ship or a submarine to touch it, and then it blows up. People put mines in the water to stop enemy ships from going where they want. Some mines are cheap, and some are very fancy and cost a lot of money. Countries have to tell other people when they put mines in the water, so that boats can stay away.
Watercolour\n\nWatercolour is a kind of painting that uses special colors mixed with water. You dip a brush in water and then in the color, and then you paint on paper. The colors spread and mix in pretty ways. When the water dries, the color stays on the paper. People have been making watercolour paintings for a very long time, first in China and then in Japan.
Pen\n\nA pen is a tool for writing or drawing. It puts ink on paper. Long ago, people made pens from reeds that grew by the Nile River. They also made pens from bird feathers, like goose feathers. You had to dip those pens in ink every few words. Today, some pens hold ink inside so you can write many pages without dipping. A ballpoint pen has a tiny ball that rolls the ink onto the paper. There are also pens that work on computer screens. Even though computers are common, writing with a pen can show someone you care.
Water buffalo\n\nA water buffalo is a big animal that looks like a cow. It lives in Asia, South America, and Southern Europe. People keep water buffaloes for their milk, which is very creamy and makes cheese like mozzarella. They also help people by pulling plows and carrying things. Water buffaloes have big horns and like to eat grass near water. A baby water buffalo is called a calf. Wild water buffaloes are rare and live only in a few safe places in India, Nepal, Bhutan, and Thailand.
Freedom of religion\n\nFreedom of religion means you can choose what you believe about God or not believe at all. No one can make you follow a religion you do not want. In the United States, the law says the government cannot pick one religion for everyone. You can go to a church, a temple, or stay home, and that is okay. People from different religions should be nice to each other.
Central America\n\nCentral America is a part of the world that connects North America and South America. It is a long, thin strip of land with many countries. The countries in Central America are Guatemala, Belize, Honduras, El Salvador, Nicaragua, Costa Rica, and Panama. Most people there speak Spanish, but in Belize they speak English. Central America has tall mountains, valleys, and volcanoes. Sometimes the ground shakes, and sometimes volcanoes shoot out hot ash. Many different kinds of animals and plants live there because it is warm and green.
Pollen\n\nPollen is a tiny powder made by flowers. It helps flowers make seeds so new flowers can grow. The powder is very light and can float in the wind. Sometimes bees and other bugs carry pollen from one flower to another. When a bee lands on a flower to drink sweet juice called nectar, pollen sticks to its body. Then the bee flies to another flower, and the pollen rubs off. That is how flowers get the pollen they need. Some flowers even pop open when you touch them and throw their pollen out.
Narcissus (genus)\n\nA narcissus is a flower that grows from a bulb in the ground. It is also called a daffodil. The flower has bright petals and a darker middle part that looks like a trumpet. Most narcissus flowers are yellow, but some are white or peach. The leaves are long and thin and a little bit gray. In winter, the flower part dies, but the bulb stays safe under the soil until spring.
Conservatism\n\nConservatism is a way of thinking about how people should live together. People who like conservatism want to keep old ways of doing things. They think traditions are important. Some people want things to stay the same as they are now. Other people want to go back to how things were a long time ago. In different countries, conservatives have different ideas. In the United States, many conservatives are in the Republican Party. They do not want the government to be too big. They trust business people to decide how much things cost. In England, conservatives want rich and poor people to help each other. They also like democracy and some help from the government for people who need it.
Dingo\n\nA dingo is a wild dog from Australia. It has yellow-ginger fur, but can also be tan, black, white, or sandy. Dingos are about as long as a big dog and weigh as much as a heavy backpack. They live in small groups called packs, with a mom and dad as the leaders. Baby dingos are called cubs. Dingos do not bark like pet dogs, but they howl. They eat meat like kangaroos, rabbits, and lizards. Some people keep dingos as pets, but farmers do not like them because they eat farm animals. Dingos can be dangerous and have hurt people.
Shyness\n\nShyness is a feeling you get when you are around other people and feel a little scared or not sure what to do. It can happen when you are in a new place or doing something new. You might feel like you want to hide or be very quiet. This feeling is the opposite of feeling brave and sure of yourself. Sometimes shyness makes you worry that others will laugh at you or not like you. But many people feel shy sometimes, and that is okay.
Hathor\n\nHathor was an Egyptian goddess. She was a cow goddess and people thought she was the daughter of Ra. She was the goddess of love, beauty, dancing, and music. In pictures, she had a cow head with two horns. She wore a special heavy necklace called a menat. Sometimes she looked like a cow or a lion. Her temple is in Dendera, Egypt. People went there to pray for good wealth. Hathor could make people feel happy and joyful. If she was far away, people felt sad.
Gulf of Alaska\n\nThe Gulf of Alaska is a big part of the ocean next to Alaska. It touches the coast of Alaska, with forests, mountains, and big icy rivers called glaciers. Some glaciers go all the way to the water. There are also big bays like Cook Inlet and Prince William Sound. One bay, Lituya Bay, had the biggest wave ever.
England\n\nEngland is a country on the island of Great Britain. It is part of the United Kingdom. Many people live there, more than 57 million. The biggest city is London, and it is also the capital. Other big cities are Birmingham, Liverpool, Manchester, and Leeds. The English flag is white with a red cross. That cross is for Saint George. A red rose and three lions are also symbols of England. England has a long history with kings and queens. Long ago, people built Stonehenge with big stones. The River Thames flows through London. The Channel Tunnel goes under the sea to France.
Shanghai\n\nShanghai is the biggest city in China. It is very big and has many people. The name Shanghai means "on the sea" because it used to be next to the ocean. Long ago, Shanghai was a small fishing village. People used bamboo traps to catch fish and crabs. Today, Shanghai has tall towers, parks, and a Disneyland. Many people visit Shanghai to see the big buildings and the river.
Magnetism\n\nMagnetism is a force that can pull or push things. Some things, like a fridge magnet, have a special power to pull metal objects that have iron in them. This is called a magnet. Magnets have two ends, called poles. One end is north, and the other is south. If you put two north poles together, they push away. If you put a north pole near a south pole, they pull together and stick. Magnets have an invisible space around them called a magnetic field. Things inside this field get pulled to the magnet. You can make a magnet by rubbing a piece of iron with another magnet. Some magnets only work when electricity runs through them. These are called electromagnets. They are used in computers, TVs, radios, and doorbells. The Earth itself is a big magnet. It has a North Magnetic Pole and a South Magnetic Pole. A compass uses the Earth's magnetism to show which way is north.
Macadamia nut\n\nA macadamia nut is a food that comes from a tree. The tree first grew in Australia. It stays green all year and has small white flowers. The nut has a hard shell around it. Inside, the soft part is creamy white or a little yellow. Many people like the taste. People eat macadamia nuts after cooking them. They also put them in cookies, cakes, and candies. But macadamia nuts are bad for dogs. If a dog eats one, it can get sick.
Camel\n\nA camel is a big animal that lives in the desert where it is very hot and dry. Camels have one or two humps on their back. The hump stores fat that the camel can use for energy when there is no food or water. Camels have long legs and big feet that help them walk on soft sand. They have thick fur to keep them cool in the day and warm at night. Their long eyelashes and bushy eyebrows keep sand out of their eyes. Camels can go a long time without drinking water. People ride camels and use them to carry heavy things. Baby camels are called calves and can run just a few hours after they are born.
Drinking water\n\nDrinking water is water that is safe to drink. Water from rivers, lakes, or underground can have tiny germs that make you sick. To make it safe, people clean the water by filtering it through sand and adding a special chemical to kill the germs. People need water every day to stay healthy. In many places, water from the tap is safe to drink. Water is also used for washing, flushing toilets, and watering plants.
Hybrid\n\nA hybrid is something that comes from two different kinds of parents. For example, a mule is a hybrid animal. Its mother is a horse and its father is a donkey. Many garden flowers and food plants are also hybrids. Some hybrids can have babies, but others cannot.
Spacecraft\n\nA spacecraft is a machine that can fly into space. It can carry people or things to other planets or to the moon. Most spacecraft use rockets that shoot hot gas to push them up. Spacecraft are very expensive to build and launch. Some spacecraft have people inside, and those people are called astronauts. Other spacecraft are satellites that go around the Earth. Satellites help us watch TV, check the weather, and take pictures of our planet.
Botfly\n\nA botfly is a kind of fly. The baby botflies grow inside the body of animals like cows or horses. That can hurt the animal. The fly lays eggs on the animal's skin. When the eggs hatch, the little worms go inside the animal's body. Some worms grow in the animal's flesh, and some grow in its tummy.
Optical illusion\n\nAn optical illusion is a picture that looks different from what is really there. Your eyes see the picture, but your brain gets tricked. Sometimes lines look bent when they are straight. Sometimes colors look different than they really are. Your brain tries to guess what you are seeing, and sometimes the guess is wrong. That is why you see an optical illusion. It is like a fun puzzle for your eyes and brain.
Spoon\n\nA spoon is a tool you use for eating. It helps you eat foods like soup, yogurt, and ice cream. You can also use a spoon to stir things. There are many kinds of spoons, like big ones for soup and small ones for tea. Some people collect spoons. A few musicians even play spoons like a musical instrument. People have used spoons for a very long time, starting with shells or pieces of wood.
Bhutan\n\nBhutan is a small country high up in the Himalaya mountains. It is ruled by a king. The capital city is Thimphu. About 700,000 people live there. Most people in Bhutan are Buddhist. The country was closed to visitors until 1974. Now people can visit, but only a few at a time. Bhutan is special because it is the only country in the world that does not make the air dirty. The national sport is archery, where people shoot arrows at a target. People also like to play cricket and football.
Korean language\n\nKorean is a language spoken by many people in North Korea and South Korea. More than 78 million people speak it. In South Korea, people call it "hangukmal" or "hangugeo." In North Korea, they call it "choseonmal" or "choseoneo." Koreans also call their language "urimal," which means "our language." Korean has its own special alphabet called Hangul. A long time ago, a king named Sejong the Great helped make Hangul so that more people could learn to read and write. Before Hangul, people used Chinese characters called Hanja. Today, most writing in Korea uses Hangul, but some newspapers still use Hanja.
Balkan Mountains\n\nThe Balkan Mountains are a long chain of very tall hills in Europe. They go through two countries called Serbia and Bulgaria. The mountains are so high that snow stays on top even in summer. People who live near these mountains are called Balkandjii. The highest point in the Balkan Mountains is Botev peak. It is very high, and you can see far away from the top. Some roads go over the mountains so cars can cross from one side to the other.
Greenland ice sheet\n\nThe Greenland ice sheet is a very big, thick layer of ice that covers most of the island of Greenland. It is the second biggest ice sheet in the world, after the one in Antarctica. The ice is more than two kilometers thick in many places, and it has been there for a very long time, about 110,000 years. The ice is so heavy that it pushes the ground down. Some scientists think that if the Earth gets warmer, the ice might melt and make the ocean rise, which could flood many cities near the coast. But other scientists are not sure because the weather in Greenland has not changed much.
Melting\n\nMelting is when something hard turns into something wet. Ice melts into water when it gets warm. The sun can melt ice on a cold day. When you heat a solid, it gets soft and turns into a liquid. Ice melts faster in warm water than in cold water.
Cartography\n\nCartography is making maps. Maps show where things are, like streets, rivers, or mountains. Long ago, people drew maps by hand with a pen. Now, most maps are made on a computer. Someone who makes maps is called a cartographer. Anyone can draw a simple map, but cartographers learn how to make maps that are very neat and correct. You might see maps on a phone or a computer screen.
Neuron\n\nA neuron is a tiny cell inside your body that sends messages. Your brain has billions of neurons. They talk to each other through small gaps. Some neurons tell your muscles to move. Others tell your brain what you see, hear, or feel. Neurons do not grow new ones when you are grown up, but they are very busy every day.
Americas\n\nThe Americas are big lands on the other side of the world. They are made of two big parts: North America and South America. There are also many islands near them. A long time ago, people from Europe came to the Americas on ships. They found new places and met people who already lived there. Some of those people had big cities and strong rulers. Later, many countries in the Americas became their own countries, like the United States. Today, people in the Americas speak many different languages and have many different ways of life.
Sea level\n\nSea level is how high the ocean water is. It is the average height of the sea. The sea goes up and down with the tides, so we use an average. Mountains and land are measured from sea level. Sea level can change over time. Right now, the sea is getting a little higher because the Earth is getting warmer. This can make water come onto land near the ocean.
Centipede\n\nA centipede is a small bug with many legs. It hunts at night and eats other bugs like cockroaches and flies. Some centipedes have poison, but they cannot hurt people badly. A centipede has a long body with many parts, and each part has one pair of legs. Some centipedes have only 5 legs, and some have many more. There are many kinds of centipedes all over the world.
Poison\n\nPoison is something that can make you very sick or even die if you eat it, drink it, or get it on your skin. Some poisons come from plants, like certain mushrooms. Other poisons are made by people. A little bit of poison can hurt you a lot. Sometimes, a doctor can give you a special medicine called an antidote to stop the poison from hurting you. Some animals, like snakes and bees, have poison in their bite or sting. That kind of poison is called venom. You should never eat or touch something if you do not know what it is, because it might be poison.
Manchester\n\nManchester is a big city in England. It is in the north-west part of the country. Many people live there. Manchester has two famous football teams: Manchester United and Manchester City. The city has a big airport where planes fly to many places around the world. There are also trains and trams that help people get around. Manchester has lots of old red brick buildings. Some of them used to be cotton mills where cloth was made. The city has two big universities with many students. Manchester is also known for its music. Bands like The Smiths and Joy Division came from there. In the city, there is a big park called Heaton Park where people can see animals and enjoy nature.
Time\n\nTime is how we know when things happen. It goes from the past, through now, and into the future. We can measure time by watching the sun rise and set each day. Long ago, people used the sun's shadow to tell time. Today, clocks help us know the time. A clock can show seconds, minutes, and hours. Time helps us know when to wake up, eat, and play.
Academic art\n\nAcademic art is a way of painting and making art that was popular a long time ago. Art schools made rules about what a good picture should look like. Artists tried to make their art look very real, like a true copy of something in the world. They often painted stories from old myths. This kind of art was taught at a famous school in Paris. Later, new ways of painting became popular, and academic art was not used as much.
Antarctic Circle\n\nThe Antarctic Circle is a pretend line around the bottom of the Earth. It is very, very cold there. In December, the sun shines all day and all night for a whole day. In June, it is dark all day and all night for a whole day. No one lives there all the time, but some scientists stay for a while to study the cold. Antarctica is the big land inside the circle, and it is one of the coldest places on Earth.
Oxygen\n\nOxygen is a gas you cannot see, smell, or taste. It is part of the air we breathe. About one-fifth of the air around us is oxygen. Plants make oxygen when they use sunlight to make food. People and animals need oxygen to live. When you breathe in, your body takes oxygen from the air. Oxygen helps things burn, but it does not burn by itself. It is also in water, rocks, and soil. Doctors give extra oxygen to people who have trouble breathing. Oxygen is stored in tanks for astronauts in space and divers underwater.
Kalahari Desert\n\nThe Kalahari Desert is a big sandy place in southern Africa. It covers parts of Botswana, Namibia, and South Africa. Even though it is called a desert, it gets a little rain, so some plants and animals live there. You can find grasses, acacia trees, and even wild watermelons. Animals like lions, giraffes, meerkats, and cheetahs live in the Kalahari. There are also special parks where the animals are protected. Long ago, people called Bushmen lived in the Kalahari. They moved from place to place to find food and water. They did not keep animals and carried only what they needed.
Basil\n\nBasil is a green plant that people use in cooking. It has light green, soft leaves that grow opposite each other. The plant can grow as tall as a small table. Basil smells sweet and strong, a little like licorice. People put fresh basil on pizza, in pasta, and in salads. It tastes best when you add it at the very end of cooking. Basil likes hot, sunny weather and does not like cold. You can grow basil in a pot on a sunny windowsill. If you pick the leaves often, the plant will grow more leaves. Some people also use basil seeds in drinks and desserts.
Ruby\n\nA ruby is a pretty stone that people like to wear as jewelry. It is usually red, but sometimes it can be other colors too. Rubies are made from a mix of aluminum and oxygen, and a tiny bit of another thing called chromium gives them their red color. Many people think rubies are special for the month of July.
Millet\n\nMillet is a tiny grain that people can eat. It is like a small seed. There are many kinds of millet. Millet is good for you because it has things your body needs. But it is hard for your body to break down, so some people do not like to eat it.
Rama\n\nRama is a very special person in a religion called Hinduism. He is a hero in an old story called the Ramayana. Rama was a prince who lived in a place called Ayodhya. He had a wife named Sita and a brother named Lakshmana. A bad king named Ravana took Sita away. Rama and Lakshmana went on a long trip to save her. They fought many fights and finally saved Sita. Rama is kind, brave, and good. Many people love Rama and tell his story even today.
Braslia\n\nBrasília is the capital city of Brazil. It is the city where the country's leaders work. From above, the city looks like an airplane or a butterfly. There are big roads and a large lake called Lake Parano. The city was built a long time ago, starting in 1956. Many people helped build it. Today, many people live there. There is a subway and an airport to help people travel.
Frankenstein\n\nFrankenstein is a story about a man who makes a monster. The man's name is Victor Frankenstein. He is a scientist. He puts together parts from dead bodies. Then he uses a big storm to make the monster come alive. The monster is big and scary. Victor gets very scared and runs away. The monster feels sad because no one wants to be his friend. He asks Victor to make him a wife monster. Victor says no. They chase each other all the way to a cold, icy place. Victor dies there. The monster goes away into the fog and is never seen again.
Musician\n\nA musician is a person who makes music. They can play an instrument like a guitar or a piano. Some musicians sing songs with their voice. Other musicians write new songs for people to play. Sometimes musicians get together in a group and play music for others to hear.
Whale shark\n\nA whale shark is the biggest fish in the ocean. It can be as long as a big bus and weigh as much as many cars. Whale sharks have a huge mouth that they use to eat tiny sea animals like plankton and krill. They are gray or blue with white spots and stripes, like a checkerboard. Whale sharks live in warm seas all over the world. They are gentle and not scary. People like to swim near them to see how big they are.
Witchcraft\n\nWitchcraft is when people try to use magic. A person who does witchcraft is called a witch. Witches might use plants to make medicine or to help people. Some witches use special things like candles, sticks, or a big pot called a cauldron. Long ago, people thought witches could make bad things happen. They blamed witches when someone got sick or crops did not grow. Today, some people still believe in witchcraft, and others practice a kind called Wicca that is peaceful. In different parts of the world, people have different ideas about witches.
Plant breeding\n\nPlant breeding is when people help plants grow better. For a very long time, farmers have picked the best plants to save seeds from. They choose plants that give more food or that bugs do not like. Now scientists also help by learning how plants grow. This way we can have more fruits and vegetables to eat.
Restaurant\n\nA restaurant is a place where you can go to eat food that someone else cooks for you. You sit down at a table and order from a list called a menu. Some restaurants are fast food places like McDonald's, where you get your food quickly and it does not cost a lot of money. At some fast food places, you can even stay in your car and get your food from a window. Other restaurants are fancier and have nicer food. Long ago, in ancient Greece and Rome, there were small places where people could buy food and drinks because many homes did not have kitchens.
Bridge\n\nA bridge is a thing you build to go over a river, a deep hole, or a road. People have walked on bridges for a very long time. Big bridges today let cars and trucks drive over water or other roads. Some bridges are made of stone and can last for thousands of years. Newer bridges are often made of steel. There are also special bridges that soldiers can move from place to place.
Wonders of the World\n\nWonders of the World are very special and famous buildings or places. A long time ago, people made a list of seven great buildings from old times. These were called the Seven Wonders of the Ancient World. Most of them were built by the Greeks. Today, only one of those old wonders is still standing: the Great Pyramid. People also made new lists of wonders, like the Seven Wonders of the Modern World and the Seven Natural Wonders of the World. Some lists were chosen by voting on the internet. Many people like to visit these amazing places.
Kuwait\n\nKuwait is a small country in the Middle East. It is very hot and dry there, so not much food can grow. Kuwait has a lot of oil under the ground. The country sells this oil to make money. Many people from other countries live and work in Kuwait. The people there speak Arabic and English. In 1990, another country called Iraq came to fight in Kuwait. That started a war. Most people in Kuwait follow the religion of Islam.
Loudspeaker\n\nA loudspeaker is a thing that makes sound. You find it in radios, TVs, and music players. Inside, there is a paper cone, a wire coil, and a magnet. When electricity goes through the wire, it moves back and forth. This makes the paper cone shake and create sound. Some loudspeakers make low sounds, like a big drum. Others make high sounds, like a bird singing. Alexander Graham Bell made the first loudspeaker a long time ago.
Honey\n\nHoney is a sweet food made by honeybees. Bees collect nectar from flowers and turn it into honey. They store the honey in a honeycomb. Honey is very sweet and can be used instead of sugar. It comes in different colors and tastes, depending on which flowers the bees used. Some honey is light and some is dark. Honey does not go bad, even after a very long time. People have found honey in old jars from ancient Egypt that is still good to eat. Honey is thick and sticky. You can eat it on bread or in tea.
Pound sterling\n\nThe pound sterling is the money used in the United Kingdom. People also use it in some other places like the Isle of Man and Guernsey. One pound is the same as 100 pence. There are coins for 1 penny, 2 pence, 5 pence, 10 pence, 20 pence, 50 pence, 1 pound, and 2 pounds. There are paper notes for 5, 10, 20, and 50 pounds. Long ago, one pound was made of real silver. The symbol for pound looks like an L. The symbol for pence is p. Before 1971, the pound was split into 20 shillings, and each shilling was 12 pennies. That was a lot of numbers to remember! Now it is easier because one pound is just 100 pence.
Western Europe\n\nWestern Europe is a part of the world that has many countries. Some of these countries are Spain, the United Kingdom, and Norway. The land has long coastlines where the water meets the land. Many people there share the same way of life and work together with countries far away. Some countries in Western Europe are also part of a big group called the European Union.
Grasshopper\n\nA grasshopper is an insect with long, strong back legs that help it jump very far. It lives in places with lots of grass, like fields, gardens, and meadows. Grasshoppers eat grass, leaves, and plants. Some grasshoppers can change color when there are many of them together, and then they are called locusts. People in some parts of the world eat grasshoppers as food because they are good for you.
Control of fire by early humans\n\nLong, long ago, people learned how to make fire. This was a very big step for them. Fire gave them warmth and light. It kept them safe from wild animals and bugs.
Blindness\n\nBlindness is when a person cannot see anything. Some people who are blind can see a little bit, like blurry shapes or colors. People can be blind from birth, or they can become blind from sickness or an accident. Blind people use special tools to help them, like a book with bumps they can feel with their fingers, called braille. Some blind people have a helper dog that shows them where to go. Many blind people wear sunglasses to protect their eyes. There are famous blind people like Helen Keller and Stevie Wonder.
Automotive industry\n\nThe automotive industry is about making cars and other vehicles that drive on roads. It is a very big business that makes a lot of money. Long ago, cars were called "horseless carriages" because they did not need horses. The Ford Model T was a car that many people could buy for not much money. At first, most cars were made in the United States. Later, Japan made many cars too. Now, China makes more cars than any other country.
Platypus\n\nA platypus is a small animal that lives in Australia. It has a brown furry body and a wide flat tail like a beaver. Its nose is big and rubbery, like a duck's bill. Platypuses live in rivers and river banks. They are very good swimmers and have webbed feet to help them paddle. They sleep during the day and come out at night to find food. They eat worms, insects, and small shrimp from the bottom of the river. The male platypus has a sharp spike on its back ankles that can give a painful sting. Platypuses are special because they lay eggs, like birds, but they also make milk for their babies. The mother makes a nest in a long tunnel in the river bank and lays her eggs there. When the babies hatch, they drink milk from the mother's skin. After four months, the babies can take care of themselves.
Ceramic\n\nCeramic is a hard material that people make by heating clay or other special powders in a very hot oven. People have been making ceramics for a long time. They use their hands or a spinning wheel to shape the soft clay into bowls, plates, cups, and tiles. After shaping, the clay is baked until it becomes hard and strong. Some ceramics are smooth and shiny, like the tiles in a bathroom. Others are rough and have tiny holes. Ceramics can break easily if you drop them because they are brittle. You can find ceramics in many places, like in your kitchen in the form of plates and mugs, or in the walls of a house as bricks and tiles.
Drum\n\nA drum is a musical instrument that you hit to make a sound. You can hit it with your hands or with a special stick called a drum stick. Drums help keep a steady beat in a song. They can make music feel fast or slow. A group of drums and cymbals is called a drum kit. Drum kits are used in rock, jazz, country, and many other kinds of music. Some drums are acoustic, which means they make sound when you hit them. Other drums are electric, which make sound through a speaker or headphones. Electric drums are good for practicing quietly.
Orbit\n\nAn orbit is the path something takes in space when it goes around a bigger thing, like a star or a planet. The Earth goes around the Sun in an orbit. The Moon goes around the Earth in an orbit too. A long time ago, people thought the Sun went around the Earth, but now we know the Earth goes around the Sun. Gravity is what keeps things in their orbit. Some orbits are shaped like a circle, and some are shaped like a flattened circle, which is called an ellipse. The time it takes to go all the way around is called the orbital period. For Earth, that is one year.
Job\n\nA job is work that people do to get money. Some jobs are at home, like washing dishes or fixing things. Other jobs are for an employer who pays you. A teacher's job is to help children learn. A firefighter's job is to put out fires and save people. A taxi driver's job is to drive people around. Some jobs pay only a little money. A group called the International Labour Organization helps make jobs better for everyone.
Year\n\nA year is a long time that takes about 365 days. It is how long the Earth takes to go all the way around the sun. A year starts on January 1 and ends on December 31. Sometimes a year has 366 days, and that is called a leap year. A school year can start and end on different days.
Religion\n\nReligion is what people believe about God, the world, and how to live. Different religions have different ideas. Some people believe in one God. Some believe in many gods. Some believe in spirits. Many religions teach that people have a soul that lives on after the body dies. Religions have special days and ways of doing things, like praying or celebrating. People often go to a special building, like a church, to worship. The biggest religions are Christianity, Islam, Hinduism, Buddhism, and Judaism. People who do not believe in any god are called atheists.
Greeting\n\nA greeting is something you say or do when you meet someone. You can say "Hello" or "Hi" to start talking. You can also wave your hand or smile to say hello without words. Different people around the world greet in different ways.
Lake District\n\nThe Lake District is a place in England with many lakes and mountains. People go there on vacation to see the water and the hills. There are big lakes like Windermere and small ones called tarns. The land is very high in some spots, and it is one of the few places in England with tall mountains. The Lake District is also known for a poet named William Wordsworth who wrote about the beautiful nature there.
Meat\n\nMeat is the part of an animal that people eat. It comes from cows, pigs, sheep, chickens, and other animals. Meat helps your body grow strong because it has lots of protein. Some meat is red, like beef from cows, and some is white, like chicken. People cook meat before they eat it to make it safe and tasty. Some people choose not to eat meat, and they are called vegetarians.
Shiitake\n\nA shiitake is a kind of mushroom that people can eat. It is also called a black mushroom. It grows on trees like oak. Some shiitake mushrooms have cracks on top that look like flowers. They like cool weather to grow.
Italian literature\n\nItalian literature is made up of books and poems written in the Italian language. People in Italy started writing books in Italian a long time ago, around the 12th century. One of the most famous Italian writers is Dante Alighieri, who wrote a long poem called "The Divine Comedy." Another important writer is Alessandro Manzoni, who wrote a story called "The Betrothed." Many Italian writers have won a big prize called the Nobel Prize for their stories and poems.
History of the universe\n\nThe history of the universe is the story of everything that exists. It started a very long time ago with a big bang, like a giant explosion. At first, everything was packed together very tightly, and then it spread out fast. The universe is still getting bigger today. After the big bang, tiny pieces called atoms started to form. Atoms are what everything you can touch is made of. The first atoms were hydrogen and helium. They made big clouds of gas. Gravity pulled the gas together to make stars and galaxies. Some dust and gas also made planets, like our Earth. Earth formed about 4 billion years ago. Life on Earth started soon after, but people came much later. The universe will keep expanding for a very, very long time. Someday, it might end, but that will not happen for a super long time.
Mushroom\n\nA mushroom is a kind of food that grows in the ground. It is not a plant because it does not need sunlight to grow. Most mushrooms have a stem and a round top called a cap. Under the cap, there are little lines called gills that hold tiny seeds called spores. Some mushrooms are safe to eat and people cook them in soups and on pizza. But some mushrooms are poisonous and can make you very sick if you eat them. Mushrooms come in many colors and shapes. Some are white, some are brown, and some are even red.
Factory\n\nA factory is a big building where people use machines to make many things to sell. Before factories, people made things one by one at home or in small shops. Factories can make things very fast, like toys, cars, and clothes. Long ago, factories had bad working conditions. People worked long hours for little money. Sometimes children worked there too. Now, some factories use machines that work without people. Factories can also make the air dirty with smoke. Many people work in factories to make the things we use every day.
Hmong people\n\nHmong people are a group of people who first lived in China, near big rivers. Long ago, some Hmong people moved to other countries in Asia like Vietnam, Laos, Thailand, and Myanmar. Later, many Hmong people moved to the United States, Australia, France, and Canada. Today, Hmong people live in many places around the world. They have their own language and traditions. Some Hmong people are called White Hmong or Green Hmong.
Food preservation\n\nFood preservation is how we keep food from going bad. Food can get yucky if tiny germs get on it. A long time ago, people learned to dry food in the sun, like fish or meat. They also used salt to keep food fresh. Today, we still do some of the same things. We can put food in a jar with vinegar to make pickles. We can cook fruit with lots of sugar to make jam. We can also smoke meat over a fire to make it last longer. These ways help us save food to eat later.
Animal welfare\n\nAnimal welfare is about taking good care of animals. It means making sure animals have enough food, clean water, and a safe place to live. People who care about animal welfare want animals to be happy and healthy. This includes pets at home, animals on farms, and animals in zoos. It also means being kind to wild animals and not hurting them.
Jupiter (mythology)\n\nJupiter is the king of the gods in old Roman stories. He was the god of the sky and thunder. His brothers were Neptune and Pluto, and his sister was Ceres. When Jupiter was a baby, his father Saturn tried to eat him, but his mother hid him away. When Jupiter grew up, he made Saturn throw up his brothers and sisters. Then Jupiter and his brothers and sisters fought and beat Saturn and the other Titans. After that, Jupiter and his brothers split up the world. Jupiter got the sky, Neptune got the sea, and Pluto got the underworld. That is how Jupiter became the king of all the gods.
Predation\n\nPredation is when one animal hunts and eats another animal. The animal that does the hunting is called a predator. The animal that gets eaten is called prey. Predators like lions, sharks, and eagles catch other animals for food. Some predators hide and wait for their prey to come close. Others chase their prey very fast. Predators mostly eat meat.
Tulip\n\nA tulip is a flower that grows from a bulb in the ground. Tulips come in many colors like red, yellow, pink, and purple. They grow in gardens and parks. People like to plant them in pots too. Tulips grow in Europe, Africa, and Asia. They are the national flower of Afghanistan. Many people think of Holland when they see tulips.
Euro\n\nThe euro is a kind of money that many countries in Europe use together. One euro is made of 100 smaller pieces called cents. The euro comes in paper bills and metal coins. The bills are different colors and sizes, like a 5 euro bill that is gray and a 10 euro bill that is red. The coins have one side that looks the same in every country, and the other side has a special picture for each country. People can use the same euro money in all the countries that share it, like France, Germany, and Spain. The euro has a special sign that looks like a letter E with two lines across it.
Delhi\n\nDelhi is a big city in India. It is the place where the country's capital, New Delhi, is. Many people live there. The Yamuna River flows through Delhi. There are old buildings and monuments that tell stories from long ago. One famous monument is the India Gate, which is a war memorial. Delhi has a lot of air pollution, which can make it hard to breathe.
Nanjing\n\nNanjing is a big city in eastern China. It has many, many people living there. The name Nanjing means "The Southern Capital" in Chinese. A long time ago, a ruler named Yongle Emperor moved most of his government to Beijing, which means "The Northern Capital." Today, people spell the city's name as Nanjing. Nanjing has 11 parts called districts and is friends with 18 other cities around the world.
Fiji\n\nFiji is a country made of many islands in the big Pacific Ocean. It has 322 islands, and the biggest ones are Vanua Levu and Viti Levu. The main city is Suva, where many people live. About 844,330 people live in Fiji. People there speak Fijian, English, and Hindi. Fiji has lots of forests, fish, and pretty coral reefs. Many visitors come from Australia, New Zealand, and the USA to swim and dive in the warm water.
Japanese art\n\nJapanese art is the art made by people in Japan. It includes many kinds of art like painting with ink, making pottery, folding paper into shapes called origami, and writing beautifully with a brush. In Japan today, art also includes comic books called manga and cartoons called anime.
Trinidad and Tobago\n\nTrinidad and Tobago is a country in the warm Caribbean Sea. It is made of two big islands and many small ones. The capital city is Port-of-Spain. Many different kinds of people live there, like people whose families came from Africa, Europe, India, and China a long time ago. Some people believe in Christianity, and some believe in Hinduism. The country has gas under the ground and under the sea that helps make heat and run machines. People from far away visit the islands to take pictures and have fun. The people there are famous for making music and playing sports like football and cricket.
Galago\n\nA galago is a small animal that lives in trees in Africa. It is also called a bushbaby. Galagos come out at night to look for food. They have big eyes to see in the dark. They can jump very far from branch to branch. Galagos eat bugs like grasshoppers, and also eat fruit, seeds, and flowers. Some galagos use their teeth to get gum from tree bark.
Gravity\n\nGravity is a force that pulls things together. It is why things fall down to the ground. The Earth has gravity, so it pulls you, your toys, and everything else toward it. The Moon has less gravity than Earth, so you would feel lighter there. Gravity also keeps the Earth going around the Sun. Without gravity, everything would float away.
Olympic Games\n\nThe Olympic Games are a big sports party where people from all over the world come to play games and show how fast, strong, and good they are. There are Summer Games and Winter Games, and they happen every four years. The first Olympic Games were a long, long time ago in a place called Greece. People ran races, wrestled, and did other sports. Today, athletes from many countries compete for gold, silver, and bronze medals. The Olympic flag has five rings that stand for the different parts of the world. A torch is lit and carried to the city where the games will be held. The games start with a big opening show and end with a closing party.
